narrative_text: B737-300 L-1 windscreen was replaced after it shattered in flight; sealer was applied in cold ambient conditions (approx 40F) and the aircraft was released with speed tape deferred over the uncured sealer per MEL. On the subsequent ferry departure from PDX, the speed tape came loose and wet sealer blew out at the upper left corner of the L-1 window during climb, causing an air leak at altitude; crew returned to PDX uneventfully. Window was retorqued and resealed with fresh protective tape and returned to service; next crew should confirm sealer cure time before further dispatch and monitor L-1 window integrity on next flights.
summary: L-1 windscreen replacement sealer failed to cure properly in cold weather, causing a minor in-flight air leak that required aircraft return and reseal.

narrative_text: Dirisha la L-1 la ndege ya B737-300 lilibadilishwa baada ya kupasuka wakati wa safari; sealer iliwekwa wakati wa hali ya baridi (nyuzi joto 40F hivi) na ndege ikaruhusiwa kuendelea na safari huku speed tape ikiwekwa juu ya sealer ambayo haikuwa imekauka kikamilifu, kama ilivyoruhusiwa na taratibu za matengenezo. Wakati wa safari ya kurudisha ndege PDX, speed tape ililegea na sealer mbichi ikatoka kwenye kona ya juu kushoto ya dirisha la L-1, na kusababisha uvujaji wa hewa angani; wafanyakazi walirudisha ndege PDX salama. Dirisha lilikaziwa tena na kufunikwa na tepi mpya ya kinga kisha ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma; zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha muda wa kukausha kwa sealer kabla ya safari nyingine na kufuatilia hali ya dirisha la L-1.
summary: Sealer ya dirisha la L-1 haikukauka vizuri kutokana na baridi, na kusababisha uvujaji mdogo wa hewa angani uliohitaji ndege kurudi na kufanyiwa ukarabati zaidi.

entities.text: kukaziwa tena na kufunikwa na tepi mpya

narrative_text: Ile L-1 window ya B737-300 ilipasuka enroute, tukafanya replacement lakini sealer iliwekwa wakati ni baridi sana (about 40F), so tukadeferu na speed tape juu ya sealer ambayo haijakauka kabisa, kama MEL inavyoallow. Wakati ferry flight ilikuwa inatoka PDX, ile speed tape ikaloosen na wet sealer ikablow out kwenye upper left corner ya window, air ikaanza kuleak juu, crew wakarudi PDX salama. Tulikaza window tena na kuweka fresh protective tape kabla ya kuirudisha kwa service; next shift wahakikishe sealer cure time imefikiwa before dispatch na wa-monitor L-1 window kwa flights zinazofuata.
summary: Sealer ya L-1 window haikucure vizuri due to cold weather, ikasababisha air leak kidogo mid-flight na ndege ikahitaji kurudi na kufanyiwa reseal.

entities.text: kukaza window tena na kuweka fresh protective tape

narrative_text: During the RH elevator R&R on the B737-800 (lightning strike repair), the trim tab balance weights were transferred from the old assembly without verification against the AMM illustration. New elevator had 3 weights per location versus 2 on the old unit; extra weights were removed only after Inspector queried the discrepancy, but this was not fully cross-checked against the manual at time of closeout. Next shift/QA to double-confirm balance weight configuration is per AMM before any further ops checks, especially since a similar LH elevator R&R on another aircraft later revealed incorrect weights were pulled. Recommend reviewing handover communication between shifts on this task and flagging balance weight verification as a mandatory sign-off item.
summary: Balance weight configuration on a B737-800 RH elevator replacement was not properly verified between shifts, leading to a discrepancy later confirmed on a similar job on another aircraft.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuondoa na kufunga upya elevator ya kulia (RH) ya ndege ya B737-800 kutokana na kupigwa na radi, uzani wa kusawazisha (balance weights) ulihamishwa kutoka kwa assembly ya zamani bila kuthibitishwa vizuri kulingana na mchoro wa AMM. Elevator mpya ilikuwa na uzani tatu kwa kila sehemu badala ya mbili kama ya zamani, na hii ilibainika tu baada ya Inspector kuhoji tofauti hiyo, lakini uthibitisho kamili haukufanyika mapema. Shift inayokuja au timu ya ubora (QA) wanahitajika kuthibitisha tena mpangilio wa uzani huo kwa mujibu wa AMM, hasa kwa kuwa hitilafu kama hiyo ilijitokeza tena wiki moja baadaye kwenye kazi ya elevator ya kushoto (LH) ya ndege nyingine. Inashauriwa kuboresha mawasiliano ya turnover kati ya shift na kufanya uthibitisho wa uzani kuwa hatua ya lazima kabla ya kufunga panel.
summary: Uzani wa kusawazisha kwenye ukarabati wa elevator ya B737-800 haukuthibitishwa vizuri kati ya shift, jambo lililosababisha hitilafu iliyogunduliwa tena kwenye kazi nyingine baadaye.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile RH elevator R&R ya B737-800 baada ya lightning strike, tulitransfer trim tab balance weights kutoka kwa assembly ya zamani bila kuverify vizuri na AMM illustration. New elevator ilikuwa na weights tatu kila location, lakini ya zamani ilikuwa na mbili tu, so extra weights zilitolewa but ni baada ya Inspector kuquestion discrepancy hiyo, si mapema. Next shift au QA wanafaa wadouble-check balance weight configuration kulingana na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na operational checks, especially since incident kama hii ilirudia wiki moja baadaye kwenye LH elevator ya ndege nyingine. Tafadhali flag hii kwenye turnover, weight verification lazima iwe mandatory sign-off item.
summary: Balance weights za elevator ya B737-800 hazikuverifiwa properly kati ya shifts, na hitilafu ile iligunduliwa tena kwenye kazi nyingine baada ya wiki moja.

narrative_text: Heads up on the B737-700 horizontal stabilizer jackscrew/cable R/R at STA 328: two pulleys (STA and STB cables) were removed during the job but never reinstalled before panels were closed up. Day shift signed off cable tension and adjustment as OK, and the Inspector closed out the R/R and NRC cards without knowing the pulleys were missing. Please pull jobcard XXXX and the maintenance form, verify pulley installation against the maintenance manual before further flight release.
summary: Two horizontal stabilizer cable pulleys were left uninstalled after a jackscrew/cable R/R on a B737-700 and were signed off in error, requiring verification before release.

narrative_text: Kuna tatizo kwenye kazi ya kubadilisha jackscrew na cable za horizontal stabilizer kwenye ndege ya B737-700 karibu na STA 328: pulley mbili, moja ya STA na nyingine ya STB, ziliondolewa wakati wa kazi lakini hazikurudishwa kabla ya paneli kufungwa. Zamu ya mchana walithibitisha mvutano wa cable kuwa sawa, na Inspector alisaini fomu za R/R na NRC bila kujua pulley hazikuwekwa. Tafadhali angalia jobcard XXXX na fomu ya matengenezo, na hakikisha pulley zimewekwa kulingana na maelekezo ya maintenance manual kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Pulley mbili za cable za horizontal stabiliza ziliachwa bila kuwekwa baada ya kazi ya R/R kwenye B737-700, na zilisainiwa kimakosa, hivyo zinahitaji kuangaliwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege.

entities.text: jackscrew na cable za horizontal stabilizer

narrative_text: Guys, kuna issue kwenye ile horizontal stabilizer jackscrew/cable R/R kwenye B737-700 pale STA 328. Zile pulley mbili, moja ya STA cable na nyingine ya STB cable, ziliremovewa lakini hazikurudishwa before panels zikacloswa. Day shift walisema cable tension na adjustment ni OK, halafu Inspector akasign-off R/R card na NRC bila kujua kama pulley hazijawekwa. Tafadhali check jobcard XXXX na ile maintenance form, tuconfirm pulley zimeinstall properly kulingana na manual kabla ya release.
summary: Pulley mbili za horizontal stabilizer cable ziliachwa bila kuinstall kwenye B737-700 na zikasignwa off kimakosa, so inahitaji kuchekiwa kabla ya release.

narrative_text: Completed the #1 engine lube and scavenge pump replacement on the B757-200 per AMM; old pump was removed and new unit installed, then high-power oil pressure run performed with no leaks observed by the lead AMT. Two days later the #5 bearing scavenge line nut backed off, causing oil loss and an in-flight shutdown; investigation found the line had not been safety wired. Since we did not disconnect that line during the job, we were unaware it required safety wire, and the AMM does not call it out. Recommend flagging the AMM for revision to add a safety-wire step on the #5 bearing scavenge line nut before further pump replacements.
summary: Missing safety-wire step in AMM for #1 engine scavenge pump replacement led to a loose fitting and subsequent in-flight shutdown.

narrative_text: Tulimaliza kubadilisha pump ya #1 engine lube na scavenge kwenye B757-200 kulingana na AMM; pump ya zamani iliondolewa na mpya ikafungwa, kisha ukafanywa mtihani wa oil pressure kwa high power run na lead AMT akakagua bila kupata uvujaji wowote. Baada ya siku mbili, nati ya line ya scavenge ya bearing namba 5 ililegea na kusababisha upotevu wa mafuta ya engine na engine kuzimika hewani. Uchunguzi ulionyesha kuwa line hiyo haikuwa imefungwa na safety wire, jambo ambalo hatukujua kwa sababu hatukuiondoa wakati wa kazi na AMM haikutaja hilo. Inashauriwa AMM irekebishwe kuongeza hatua ya kufunga safety wire kwenye nati hiyo ili kuzuia tukio kama hili tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa hatua ya safety wire kwenye AMM kulisababisha nati kulegea na engine kuzimika hewani baada ya kubadilisha pump ya #1 engine.

entities.text: pump ya #1 engine lube na scavenge
line ya scavenge ya bearing namba 5

narrative_text: Tulichukua turnover ya #1 engine lube na scavenge pump replacement kwa B757-200, old pump ilikuwa disconnected tayari so tuli-remove na kufunga new pump kama AMM inavyosema. Tuli-perform oil pressure test na high power engine run, lead AMT aka-inspect for leaks, hakuna leaks zilizopatikana. Siku mbili baadaye nut ya #5 bearing scavenge line ika-loosen, oil ika-loss na engine ika-shutdown mid-flight; investigation imeonyesha line haikuwa safety wired na sisi hatukujua kwa sababu hatukuwa tume-remove hiyo line wakati wa job. Tafadhali flag hii AMM step kwa revision, wai-add safety wire requirement kwa hiyo #5 bearing scavenge nut kabla ya next pump job.
summary: AMM haikuwa na step ya safety wire kwa #5 bearing scavenge line, na hiyo ndio iliyosababisha nut kulegea na engine kuzimika mid-flight baada ya pump replacement.

narrative_text: Handover: Skyhawk 172 that completed its 100-hr inspection lost oil pressure in flight and ran rough; pilot shut down the engine and made an emergency landing with only minor damage to airframe and prop. Follow-up found a rag left over the oil intake during magneto removal, likely left by whoever opened the engine for the owner during inspection. Next shift must safety-wire the new oil filter already installed and complete/close out the 100-hr inspection paperwork; also flag to management that we still have no proper job-turnover log to track work in progress.
summary: A Skyhawk 172 suffered an in-flight oil-pressure loss and emergency landing after a rag was left blocking the oil intake during a 100-hr inspection, exposing gaps in the shop's work-tracking system.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya zamu: Ndege ya Skyhawk 172 iliyokamilisha ukaguzi wa saa 100 ilipoteza shinikizo la mafuta angani na injini ikaanza kufanya kazi vibaya; rubani alizima injini na kutua dharura, ndege na propela zikapata uharibifu mdogo tu. Baada ya kuchunguza, tuligundua kitambaa kilichoachwa kwenye tundu la mafuta wakati wa kuondoa magneto, inaonekana kiliachwa na yeyote aliyefungua injini kwa niaba ya mmiliki wakati wa ukaguzi. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kufunga waya wa usalama kwenye kichujio kipya cha mafuta kilichowekwa na kukamilisha karatasi za ukaguzi wa saa 100; pia tujulishe uongozi kuwa bado hatuna mfumo mzuri wa kuandika kazi zinazoendelea kwa ajili ya mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya Skyhawk 172 ilipata tatizo la shinikizo la mafuta angani na kutua dharura baada ya kitambaa kuziba tundu la mafuta wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa 100, jambo lililobainisha upungufu wa mfumo wa kufuatilia kazi.

narrative_text: Handover: ile Skyhawk 172 iliyomaliza 100-hr inspection ilipoteza oil pressure mid-flight na engine ikawa inarun rough, pilot aka-shut down engine na akafanya emergency landing, minor damage tu kwa airframe na prop. Tuligundua kuna rag iliyoachwa kwenye oil intake wakati wa kuremove magneto, seems mtu aliifungua engine kwa ajili ya owner wakati wa inspection na hakuitoa. Next shift lazima wa-safety wire ile new oil filter iliyowekwa na kukamilisha 100-hr inspection paperwork; pia tuflag kwa management kwamba bado hatuna proper job turnover system ya kutrack work in progress.
summary: Skyhawk 172 ilipata oil pressure loss na emergency landing baada ya rag kuziba oil intake wakati wa 100-hr inspection, ikionyesha gaps kwenye shop's documentation system.

narrative_text: During IDG servicing on the B737 in the hangar, the aluminum drain plug was found cracked, likely from prior over-torquing or use of improper tools like channel locks. Torque effort suddenly dropped mid-sequence before the crack was confirmed visually, so the plug was replaced. Next shift, please verify replacement plug torque per block 2 step and flag this as a recurring issue with the tech team.
summary: Cracked IDG drain plug found on B737 during hangar maintenance due to prior over-torquing; plug replaced and follow-up torque check needed.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhudumia IDG ya ndege ya B737 hangarini, kizibo cha alumini kilipatikana kimepasuka, huenda kutokana na kubana kupita kiasi awali au matumizi ya zana zisizofaa kama channel locks. Nguvu ya kubana ilipungua ghafla katikati ya mchakato kabla ya kuthibitisha ufa kwa macho, hivyo kizibo kilibadilishwa. Zamu inayofuata, tafadhali hakikisheni kubana kwa kizibo kipya kunafuata hatua za block 2, na mjulishe timu ya ufundi kuhusu tatizo hili linalojirudia.
summary: Kizibo cha kutolea mafuta cha IDG kwenye B737 kilipatikana kimepasuka hangarini kutokana na kubana kupita kiasi awali; kizibo kilibadilishwa na ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulipokuwa tuki-service IDG kwa B737 hapa hangar, tulipata ile aluminum drain plug imepasuka, most likely ni kwa sababu ya over-torquing ya awali au kutumia tools mbaya kama channel locks. Torque effort ilipungua ghafla mid-sequence kabla hatujaconfirm crack kwa jicho, so tuliibadilisha plug. Zamu inayofuata, please verify torque ya plug mpya as per block 2 step, na muinform tech team hii ni recurring issue.
summary: IDG drain plug ya B737 ilipatikana imepasuka hangarini due to over-torquing awali; plug ilibadilishwa na follow-up torque check inahitajika.

narrative_text: B737-800 right-hand main gear speed brake interlock cable was routed but left uninstalled/unadjusted at end of day shift; work interruption card was written and verbal handover given to swing shift lead detailing remaining task. Next day found cable attached and safetied, with the interlock adjustment already signed off as complete, so gear door installation and rigging proceeded on that basis. Aircraft later experienced right gear retraction failure and air return; suspect the interlock adjustment signoff was made without proper verification. Follow-up: audit signoff on speed brake interlock cable installation/adjustment and reinforce shift handover documentation for incomplete gear tasks.
summary: Improper handover and unverified signoff on a speed brake interlock cable installation led to a gear retraction failure and air return on a B737-800.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-800, kebo ya interlock ya speed brake kwa gear ya kulia ilikuwa imepitishwa lakini haikuwekwa wala kurekebishwa kikamilifu mwishoni mwa shift. Kadi ya usumbufu wa kazi iliandikwa na maelezo ya mdomo yalitolewa kwa lead wa swing shift kuhusu kazi iliyobaki. Siku iliyofuata, kebo ilionekana imefungwa na kusafishwa (safetied), na sehemu ya marekebisho ilikuwa tayari imesainiwa kama imekamilika, hivyo kazi ya kufunga milango ya gear na kuipanga (rigging) iliendelea kwa msingi huo. Baadaye ndege ilirudi uwanjani (air return) kwa sababu ya hitilafu ya kurudisha gear ya kulia; inashukiwa saini ya marekebisho ilitolewa bila uthibitisho sahihi. Hatua inayofuata: kufanya ukaguzi wa saini kwenye ufungaji wa kebo ya interlock na kuboresha mawasiliano ya kazi zisizokamilika baina ya zamu.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu na saini isiyothibitishwa kwenye kebo ya interlock ya speed brake vilisababisha hitilafu ya gear na kurudi kwa ndege ya B737-800.

entities.text: kebo ya interlock ya speed brake
kufunga milango ya gear na kuipanga

narrative_text: Kwa B737-800, ile speed brake interlock cable ya right gear tuliipitisha lakini hatukuweza ku-install na ku-adjust kabla ya shift kuisha. Niliandika work interruption card na nikatoa verbal handover kwa swing shift lead kuhusu kazi iliyobaki. Next day nikakuta cable imeshikwa na kusafetiwa, na interlock adjustment ilikuwa already signed off as complete, so tukaendelea na gear door installation na rigging tukiamini iko sawa. Baadaye aircraft ikapata right gear retraction failure na air return; inaonekana ile signoff ilifanywa bila proper verification. Follow-up inahitajika: audit ya signoff kwenye interlock cable installation, na tuboreshe communication during shift handover kwa open tasks.
summary: Communication breakdown wakati wa shift handover na signoff isiyo-verified kwenye speed brake interlock cable ndio ilisababisha gear retraction failure na air return kwa B737-800.

narrative_text: B737-700 had a right engine EGT exceedance reported by the previous controller, who briefed the operator on required steps before departure. During shift handover the mechanic signed off the item as EGT red box reset with inlet/exhaust inspection, but the aircraft departed before the inspection could be verified against the AMM. Since EGT exceedances are a known chronic issue on this fleet, a log entry has been raised for EEC interrogation and the aircraft is being held at the next station for repair; going forward, any item requiring Maintenance Management follow-up should be locked until concurrence is confirmed.
summary: A B737-700 departed with an unverified right engine EGT exceedance inspection, prompting a follow-up log entry and a decision to hold the aircraft at the next station for repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa na tatizo la joto kupita kiasi (EGT) kwenye injini ya kulia, na kontroller wa awali alikuwa amewaelekeza wahusika hatua zinazotakiwa kabla ya safari. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift, fundi aliweka sahihi kwamba EGT ilirudishwa katika hali ya kawaida na ukaguzi wa mlango wa hewa na wa moshi ulifanyika, lakini ndege iliondoka kabla ya ukaguzi huo kuthibitishwa kulingana na taratibu za AMM. Kwa kuwa tatizo hili la EGT ni la kawaida kwenye fleet hii, taarifa imewekwa kwenye logi kuomba ukaguzi wa EEC, na ndege itasimamishwa kituo kinachofuata kwa ajili ya matengenezo; kuanzia sasa, kipengele chochote kinachohitaji uthibitisho wa Usimamizi wa Matengenezo kifungwe hadi idhini itolewe.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 iliruka huku ukaguzi wa tatizo la EGT kwenye injini ya kulia ukiwa haujathibitishwa, hivyo kusababisha maombi ya ukaguzi zaidi na uamuzi wa kuisimamisha ndege kituo kinachofuata kwa matengenezo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mlango wa hewa na wa moshi

narrative_text: Tuli-receive turnover kwamba B737-700 ina right engine EGT exceedance, na controller wa kabla alikuwa ame-brief crew kuhusu steps zinazotakiwa. Kwa hivyo during handover, mechanic ame-sign off item kama EGT red box reset pamoja na inspection ya inlet na exhaust, lakini aircraft ikaondoka kabla inspection kuverify na AMM procedures. Since hii ni chronic issue kwenye fleet, nimeraise log entry ya EEC interrogation na tume-decide kuistop ndege next station kwa repair; going forward, any item inayohitaji Maintenance Management concurrence lazima ilockwe mpaka verification ikamilike.
summary: B737-700 ilidepart na right engine EGT inspection isiyo-verify, hivyo tuka-raise EEC interrogation na kudecide kuistop aircraft next station kwa repair.

narrative_text: During the last shift, the floor beam on the A320 (contract MRO line) was found forced down over a Hi-Lok, causing a gouge in an area with zero damage tolerance; the beam was pulled for review. On return we found the same damaged beam had already been re-installed by another crew without disposition, which is a safety concern. Two technicians were directly involved, and the DOM was notified but has not responded. Incoming shift must stop work on this beam, confirm engineering disposition before any further installation, and escalate DOM non-response.
summary: A damaged A320 floor beam was re-installed without proper disposition despite it being flagged, and DOM notification received no response.

narrative_text: Katika zamu iliyopita, boriti ya sakafu ya ndege ya A320, katika kituo cha ukarabati cha kandarasi, ilipatikana ikiwa imesukumwa kwa nguvu juu ya Hi-Lok na kusababisha mkwaruzo katika sehemu isiyoruhusiwa kuwa na uharibifu wowote; boriti hiyo iliondolewa kwa ukaguzi zaidi. Tuliporudi kazini, tuligundua kuwa boriti ile ile yenye hitilafu ilikuwa tayari imewekwa tena bila idhini rasmi, jambo ambalo ni hatari kiusalama. Mafundi wawili walihusika moja kwa moja, na Meneja wa Matengenezo (DOM) alijulishwa lakini hajajibu mpaka sasa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kusitisha kazi kwenye boriti hii, kuthibitisha idhini ya kihandisi kabla ya kuendelea, na kufuatilia ukimya wa DOM.
summary: Boriti ya sakafu ya A320 yenye hitilafu iliwekwa tena bila idhini rasmi, na taarifa kwa DOM haijajibiwa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii zamu iliyopita, ile floor beam ya A320 huko contract MRO ilipatikana imeforce down juu ya Hi-Lok, ikaleta gouge kwa area ambayo hakuna damage limits allowed - so tuka-remove hio beam for review. Tulipo-return, tukakuta hio beam ile ile yenye damage imeshaingizwa tena bila disposition, which ni safety concern kabisa. Watu wawili walikuwa heavily involved, na DOM alijulishwa lakini hajarespond mpaka sasa. Next shift lazima wa-stop work kwa hii beam, wa-confirm engineering disposition kabla ya kuendelea na installation, na ku-escalate hii DOM silence.
summary: Ile A320 floor beam yenye damage ilirudishwa kwa installation bila disposition, na DOM hajarespond kwa report.

narrative_text: B777-200 pax seat rework per CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) was completed this shift, but the seatbelt shackle attachment fitting (P/N 1022492-125) was not installed, leaving no attachment point for the seatbelt. Seat arrived with prior work done and several parts/hardware already missing, requiring research and reordering that delayed completion; no relief manpower came at shift change so the job was finished on overtime under fatigue, with cleaning crew activity nearby adding distraction. Next shift must verify all hardware against parts list before closing out, confirm shackle fitting is installed, and re-inspect full seat build before it is released for flight.
summary: A B777-200 passenger seat was reassembled without the required seatbelt shackle fitting due to missing parts, time pressure, and fatigue during an unsupported overtime shift.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kutengeneza kiti cha abiria cha B777-200 kwa mujibu wa CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) imekamilika kwa zamu hii, lakini kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama (P/N 1022492-125) hakikuwekwa, hivyo kiti hakina sehemu ya kufunga mkanda. Kiti kilikuwa kimeshafanyiwa kazi kabla ya kufika hapa na vipuri kadhaa vilikuwa vimepotea, jambo lililohitaji utafiti na kuagiza vipuri vipya na kuchelewesha kazi; hakuna fundi mwingine aliyekuja kusaidia wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo kazi ilikamilishwa kwa saa za ziada huku uchovu ukiwa umeanza kuathiri umakini, na wafanyakazi wa usafi waliokuwa karibu na eneo la kazi walisababisha vurugu ya fikra. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha vipuri vyote dhidi ya orodha ya vipuri kabla ya kufunga kazi, kuhakikisha kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda kimewekwa, na kukagua tena kiti chote kabla ya kuruhusiwa kutumika kwenye ndege.
summary: Kiti cha abiria cha B777-200 kilirudishwa bila kifaa muhimu cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama kutokana na vipuri vilivyokosekana, shinikizo la muda, na uchovu wakati wa zamu ya saa za ziada bila msaada wa wafanyakazi wengine.

entities.text: kifaa cha kushikilia mkanda wa usalama (P/N 1022492-125)

narrative_text: Tuli-rework ile pax seat ya B777-200 kwa CMM 25-62-82 (log-pages XXXXXXX/XXXXXXY) na job ilikamilika this shift, lakini tuli-forget ku-install ile seatbelt shackle attachment fitting (P/N 1022492-125), so sasa seat haina attachment point ya seatbelt. Seat ilikuwa already worked on before kufika ZZZ, na kuna parts na hardware kadhaa zilikuwa missing, tukalazimika ku-research na ku-order zingine, hivyo ikachukua muda mrefu; hakuna relief iliyokuja during shift change so tulilazimika kufanya overtime, fatigue ikaanza kuathiri concentration, plus wale cleaning crew walikuwa working karibu na eneo la job wakatu-distract kidogo. Oncoming shift inafaa ku-verify hardware zote against parts list, confirm kwamba shackle fitting imewekwa, na ku-re-inspect full seat build before iko-released for flight.
summary: Pax seat ya B777-200 iliezekwa without ile required shackle fitting kwa sababu ya missing parts, time pressure, na fatigue during overtime bila relief manpower.

narrative_text: MD-80 forward cargo ceiling panels 5160C, 5161C and 5162C were signed off as installed on the pattern card Monday, but were found open at shift start Wednesday morning with no logbook entry or verbal turnover explaining the change. Incoming lead technician please verify current panel status against the pattern card before further work and confirm with previous shift lead why the discrepancy was not documented. Close out logbook entry once panels are reinstalled and re-inspected.
summary: Forward cargo ceiling panels on an MD-80 were found open despite being signed off as installed, with no turnover documentation, requiring verification and logbook correction.

narrative_text: Paneli za dari za sehemu ya mizigo ya mbele kwenye ndege ya MD-80, yaani 5160C, 5161C na 5162C, zilisainiwa kwenye pattern card Jumatatu kuwa zimefungwa, lakini asubuhi ya Jumatano zilikutwa zikiwa wazi bila maelezo yoyote kwenye logbook au taarifa ya mkabidhi wa zamu iliyopita. Fundi mkuu anayeingia zamu aangalie hali halisi ya paneli hizo kabla ya kuendelea na kazi nyingine, na afuatilie kwa nini hitilafu hii haikuandikwa popote. Baada ya paneli kufungwa upya na kukaguliwa, logbook ijazwe ipasavyo.
summary: Paneli za dari za mizigo kwenye ndege ya MD-80 zilikutwa wazi ingawa zilisainiwa kama zimefungwa, bila maelezo ya turnover, hivyo zinahitaji ukaguzi na marekebisho ya logbook.

entities.text: Paneli za dari za sehemu ya mizigo ya mbele... 5160C, 5161C na 5162C

narrative_text: Kwenye MD-80, ile forward cargo ceiling panels 5160C, 5161C na 5162C zilikuwa zime-sign off kwenye pattern card as installed siku ya Monday, lakini Wednesday morning tumekuja tukazikuta ziko open, hakuna log entry wala mtu ame-brief kuhusu hio discrepancy. Lead technician anayeingia shift a-verify status ya panels dhidi ya pattern card kabla ya kuendelea na other tasks, na a-confirm na previous shift kwanini hio issue haikua-documented. Panels zikishafungwa tena na kukaguliwa, logbook i-update ipasavyo.
summary: MD-80 forward cargo ceiling panels zilikutwa open ingawa zilikuwa zime-sign off as installed, na hakukuwa na turnover notes, kwa hivyo inahitaji verification na logbook update.

narrative_text: During B767-200 main landing gear support beam fitting repair, boring fixture was set up and the initial bore cut was made and signed off before the boring motor failed at shift change; small tool repair was called and the job was verbally handed to next shift. On return next day the bore was found a couple of sizes larger with no documentation, and we discovered the fixture had been removed for the air motor repair and not correctly reinstalled, leaving the bore eccentric and out of square. We enlarged and spot-faced the bore per the service instruction and documented it, but suspect the hole is now misaligned even though the support link assembled fine; management is not yet convinced. Next shift crew chief has been briefed verbally and asked to ensure all work performed is properly documented going forward.
summary: A misaligned/eccentric bore on a B767-200 main landing gear support beam fitting, caused by an undocumented fixture reinstallation error during shift handover, needs management follow-up despite parts fitting up correctly.

entities.text: main landing gear support beam fitting

narrative_text: Wakati wa kurekebisha fitting ya main landing gear support beam ya ndege ya B767-200, boring fixture iliwekwa na kuanzishwa bore ya kwanza, kazi ikasainiwa, kabla motor ya kuchimba kuharibika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Fundi wa kurekebisha vifaa aliitwa na kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu. Siku iliyofuata, tulikuta bore imeongezeka ukubwa kidogo bila nyaraka zozote, na tukagundua fixture ilikuwa imeondolewa wakati wa kurekebisha air motor na haikurudishwa vizuri, jambo lililosababisha bore kuwa mlalo na isiyo sawa. Tuliongeza ukubwa wa bore na kufanya spot-facing kulingana na maelekezo ya huduma na kuandika kazi hiyo, ila tunashuku shimo bado halijalingana vizuri hata ingawa support link ilifungamana bila shida; usimamizi bado haujakubaliana na hoja hii, na zamu inayofuata imeambiwa kuhakikisha kazi zote zinaandikwa vizuri.
summary: Bore ya support beam fitting ya main landing gear katika ndege ya B767-200 haikulingana vizuri kwa sababu ya fixture kutorudishwa ipasavyo wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, na hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi wa usimamizi.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya repair ya main landing gear support beam fitting kwa hiyo B767-200, boring fixture ikawekwa, tukasign initial cut halafu boring motor ikafail exactly end of shift. Tulicall small tool repair na tuka-handover job kwa next shift kwa mdomo tu. Next day tukirudi, tunakuta bore imekuwa sizes mbili kubwa zaidi bila documentation yoyote, tukagundua fixture ilikuwa imeondolewa wakati wa kufix air motor na haikurudishwa properly, kwa hivyo bore ikawa eccentric na out of square kabisa. Tuka-enlarge bore mpaka max diameter, tukafanya spot-facing per service instruction na kudocument kazi hiyo, lakini bado nina suspicion hii hole haija-align vizuri, ingawa support link na parts zake zilifit sawasawa - management bado hawaja-convince. Nimeambia crew chief wa next shift verbally aensure watu wake wanadocument kazi zao vizuri.
summary: Bore ya support beam fitting kwa B767-200 landing gear haija-align sawasawa kwa sababu fixture haikurudishwa properly during handover, na issue hii inahitaji follow-up zaidi na management.

entities.text: main landing gear support beam fitting

narrative_text: MD-80 nosewheel steering cable rigging was completed overnight by a heavy maintenance mechanic sent in by the carrier; I was not involved in the repair itself and had just returned from days off with no background on the job. After reviewing the logbook and finding all entries and job card turnovers signed off, I signed the airworthiness release, but it was later found that the required inspection item for the steering work was never entered in the logbook. Next shift please verify that any required inspection item tied to this steering repair is properly logged before further release, and confirm with the mechanic who performed the rigging whether the RII was actually completed.
summary: An MD-80's nosewheel steering repair was signed off as airworthy without the required inspection item being logged, and the next shift needs to confirm proper RII documentation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za steering za nosewheel kwenye ndege ya MD-80 ilikamilishwa usiku na fundi wa heavy maintenance aliyetumwa na kampuni; mimi sikuhusika kabisa na kazi hiyo kwani nilikuwa ninatoka likizo ya wikendi bila taarifa yoyote kuhusu ilichofanyika. Baada ya kupitia logbook na kuona sahihi zote za kazi zimekamilika, nilisaini airworthiness, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kuwa required inspection item ya kazi hiyo haikuwahi kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Shift inayofuata tafadhali hakikisheni required inspection item ya kazi ya steering imeandikwa vizuri kabla ya kutoa ndege, na muulize fundi aliyefanya rigging kama RII ilikamilishwa.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 ilisainiwa kuwa airworthy licha ya required inspection item ya ukarabati wa nosewheel steering kutoandikwa, hivyo shift inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha uandikaji sahihi.

narrative_text: Ile MD-80 ilikuwa na nosewheel steering issue, na yule heavy maintenance mechanic kutoka carrier ndiye alifanya rigging ya cables usiku - mimi nilikuwa nimetoka tu weekend off so sikujua chochote kuhusu job hiyo. Nikaangalia logbook, nikaona job cards zote zime-sign off, so nikasign airworthiness pia, lakini baadaye wakaniambia kwamba required inspection item ya hiyo steering job haikuwahi kuingizwa logbook. Next shift please mhakikishe RII imeenter vizuri kwa logbook kabla ya kutoa aircraft, na muconfirm na yule mechanic aliye-rig cables kama alifanya required inspection item.
summary: MD-80 ilisign off kama airworthy lakini required inspection item ya nosewheel steering job haikuandikwa logbook, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-verify RII documentation.

narrative_text: Second Shift rushed to complete the copilot flight control cable tension adjustment on the Gulfstream G650 before end of shift ahead of an early morning departure. QC gave 'OK to Close' on the main under-floor access area after inspecting for FOD and rig pin removal, but was not informed that adjacent inspection panels had been opened or that a control rod had been removed at the aileron control system. Later found (when crew seats were removed) that those panels were left unsecured under the carpet and a cotter pin at the control rod attach point was not properly secured. Incoming shift must verify all under-floor inspection panels and cotter pins on both pilot and copilot control modules, and tighten turnover accountability between shifts.
summary: Incomplete shift turnover led to unsecured inspection panels and an improperly secured cotter pin on the G650 aileron control system after a rushed cable tension adjustment.

entities.text: copilot flight control cable tension adjustment

narrative_text: Shift ya Pili ilikimbizwa kukamilisha marekebisho ya tension ya cable ya udhibiti wa ndege ya copilot kwenye Gulfstream G650 kabla ya kuisha kwa shift, kwa sababu ndege ilikuwa na safari ya asubuhi mapema. Msimamizi wa Ubora alitoa idhini ya kufunga eneo la chini ya sakafu baada ya kukagua uchafu na kuondoa rig pin, lakini hakujulishwa kuwa paneli za ukaguzi za jirani zilikuwa zimefunguliwa au kwamba control rod ilikuwa imeondolewa kwenye mfumo wa udhibiti wa aileron. Baadaye, wakati viti vya crew vilipoondolewa, ilibainika kuwa paneli hizo hazikufungwa vizuri na zilikuwa zimefichwa na carpet, na cotter pin ya control rod haikuwa imefungwa sawasawa. Shift inayoingia inapaswa kuhakikisha paneli zote za ukaguzi na cotter pins za mifumo ya udhibiti ya pilot na copilot zimekaguliwa vizuri, na uwajibikaji wa mkabidhi kati ya shift uboreshwe.
summary: Mkabidhi wa shift usiokamilika ulisababisha paneli za ukaguzi zisizofungwa vizuri na cotter pin isiyokamilika kwenye mfumo wa udhibiti wa aileron wa Gulfstream G650 baada ya marekebisho ya haraka ya cable.

narrative_text: Second Shift walikimbizwa kufinish cable tension adjustment ya copilot flight controls kwenye Gulfstream G650 kabla ya shift kuisha, kwa sababu kulikuwa na early morning flight. QC nikatoa 'OK to Close' kwa under-floor access area baada ya kukagua FOD na kuremove rig pin, lakini sikuwa notified kuwa inspection panels za jirani zilikuwa zimefunguliwa au kwamba control rod ilikuwa imeremovwa kwenye aileron control system. Baadaye, wakati crew seats zilipoondolewa, ikabainika kuwa panels hazikuwa secured vizuri na zilikuwa zimefunikwa na carpet, plus cotter pin ya control rod haikuwa properly secured. Shift inayoingia lazima iverify panels zote na cotter pins kwenye pilot na copilot control modules, na turnover communication kati ya shifts iimarishwe.
summary: Poor shift handover ilisababisha unsecured inspection panels na cotter pin isiyo secure kwenye aileron control system ya G650 baada ya rushed cable adjustment.

narrative_text: On the MD-11 (MCO check), previous shift turned over an AUX LOWER R PUMP status message with a wiring schematic for the forward aux tanks; this led me to misidentify the fault as forward aux instead of the ctr aux lower tank. I pulled parts and replaced remote control circuit breaker B1 and control relay R2 on the wrong tank circuit, then reapplied power and passed the fuel system controller return-to-service test before pulling the placard. Next shift please verify tank nomenclature on any AUX LOWER status messages before starting work, and re-check ctr aux lower R pump wiring since the original fault was never actually addressed.
summary: A technician replaced fuel pump control components on the wrong aux tank after misreading an ambiguous status message, so the actual fault on the ctr aux lower pump remains unresolved.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-11 iliyokuwa chini ya ukaguzi wa MCO, zamu iliyopita ilinipa taarifa ya ujumbe wa hitilafu ya AUX LOWER R PUMP pamoja na mchoro wa nyaya wa matangi ya mbele ya aux, na hii ilinifanya nidhani hitilafu ilitoka kwenye tangi la mbele badala ya tangi la chini la ctr aux. Niliondoa nguvu kwenye ndege na kubadilisha circuit breaker B1 na relay R2 kwenye mzunguko usiokuwa sahihi, kisha nikarudisha umeme na kufanya jaribio la kurudisha mfumo wa mafuta kwenye huduma, ambalo lilipita salama kabla sijaondoa placard. Zamu inayofuata iangalie kwa makini majina ya matangi kwenye ujumbe wa AUX LOWER kabla ya kuanza kazi, na kuhakiki tena waya za ctr aux lower pump kwani hitilafu halisi bado haijashughulikiwa.
summary: Fundi alibadilisha vipuri vya pump ya mafuta kwenye tangi lisilo sahihi baada ya kutoelewa vizuri ujumbe wa hitilafu, hivyo tatizo halisi la ctr aux lower pump bado halijashughulikiwa.

entities.text: jaribio la kurudisha mfumo wa mafuta kwenye huduma
tangi la chini la ctr aux

narrative_text: Kwenye MD-11 iko under MCO, previous shift walinipatia turnover ya AUX LOWER R PUMP status message pamoja na wiring schematic ya forward aux tanks, so nikaishia ku-assume fault ni ya forward aux instead of the ctr aux lower tank. Nilitoa power kwa ndege, nika-replace remote control circuit breaker B1 na control relay R2 kwenye wrong tank circuit, kisha nika-reapply power na kufanya return-to-service test ya fuel system controller ambayo ilipita before I removed the placard. Next shift wanatakiwa ku-double check tank nomenclature kwa status messages zozote za AUX LOWER kabla ya kuanza task, na ku-recheck wiring ya ctr aux lower pump kwa sababu ile actual fault bado haijafanyiwa kazi.
summary: Fundi ali-replace fuel pump control components kwenye tank isiyo sahihi baada ya ku-misread status message, so real fault kwenye ctr aux lower pump bado haijashughulikiwa.

narrative_text: The Change Order Auth job cards for the A320 cowling were missing from the system for most of the shift; maintenance control only delivered the paperwork late, close to end of shift. While completing the cards, my co-worker and I went straight to the text steps and illustrations but did not reference the TOD document at the front of the package, so step G's latch security check was not flagged as a Required Inspection Item and no inspector signed it off. This was only caught the next day when a union steward mentioned a similar miss on another aircraft's same Change Order Auth. Follow-up: confirm an inspector has since completed the RII latch inspection on our tail number and the TOD document is properly closed out.
summary: A Change Order Auth on an A320 cowling was completed without the required RII latch inspection because the TOD document was overlooked, and this needs inspector sign-off follow-up.

narrative_text: Karatasi za Change Order Auth za cowling ya ndege ya A320 hazikuwepo mfumoni kwa muda mrefu wa shift; idara ya maintenance ilileta nyaraka hizo taratibu, karibu na mwisho wa kazi. Mimi na mfanyakazi mwenzangu tulianza kazi moja kwa moja tukisoma maandishi na michoro bila kuangalia hati ya TOD iliyokuwa mwanzoni mwa pakiti, hivyo hatua ya G ya kukagua usalama wa latches haikutambuliwa kama Required Inspection Item na hakuna inspector aliyeidhinisha. Jambo hili ligundulika siku iliyofuata baada ya union steward kutaja tatizo linalofanana kwenye ndege nyingine yenye Change Order Auth ile ile. Kinachohitajika: kuthibitisha kwamba inspector amefanya ukaguzi wa RII wa latches kwenye ndege yetu na hati ya TOD imekamilishwa vizuri.
summary: Change Order Auth ya cowling ya A320 ilikamilishwa bila ukaguzi wa RII wa latches kwa sababu hati ya TOD haikuangaliwa, na jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka kwa inspector.

narrative_text: Hii Change Order Auth job cards za cowling ya A320 hazikuwa kwa system mpaka late sana kwa shift, maintenance walileta paperwork almost mwisho wa shift. Mimi na co-worker tulistart kazi tukisoma tu text na illustrations, hatuku-refer TOD document iliyokuwa mbele ya package, so step G ya kukagua latches for security haikuflaggiwa kama Required Inspection Item na hakuna inspector aliye-sign off. Tuligundua tu siku iliyofuata wakati union steward alitaja same issue kwa ndege nyingine yenye Change Order Auth hiyo hiyo. Follow-up: confirm inspector amefanya RII latch inspection kwa tail number yetu na TOD document imekamilika properly.
summary: Change Order Auth ya A320 cowling ilikamilika bila RII inspection ya latches kwa sababu TOD document ilipuuzwa, hivyo inahitajika follow-up ya inspector.

narrative_text: CRJ200 had a roll issue traced to flight controls; a Bombardier rep and two company mechs worked the aileron and flap rigging through the shift. I repeatedly told the mechs to generate work cards so the disturbed flight control items could be flagged for RII, but by end of shift the cards for the flaps and aileron were still not written up. I logged a turnover note and verbally briefed the incoming inspector that RII is still required on the flaps and aileron before further flight. Next shift must confirm work cards are generated and RII completed before the aircraft is released for test flight.
summary: Outgoing inspector flags that RII documentation for CRJ200 flap and aileron work was not completed and must be verified before flight.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ200 ilikuwa na tatizo la kuyumba (roll) lililohusiana na flight controls; mwakilishi wa Bombardier pamoja na mafundi wawili wa kampuni walikuwa wakifanyia kazi aileron na flap wakati wa shift. Niliwaeleza mafundi mara kadhaa watengeneze work cards ili vipengele vilivyofunguliwa viweze kuwekwa alama ya RII, lakini mpaka shift yangu ikiisha work cards za flaps na aileron hazikuwa zimeandaliwa. Nimeandika turnover note na pia nimemweleza kwa mdomo inspector wa shift inayokuja kuwa RII bado inahitajika kwenye flaps na aileron kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka. Shift inayokuja lazima ihakikishe work cards zimeandaliwa na RII imekamilika kabla ya test flight.
summary: Inspector aliyeondoka anaonya kuwa nyaraka za RII kwa kazi ya flaps na aileron ya CRJ200 hazijakamilika na zinahitaji kuthibitishwa kabla ya safari ya ndege.

narrative_text: Hii CRJ200 ilikuwa na roll issue, ikaishia kwa flight controls; Bombardier rep na mechs wawili wa company walikuwa wanafanya kazi kwenye aileron na flaps kwa shift yote. Nikawaambia mechs several times waandike work cards ndio nizi-flag for RII, lakini mpaka shift yangu inaisha, hizo cards za flaps na aileron hazikuwa zimegenerate. Nimeandika turnover note kwa log na pia nikamwambia verbally inspector wa next shift kwamba RII bado inahitajika kwa flaps na aileron kabla ya kuendelea na test flight. Shift inayokuja wahakikishe work cards zimegenerate na RII imecompletiwa kabla plane iende for flight.
summary: Outgoing inspector anaflag kwamba RII documentation ya CRJ200 flaps na aileron work bado haijakamilika, inahitaji verification kabla ya flight.

narrative_text: Followed up on the B757-200 pilot log write-up for L1 door hard to open; found an external fuselage hinge access panel removed with no logbook entry or non-routine write-up documenting prior troubleshooting. A replacement part had already been ordered, but door operation checked normal to us and to other mechanics and both crew chiefs; only the damping snubber pin indicator was found extended. Lubricated the door and coordinated with Technical Services, who agreed the snubber does not affect door operation and will raise an item to replace it. Next shift please confirm the replacement part item is logged and ensure the supervisor turnover sheet is available at the hangar going forward.
summary: Technicians found undocumented prior troubleshooting on a B757 L1 door hard-to-open write-up, confirmed normal door operation, lubricated it, and flagged a snubber pin for replacement via Technical Services.

narrative_text: Tulipokea report ya L1 door ya ndege B757-200 kuwa ngumu kufunguliwa, na tukagundua panel ya nje ya hinge ya fuselage ilikuwa imeondolewa bila kuandikwa logbook wala non-routine write-up ya troubleshooting iliyofanyika awali. Part mpya ilikuwa tayari imeorder, lakini baada ya kuangalia, mlango ulionekana kufanya kazi vizuri kama walivyothibitisha mafundi wengine na crew chiefs wawili; kitu tu kilichoonekana tofauti ni pin indicator ya snubber ya damping iliyokuwa imetoka nje kidogo. Tulilainisha (lube) mlango na kuwasiliana na Technical Services, ambao walikubaliana kuwa snubber hiyo haiwezi kuathiri operesheni ya mlango na wataandaa order ya kuibadilisha. Shift inayokuja tafadhali thibitisha kama order ya part hiyo imewekwa kwenye system na kwamba turnover sheet ya supervisor inapatikana hangar-ni siku zijazo.
summary: Mafundi waligundua kuwa troubleshooting ya awali ya mlango wa L1 wa ndege ya B757 haikuandikwa vizuri, wakathibitisha mlango unafanya kazi vizuri, wakaulainisha, na kutoa taarifa ya kuibadilisha snubber kupitia Technical Services.

entities.text: panel ya nje ya hinge ya fuselage
pin indicator ya snubber ya damping

narrative_text: Tuliendelea na troubleshooting ya B757-200 kwa ile pilot log kwamba L1 door ni hard to open; tukakuta external fuselage hinge access panel imeondolewa lakini hakuna documentation yoyote kwenye logbook au non-routine write-up ya kile kilichofanyika before. Part ilikuwa tayari imeorder, lakini door operation ilikuwa normal kwetu na pia kwa mechs wengine na crew chiefs, isipokuwa pin indicator ya damping snubber ilikuwa imeextend kidogo. Tulilube door na kutalk na Technical Services, wakakubali kwamba snubber haiaffect operation ya door na watapanga replacement item. Kwa next shift, please confirm kama part order imeenter kwenye system, na pia hangar inatakiwa iwe na turnover sheet ya supervisor kila wakati.
summary: Wakati wa troubleshooting ya L1 door write-up kwenye B757, mechs walikuta hakuna documentation ya awali, walithibitisha door operation ni normal, walilube, na wakaraise item ya kubadilisha snubber pin kupitia Technical Services.

narrative_text: While troubleshooting the cockpit airflow write-up on the B737-300, I pulled the instrument panel and several cannon plugs, including #1 and #2 engine N1 tachometer indicator plugs, then reinstalled everything. Shift ended before the airflow issue was resolved and I had to wait for the logbook/turnover book to be free, so I briefed the oncoming crew verbally in a rush and missed writing up that an engine run is required to check the tach gauges after the cannon plug work. Next shift please confirm an engine run has been done to verify #1 and #2 N1 tachometer indications before further dispatch.
summary: A rushed, incomplete written handover after cannon plug work on the tachometer indicators omitted the required engine run check, which was only caught at pushback.

entities.text: #1 and #2 engine N1 tachometer indicator plugs

narrative_text: Wakati nikichunguza tatizo la mtiririko wa hewa kwenye cockpit ya ndege ya B737-300, niliondoa kibao cha vyombo vya kupimia pamoja na cannon plugs kadhaa, ikiwemo zile za tachometer za engine namba 1 na namba 2, kisha nikazirudisha zote mahali pake. Zamu yangu iliisha kabla tatizo la hewa kutatuliwa kabisa, na kwa sababu kitabu cha logbook na turnover kilikuwa kikitumiwa na fundi mwenzangu, niliwaeleza wafanyakazi wa zamu inayofuata kwa mdomo tu kwa haraka, na nikasahau kuandika kwamba inahitajika engine run kuhakikisha vipimo vya tachometer vinafanya kazi sawasawa baada ya kazi ile ya cannon plugs. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kuwa engine run imefanywa na vipimo vya tachometer namba 1 na namba 2 vinaonyesha sahihi kabla ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Taarifa ya mkabidhiano iliyoandikwa kwa haraka baada ya kazi ya cannon plugs kwenye tachometer haikutaja hitaji la engine run, jambo lililogunduliwa tu wakati wa pushback.

entities.text: tachometer za engine namba 1 na namba 2

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikitroubleshoot ile airflow write-up kwa B737-300, nikaremove instrument panel na cannon plugs kadhaa, including zile za #1 na #2 engine N1 tachometer indicators, kisha nikazireinstall zote. Shift yangu iliisha before airflow issue kutatuliwa, na kwa sababu logbook na turnover book zilikuwa zikitumiwa na mwenzangu, nikaeleza incoming crew verbally huku nikiwa in a rush, na nikaforget kuwrite down kwamba inahitajika engine run kucheck zile tach gauges baada ya kazi ya cannon plugs. Next shift wachek kama engine run imefanywa kuconfirm #1 na #2 N1 tachometer indications kabla ya kurelease ndege.
summary: Turnover note iliandikwa kwa haraka baada ya cannon plug work kwenye tachometer, ikamiss ile requirement ya engine run, na ikagundulika saa ya pushback.

narrative_text: During shift, observed a new-hire technician securing the Dash 8-100 aircraft batteries to the battery tray using copper breakaway wire instead of the required 0.032 inch safety wire. She admitted using the same incorrect method on another aircraft the previous week. Supervisor was notified and maintenance control was contacted to trace that aircraft for inspection; incoming shift must confirm status of that aircraft and verify the aux battery connector rework was completed.
summary: A new-hire technician improperly safety-wired aircraft batteries with copper breakaway wire, prompting a search for a previously affected aircraft and follow-up on battery connector rework.

entities.text: verify the aux battery connector rework

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift, nilimwona fundi mpya akiwa anafunga betri za ndege ya Dash 8-100 kwenye tray kwa kutumia waya wa shaba (copper breakaway wire) badala ya waya sahihi wa usalama wa 0.032 inch. Alikiri kuwa alitumia mbinu hiyo hiyo isiyo sahihi wiki iliyopita kwenye ndege nyingine. Supervisor alijulishwa na maintenance control wakawasiliana kuifuatilia ndege hiyo kwa ukaguzi; shift inayokuja lazima wathibitishe hali ya ndege hiyo na kuhakikisha aux battery connector imerekebishwa ipasavyo.
summary: Fundi mpya alifunga betri za ndege kwa waya wa shaba usiofaa, hivyo kuhitajika ufuatiliaji wa ndege iliyoathirika na urekebishaji wa connector ya betri.

entities.text: waya sahihi wa usalama wa 0.032 inch
kuhakikisha aux battery connector imerekebishwa ipasavyo

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift yangu niliona new hire mech akifunga aircraft batteries kwenye battery tray ya Dash 8-100 akitumia copper breakaway wire badala ya ile 0.032 inch safety wire inayotakiwa. Akaniambia alitumia hiyo copper wire hivyo hivyo last week kwenye ndege nyingine. Nikamwambia supervisor, akacontact maintenance control ili watrace hiyo aircraft ya awali for inspection; next shift wanahitaji kufollow up status ya hiyo ndege na kuconfirm kama aux battery connector imesecure vizuri na copper safety wire.
summary: New hire mech alifunga batteries za ndege kwa copper wire isiyo sahihi, hivyo maintenance control inatrace ndege ya awali na next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm rework ya battery connector.

entities.text: watrace hiyo aircraft ya awali for inspection
kuconfirm kama aux battery connector imesecure vizuri

narrative_text: During troubleshooting on the Bell 412, an engine bolt was found jammed near the #1 engine twist grip, lodged in an inaccessible area next to the idle cutoff inner bellcrank. The 12-point bolt had anti-seize applied but no safety wire installed, and last engine maintenance in that area was recorded on Day 1. Incoming powerplant tech to re-verify engine control installation and do a borescope/panel check for any additional FOD before next run.
summary: A loose, unsafetied engine bolt was found near the #1 twist grip on a Bell 412, requiring verification of engine control installation and further FOD inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya uchunguzi kwenye helikopta ya Bell 412, bolt ya injini ilipatikana ikiwa imekwama karibu na twist grip ya injini namba 1, mahali pasipofikika kwa urahisi karibu na bellcrank ya ndani ya idle cutoff. Bolt hiyo yenye vichwa kumi na mbili ilikuwa na anti-seize lakini haikuwa na waya wa usalama, na matengenezo ya mwisho ya injini eneo hilo yalifanyika Siku ya Kwanza kulingana na rekodi. Fundi atakayeingia zamu anaombwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa vidhibiti vya injini na kufanya ukaguzi wa ziada wa uchafu wowote uliobaki kwa kutumia borescope au kupitia paneli zilizofunguliwa.
summary: Bolt ya injini isiyo na usalama ilipatikana karibu na twist grip namba 1 ya helikopta ya Bell 412, hivyo ufungaji wa vidhibiti vya injini na uchunguzi zaidi wa uchafu unahitajika.

entities.text: bellcrank ya ndani ya idle cutoff

narrative_text: Tulipata engine bolt ikiwa imejam karibu na #1 engine twist grip wakati wa troubleshooting kwenye hii Bell 412, iko mahali pasipoeasy-access karibu na idle cutoff inner bellcrank. Ile 12-point bolt ilikuwa na anti-seize lakini hakukuwa na safety wire kabisa, na maintenance record inaonyesha last work kwenye eneo hilo ilifanyika Day 1. Next shift wafanye verify engine control installation na wafanye borescope au wachek through open panels kuhakikisha hakuna FOD nyingine iliyobaki.
summary: Kuna engine bolt ambayo haikuwa na safety wire iliyopatikana karibu na #1 twist grip kwenye Bell 412, hivyo engine control installation lazima i-verify na FOD check ifanyike.

narrative_text: During night shift we swapped the right Air Cycle Machine on the MD-80 following a pilot report of poor cooling; dayshift techs completed the remaining duct connections and were to run the Leak and Operational Checks. While closing out the 8130 tag I did not catch that the installed unit was part number XYZ-AAA6 instead of the IPC-required XYZ-AAA1, and this was only discovered later that day. Maintenance Control has been notified; dayshift must verify the part number before further ops and confirm whether the aircraft needs to be pulled from service.
summary: Wrong-part ACM was installed on an MD-80 during a night-shift pack change and only caught later, requiring Maintenance Control follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa shift ya usiku tulibadilisha Air Cycle Machine ya kulia kwenye ndege ya MD-80 kutokana na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu upoezaji hafifu; wafanyakazi wa mchana waliendelea kuunganisha mabomba yaliyobaki na walikuwa wapange kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji. Nilipokamilisha fomu ya 8130 sikugundua kwamba kipande kilichowekwa kilikuwa namba XYZ-AAA6 badala ya XYZ-AAA1 inayohitajika kwa mujibu wa kitabu cha vipande (IPC), na hili ligundulika baadaye siku hiyo. Idara ya Udhibiti wa Matengenezo imejulishwa; wafanyakazi wa mchana wanahitajika kuthibitisha namba sahihi ya kipande kabla ya operesheni zaidi na kuamua kama ndege inahitaji kutolewa kwa huduma.
summary: Kipande kisicho sahihi cha ACM kiliwekwa kwenye ndege ya MD-80 wakati wa shift ya usiku na kugunduliwa baadaye, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji wa Udhibiti wa Matengenezo.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tuli-swap right Air Cycle Machine kwa MD-80 kwa sababu ya pilot report ya insufficient cooling; dayshift wataconnect ducting iliyobaki na wafanye Leak and Operational Checks. Nilipokuwa nikifill ile 8130 tag sikunotice kwamba part iliyoinstall ni XYZ-AAA6 badala ya XYZ-AAA1 kama IPC inavyorequire, na tuligundua hii mistake mwishoni mwa siku. Nimeshanotify Maintenance Control; dayshift wanahitaji ku-verify part number kabla ya kuendelea na kuconfirm kama aircraft inahitaji kutolewa service.
summary: Part number ya ACM ilikuwa wrong pale MD-80, kama ilivyodiscover baadaye, hivyo Maintenance Control inahitaji kufuatilia.

narrative_text: On the SF340B engine mount replacement, Mechanic X handed over the left side to me verbally, stating the new mount was on and secured loosely with old hardware pending new bolts. When the new bolts arrived I removed the old ones and torqued/safetied the new hardware without re-verifying which mount was actually installed, and it turned out an old/bad mount had been swapped back in during tagging. Engine has since been removed and the correct mount installed, but incoming shift should confirm all verbal turnovers on mount/hardware jobs are backed up with written or tagged confirmation before closing out torque and safety steps. Recommend double-checking any job left mid-task where good and bad parts were staged together on the bench.
summary: A verbal-only turnover between mechanics on an SF340B engine mount replacement led to a bad mount being reinstalled, later corrected; written turnovers recommended going forward.

narrative_text: Katika kazi ya kubadilisha engine mount kwenye SF340B, Fundi X alinipa taarifa ya mdomo tu kuhusu upande wa kushoto, akisema mount mpya imewekwa na imefungwa kwa muda kwa hardware ya zamani huku tukisubiri bolts mpya. Bolts zilipofika niliondoa zile za zamani na kufunga zile mpya kikamilifu bila kuthibitisha tena kama mount iliyowekwa ni ile sahihi, na baadaye ikagundulika kuwa mount mbovu ilirudishwa kimakosa wakati wa kuweka tag. Engine imeondolewa na mount sahihi imewekwa, lakini zamu inayoingia inapaswa kuhakikisha taarifa za mdomo pekee hazitumiwi tena bila uthibitisho wa maandishi, hasa pale sehemu nzuri na mbovu zinapowekwa pamoja mezani.
summary: Taarifa ya mdomo pekee kati ya mafundi kuhusu engine mount ya SF340B ilisababisha mount mbovu kurudishwa kimakosa, hali iliyorekebishwa baadaye; taarifa za maandishi zinapendekezwa.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile engine mount replacement ya SF340B, Mechanic X aliniambia verbally tu kuhusu left side, akisema mount mpya iko 'on' loosely na old hardware while tunasubiri bolts mpya kufika. Bolts zilipoarrive niliremove zile old na kufunga new hardware, ni-torque na ku-safety, bila ku-double check kama ile mount imewekwa ni sahihi, na turns out ile bad mount ndio ilirudishwa by mistake wakati wa tagging. Engine imekuwa removed na correct mount imefungwa, lakini next shift wanapaswa kuconfirm turnovers zote za hardware jobs ziko documented, si verbal pekee, especially pale good na bad parts zinawekwa pamoja mezani.
summary: Verbal passdown pekee kwenye engine mount job ya SF340B ilileta confusion na bad mount kurudishwa, later fixed; written turnovers zina-recommendiwa going forward.

narrative_text: During my shift I worked on the L-hand main gear strut repack per MM 32-11-02 on the MD-82 but did not finish before shift change. While writing the turnover entry I missed the required adjustment/test step for the wheel proximity sensor per MM 32-60-05 pg 201, and the aircraft was released back to service. Next shift must check with the crew that troubleshot the resulting discrepancies, since they found the L-hand main gear prox sensor out of adjustment and had to re-adjust and re-test it. Please confirm no further squawks remain before next flight.
summary: A missed prox sensor adjustment/test step during an MD-82 main gear strut repack led to an out-of-adjustment sensor that required later troubleshooting and correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu yangu nilikuwa nikifanya kazi ya kubadilisha grisi kwenye strut ya gia kuu ya kushoto ya ndege ya MD-82 kwa mujibu wa mwongozo 32-11-02, lakini sikumaliza kabla ya zamu kuisha. Nilipokuwa nikiandika taarifa ya makabidhiano nilisahau hatua muhimu ya kufanya marekebisho na kipimo cha sensor ya ukaribu wa gurudumu kama inavyotakiwa kwenye ukurasa 201 wa mwongozo 32-60-05, na ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma. Timu iliyofuata ilibidi ifanye uchunguzi baada ya matatizo kujitokeza, wakagundua sensor hiyo haikuwa sahihi kwa vipimo, wakaifanyia marekebisho na kipimo tena. Naomba zamu inayofuata ithibitishe kuwa hakuna hitilafu nyingine iliyobaki kabla ndege haijaruka tena.
summary: Hatua ya kufanya kipimo cha sensor ya ukaribu ilisahaulika wakati wa ukarabati wa gia ya ndege ya MD-82, jambo lililosababisha sensor kutokuwa sahihi na kuhitaji marekebisho baadaye.

entities.text: strut ya gia kuu ya kushoto

narrative_text: Kwa shift yangu nilikuwa nikifanya main gear strut repack kwa L-hand side ya MD-82 kufuata MM 32-11-02, lakini sikumaliza before shift change. Nilipokuwa naandika turnover note kwenye logbook nilimiss hatua ya adjustment/test ya wheel prox sensor per MM 32-60-05 page 201, na aircraft ikaenda back into service. Maintenance crew waliokuja ku-troubleshoot discrepancies walikuta L-hand main gear prox sensor iko out of adjustment, wakai-adjust na kufanya test tena. Please confirm hakuna discrepancy nyingine before next flight.
summary: Wakati wa strut repack ya MD-82, hatua ya prox sensor adjustment/test ilimissed, hivyo sensor iligundulika out of adjustment na ikahitaji marekebisho baadaye.

narrative_text: Aircraft X (A321) was defueled from 22,000 to 13,000 lbs as a precaution ahead of RH wing INBD fuel pump removal for a reported leak; fuel was subsequently transferred to balance tanks before the mechanic began pump removal per AMM. During removal, the slide valve stayed attached to the pump instead of separating as designed, and the pump could not be reseated, causing a fuel leak from the wing that required spill kit response and fire department notification. Follow-up needed: review AMM procedure/design issue with the slide valve-pump separation, confirm leak source fully contained, and inspect wing tank/pump area before next task card is opened.
summary: During precautionary defuel and fuel pump removal on Aircraft X, the slide valve failed to separate from the pump as designed, causing a wing fuel leak requiring emergency response.

narrative_text: Ndege X (A321) ilipunguziwa mafuta kutoka lbs 22,000 hadi 13,000 kama tahadhari kabla ya kuondoa fuel pump ya bawa la kulia (INBD) iliyokuwa na uvujaji. Mafuta yalihamishwa kusawazisha matangi kabla fundi hajaanza kuondoa pump kwa mujibu wa AMM, lakini wakati wa kuiondoa, slide valve haikutengana na pump kama inavyotakiwa, na pump haikuweza kurudishwa mahali pake, hivyo kusababisha uvujaji wa mafuta kutoka kwenye bawa. Timu ilitumia spill kits na zimamoto waliarifiwa mara moja. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kagua utaratibu wa AMM kuhusu kutotengana kwa slide valve na pump, thibitisha uvujaji umezimwa kabisa, na kagua eneo la tangi la bawa kabla ya kazi nyingine kuendelea.
summary: Wakati wa kuondoa fuel pump baada ya kupunguza mafuta kwa tahadhari kwenye Ndege X, slide valve haikutengana na pump kama ilivyopangwa, na kusababisha uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye bawa uliohitaji hatua za dharura.

entities.text: fuel pump ya bawa la kulia (INBD)

narrative_text: Aircraft X (A321) tuli-defuel kutoka 22,000 lbs mpaka 13,000 lbs kama precaution kabla ya kutoa ile RH wing INBD fuel pump iliyokuwa na leak. Fuel ilihamishwa ku-balance matangi before mechanic ku-start removal per AMM, lakini during removal, ile slide valve haiku-separate na pump kama inavyotakiwa, so pump haiku-reseat vizuri na ikasababisha fuel leak kwa wing - tuli-call spill kits na fire department wakanotifiwa immediately. Follow-up inahitajika: check AMM procedure kuhusu hii slide valve/pump design issue, confirm leak imezimwa fully, na inspect wing tank area kabla ya next task card kufunguliwa.
summary: Wakati wa fuel pump removal baada ya precautionary defuel kwa Aircraft X, slide valve haikutoka separate na pump kama designed, na kusababisha fuel leak kwa wing iliyohitaji emergency response.

narrative_text: Handover from midnight shift on the B757-200 left engine lube pump change: verbal turnover confirmed only the oil tank and gearbox drain plugs were safetied, but the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut safety holes were missed during reinstallation and left un-safetied. Pump was replaced, oil tank serviced, leak and operational checks completed with no issues noted, and logbook was signed off before return to gate. Next shift must verify safety wire on the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut given the missed step, especially since the aircraft later had an in-flight shutdown of the left engine after oil pressure loss.
summary: A missed safety wire on the #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut during a B757-200 left engine lube pump change led to an in-flight engine shutdown, and follow-up verification is required.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mkabidhi kutoka zamu ya usiku kuhusu kubadilishwa kwa pump ya lube kwenye engine ya kushoto ya B757-200, ilielezwa kuwa safety wire ziliwekwa tu kwenye oil tank na gearbox drain plugs. Hata hivyo, wakati wa kufunga tena #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut, matundu ya safety wire hayakuonekana hivyo haikuwekwa waya wa usalama. Kazi zote za ukaguzi wa leak na uendeshaji zilikamilika bila tatizo na logbook ilisainiwa kabla ndege kurudi kwenye gate. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kuwa B-nut hiyo ina safety wire, kwani baadaye engine ya kushoto ilizimika ikiwa angani kutokana na kupungua kwa mafuta ya oil.
summary: Kukosekana kwa waya wa usalama kwenye #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut wakati wa ukarabati wa engine ya B757-200 kulisababisha kuzimika kwa engine ikiwa angani, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika.

narrative_text: Kwa handover kutoka night shift kwenye lube pump change ya L engine, B757-200, waliniambia safety wire iliwekwa tu kwenye oil tank na gearbox drain plugs. Ple, tukiwa na day shift mech tunafanya reinstall ya #5 bearing scavenge tube, nikamiss zile safety holes za B-nut, so haikuwa safety wired. Leak check na operational check zote zilipass, tuka-sign off logbook kabla ndege kurudi gate. Next shift wanahitaji kucheck hiyo B-nut ina safety wire, coz baadaye kuna IFSD ya L engine angani, oil pressure ikadrop kabisa.
summary: Kuna missed safety wire kwenye #5 bearing scavenge tube B-nut baada ya lube pump change kwenye B757-200, na hiyo ndio ilisababisha IFSD, so follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: A319 TRF vibration sensor replacement was completed per AMM 77-31-30-400 up to Step 9 (Close-Up), but final closeout paperwork was not finished due to shift-turnover confusion, a Mechanic needing help with the MEL Call Horn (Interphone) swap, and Manager pressure to move the aircraft to the gate during heavy rain. Logbook was requested before entries were complete and paperwork got disorganized during handover. Next shift must verify Step 9 close-up is signed off, confirm logbook entries are accurate/complete, and check status of the Call Horn/Interphone MEL item before dispatch.
summary: Incomplete closeout paperwork on an A319 after TRF vibration sensor replacement, caused by shift-change confusion and weather-related time pressure, needs verification by next shift.

narrative_text: Ubadilishaji wa TRF vibration sensor kwenye ndege ya A319 ulifanyika kwa kufuata AMM 77-31-30-400 hadi Step 9 (Close-Up), lakini karatasi za mwisho hazikukamilika kwa sababu ya msukosuko wa mabadiliko ya zamu, Fundi mwingine alihitaji msaada kubadilisha Call Horn iliyokuwa MEL, na Meneja alisisitiza ndege ipelekwe getini haraka wakati wa mvua kubwa. Logbook ilihitajika kabla maandishi hayajakamilika na karatasi zikaharibika mpangilio wakati wa mkabidhiano. Zamu inayokuja inapaswa kuthibitisha kama Step 9 imesainiwa, kuangalia usahihi wa maandishi ya logbook, na kuhakiki hali ya Call Horn/Interphone kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Karatasi za mwisho za kazi ya A319 hazikukamilika baada ya kubadilisha TRF vibration sensor, kwa sababu ya msukosuko wa zamu na shinikizo la muda kutokana na mvua, hivyo zinahitaji kuangaliwa na zamu inayofuata.

narrative_text: Tulikamilisha replacement ya TRF vibration sensor kwa A319 kufuata AMM 77-31-30-400 mpaka Step 9 (Close-Up), lakini closeout paperwork haikukamilika kwa sababu ya confusion ya shift turnover, mmoja wa Mechanic alihitaji msaada wa kubadilisha Call Horn (Interphone) ambayo ilikuwa MEL, na Manager alikuwa akipush aircraft ipelekwe gate 'now' wakati wa heavy rain. Logbook ilihitajika before entries zikamilike, na paperwork ikaenda disarray during handover. Next shift wajaribu kuconfirm kama Step 9 close-up imesignwa, kucheck logbook entries ziko complete, na kuverify status ya Call Horn/Interphone MEL item before dispatch.
summary: A319 ilikuwa na incomplete paperwork baada ya TRF vibration sensor replacement, caused na shift-change confusion pamoja na time pressure kutoka kwa weather, hivyo inahitaji follow-up na next shift.

narrative_text: Took over logbook closeout for the B767-300 from the outgoing Lead Mechanic after a rushed handover with seven aircraft OTS; reviewed the work package and accountability sheet and cleared the one outstanding item, believing everything else was accounted for. This morning it was found that two MEL items had been signed off on the Maintenance Report but never actually entered into the aircraft logbook. Next shift please verify logbook entries against the Maintenance Report for this tail number before further dispatch, and ensure a proper verbal turnover is done between Lead Mechanics on busy shifts.
summary: Incoming Lead Mechanic closed out a B767-300 logbook after a rushed turnover and missed two MEL items that were signed off but never entered into the logbook.

narrative_text: Nilipokea jukumu la kufunga logbook ya B767-300 kutoka kwa Lead Mechanic aliyekuwa akiondoka, turnover ikiwa ya haraka kwa sababu ndege saba zilikuwa hazifanyi kazi (OTS) siku hiyo. Nilipitia work package na accountability sheet, nikaona kila kitu kimesainiwa isipokuwa kipengele kimoja ambacho nilikifunga mwenyewe. Asubuhi hii imegundulika kuwa vipengele viwili vya MEL vilisainiwa kwenye Maintenance Report lakini havikuwahi kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuhakiki logbook dhidi ya Maintenance Report kabla ya ndege hiyo kutumika tena, na kuhakikisha turnover kamili inafanyika kati ya Lead Mechanics wakati wa siku zenye shughuli nyingi.
summary: Lead Mechanic aliyeingia zamu alifunga logbook ya B767-300 baada ya turnover ya haraka na kukosa kuona vipengele viwili vya MEL vilivyosainiwa lakini havikuandikwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: Nili-take over closeout ya logbook ya B767-300 kutoka kwa Lead Mechanic aliyekuwa anaenda home, lakini turnover ilikuwa ya haraka sana coz tulikuwa na seven aircraft OTS siku hiyo. Ni-review work package na accountability sheet, kila kitu kimeonekana signed-for except item moja ambayo ni-clear mwenyewe. Leo asubuhi tumepata report kwamba MEL items mbili zilikuwa signed-off kwenye Maintenance Report lakini hazikuwahi ku-enter kwenye logbook. Next shift please mu-verify logbook against Maintenance Report kabla ya kuendelea na dispatch, na tuhakikishe tuna-do proper verbal turnover kati ya Lead Mechanics especially siku za busy namna hii.
summary: Lead Mechanic ali-close logbook ya B767-300 after rushed turnover na aka-miss MEL items mbili ambazo zilikuwa signed-off lakini hazikuingizwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: A320, engine #2: VSV actuator was removed and reinstalled per AMM procedure, and idle leak check was performed with no leaks noted at the time. Verbal turnover was given to the oncoming shift, but once the aircraft was on blocks a discrepancy was noted with the installation. Next shift needs to re-verify the VSV actuator rigging and confirm proper installation before further dispatch.
summary: VSV actuator on engine #2 was reinstalled and checked with no leaks noted, but a discrepancy was later found on blocks requiring re-verification.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A320, actuator ya VSV kwenye injini namba mbili iliondolewa na kuwekwa tena kulingana na taratibu za AMM, na ukaguzi wa uvujaji wakati wa idle ulifanyika bila kuonekana tatizo lolote wakati huo. Taarifa ilitolewa kwa mdomo kwa zamu iliyofuata, lakini ndege ilipokuwa imesimama sehemu ya maegesho, hitilafu iligundulika kwenye ufungaji huo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kukagua tena ufungaji wa actuator ya VSV na kuhakikisha imewekwa sawasawa kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Actuator ya VSV kwenye injini namba mbili ilifungwa upya bila hitilafu wakati wa ukaguzi, lakini baadaye tatizo liligunduliwa likihitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji wakati wa idle

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320, engine #2, tuli-remove na kuinstall VSV actuator kulingana na AMM, then tukafanya idle leak check, hakuna leaks zilizoonekana that time. Nilitoa verbal turnover kwa oncoming shift, lakini aircraft ilipokuwa on blocks tukagundua kuna discrepancy kwa installation. Next shift wanahitaji ku-recheck rigging ya VSV actuator na kuconfirm installation before dispatch.
summary: VSV actuator ya engine #2 ili-installed sawa na leak check ilipita, lakini discrepancy iligundulika later on blocks na inahitaji recheck.

narrative_text: MD-80 nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin was found protruding in flight even though gear was up and locked; contract maintenance worked on it overnight and short-signed that gear pins were installed. On arrival we jacked the aircraft per maintenance control instructions and, after a shift change on their end, were told to open everything up and check for rubbing or catching; multiple gear swings showed no fault and the pin cycled correctly each time. Follow-up needed: contract tech later admitted safeties were broken and the system was adjusted and swing-tested overnight, none of which was documented, so rigging and safety wire on the NLG system still need to be verified and all work properly logged.
summary: Undocumented contract maintenance work on an MD-80 nose gear indicator system led to an incomplete handover and unverified rigging/safety checks.

entities.text: nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin

narrative_text: Ndege ya MD-80 ilikuwa na tatizo kwenye pini ya kiashiria cha gia la mbele (nose landing gear) ambayo ilionekana ikitokeza wakati wa safari ya anga hata ingawa gia lilikuwa juu na limefungwa vizuri. Fundi wa kampuni ya kandarasi alifanya kazi usiku kucha na kutia sahihi kwa kifupi kuwa pini za gia zimewekwa, kisha sisi tulipofika tuliagizwa na kituo cha udhibiti wa matengenezo kuinua ndege na kufanya ukaguzi wa jumla baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu upande wao. Tulikagua kila sehemu, tukalizungusha gia mara nyingi bila kupata hitilafu, lakini baadaye tuligundua kuwa fundi wa kandarasi alikuwa amevunja usalama (safeties) na kurekebisha mfumo bila kuandika chochote kwenye rekodi; jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuhakikisha urekebishaji na hati za usalama vimekaguliwa upya na kuandikwa ipasavyo.
summary: Kazi ya matengenezo ya kandarasi kwenye mfumo wa kiashiria cha gia la mbele la ndege ya MD-80 haikuandikwa, hivyo kusababisha mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu na hitaji la ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: pini ya kiashiria cha gia la mbele

narrative_text: Kwenye hii MD-80, ile nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin ilikuwa inaonekana ikitokeza wakati wa flight ingawa gear ilikuwa up and locked, na contract maintenance tech alifanya kazi mpaka usiku ukiisha na aka-short sign kwamba gear pins zimewekwa. Tulipofika, maintenance control walituambia tu-jack ndege na baada ya shift change upande wao tukaambiwa tuopen up na tuangalie kama kuna kitu kina-catch au ku-rub; tulifanya gear swings kadhaa but hakuna prob tuliyoipata, pin ilikuwa inafanya kazi sawasawa kila mara. Shida ni kwamba baadaye tuligundua contract tech alikuwa ame-break safeties na ku-adjust system halafu aka-swing test bila kudocument chochote, kwa hivyo tunahitaji kufuatilia rigging na safety wire za NLG system na kuhakikisha kila kitu kime-log properly.
summary: Contract maintenance walifanya kazi kwenye MD-80 nose gear indicator system bila documentation, na hii imesababisha communication gap wakati wa handover inayohitaji follow-up.

entities.text: nose landing gear down-and-locked indicator pin

narrative_text: Completed nose landing gear replacement steps on the DC-9, including cylinder attachment, nosewheel install, strut servicing and lubrication, then assisted with rigging the ground sense control cables and nose gear steering system due to tight access in the wheel well. Nose gear steering functional check was done before end of shift, but landing gear retract/extension functional check and gear door reinstallation were not completed and are handed over to the incoming mechanic. Note: rigging procedure for the ground sense/steering system in the maintenance manual is easy to misread given the confined work area, so double-check cable tension charts before running the retract check.
summary: Nose gear replacement on the DC-9 was left mid-task with the retract/extension functional check and gear door reinstallation pending for the next shift.

narrative_text: Nimekamilisha hatua za kubadilisha nose landing gear kwenye DC-9, ikiwemo kuunganisha silinda, kufunga nosewheel, kuweka mafuta na kuhudumia strut, kisha nikamsaidia fundi mwenzangu kurekebisha nyaya za ground sense control na mfumo wa uongozaji wa nose gear kwa sababu nafasi ya kufanyia kazi kwenye wheel well ni finyu. Ukaguzi wa utendaji wa uongozaji wa nose gear umefanyika kabla ya shift kuisha, lakini ukaguzi wa retract/extension wa landing gear na kufunga tena milango ya gear haujakamilika, hivyo kazi hiyo inabaki kwa shift inayokuja. Tahadhari: taratibu za maandiko ya matengenezo kuhusu urekebishaji wa mfumo wa ground sense zinaweza kuchanganya kwa urahisi kwa sababu ya nafasi finyu, hivyo angalia vizuri chati za mvutano wa nyaya kabla ya kufanya ukaguzi wa retract.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha nose landing gear ya DC-9 imesalia nusu, huku ukaguzi wa retract/extension na milango ya gear ikibaki kwa shift inayokuja.

entities.text: mfumo wa uongozaji wa nose gear
ukaguzi wa retract/extension wa landing gear

narrative_text: Nilikamilisha steps za nose landing gear replacement kwenye DC-9 — cylinder attachment, nosewheel install, strut servicing na lubrication zote done. Baadaye nikamsaidia fundi mwingine na rigging ya ground sense control cables na nose gear steering system, kwa sababu access kwenye wheel well ilikuwa tight sana. Nose gear steering functional check tulifanya kabla shift yangu kuisha, lakini landing gear retract/extension functional check na kurudisha gear doors bado, so it's on the next mechanic. Kitu moja tu, ile rigging procedure ya ground sense system kwenye maintenance manual ni rahisi kuchanganya, so double-check cable tension charts kabla ya kuendelea na retract check.
summary: Nose gear replacement kwenye DC-9 imesalia mid-task, na retract/extension check pamoja na gear doors zinabaki kwa next shift.

narrative_text: ERJ 145 nose gear sliding tube seals were replaced on nightshift after a strut leak write-up, and reinstallation of the strut assembly was carried over to dayshift per Embraer AMM 32-20-08. Inspector and AMT completed the reinstall and aircraft was released, but the first flight had an air turnback due to an AIR/LDG IND EICAS message with gear selected up; override worked and gear was down and locked for landing.
