Later teardown found the centering upper cam 90 degrees out; note that the AMM does not call for a gear extension/retraction or WOW check after this seal replacement, so next shift should verify cam alignment and push for a procedure review.
summary: A nose gear seal reinstallation on an ERJ 145 was missed on cam alignment, causing an air turnback, and the maintenance manual gap needs follow-up.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya ERJ 145, mihuri ya bomba la nose gear ilibadilishwa zamu ya usiku baada ya ripoti ya kuvuja kwa strut, na kazi ya kurudisha strut ile ilihamishiwa zamu ya mchana kwa mujibu wa mwongozo wa Embraer 32-20-08. Inspekta na fundi walimaliza kazi hiyo na ndege ikaruhusiwa kurudi kazini, lakini safari ya kwanza ilirudi uwanjani kutokana na ujumbe wa EICAS wa AIR/LDG IND wakati gear ilikuwa imewekwa juu; mfumo wa override ulifanya kazi vizuri na gear ilishuka na kufungwa vizuri kabla ya kutua. Baadaye, ukaguzi wa kina ulionyesha kuwa centering upper cam ilikuwa imegeuka digrii 90 kimakosa; kwa kuwa mwongozo haujataja ukaguzi wa gear extension/retraction au WOW baada ya kazi hii, zamu inayofuata ihakikishe mpangilio wa cam na itafute marekebisho ya taratibu.
summary: Ukarabati wa mihuri ya nose gear katika ERJ 145 ulikosea mpangilio wa cam na kusababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, hivyo mwongozo wa matengenezo unahitaji kuangaliwa upya.

entities.text: mihuri ya bomba la nose gear

narrative_text: Sasa hii ERJ 145, nose gear sliding tube seals zilibadilishwa night shift baada ya pilot report ya strut kuvuja, na reinstallation ya strut assembly ikaachwa turnover kwa dayshift, tukifuata Embraer AMM 32-20-08. Inspector na AMT walimaliza ile task, aircraft ikarudi service, lakini first flight ikawa na air turnback kwa sababu ya AIR/LDG IND message kwenye EICAS wakati gear ilikuwa selected up; override ilifanya kazi sawa na gear ikawa down and locked kwa landing. Baadaye teardown ilionyesha centering upper cam iko 90 degrees out - manual haina requirement ya gear extension/retraction au WOW check baada ya hii seal replacement, so next shift wahakikishe cam alignment na tuangalie hii procedure gap.
summary: Kuna ERJ 145 ambayo ilikuwa na air turnback baada ya nose gear cam kukosewa alignment wakati wa reinstall, so tunahitaji follow-up kwenye manual procedure.

narrative_text: During the 100-hour inspection on the CRJ200 (Ref X), the left-hand landing gear uplock roller was found not moving freely, so the uplock brackets and roller pin were replaced per the CMM. It was later discovered the uplock brackets were mistakenly installed upside down. Next shift must perform a full gear swing before release to confirm correct installation and free movement of the uplock roller.
summary: Incorrectly installed (upside-down) left landing gear uplock brackets on a CRJ200 require a gear swing check before the aircraft can be released.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa mia moja kwenye ndege ya CRJ200 (Ref X), roller ya uplock kwenye gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto ilionekana haisogei vizuri, hivyo brackets za uplock pamoja na pin ya roller zilibadilishwa kufuatana na CMM. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa brackets za uplock ziliwekwa kimakosa zikiwa zimegeuzwa chini juu. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufanya gear swing kikamilifu kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuruka, ili kuhakikisha ufungaji ni sahihi na roller inasogea kama inavyotakiwa.
summary: Brackets za uplock kwenye gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto wa ndege ya CRJ200 ziliwekwa kimakosa hivyo gear swing inahitajika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege.

entities.text: gia ya kutua upande wa kushoto

narrative_text: Wakati wa 100-hour inspection kwenye CRJ200 (Ref X), tuligundua left-hand landing gear uplock roller haiku-move freely kama inavyotakiwa, so tuli-replace uplock brackets na roller pin kama CMM inavyosema. Lakini turns out brackets za uplock zili-install upside down bila kukusudia. Zamu inayofuata lazima ifanye gear swing kabla ya release, kuhakikisha installation ni sahihi na roller inasogea properly.
summary: Uplock brackets kwenye left landing gear ya CRJ200 zili-install upside down, hivyo gear swing inahitajika before release.

narrative_text: During the time-change task on the right overwing escape slide bottle, removal and installation steps per the AMM and work card were completed, then handed over to avionics for the squib continuity check. While performing the continuity test, the avionics tech inadvertently fired the bottle, deploying the slide; supervisor was notified immediately. Investigation showed the work card did not specify which AMM subtask to use for the test, and the work card/AMM references appear to conflict. Follow-up: update the work card to reference the correct continuity-check subtask and clarify procedure before further slide bottle time changes.
summary: A right overwing slide bottle was inadvertently fired during a squib continuity check because the work card lacked clear AMM subtask guidance, causing unintended slide deployment.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha chupa ya slide ya dharura upande wa juu wa bawa la kulia, hatua za kuondoa na kufunga kulingana na AMM na work card zilikamilika, kisha kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa timu ya avionics kufanya continuity check ya squib. Wakati wa kupima continuity, fundi wa avionics kwa bahati mbaya alisababisha chupa kulipuka na slide kutoka; msimamizi alijulishwa mara moja. Uchunguzi ulionyesha kuwa work card haikueleza wazi subtask gani ya AMM ya kutumia, na kuna mgongano kati ya maelekezo ya work card na AMM. Ufuatiliaji unahitajika: work card isasishwe ili ionyeshe subtask sahihi ya continuity check kabla ya kazi nyingine za namna hii kufanyika.
summary: Chupa ya slide ya dharura ililipuka bila kukusudiwa wakati wa continuity check kwa sababu work card haikuonyesha wazi subtask sahihi ya AMM.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya time change ya right overwing slide bottle, tukamaliza removal na installation steps kulingana na AMM na work card, then tukahand over kwa avionics wafanye squib continuity check. Sasa wakati wanafanya hiyo test, kwa bahati mbaya avionics tech aka-fire bottle na slide ikadeploy; tuli-notify supervisor immediately. Turns out work card haiko clear kuhusu ni subtask gani ya AMM ya kutumia, kuna conflict kati ya work card na AMM references. Follow-up: hio work card i-update ionyeshe correct subtask ya continuity check kabla ya kufanya another slide bottle time change.
summary: Slide bottle ilideploy bila kupangwa wakati wa continuity check kwa sababu work card haikuwa clear kuhusu correct AMM subtask.

narrative_text: An A321 received a last-minute hazmat/restricted-article shipment plane-side just before flight closure, and as crew chief I accepted it without realizing it could be refused. This forced the ramp crew to close the aft cargo and reopen the forward hold to load it, since that is the only compliant position on this aircraft type. At departure the restricted article was not reflected on the final load sheet; I completed the NOTOC but the final was not updated, so loads had to be called to reopen and rescan the item before refinalizing. Next shift should confirm any hazmat handling training gaps and verify final load sheet reconciliation procedures are being followed.
summary: A crew chief accepted a late hazmat shipment on an A321 without proper reconciliation with the final load sheet, causing delay and requiring the flight to be reopened and rescanned before departure.

narrative_text: Ndege ya aina ya A321 ilipokea mzigo wa hatari (hazmat) muda mfupi kabla ya kufunga safari, na kama crew chief nilipokea mzigo huo bila kujua kwamba ningeweza kuukataa. Hali hiyo ilisababisha wafanyakazi wa uwanjani kufunga cargo ya nyuma na kufungua tena cargo ya mbele ili kuweka mzigo huo, kwa kuwa hapo ndipo pekee panapofaa kwa aina hii ya ndege. Wakati wa kuondoka, ilibainika kuwa kipengele hicho cha hatari hakikuwa kimeonekana kwenye final load sheet, hivyo ilibidi kupigiwa simu idara ya mizigo kufungua tena safari, ku-scan mzigo huo, na kukamilisha upya taratibu za mwisho. Zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuhakikisha mafunzo kuhusu mizigo ya hatari yameimarishwa na taratibu za uhakiki wa final load sheet zinafuatwa ipasavyo.
summary: Crew chief alipokea mzigo wa hatari kwa dharura kwenye ndege ya A321 bila kuujumuisha vizuri kwenye final load sheet, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji na kufunguliwa upya kwa safari kabla ya kuondoka.

narrative_text: Kuna A321 ilipata hazmat shipment last minute plane-side, na mimi kama crew chief nilipokea bila kujua niko na option ya ku-refuse. Iyo ikafanya crew wa ramp wa-close aft cargo halafu wa-reopen front cargo ndio wa-load hiyo hazmat, coz kwa hii aircraft ndio pekee position inayoruhusiwa. Time ya departure ikaonekana restricted article haikuwa imeshow kwenye final load sheet, nilikua nimefanya NOTOC lakini system haiku-update final, so tulilazimika ku-call loads wa-reopen flight, wa-scan item na ku-finalize tena. Next shift wanafaa kucheki kama kuna training gap ya hazmat na kuhakikisha final load sheet inareconcile properly kabla ya closure.
summary: Crew chief alipokea hazmat shipment last minute kwenye A321 bila kuupdate final load sheet vizuri, na hiyo ikasababisha delay na kufunguliwa upya kwa flight kabla ya departure.

narrative_text: B737-700 lost its aft lower #2 VHF antenna in flight; FAA inspectors traced the install record to a tech whose employee number was on the tag, but he only prepped/cleaned the mount surface before shift change, and another mechanic completed the actual installation. Records do not clearly show who torqued the final fasteners or confirmed screw length per the mesh-gasket tip sheet, so the cause of separation remains unexplained. Next shift needs to pull the full install history and fastener torque sequence for this tail number, and confirm with the mechanic who took over the job at shift change.
summary: A B737-700 lost its VHF antenna in flight, and handover records are unclear on who completed the final installation steps, requiring further investigation into torque and fastener procedures.

entities.text: pull the full install history and fastener torque sequence

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilipoteza antenna ya VHF (ya nyuma chini) ikiwa angani; wakaguzi wa FAA walifuatilia rekodi ya usakinishaji hadi kwa fundi ambaye namba yake ya kazi ilikuwa kwenye tagi, lakini alisema alifanya tu usafishaji na maandalizi ya sehemu ya kuunganisha kabla ya zamu kubadilika, na fundi mwingine ndiye aliyemaliza kazi ya kufunga antenna. Rekodi hazionyeshi wazi ni nani alifunga fasteners za mwisho kwa nguvu (torque) sahihi au kuthibitisha urefu wa screws kulingana na maelekezo ya gasket ya mesh, hivyo sababu halisi ya antenna kuanguka bado haijulikani. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kupitia upya historia kamili ya usakinishaji na mfululizo wa torque ya fasteners kwa ndege hii, na kuwasiliana na fundi aliyemaliza kazi hiyo baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 ilipoteza antenna yake ya VHF angani, na rekodi za zamu hazionyeshi wazi ni nani alikamilisha usakinishaji, hivyo uchunguzi zaidi wa taratibu za torque na fasteners unahitajika.

entities.text: kupitia upya historia kamili ya usakinishaji

narrative_text: Ile B737-700 ilipoteza #2 VHF antenna ya aft lower ikiwa in flight; FAA inspectors walifuatilia install record hadi kwa fundi ambaye employee number yake ilikuwa kwenye tag, lakini alisema ni yeye alifanya tu prep na cleaning ya mount surface kabla ya shift change, halafu mechanic mwingine ndiye alicomplete installation. Records hazi-show clearly ni nani alitorque final fasteners au akaconfirm screw length kulingana na mesh-gasket tip sheet, so cause ya separation bado haiko clear. Next shift wanahitaji ku-pull full install history na torque sequence ya fasteners kwa hii tail number, na ku-confirm na yule mechanic aliyechukua job baada ya shift change.
summary: B737-700 ilipoteza VHF antenna ikiwa in flight, na handover records hazi-clarify vizuri ni nani alicomplete installation, so follow-up inahitajika kwa torque na fastener procedures.

entities.text: ku-pull full install history na torque sequence

narrative_text: On the B737, after full replacement of the LEAP-1B fuel nozzles, the idle leak check came back clean for fuel but showed an oil leak. During the follow-up 70% part power run using the bag method at the drain lines, a significant fuel leak developed in the hot section. Current EA does not require a nitrogen leak check with test solution before power runs, and this needs to be escalated since a similar hot section fire was reported weeks ago. Next shift: follow up on request to revise EA to require either a high power run or proper nitrogen leak-check tooling, and check status of ordered leak detector liquid.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement on a B737 revealed a hot-section fuel leak during power run testing, prompting a request to revise engineering authorization for stricter leak checks.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737, baada ya kubadilisha fuel nozzles zote za injini ya LEAP-1B, ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa idle ulionyesha hakuna mvujo wa mafuta ya ndege lakini kulikuwa na mvujo wa oil. Wakati wa jaribio la pili la 70% power kwa kutumia njia ya bag kwenye drain lines, mvujo mkubwa wa mafuta ulionekana kwenye hot section. Utaratibu wa sasa wa EA hauhitaji ukaguzi wa uvujaji kwa nitrogen kabla ya majaribio hayo, jambo ambalo linahitaji kufuatiliwa haraka kwani tukio kama hili la moto kwenye hot section liliripotiwa wiki chache zilizopita. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie ombi la kurekebisha EA ili kudai jaribio la high power au vifaa sahihi vya ukaguzi wa nitrogen, na iangalie hali ya maji ya kugundua uvujaji yaliyoagizwa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa fuel nozzles kwenye ndege ya B737 ulisababisha mvujo wa mafuta kwenye hot section wakati wa jaribio la power, hivyo kuhitajika marekebisho ya haraka ya taratibu za ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737, baada ya kufanya replacement ya fuel nozzles zote za LEAP-1B, ile idle leak check ilikuwa clean kwa fuel lakini ikaonyesha oil leak. Wakati wa 70% part power run tukitumia bag method kwenye drain lines, kuka-develop fuel leak kubwa kwenye hot section. Sasa hivi EA haitaki nitrogen leak check na test solution kabla ya power run, na hii inafaa iangaliwe haraka kwa sababu kuna report ya hot section fire ya wiki chache zilizopita. Shift inayofuata i-follow up ombi la ku-revise EA ili idai high power run au proper nitrogen tooling, na icheck status ya leak detector liquid iliyo-order.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement kwenye B737 ilisababisha fuel leak kwenye hot section wakati wa power run, hivyo kunahitajika EA revision haraka.

narrative_text: Fire extinguisher bottle squibs are again arriving from vendors without proper ESD shunt caps installed, only a non-ESD plastic cover, and the shipping cartons are labeled as nonflammable gas with no explosive hazard marking. This was flagged before when shunt cap stock was down to one unit and techs were told to fabricate caps under a supplement due to no inventory. Next shift needs to hold any CRJ200 squib work until shunts are confirmed on hand, and follow up with vendors/shipping dept on proper squib handling and carton labeling.
summary: Fire extinguisher squibs are being received/shipped without proper shunt caps and hazard labeling, requiring vendor education and inventory follow-up.

narrative_text: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto zinaendelea kuletwa na wauzaji bila shunt caps za ESD, badala yake zina kifuniko cha plastiki cha kawaida tu, na masanduku ya usafirishaji yameandikwa kuwa na gesi isiyoshika moto pekee bila alama ya hatari ya mlipuko. Suala hili liliwahi kuripotiwa awali wakati akiba ya shunt caps ilipopungua hadi moja, na mafundi waliambiwa watengeneze caps zao kupitia nyongeza ya maelekezo kwa sababu hakukuwa na akiba ya kutosha. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kusitisha kazi yoyote ya squib kwa ndege za CRJ200 mpaka shunt caps zithibitishwe zipo, na kufuatilia na wauzaji pamoja na idara ya usafirishaji kuhusu utunzaji sahihi wa squibs na uwekaji lebo ya hatari kwenye masanduku.
summary: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto zinapokelewa na kusafirishwa bila shunt caps sahihi na lebo ya hatari, hivyo kuhitaji elimu kwa wauzaji na ufuatiliaji wa akiba.

entities.text: Squibs za chupa za kuzimia moto

narrative_text: Hizi squibs za fire extinguisher bottles zinaendelea kuletwa na vendors bila shunt caps za ESD, ni plastic cap ya kawaida tu, na cartons zimewekewa label ya nonflammable gas tu bila kuonyesha ni explosive hazard. Hii ilishawahi kuripotiwa before, wakati stock ya shunt caps ilikuwa moja tu, na tukaambiwa tu-fabricate caps kwa supplement kwa sababu ya no inventory. Zamu ijayo lazima ihold squib work yoyote ya CRJ200 mpaka shunts zithibitishwe ziko in-house, na tufuatilie na vendors na shipping dept kuhusu proper handling na labeling ya cartons.
summary: Squibs za fire extinguisher bottles zinakuja bila proper shunt caps na hazard labeling, hivyo inahitajika vendor education na inventory follow-up.

narrative_text: Fan blade #4 was installed on the #1 engine of the A320 using paperwork left over from a previous shift, and the retaining ring illustration in the maintenance manual was unclear, causing a row of securing fasteners to be omitted. The engine run afterward showed excessive vibration, and the next crew found the missing bolts when pulling the spinner to add weights. Handover between the foreman and lead was inconsistent, with each tech getting different information, and the fasteners were left loose in cups instead of bagged/tagged with the part; please verify fastener kits are properly labeled and confirm full turnover briefing before any follow-on fan blade work.
summary: Incomplete retaining ring fastener installation on an A320 #1 engine fan blade, caused by unclear manual illustration and inconsistent shift handover, led to excessive vibration and required rework by the next crew.

narrative_text: Blade ya fani namba 4 kwenye engine ya kwanza ya ndege ya A320 ilifungwa kwa kutumia karatasi za kazi zilizobaki kutoka shift iliyopita, na picha ya jinsi ya kufunga retaining ring kwenye maintenance manual haikuwa wazi, hivyo safu moja ya bolti za kufunga ikakosekana. Baada ya kufanya engine run, mtetemo mkubwa uligundulika, na wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata walipata bolti zilizokosekana walipokuwa wakitoa spinner kuongeza uzito. Mawasiliano kati ya foreman na lead yalikuwa hayaeleweki vizuri kwani kila fundi alipewa maelezo tofauti, na bolti zenyewe zilikuwa zimewekwa kwenye vikombe bila kuandikwa lebo au kufungwa pamoja na kipande chake; tafadhali hakikisheni bolti zote zina lebo sahihi na kwamba maelezo kamili ya turnover yanatolewa kabla ya kazi yoyote ya blade kufanywa tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa bolti za kufunga retaining ring kwenye fan blade ya engine ya kwanza ya A320, kulikosababishwa na picha isiyo wazi kwenye manual na mawasiliano mabovu ya shift, kulisababisha mtetemo mkubwa na kazi ya kurekebisha kufanywa na shift nyingine.

narrative_text: Tuliinstall fan blade #4 kwa #1 engine ya A320 tukitumia paperwork iliyobaki kutoka shift ya jana, na hiyo illustration ya retaining ring kwenye maintenance manual haikuwa clear, hivyo tukamiss row moja ya fasteners. Baada ya engine run tukapata excessive vibration, halafu crew ya next shift wakakuta zile bolts missing wakati wanapull spinner kuadd weights. Handover kati ya foreman na lead haikuwa sawa, kila AMT alipewa turnover tofauti, na hizo fasteners zilikuwa zimewekwa tu kwa cups bila kubagged wala kutagged kwa part yake; tafadhali verify ma-kit ya fasteners yamewekwa labeled sawasawa na turnover ifanywe properly kabla ya kufanya fan blade job tena.
summary: Fasteners za retaining ring zilimiss kwa fan blade ya #1 engine ya A320 kwa sababu ya illustration mbovu kwenye manual na handover isiyo clear, hivyo ikasababisha vibration excessive na rework na next crew.

narrative_text: During tow-in from the gate to the hangar, Aircraft X's left winglet contacted Aircraft Y's right winglet while being guided by the marshaller at the lead-in line; the marshaller believed clearance was adequate but a jolt was felt just before the stop signal was given. Flight deck crew set brakes, shut down both engines, and notified Ramp Control and the supervisor once contact was suspected. Post-shutdown inspection confirmed winglet-to-winglet and strakelet-to-strakelet contact; area has been secured pending damage assessment. Follow-up needed: coordinate with maintenance to inspect both aircraft, review marshalling clearance procedures, and debrief flight deck/ground communication breakdown.
summary: Winglet-to-winglet contact occurred between two aircraft during a hangar tow-in due to a marshalling clearance misjudgment, requiring inspection and procedural review.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuvuta ndege kutoka geti hadi hangarini, ncha ya bawa la kushoto la Ndege X iligusana na ncha ya bawa la kulia la Ndege Y wakati zikiongozwa na marshaller kwenye mstari wa kuingilia; marshaller alidhani nafasi ilikuwa ya kutosha lakini wafanyakazi wa ndani ya ndege walihisi mtikisiko kabla ya ishara ya kusimama kutolewa. Wafanyakazi wa flight deck waliweka breki, wakazima injini zote mbili, na kuwajulisha Ramp Control pamoja na msimamizi mara tu waliposhuku mgusano huo. Ukaguzi baada ya kuzima ulithibitisha mgusano wa ncha za mabawa na strakelet, na eneo limefungwa likisubiri tathmini ya uharibifu. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuratibu na idara ya matengenezo kukagua ndege zote mbili, kupitia taratibu za umbali wa usalama wakati wa uongozaji, na kufanya mazungumzo ya kina kuhusu mawasiliano baina ya flight deck na wafanyakazi wa ardhini.
summary: Mgusano wa ncha za mabawa ulitokea kati ya ndege mbili wakati wa kuvutwa kuelekea hangarini kutokana na makadirio mabaya ya nafasi na marshaller, hivyo ukaguzi na mapitio ya taratibu yanahitajika.

narrative_text: Wakati wa tow-in kutoka gate kwenda hangar, left winglet ya Aircraft X iligonga right winglet ya Aircraft Y wakati marshaller alikuwa akiongoza kwenye lead-in line; marshaller alidhani clearance ilikuwa sawa lakini crew walisikia jolt kidogo before stop signal ipewe. Flight deck crew waliweka brakes, wakazima both engines, halafu wakanotify Ramp Control na supervisor mara tu waliposhuku kuna contact imetokea. Baada ya shutdown, inspection ilithibitisha winglet-to-winglet na strakelet-to-strakelet contact, so area imesecure ikisubiri damage assessment. Follow-up inahitajika: coordinate na maintenance wakague both aircraft, review procedures za marshalling clearance, na debrief kuhusu communication breakdown kati ya flight deck na ground personnel.
summary: Kuliwa na winglet-to-winglet contact kati ya ndege mbili during hangar tow-in kwa sababu ya marshalling clearance error, so inspection na procedure review zinahitajika.

narrative_text: Took over from swing shift on the DC-10 #1 reverser system pneumatic drive motor and overpressure valve installation, including associated ducting. Completed the installation and ran a leak check on all components I installed, with no leaks noted at that time. On the outbound flight a duct in the shared work area came loose, causing an inflight shutdown and return to field; the issue was corrected at the gate before dispatch. Follow-up needed: confirm exactly which clamp/fitting failed, since there is conflicting information between shifts on the root cause.
summary: A duct clamp in a shared work area on the DC-10 #1 reverser system came loose after shift handover, causing an inflight shutdown, and the exact failure point is still unconfirmed.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi kutoka kwa zamu ya jioni kuhusu ufungaji wa motor ya pneumatic drive na overpressure valve pamoja na ducting za mfumo wa #1 reverser wa ndege ya DC-10. Nilimaliza ufungaji na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji hewa kwenye vipengele nilivyofunga, na hakuna uvujaji uliopatikana wakati huo. Katika safari iliyofuata, bomba katika eneo lile ambalo zamu zote mbili zilikuwa zikifanyia kazi lililegea, na kusababisha injini kuzimwa hewani na ndege kurudi uwanjani; tatizo lilirekebishwa langoni kabla ya kuruhusiwa kuruka tena. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji zaidi kubaini ni clamp gani hasa iliyolegea, kwani kuna taarifa zinazokinzana kati ya zamu mbili kuhusu chanzo halisi.
summary: Bomba katika eneo la kazi lililoshirikiwa na zamu mbili kwenye mfumo wa #1 reverser wa DC-10 lililegea baada ya kukabidhiwa kazi, na kusababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, huku chanzo hasa kikiwa bado hakijathibitishwa.

entities.text: eneo lile ambalo zamu zote mbili zilikuwa zikifanyia kazi

narrative_text: Nilichukua turnover kutoka swing shift kwa ile installation ya pneumatic drive motor na overpressure valve, plus ducting za #1 reverser system ya DC-10. Nilimaliza installation na nikafanya leak check kwa components zote nilizofunga, hakuna leak iliyoonekana that time. Lakini kwa outbound flight, duct kwenye area ambayo both shifts zilikuwa zinafanyia kazi ililegea, ikasababisha inflight shutdown na ndege ikarudi field. Tatizo lilifixiwa palepale gate kabla flight haijaenda tena, but tunahitaji kufollow up kujua ni clamp gani hasa ilikuwa loose kwa sababu kuna conflicting info kati ya shifts.
summary: Duct kwenye area ambayo shifts mbili zilikuwa zikifanya kazi ililegea kwenye #1 reverser system ya DC-10, ikasababisha inflight shutdown, na bado hatujajua ni clamp gani exactly ilifail.

entities.text: area ambayo both shifts zilikuwa zinafanyia kazi

narrative_text: During the C150 annual inspection, the prop spinner was not removed, so the spinner retaining bulkhead security check was missed; the prop was only dressed for minor nicks and the checklist item was signed off assuming the inspection was complete. This happened near shift change under time pressure, and the next shift did not follow up to verify it. The aircraft later developed rough running in flight due to a loose spinner and landed uneventfully; spinner and bulkhead have since been replaced and the prop re-dressed. Next shift: confirm the new detailed prop-inspection checklist is being used and watch for unauthorized panel removal by owner/pre-buy parties on this aircraft.
summary: A missed spinner bulkhead inspection during a rushed shift-change annual led to in-flight rough running from a loose spinner, now corrected with parts replacement and a revised checklist.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwaka wa ndege ya C150, spinner ya propela haikutolewa, hivyo ukaguzi wa usalama wa bulkhead inayoshikilia spinner ulikosekana; propela ilisafishwa tu kwa mikwaruzo midogo na sehemu ya orodha ya ukaguzi ilitiwa saini kana kwamba kazi yote ilikamilika. Hili lilitokea karibu na mabadiliko ya zamu huku kukiwa na haraka, na zamu iliyofuata haikufuatilia jambo hili kuhakikisha limekamilika ipasavyo. Baadaye ndege ilipata tatizo la injini kuendesha kwa mshtuko hewani kutokana na spinner iliyolegea, ikatua salama; spinner na bulkhead vimeshabadilishwa na propela imesafishwa upya. Zamu inayofuata: hakikisha orodha mpya ya ukaguzi wa kina wa propela inatumika, na kuwa mwangalifu na uwezekano wa watu kuondoa paneli bila idhini kwenye ndege hii.
summary: Ukaguzi wa spinner ya propela ulikosekana wakati wa zamu ya haraka, na kusababisha tatizo la injini hewani ambalo sasa limerekebishwa kwa vipuri vipya na orodha mpya ya ukaguzi.

entities.text: orodha mpya ya ukaguzi wa kina wa propela

narrative_text: Wakati wa annual inspection ya C150, spinner haikutolewa kabisa, so tuka-miss ile check ya security ya spinner retaining bulkhead; prop ilidressiwa tu kwa nicks ndogo na checklist ika-signed off kana kwamba kila kitu kilikuwa done. Hii ilitokea karibu na shift change, kukiwa na rush na stress, na next shift hawakufollow up ku-confirm. Baadaye engine ika-develop rough running mid-flight kwa sababu ya loose spinner, ikalanda salama; spinner na bulkhead zimebadilishwa na prop imedressiwa upya. Next shift: hakikisheni ile new checklist ya prop inspection inafuatwa, na kuwa alert na watu wanao-remove panels bila authorization kwa hii aircraft.
summary: Spinner bulkhead check ilimissiwa during rushed shift change, causing rough engine running mid-flight, sasa imefixiwa na parts mpya plus revised checklist.

narrative_text: During the B757 door 1R escape slide change, we pinned the door assist bottle using two bolts instead of the proper MM pin since none were available, but did not attach safety streamers since we expected to finish the job ourselves. The ceiling panel near the main entrance was closed afterward to prevent head strikes, so the bolts were never visually confirmed or removed by the next shift. Aircraft continued flying until C-check, where the bolts were discovered still installed in the bottle. Next shift must always verify and remove all temporary pins/bolts on the door assist bottle before closing panels, and streamers must be used regardless of expected job completion.
summary: A B757 door slide bottle was pinned with unmarked bolts instead of proper pins during a slide change, and the omission went undetected for the panel closure until discovered at C-check.

entities.text: ceiling panel near the main entrance

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha slide ya mlango 1R kwenye ndege ya B757, tulitumia boliti mbili badala ya pin sahihi ya bottle ya door assist kwa sababu pin haikupatikana, lakini hatukuweka streamer za usalama kwa kuwa tulitarajia kumaliza kazi wenyewe. Baada ya hapo tulifunga panel ya juu karibu na mlango mkuu ili kuzuia watu kugonga vichwa, hivyo boliti hazikuthibitishwa au kutolewa na zamu iliyofuata. Ndege iliendelea kufanya safari mpaka ilipoenda C-check ndipo boliti zikagundulika bado zimewekwa kwenye bottle. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha pins/boliti zote za muda zinatolewa kabla ya kufunga paneli, na streamer lazima zitumike hata kama kazi inatarajiwa kukamilika mara moja.
summary: Bottle ya door assist ya B757 iliwekewa boliti badala ya pin sahihi wakati wa kubadilisha slide, na jambo hilo halikugunduliwa mpaka ndege ilipofika C-check.

entities.text: panel ya juu karibu na mlango mkuu

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya door 1R slide change kwa B757, tukatumia bolts mbili kwa ku-pin ile door assist bottle badala ya proper pin kwa sababu haikuwa available, lakini hatukuweka streamers coz tulitegemea kumaliza job wenyewe. Then tukafunga ile ceiling panel karibu na main entrance ili watu wasigonge vichwa, so bolts hazikuwa verified au removed na next shift. Ndege iliendelea kufly mpaka ikaenda C-check ndio wakagundua bolts bado ziko kwa bottle. Next shift lazima wa-check na kutoa hizo pins/bolts zote kabla ya ku-close panel, na streamers zi-installed always regardless ya expectation ya kumaliza job.
summary: Wakati wa B757 door slide change, bottle ilipinned na bolts bila streamer, na iko missed mpaka C-check ndipo ikagunduliwa.

entities.text: ceiling panel karibu na main entrance

narrative_text: Prior to departure, #3 and #4 MLG tires on the B737 MAX 8 had to be replaced after #4 wheel assembly was found with low tire pressure. Root cause was traced to the valve stem on the #4 MLG wheel not being torqued properly in the back shop, so loose it separated when the valve core tool was removed. Next shift please flag this for a back-shop audit and confirm whether torque stripes and valve stem safety measures can be added as a standing inspection item, since the MAX MLG wheel design has no safety wire on the stem.
summary: Low tire pressure on B737 MAX 8 #4 MLG traced to an improperly torqued valve stem from the back shop, requiring tire changes and follow-up audit/inspection action.

narrative_text: Kabla ya ndege kuondoka, matairi ya #3 na #4 MLG ya B737 MAX 8 yalilazimika kubadilishwa baada ya kugundulika hewa ya tairi la #4 imeshuka sana. Chanzo kilibainika kuwa valve stem ya gurudumu la #4 haikubanwa (torque) vizuri wakati wa kazi ya back shop, hivyo ikawa huru mno na ikatoka wakati zana ya kuondoa valve core ilipotumika. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali fuatilieni suala hili kwa ukaguzi wa back shop na muangalie kama inawezekana kuweka alama ya torque na hatua za usalama za valve stem kama sehemu ya ukaguzi wa kudumu, kwani muundo wa gurudumu la MLG la ndege hii haina waya wa usalama kwenye valve stem.
summary: Tatizo la hewa kushuka kwenye tairi la #4 MLG la B737 MAX 8 lilitokana na valve stem isiyobanwa vizuri kutoka back shop, hivyo kuhitaji ukaguzi na hatua za ziada za usalama.

narrative_text: Before departure tulilazimika kubadilisha #3 na #4 MLG tires kwa hii B737 MAX 8 baada ya kugundua #4 wheel assembly ina low tire pressure. Iligundulika kuwa valve stem ya #4 MLG haikuwa torqued vizuri na back shop, ikawa loose sana mpaka ikatoka wakati wa kutoa valve core tool. So next shift please fuatilieni hii issue, tunahitaji audit ya back shop na tuone kama tunaweza kuongeza torque stripe na some safety measure kwa valve stem, kwani design ya MAX MLG wheels haina safety wire kabisa.
summary: Low tire pressure kwenye #4 MLG ya B737 MAX 8 ilitokana na valve stem isiyo-torqued vizuri from back shop, hivyo kuhitaji audit na safety follow-up.

narrative_text: Techs reinstalled the ceiling panels in the aft cargo bay after cleaning, but the aircraft was released back to service before the floor and belly area cleaning turnover was completed. A supervisor signed off the MD-80 without confirming this task was closed, so there is a possible contamination risk to passengers and ramp crew. Next shift please verify cargo bay floor/belly cleaning status before further dispatch and log any deviation found.
summary: MD-80 was returned to service with the aft cargo bay floor/belly cleaning left incomplete, creating a contamination risk that needs verification.

narrative_text: Mafundi walikuwa wamesafisha na kurudisha paneli za dari kwenye sehemu ya mizigo ya nyuma ya ndege, lakini ndege ilirudishwa kazini kabla ya usafi wa sakafu na sehemu ya chini ya tumbo la ndege kukamilika. Msimamizi alitia saini kuruhusu MD-80 kuendelea na safari bila kuthibitisha kazi hiyo imekamilika, jambo linaloweza kusababisha uchafuzi kwa abiria na wafanyakazi wa uwanjani. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuthibitisha hali ya usafi wa eneo hilo kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena, na kuripoti tofauti yoyote itakayoonekana.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 ilirudishwa kazini kabla ya usafi wa sakafu na tumbo la mizigo kukamilika, hali inayoweza kuleta hatari ya uchafuzi.

entities.text: usafi wa sakafu na sehemu ya chini ya tumbo la ndege

narrative_text: So jana wale techs walimaliza kufunga ceiling panels kwa aft cargo bay baada ya kusafisha, lakini acft ilireleased ku-service kabla ya hiyo floor na belly cleaning turnover kufanyika. Supervisor alisign off hiyo MD-80 bila kuconfirm kama job imeclose, hivyo kuna contamination risk kwa pax na hata ramp workers. Next shift muverify status ya hiyo cleaning kabla ya kuidispatch tena, na mkilog deviation yoyote mtakayoikuta.
summary: MD-80 iliassigned back ku-service ingawa floor/belly cleaning ya aft cargo bay haijakamilika, so kuna contamination risk inayohitaji kuverifiwa.

narrative_text: B737-300 was moved from Gate A to Gate B for continued electrical troubleshooting after the #2 generator repeatedly dropped off line during taxi; APU power was used to feed both busses as a workaround. Attempts to reset the thrust reverser #2 and #3 circuit breakers did not resolve the fault, and we ran out of time to complete diagnosis before shift change. Next shift found the cause to be a failed R4 ALT transfer relay, which has since been replaced; an ops check is still required before return to service.
summary: B737-300 #2 generator fault traced to a failed R4 ALT transfer relay, now replaced and pending ops check.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilihamishwa kutoka geti A kwenda geti B ili kuendelea kutafuta chanzo cha tatizo la umeme, baada ya jenereta namba mbili kukatika mara kwa mara wakati wa taxi. Tulitumia nguvu ya APU kulisha mifumo yote miwili ya umeme huku tukiendelea kutafuta chanzo cha hitilafu, ikiwemo kujaribu kurudisha circuit breakers za thrust reverser namba mbili na tatu, lakini muda wa zamu yetu uliisha kabla ya kumaliza uchunguzi. Zamu iliyofuata iligundua kuwa tatizo lilitokana na relay ya R4 ALT iliyoharibika, ambayo tayari imebadilishwa; hata hivyo ukaguzi wa uendeshaji (ops check) bado unahitajika kabla ndege kurejea kazini.
summary: Tatizo la jenereta namba mbili kwenye B737-300 lilisababishwa na relay ya R4 ALT iliyoharibika, ambayo sasa imebadilishwa na inasubiri ukaguzi wa uendeshaji.

entities.text: circuit breakers za thrust reverser namba mbili na tatu

narrative_text: Tuli-move B737-300 kutoka Gate A kwenda Gate B ku-continue troubleshooting ya electrical problem, kwa sababu #2 generator ilikuwa inadrop off line kila taxi. Tulitumia APU power ku-feed busses zote mbili wakati tukiendelea kuangalia, tukajaribu ku-reset thrust reverser #2 na #3 circuit breakers lakini haikusaidia, na shift yetu ikaisha kabla hatujamaliza. Next shift walipata kwamba tatizo ni R4 ALT transfer relay iliyofail, imeshabadilishwa but bado inahitaji ops check kabla ya return to service.
summary: #2 generator ya B737-300 ilikuwa na tatizo kwa sababu ya R4 ALT relay iliyofail, sasa imebadilishwa na inasubiri ops check.

narrative_text: During the 300-hour scheduled maintenance on the Bell 206L1+, the tail rotor gearbox was serviced and the oil cap installed, then verified by a second AMT during the safety and security check before cowling closure. The aircraft passed ground runs and an OCF with no signs of leakage, but the receiving pilot's preflight at destination found the gearbox oil cap missing. Please review the SSC sign-off process and brief incoming techs to double-check fastener/cap security independently before cowling closeout, since two mechanics and two pilots reportedly confirmed the cap was in place prior to departure.
summary: A tail rotor gearbox oil cap was found missing during a post-departure preflight despite two mechanics and pilots having verified its installation before the aircraft left the facility.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa saa 300 kwa helikopta ya Bell 206L1+, gearbox ya tail rotor ilihudumiwa na kifuniko cha mafuta kikawekwa, kisha kikathibitishwa na fundi mwingine wakati wa ukaguzi wa usalama kabla ya cowling kufungwa. Ndege ilifanyiwa majaribio ya ardhini na safari ya majaribio bila dalili yoyote ya uvujaji, lakini rubani aliyepokea ndege eneo la marudio aligundua kifuniko cha mafuta cha gearbox hakikuwepo. Tafadhali kagua tena mchakato wa uthibitishaji wa ukaguzi wa usalama na uwaelekeze mafundi wanaoingia zamu kuhakikisha vifuniko vimefungwa vizuri kabla ya kufunga cowling, kwani mafundi wawili na marubani wawili walidai walithibitisha kifuniko kilikuwa kimewekwa kabla ya ndege kuondoka.
summary: Kifuniko cha mafuta cha gearbox ya tail rotor kilikutwa hakipo baada ya ndege kuondoka, ingawa mafundi na marubani kadhaa walikuwa wamethibitisha kimewekwa kabla ya safari.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya 300-hour scheduled maintenance kwa Bell 206L1+, tail rotor gearbox ikahudumiwa na oil cap ikawekwa, then ikaverified na AMT mwingine during SSC before cowling kufungwa. Aircraft ilipita ground runs na OCF bila leak yoyote kuonekana, lakini pilot alipo-preflight destination alikuta oil cap ya gearbox haiko. Tafadhali review process ya SSC sign-off na brief incoming techs wa-double check cap security independently kabla ya cowling closeout, kwa sababu mechanics wawili na pilots wawili walisema walithibitisha cap ilikuwa imewekwa kabla ya departure.
summary: Oil cap ya tail rotor gearbox ilikutwa missing baada ya aircraft kuondoka, ingawa mechanics na pilots kadhaa walikuwa wame-verify installation before departure.

narrative_text: B737-300 left over from hangar overnight routine had a fuselage crack repair on the left side; outgoing shift said the package was complete except for the crack repair and aft cargo sidewall panels removed for access. After the repair we closed up the cargo bin and signed off our shift paperwork including engine cowling closure and leak checks, but we were not told there was a second cover sheet with a duplicate 'A' check containing additional blanks for the same cowling closure and leak check items. Next shift needs to verify the 'A' check package for any unsigned blocks before further release, and this should go through a coordinator review given the size of the package.
summary: A duplicate 'A' check cover sheet on a B737-300 structural repair package went unnoticed at shift turnover, leaving some paperwork blocks unsigned despite the physical work being complete.

entities.text: engine cowling closure and leak checks

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 iliyoachwa na zamu ya usiku ya hangar ilikuwa na ukarabati wa ufa kwenye fuselage upande wa kushoto; zamu iliyoondoka ilituambia kazi ilikuwa imekamilika isipokuwa ukarabati wa ufa huo na paneli za ukuta wa cargo ya nyuma zilizotolewa kupata sehemu ya ukarabati. Baada ya ukarabati kukamilika, tulifunga mlango wa cargo na kusaini nyaraka zote za zamu yetu ikiwemo ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa injini na kufunga cowling, lakini hatukuarifiwa kuhusu jarida la pili la ukaguzi lenye 'A' check ya ziada yenye visanduku vingine vya kazi zilezile. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kupitia upya kifurushi chote cha nyaraka za 'A' check kuhakikisha hakuna kisanduku kilichoachwa bila saini, na kwa kazi kubwa namna hii, ukaguzi wa mratibu unapaswa kufanyika kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Jarida la pili la ukaguzi lenye 'A' check ya nakala mbili kwenye ndege ya B737-300 halikutambuliwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo baadhi ya visanduku vya nyaraka kubaki bila saini ingawa kazi halisi ilikuwa imekamilika.

entities.text: paneli za ukuta wa cargo ya nyuma
ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa injini na kufunga cowling

narrative_text: Hii B737-300 ilikuwa leftover kutoka hangar overnight routine, ilikuwa na crack repair kwa left side ya fuselage; zamu iliyotoka waliniambia package ilikuwa complete isipokuwa hiyo crack repair na aft cargo sidewall panels ambazo zilitolewa kupata access ya kufanya repair. Baada ya repair kukamilika tulifunga cargo bin na kusign off paperwork yote ya shift yetu including engine cowling closure na leak checks, lakini hatukujua kama kulikuwa na second cover sheet na duplicate 'A' check yenye additional blocks za hizo hizo cowling closure na leak checks. Next shift wanafaa wapitie 'A' check package vizuri kuhakikisha hakuna block imebaki open, na kwa package kubwa namna hii coordinator anafaa a-review kabla ndege ha-release.
summary: Duplicate 'A' check cover sheet kwa B737-300 structural repair package haikutambuliwa wakati wa shift turnover, hivyo baadhi ya paperwork blocks zikabaki unsigned ingawa kazi halisi ilikuwa complete.

entities.text: engine cowling closure na leak checks

narrative_text: MD-88 R main landing gear strut repack completed this shift: scissors, brake lines, and both electrical conduits/cannon plugs reconnected, gear swung 4x with normal indications, then lower wing panel reinstalled and aircraft returned to service. Follow-up crew must note that the required operational check of the weight-on-wheels sensor and wheel speed transducers was NOT performed before release, which likely contributed to the antiskid/autobrake/autospoiler faults reported after departure. Next shift to verify WOW sensor and gland nut lock installation and confirm cannon plug keying/routing before further flight.
summary: After an MD-88 gear strut repack, the required WOW sensor and wheel speed transducer checkout was missed, contributing to inflight antiskid/autobrake anomalies that need follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha mafuta ya strut ya gear ya kulia (R main landing gear) ya ndege ya MD-88 imekamilika kwa shift hii, ikiwemo kuunganisha upya scissors, mabomba ya breki, na conduit mbili za umeme pamoja na cannon plugs zake. Gear ilijaribiwa mara nne na dalili zote zilionekana kuwa za kawaida, hivyo panel ya chini ya bawa ilirudishwa na ndege ikarudishwa kwa huduma. Hata hivyo, ukaguzi wa lazima wa sensor ya weight-on-wheels na transducers za mwendo wa magurudumu haukufanyika kabla ya kuachiliwa, jambo ambalo linaaminika kuchangia matatizo ya autobrake, anti-skid, na autospoiler yaliyojitokeza baada ya kuruka. Shift ijayo inatakiwa kuthibitisha usakinishaji sahihi wa sensor hiyo na gland nut lock, na pia kuangalia tena mpangilio wa cannon plugs.
summary: Baada ya kazi ya kubadilisha mafuta ya strut ya gear ya ndege ya MD-88, ukaguzi muhimu wa sensor ya weight-on-wheels haukufanyika, jambo lililochangia matatizo ya mfumo wa breki angani na linahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Tuma-complete ile R main landing gear strut repack ya MD-88 kwa shift hii - tuli-reconnect scissors, brake lines, na conduits mbili za umeme pamoja na cannon plugs zao. Tuli-swing gear mara nne, indications zote zikawa normal, kisha tuka-reinstall lower wing panel na ndege ika-return to service. Shida ni kwamba hatuku-do ile required checkout ya WOW sensor na wheel speed transducers kabla ya release, na hiyo ndio inaonekana ilichangia zile antiskid, autobrake na autospoiler irregularities baada ya departure. Next shift wa-verify installation ya WOW sensor na gland nut lock, pia wa-confirm kama cannon plugs zime-route sawa.
summary: Baada ya MD-88 gear strut repack, checkout ya WOW sensor na wheel speed transducers haiku-done kabla ya release, na hiyo imesababisha antiskid/autobrake issues zinazohitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: During the A-check on the Dash 8-400, avionics ran test equipment that inadvertently inflated the main cabin door seal without informing the mechanics on shift; a technician then opened/closed the door and tore the seal. After the seal was replaced, the ops check crew was not told the reservoir was already filled and began servicing it, which caused the reservoir end cap to blow off and damage the airframe structure. Next shift needs to verify structural repair status and confirm avionics-maintenance communication procedure is updated before further door seal work.
summary: Poor coordination between avionics and mechanics led to an over-pressurized door seal reservoir rupturing and causing structural damage on a Dash 8-400.

narrative_text: Wakati wa A-check kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-400, fundi wa avionics alitumia vifaa vya kupima ambavyo kwa bahati mbaya vilijaza hewa kwenye seal ya mlango mkuu wa abiria, bila kuwajulisha mafundi wengine waliokuwa kazini. Fundi mmoja alifungua na kufunga mlango huo, jambo lililosababisha seal kuraruka. Baada ya seal kubadilishwa, timu iliyofanya ukaguzi haikujulishwa kuwa reservoir ilikuwa imejaa tayari, hivyo walijaribu kuijaza zaidi, na hii ilisababisha mwisho wa reservoir kutoka kwa nguvu na kuharibu muundo wa ndege. Shift inayokuja inahitajika kuthibitisha hali ya ukarabati wa muundo huo na kuboresha mawasiliano kati ya avionics na wahandisi wa matengenezo.
summary: Kukosekana kwa mawasiliano kati ya avionics na mafundi wa matengenezo kulisababisha reservoir ya seal ya mlango kulipuka na kuharibu muundo wa ndege ya Dash 8-400.

entities.text: seal ya mlango mkuu wa abiria

narrative_text: Wakati wa A-check kwenye Dash 8-400, avionics guy alikuwa akitest equipment na aku-inflate ile main cabin door seal bila kuwaambia mechanics waliokuwa on shift. Mechanic mmoja aka-open na kuclose door, seal ikatear. Baada ya kubadilisha seal, tulifanya ops check lakini hatukujua reservoir ilikuwa already filled na avionics test, so tuka-service tena, matokeo end ya reservoir ika-blow off na kuharibu structure ya ndege. Next shift wafuatilie status ya structural repair na wa-confirm communication procedure kati ya avionics na maintenance imeboreshwa kabla ya kufanya door seal job tena.
summary: Miscommunication kati ya avionics na mechanics ilisababisha door seal reservoir kulipuka na kuharibu structure ya Dash 8-400.

narrative_text: Completed the visual inspection of the engine driven fuel pump installation on the B737-700; installation appeared satisfactory with no signs of mechanical fault. Due to shift change I was unable to stay and witness the fuel pump leak check during engine runs, so this was handed over to the incoming maintenance team. Next shift to confirm whether any leaks were observed during the runs and ensure findings, if any, are properly documented in the logbook.
summary: Fuel pump visual inspection completed but leak check handed over to next shift due to time constraints, pending confirmation and documentation.

narrative_text: Nimemaliza ukaguzi wa kuona wa pampu ya mafuta iliyowekwa kwenye injini ya ndege ya B737-700; ufungaji ulionekana kuwa mzuri bila dalili za hitilafu ya kimitambo. Kutokana na mabadiliko ya zamu, sikuweza kubaki kushuhudia ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa pampu ya mafuta wakati wa majaribio ya injini, hivyo jukumu hilo limekabidhiwa kwa wafanyakazi wa zamu inayofuata. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuthibitisha kama kulikuwa na uvujaji wowote uliobainika wakati wa majaribio na kuhakikisha taarifa hizo zimeandikwa vizuri kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo.
summary: Ukaguzi wa kuona wa pampu ya mafuta umekamilika lakini ukaguzi wa uvujaji umekabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa uthibitisho na uandikishaji.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa pampu ya mafuta

narrative_text: Nimefanya visual inspection ya ile fuel pump installation kwa B737-700, na installation ilikuwa sawa, hakuna dalili za mechanical fault. Lakini kwa sababu ya shift change sikuweza ku-witness ile leak check wakati wa engine runs, so nimehand over kwa next shift wakamilishe. Wao waconfirm kama kulikuwa na leaks zozote during the runs na wahakikishe wame-document vizuri kwenye logbook.
summary: Fuel pump visual inspection imekamilika but leak check imehandover kwa next shift for confirmation na documentation.

narrative_text: B767 arrived with a pilot writeup for #1 engine reverse thrust and MEL XX-XX-X was started per turnover. The MEL calls for an electrical cap part number that has never been stocked or procured, and Engineering declined to issue relief since they cannot deviate from the MEL. Separately the cord manufacturer part number in the MEL does not cross-reference correctly to the M/E part number, and the correct number appears to be a one-digit typo away, so it is unclear whether the card is wrong or the part simply cannot be sourced. Additional discrepancies (helicoil damage, incorrect T-R sleeve markings) were found and logged; next shift needs to follow up with Engineering on the part number conflict before continuing the MEL procedure.
summary: Technician could not complete MEL procedure for #1 engine reverse thrust on a B767 due to unresolved part-number discrepancies and needs Engineering follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B767 ilifika ikiwa na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu reverse thrust ya injini namba moja, na utaratibu wa MEL XX-XX-X ulianzishwa kulingana na turnover. Hata hivyo, namba ya sehemu ya electrical cap inayotakiwa na MEL haijawahi kununuliwa wala kuhifadhiwa stoo, na idara ya Uhandisi imekataa kutoa ruhusa ya kubadilisha kwa kuwa hawawezi kukiuka maelekezo ya MEL. Zaidi ya hayo, namba ya sehemu ya cord kutoka kwa mtengenezaji haiendani kabisa na namba sahihi ya M/E, ikionekana kama kuna kosa la kuandika tarakimu moja, hivyo bado haijulikani kama ni hitilafu ya karatasi ya MEL au tatizo la upatikanaji wa sehemu hiyo. Pia kulibainika matatizo mengine kama uharibifu wa helicoil na alama zisizo sahihi kwenye T-R sleeve, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufuatilia na Uhandisi kabla ya kuendelea na kazi hii.
summary: Fundi hakuweza kukamilisha utaratibu wa MEL kwa reverse thrust ya injini namba moja ya B767 kutokana na mkanganyiko wa namba za sehemu, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji na idara ya Uhandisi.

entities.text: reverse thrust ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Aircraft B767 ilikuja na pilot report kuhusu #1 engine reverse thrust, tukaanza MEL XX-XX-X kama tulivyopewa turnover. Tatizo ni kwamba ile electrical cap part number iliyo listed kwenye MEL haijawahi kununuliwa wala ku-stock, na Engineering wamekataa kutoa relief kwa sababu hawawezi ku-deviate MEL bila EO. Pia kuna hii cord part number ambayo haiendani vizuri na M/E number, inaonekana kama typo ya digit moja tu, so hatujui kama ni MEL error au part haiwezi kupatikana kabisa. Kuna pia issues zingine kama helicoil damage na wrong markings kwenye T-R sleeve, so next shift wafuatilie na Engineering before ku-proceed na hii MEL procedure.
summary: Fundi ame-struggle ku-comply na MEL procedure ya #1 engine reverse thrust kwenye B767 kwa sababu ya part number discrepancies, so inahitajika follow-up na Engineering.

narrative_text: Picked up the EO job card on the B777-200 mid-shift starting at Step 10A(7); the crew O2 stowage box was already installed and signed off as leak-checked by prior shift but fastener security was not confirmed, so I re-verified those myself. I was later informed that all four O2 mask microphones were not connected to the back of the stowage box, meaning the leak check sign-off may not be reliable. Next shift needs to pull the stowage box, verify mic connections, and Avionics should run an operational check before release. Multi-shift turnover on this job card was poorly documented and needs tightening.
summary: A multi-shift B777-200 O2 stowage box job was signed off despite the four mask microphones not being connected, requiring follow-up verification and better turnover documentation.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kadi ya kazi ya EO kwenye ndege ya B777-200 nikianzia hatua ya 10A(7) baada ya wenzangu wa zamu iliyopita kuanza kazi hiyo. Sanduku la oksijeni la wafanyakazi wa ndege lilikuwa tayari limewekwa na kuandikwa kuwa limepitisha ukaguzi wa uvujaji, ingawa uimara wa vifungashio haukuthibitishwa vizuri, hivyo nikaukagua mwenyewe. Baadaye niliambiwa kuwa maikrofoni zote nne za barakoa za oksijeni hazikuwa zimeunganishwa nyuma ya sanduku hilo, jambo linaloweka shaka kwenye ule ukaguzi uliosainiwa. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie uunganishaji wa maikrofoni na Idara ya Avionics ifanye ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, kwani mawasiliano kati ya zamu kwenye kazi hii yalikuwa dhaifu.
summary: Kadi ya kazi ya sanduku la oksijeni kwenye B777-200 ilisainiwa licha ya maikrofoni nne za barakoa kutounganishwa, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji na maboresho ya mawasiliano baina ya zamu.

narrative_text: Nilipick up ile EO job card kwa B777-200 nikianza Step 10A(7) kwa sababu previous shift walikuwa wameanza kazi hiyo. Ile crew O2 stowage box ilikuwa already installed na imesainiwa kama leak check imepass, lakini fastener security haikuwa verified vizuri so nikaicheck mwenyewe. Baadaye waliniambia ati zile four O2 mask microphones hazikuwa connected nyuma ya stowage box, so ule leak check sign-off inakuwa questionable. Next shift wafuatilie mic connections na Avionics wafanye operational check kabla aircraft haija-release, coz turnover documentation ya job card hii ilikuwa poa sana.
summary: Job card ya O2 stowage box kwa B777-200 ilisainiwa ingawa zile microphones nne hazikuwa connected, so inahitaji follow-up na turnover kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: Handover from night shift on B737-800: the FO's system annunciator light assembly (six pack) is faulty and needs replacement, but there is no specific removal/installation procedure in the maintenance manual. Tech Services initially said 'just install it,' then referred us to GPM 2-01 Para C2, and later to Maint Manual 33-18-00-02 (Master Dim and Test Lights), which is only a generic lighting procedure with no dedicated ops check for this assembly. Next shift please follow up with Tech Pubs/Engineering to get a proper task-specific procedure and installation test, since these lights annunciate critical dispatch items and have caused repeated ground interrupts after gate departure.
summary: Night shift left an unresolved FO annunciator light (six pack) replacement on a B737-800 due to lack of a specific maintenance manual procedure, requiring further coordination with Tech Pubs/Engineering.

entities.text: Maint Manual 33-18-00-02 (Master Dim and Test Lights)

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku iliniachia taarifa kuhusu ndege ya B737-800 ambapo taa za annunciator za FO, zinazojulikana kama 'six pack,' zimeharibika na zinahitaji kubadilishwa, lakini hakuna utaratibu maalum wa kuziondoa na kuzifunga kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo. Tech Services mwanzoni walisema tu 'zifunge,' kisha wakatuelekeza kwa GPM 2-01 Aya ya C2, na baadaye kwa sehemu 33-18-00-02 ya kitabu cha matengenezo, ambayo ni maelekezo ya jumla tu kuhusu taa na haina ukaguzi maalum wa uendeshaji kwa sehemu hii. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali mfuatilie suala hili na Tech Pubs/Uhandisi ili kupata utaratibu sahihi, kwani taa hizi huonyesha hitilafu muhimu za usafiri na zimekuwa zikisababisha usumbufu mara kadhaa baada ya ndege kuondoka geti.
summary: Zamu ya usiku iliacha suala la ubadilishaji wa taa za annunciator za FO kwenye B737-800 bila kutatuliwa kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa utaratibu maalum, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi na Tech Pubs/Uhandisi.

entities.text: taa za annunciator za FO (six pack)

narrative_text: Night shift walinipatia handover ya B737-800: ile FO's annunciator light assembly, six pack, imeharibika na inahitaji replacement, lakini hakuna specific procedure ya removal and installation kwenye maintenance manual. Tech Services walisema tu 'just install it,' kisha wakatupeleka GPM 2-01 Para C2, na baadaye tukaambiwa tutumie 33-18-00-02 Master Dim and Test Lights ambayo ni generic sana na haina task-specific ops check. Next shift, please follow up na Tech Pubs/Engineering tupate proper procedure na installation test, kwa sababu hizi lights zinaannunciate critical dispatch items na zimekuwa zikisababisha ground interrupts mara kadhaa baada ya gate departure.
summary: Night shift waliacha issue ya FO annunciator light (six pack) kwenye B737-800 bila kutatuliwa kwa sababu ya lack of specific procedure, hivyo inahitaji follow-up na Tech Pubs/Engineering.

narrative_text: B757-200 was in for the L pack heater repair plus several logbook write-ups; with limited manpower on shift we prioritized the logbook items, including the #1 engine pneumatic bleed system deferral that is close to MEL time limits. Not all items were completed by end of shift - I gave the incoming foreman a verbal turnover and marked the item 'in work' in the system. Next shift needs to close out the bleed system fix before the MEL clock expires, please confirm status before release.
summary: Incoming shift must urgently complete the #1 engine pneumatic bleed system repair on the B757-200 before it exceeds MEL time limits, following incomplete logbook work from the previous shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B757-200 ilikuwa na kazi ya kurekebisha L pack heater pamoja na maandishi kadhaa ya logbook ambayo bado hayajashughulikiwa. Kwa sababu ya upungufu wa wafanyakazi kwenye shift yetu, tulilazimika kuweka kipaumbele kwenye maandishi ya logbook, ikiwa ni pamoja na tatizo la mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja ambalo linakaribia kufikia muda wake wa mwisho kulingana na MEL. Kazi hazikukamilika kabla ya shift yangu kuisha, hivyo nilimpa foreman taarifa ya mdomo kuhusu kazi zilizobaki na nikaweka alama kwenye mfumo kuonyesha kazi 'inaendelea.' Shift inayofuata inahitajika kukamilisha ukarabati wa mfumo wa bleed haraka kabla muda wa MEL haujaisha.
summary: Shift inayofuata inapaswa kukamilisha haraka ukarabati wa mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja kwenye ndege ya B757-200 kabla ya muda wa MEL kuisha.

entities.text: mfumo wa pneumatic bleed wa injini namba moja

narrative_text: Hii B757-200 ilikuwa scheduled kwa L pack heater repair plus kuna logbook write-ups kadhaa ambazo zilikuwa zimebaki. Manpower ilikuwa low kwa shift yangu so tulilazimika ku-prioritize logbook items kwanza, including ile #1 engine pneumatic bleed system ambayo iko deferred na inakaribia kutoka nje ya MEL time limits asubuhi. Sikumaliza kila kitu by end of shift, so nilimpa foreman verbal turnover na nika-mark kwenye system kama 'in work'. Next shift lazima wa-confirm status ya bleed system na wai-close out kabla MEL haija-expire.
summary: Next shift wanahitaji ku-close out haraka ile #1 engine pneumatic bleed system fix kwenye B757-200 kabla ya kuvuka MEL time limits.

narrative_text: B737-300 left elevator tab job: worn hinge bracket was drilled and replaced, inspection approved tab installation, but the tab assembly itself had worn bearings so it was replaced per manual 27-31-31. Note that the tab kit ordered did not include the hardware required by the applicable AD, so new castellated nuts were pulled from bench stock instead. Next shift needs to rig the tab and close up the area, then have inspection re-verify safeties and rigging before release.
summary: Left elevator tab and hinge bracket were replaced on a B737-300 using bench-stock hardware after the ordered kit lacked AD-mandated parts, and next shift must complete rigging and inspection sign-off.

entities.text: rig the tab and close up the area

narrative_text: Kazi ya elevator tab ya upande wa kushoto kwenye B737-300 imefanyika; hinge bracket iliyokuwa imechakaa ilitobolewa na kubadilishwa, na ukaguzi ukaidhinisha kufungwa kwa tab. Lakini tab yenyewe ilikuwa na bearings zilizochakaa hivyo ilibadilishwa yote kama assembly kulingana na manual 27-31-31. Kit iliyoagizwa kwa ajili ya tab haikuwa na vifaa vilivyotakiwa na AD husika, hivyo nuts mpya za castellated zilitolewa kwenye bench stock. Shift ya pili inatakiwa ku-rig tab na kufunga eneo hilo, kisha ukaguzi uthibitishe safety na rigging kabla ndege kurudishwa kwenye huduma.
summary: Tab na hinge bracket ya elevator upande wa kushoto ilibadilishwa kwenye B737-300 kwa kutumia vifaa vya bench stock baada ya kit kukosa vipuri vilivyotakiwa na AD, na shift inayofuata inatakiwa kukamilisha rigging na uthibitisho wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-do left elevator tab change kwa B737-300; hinge bracket ilikuwa worn so tuli-drill na ku-install mpya, inspection ika-approve tab installation. Lakini tab assembly yenyewe ilikuwa na worn bearings, so tuli-replace whole assembly per manual 27-31-31. Issue ni kwamba tab kit iliyo-order haikuwa na hardware iliyo-mandated na AD husika, hivyo tuli-pull nuts mpya za castellated kutoka bench stock. Next shift wanahitaji ku-rig tab na kuclose up eneo, then inspection i-verify safeties na rigging kabla ndege ku-return to service.
summary: Left elevator tab na hinge bracket zi-replaced kwenye B737-300 tukitumia bench stock hardware baada ya kit kukosa AD parts, next shift wana-finish rigging na inspection sign-off.

entities.text: ku-rig tab na kuclose up eneo

narrative_text: B737-200, ship on #2 engine oil filter cavity repair: Y shift machinist skipped the skim cut since the cavity was not out of round, and therefore never called for the required final powerplant inspection before sign-off. X shift mechanic went ahead with the pressure test, reinstalled the filter and cap, torqued the studs, and completed the engine run leak check assuming prior steps were done. Z shift inspector signed the logbook based on gearbox and machine shop turnover notes stating all steps were complete, but later phoned the Y shift inspector at home (~0430) and discovered the final powerplant inspection was never actually performed. Inspection supervisor has been notified; need to track down the Y shift machinist to confirm whether an inspector was ever called, and re-verify the oil filter cavity before the aircraft returns to service.
summary: A required final powerplant inspection on a B737-200's #2 engine oil filter cavity repair was never performed, but was mistakenly logged as complete due to a breakdown in shift-to-shift communication.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-200, ukarabati wa kizuizi cha filter ya mafuta ya engine namba mbili ulikuwa unaendelea. Fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y hakufanya ile skim cut kwa sababu shimo halikuwa nje ya roundness, hivyo hakumwita inspector kufanya ukaguzi wa mwisho wa powerplant kama utaratibu unavyotaka. Fundi wa shift ya X akaendelea na pressure test, akarudisha filter na cap, akakaza studs, na akaomba engine run leak check bila kujua hatua ya ukaguzi haikufanyika. Inspector wa shift ya Z alitia sahihi kwenye logbook akidhani kazi zote zimekamilika kulingana na taarifa za mabadiliko ya shift kutoka gearbox na machine shop, lakini baadaye alipiga simu nyumbani kwa inspector wa shift ya Y saa za asubuhi na kugundua kuwa ukaguzi wa mwisho haujafanyika kabisa. Msimamizi wa ukaguzi ameshaarifiwa; inahitajika kumpata fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y kuthibitisha kama aliwahi kumwita inspector, na kufanya tena uhakiki wa kizuizi cha filter kabla ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa powerplant kwenye ukarabati wa filter ya mafuta ya engine ya B737-200 haukufanyika, ila ulisainiwa kimakosa kwenye logbook kutokana na mawasiliano mabovu kati ya shift.

entities.text: kizuizi cha filter ya mafuta ya engine namba mbili
Fundi wa mashine wa shift ya Y

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-200, kuna repair ya #2 engine oil filter cavity ambayo ilikuwa inaendelea. Yule machinist wa Y shift hakufanya skim cut kwa sababu hole haikuwa out of round, so hakucall inspector for final powerplant inspection kama procedure inavyotaka. Halafu X shift mechanic akaenda mbele na pressure test, akareinstall filter na cap, akatorque studs, akarequest engine run leak check akidhani kila kitu kimefanywa. Z shift inspector akasign logbook kwa sababu turnover kutoka gearbox shop na machine shop ilisay kila kitu kimekamilika, lakini alipopiga simu kwa Y shift inspector nyumbani around 0430 akajua final powerplant inspection haijafanyika kabisa. Inspection supervisor ameshanotified; tunahitaji kumfind Y shift machinist kuconfirm kama aliwahi kucall inspector, na tuverify tena hiyo oil filter cavity kabla aircraft irudi service.
summary: Final powerplant inspection kwenye #2 engine oil filter cavity ya B737-200 haikufanyika lakini ilisainiwa kimakosa kwenye logbook due to poor shift handover communication.

narrative_text: B777-200 arrived with an EICAS message for a left engine bleed air fault; R&R of the left engine Fan Air Modulating Valve (FAMV) was initiated but handover to the next shift happened with almost no turnover time, leaving the incoming team to pick up mid-task. After valve replacement, time pressure to avoid further delay led to deferring the required engine bleed ops test and instead rendering the new valve inoperative/open per MEL for dispatch; this required deactivating the thrust reverser isolation shutoff valve before opening the reverser to access the FAMV. Next shift must confirm the MEL steps were fully completed and documented in the logbook, and verify the reverser deactivation/reactivation was properly signed off before further dispatch.
summary: Left engine FAMV replacement on a B777-200 was handed over mid-task with inadequate turnover, and time pressure led to deferring the ops test in favor of an MEL dispatch that required thrust reverser deactivation, needing follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 ilifika ikiwa na tatizo la bleed air kwenye injini ya kushoto, na kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya FAMV ilianzishwa lakini makabidhiano kati ya zamu mbili hayakuwa na muda wa kutosha, hivyo zamu iliyofuata ililazimika kuendelea na kazi bila maelezo kamili. Baada ya kubadilisha valve, kwa sababu ya shinikizo la muda na kuepuka ucheleweshaji zaidi, uamuzi ulifanywa wa kutofanya kipimo cha lazima cha mfumo wa bleed na badala yake valve mpya ikafanywa isifanye kazi (open) kulingana na MEL ili ndege iruhusiwe kuruka, jambo lililohitaji kuzima thrust reverser kabla ya kufungua kufikia valve hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha hatua zote za MEL zimekamilika na kuandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook, na kuthibitisha kwamba thrust reverser imerejeshwa katika hali sahihi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa valve ya FAMV kwenye injini ya kushoto ya B777-200 ulikabidhiwa kwa zamu nyingine bila maelezo ya kutosha, na shinikizo la muda lilisababisha kuepukwa kwa kipimo cha ops na badala yake kutumika utaratibu wa MEL, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Hii B777-200 ilikuja na EICAS message ya left engine bleed air problem, so wakaanza R&R ya FAMV lakini handover kati ya shifts haikuwa na muda mzuri, so nilikuja tu nikaendelea na kazi bila kupewa full details. Baada ya kubadilisha valve, kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuepuka delay zaidi, tuka-decide kufanya valve iwe inoperative in open position per MEL for dispatch, na hii ilihitaji ku-deactivate thrust reverser isolation shutoff valve kabla ya kufungua reverser kufikia FAMV. Next shift wahakikishe MEL steps zote zime-completiwa na zime-recorded vizuri kwenye logbook, na wa-verify thrust reverser imerudishwa sawa kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: FAMV replacement kwenye left engine ya B777-200 ilifanyika na handover mbaya kati ya shifts, na time pressure ikasababisha kuskip ops test na badala yake kutumia MEL dispatch, kitu ambacho kinahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: During the overnight 'A' check on the MD-83, I measured brakes #2 and #4 below minimum tolerance and logged a discrepancy on page 27 of the check work package, then verbally notified the crew chief per the turnover report. I later discovered that page 27 had been removed and replaced with a different page, with staple holes showing the original entry was pulled without any written resolution from the mechanic who reportedly re-checked the brakes. This needs urgent follow-up: confirm actual brake #2/#4 measurements before further dispatch, and investigate the altered work package as a records-integrity issue. Please flag this aircraft's full maintenance history for review.
summary: A technician found that his logged brake-tolerance discrepancy on an MD-83 work package had been removed and replaced without written resolution, raising records-integrity concerns needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa 'A' wa usiku kwenye ndege ya MD-83, nilipima breki namba 2 na namba 4 na kugundua zilikuwa chini ya kiwango kinachokubalika, hivyo nikaandika hitilafu hiyo kwenye ukurasa wa 27 wa kitabu cha kazi na kumjulisha crew chief kwa mujibu wa taratibu za makabidhiano. Baadaye niligundua kuwa ukurasa huo wa 27 umeondolewa na kubadilishwa na ukurasa mwingine, huku alama za stapo zikionyesha wazi kuwa kurasa ya awali iliondolewa bila ufafanuzi wowote ulioandikwa kutoka kwa fundi aliyedaiwa kukagua tena breki hizo. Jambo hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka: kuthibitisha vipimo halisi vya breki namba 2 na 4 kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kusafiri tena, na kuchunguza uharibifu huu wa kumbukumbu kama tatizo kubwa la uadilifu. Tafadhali historia yote ya matengenezo ya ndege hii ipitiwe upya.
summary: Fundi aligundua kuwa hitilafu ya breki aliyoandika kwenye kumbukumbu ya ndege ya MD-83 iliondolewa na kubadilishwa bila maelezo, jambo linaloonyesha tatizo la uadilifu wa kumbukumbu linalohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Nikiwa naendelea na overnight 'A' check ya hiyo MD-83, nilicheck brakes #2 na #4 nikaona ziko below tolerance, so nikafanya write-up kwa page 27 ya work package na kumnotify crew chief kwa turnover report kama utaratibu unavyosema. Later nikadiscover kwamba page 27 ile imeondolewa na kubadilishwa na page mbaya, staple holes zinaonyesha wazi original entry ilitolewa bila resolution yoyote written kutoka kwa yule mechanic aliyeclaim ku-recheck brakes. Hii inahitaji follow-up ya haraka - confirm measurements halisi za brake #2 na #4 kabla ya aircraft kudispatch tena, na tuinvestigate huu ualteration wa work package kama record-integrity issue. Please pull maintenance history yote ya hii aircraft ipitiwe.
summary: Technician aligundua discrepancy ya brake #2/#4 aliyoiandika kwenye MD-83 work package imeondolewa bila written resolution, so kuna record-integrity concern inayohitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: After replacing the Emergency Brake Valve on the Gulfstream III, two hydraulic flex lines were reconnected reversed by maintenance, and the required operational check was never completed before the aircraft left the hangar. The Chief Pilot, who is also A&P-qualified, chose to perform the check himself and flew a test flight without doing so, then repositioned the aircraft for a next-day departure; on landing after that flight all four brakes locked up due to the crossed lines building full pressure. Follow-up: confirm operational check is completed and signed off before any further flight, and verify hydraulic line routing on this tail number before dispatch.
summary: Reversed hydraulic brake lines and a skipped operational check on a Gulfstream III led to all four brakes locking on landing.

narrative_text: Baada ya kubadilisha Emergency Brake Valve kwenye Gulfstream III, mafundi waliunganisha mabomba mawili ya hydraulic flex kwa mkorogo (reversed), na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji (operational check) haukufanywa kabla ndege haijaondoka hangarini. Chief Pilot, ambaye pia ana leseni ya A&P, aliamua kufanya ukaguzi huo mwenyewe lakini akaruka ndege ya majaribio bila kuufanya, kisha akaegesha ndege tayari kwa safari ya siku inayofuata; wakati wa kutua baada ya hiyo safari, breki zote nne zilikwama kwa sababu ya mabomba yaliyokorogwa kujaza shinikizo kamili. Inahitajika: kuhakikisha operational check inafanywa na kusainiwa kabla ya safari yoyote ijayo, na kukagua mfumo wa mabomba ya hydraulic kwenye ndege hii kabla ya kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Mabomba ya hydraulic yaliyokorogwa na kukosekana kwa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kwenye Gulfstream III kulisababisha breki zote nne kukwama wakati wa kutua.

narrative_text: Baada ya kubadilisha ile Emergency Brake Valve kwa Gulfstream III, wale maintenance guys waliconnect zile two hydraulic flex lines reversed, na ile operational check haikufanywa before ndege ku-depart hangar. Chief Pilot, ambaye pia ana A&P certificate, akasema atafanya ile check mwenyewe lakini aka-fly test flight bila kuifanya, then aka-position ndege for next-day departure; on landing baada ya hiyo test flight, brakes zote four zika-lock up kwa sababu lines zilizo-crossed zilibuild full pressure. Follow-up: hakikisha operational check imefanywa na kusignoff kabla ya any flight ijayo, na uverify hydraulic line routing kwa hii tail number kabla ya dispatch.
summary: Reversed hydraulic lines na operational check iliyoskipwa kwa Gulfstream III ndio zilisababisha brakes zote four ku-lock during landing.

narrative_text: Midnight shift completed IDG installation on the A319 in Bay 2; crew chief assisted after initial difficulty seating the IDG onto the gearbox, which required repositioning the quad ring. Two engine runs and a leak check were performed with no leaks noted, and post-taxi walkaround was also clean. Flight crew later reported oil loss from the gearbox pad cover, which was apparently left off during the install and not caught by anyone on the team. Next shift please verify pad cover installation procedures and inspect similar installs for the same oversight.
summary: IDG installation on an A319 passed ground checks but the gearbox pad cover was left off, causing in-flight oil loss and requiring follow-up review.

narrative_text: Katika shift ya usiku, timu ilikamilisha ufungaji wa IDG kwenye ndege ya A319 pale Bay 2, ambapo crew chief alisaidia baada ya changamoto za kuweka IDG kwenye gearbox na kubidi kuhamisha quad ring. Baada ya ufungaji, injini ilijaribiwa mara mbili na ukaguzi wa uvujaji ulifanyika, hakuna uvujaji ulioonekana wakati huo wala baada ya kusogeza ndege gate. Baadaye ilijulikana kuwa gearbox pad cover haikuwekwa, hali iliyosababisha upotevu wa mafuta wakati wa safari. Shift inayofuata inahitaji kuhakiki taratibu za ufungaji wa pad cover na kukagua kazi nyingine zinazofanana kuepuka kosa hilo tena.
summary: Ufungaji wa IDG kwenye A319 ulionekana sawa kwenye ukaguzi wa ardhini, lakini gearbox pad cover ilisahaulika na kusababisha upotevu wa mafuta angani, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: So during midnight shift tulikuwa assigned kufunga IDG kwenye A319 pale Bay 2, ikawa ngumu kidogo kuiweka onto the gearbox mpaka crew chief akaja kutusaidia, tukashift quad ring ndio ikakubali kumount. Baada ya installation tuka-push aircraft, tukafanya engine runs mbili plus leak check, hakuna leaks zilizoonekana, even post-taxi walkaround ilikuwa clean. Lakini baadaye tukajulishwa kuna oil loss during flight coming from the gearbox pad cover ambayo ilikuwa haijawekwa, na hakuna hata mmoja aliye-notice wala kutuinform ilitolewa. Next shift please recheck installation procedure ya pad cover na verify similar jobs ili tuepuke hii kosa tena.
summary: IDG installation kwenye A319 ilipita ground checks lakini gearbox pad cover ilisahaulika, causing oil loss mid-flight, hivyo inahitaji follow-up review.

narrative_text: During turnover on the two ERJ-140 aircraft, the inspector flagged that the Base Manager had signed off a work card block that neither outgoing shift mechanic could confirm was actually performed. About 3 hours later the same block was changed to N/A, with the Base Manager stating the inspection was not required since winds stayed under 50 kts, and the logbook was then signed off as cleared and worked. Next shift needs to verify actual completion status of that inspection block and reconcile the conflicting logbook/work card entries before further release.
summary: A work card block on an ERJ-140 was first signed off then later marked N/A by the Base Manager with no clear record of whether the inspection was actually done, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover kwa ndege mbili za ERJ-140, mkaguzi alibaini kwamba Meneja wa Kituo alikuwa amesaini sehemu ya work card ambayo hakuna fundi wa zamu iliyopita angeweza kuthibitisha kama kazi hiyo ilifanyika. Baada ya masaa matatu hivi, sehemu hiyo ilibadilishwa kuwa 'Haihusiki' (N/A), Meneja akisema ukaguzi haukuhitajika kwa sababu upepo haukuzidi mafundo 50, kisha logbook ikasainiwa kuonyesha kazi imekamilika. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha hali halisi ya ukaguzi huo na kupatanisha maelezo yanayopingana kati ya logbook na work card kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuendelea kutumika.
summary: Sehemu ya work card katika ndege ya ERJ-140 ilisainiwa kisha baadaye kubadilishwa kuwa haihusiki na Meneja wa Kituo bila uthibitisho wazi kama kazi ilifanyika, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kwa turnover ya hizi ndege mbili za ERJ-140, inspector aligundua kwamba Base Manager amesign off block ya work card, lakini hakuna hata fundi mmoja wa shift iliyopita ambaye anaweza confirm kama kazi hiyo ilifanywa. Baada ya kama masaa tatu, block ile ile ika-changwa kuwa N/A, Base Manager akisema inspection haikuhitajika kwa sababu winds hazikuzidi 50 kts, kisha logbook ika-signed off kuonyesha kazi imekamilika na kucleared. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify status halisi ya ile inspection block na kupatanisha hizo discrepancies kati ya logbook na work card kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: Block ya work card kwa ERJ-140 ilisign off kisha baadaye kubadilishwa kuwa N/A na Base Manager bila confirmation kama kazi ilifanyika, so inahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: OTS aircraft remains down for flap lock fault (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) with FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE messages; no proper turnover was given going into midnight shift, so we had to piece together prior findings from scattered paperwork. Inspection confirmed damage on track 3 and track 4 (outboard flap), with possible related damage to track 1/2 (inboard flap) not yet written up per crew chief's direction, pending track 3 reassembly. Next shift must inspect and write up track 1/2, specifically the possibly worn attaching link, once track 3 work is complete.
