summary: Midnight shift continued flap-lock troubleshooting on an OTS aircraft without proper turnover, finding additional track 3/4 damage and an unresolved, unwritten track 1/2 discrepancy needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege iliyo OTS bado ina hitilafu ya flap lock (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) pamoja na ujumbe wa FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE; hatukupewa turnover ifaayo tulipoanza shift ya usiku, hivyo tulilazimika kupitia makaratasi yaliyotawanyika kutafuta mahali pa kuanzia. Ukaguzi ulithibitisha uharibifu kwenye track 3 na track 4 (flap ya nje), na kuna uwezekano wa uharibifu unaohusiana na track 1/2 (flap ya ndani) ambao haujaandikwa bado kama alivyoelekeza crew chief, hadi track 3 itakapowekwa tena. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kukagua na kuandika hitilafu za track 1/2, hasa kiungo kinachoonekana kuchakaa, mara kazi ya track 3 itakapokamilika.
summary: Shift ya usiku iliendelea kutatua tatizo la flap lock kwenye ndege ya OTS bila turnover ifaayo, na kugundua uharibifu zaidi wa track 3/4 pamoja na hitilafu ya track 1/2 isiyoandikwa inayohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Aircraft ya OTS iko down bado kwa flap lock fault (F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED, SFCS) na messages za FLP 1/2 CHK LH MECH DRIVE; hatukupata turnover ya kutosha tulipoanza night shift, so tulilazimika ku-piece together findings kutoka kwa paperwork iliyotawanyika. Inspection ilithibitisha damage kwa track 3 na track 4 (outboard flap), na kuna possible damage related na track 1/2 (inboard flap) ambayo bado haijaandikwa kama crew chief alivyosema, mpaka track 3 iwe reassembled. Next shift wanafaa ku-check na ku-write up track 1/2, hasa ile attaching link inayoonekana worn, mara tu track 3 itakapo-complete.
summary: Night shift iliendelea na troubleshooting ya flap lock kwenye OTS aircraft bila turnover proper, wakikuta damage zaidi kwa track 3/4 na discrepancy ya track 1/2 ambayo haijaandikwa na inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Taking over the #1 engine fan assembly reinstall on the B757 from previous shift, we found the fan blades and annulus fillers were incorrectly marked/tagged during removal, making correct reassembly very difficult. Turnover paperwork was inadequate and the outgoing mechanic acknowledged the mistagging before leaving. Foreman, lead mech and powerplant engineer were briefed and instructed us to proceed using best judgment to restore correct blade/filler sequencing; recommend a full verification check on next shift before engine run.
summary: Poor shift turnover left fan blades/fillers mismarked on a B757 #1 engine, requiring the incoming crew to reconstruct correct sequencing and flagging the issue to supervision.

narrative_text: Tulipokea kazi ya kuunganisha tena fan assembly ya engine namba 1 kwenye ndege ya B757 kutoka shift iliyotangulia, na tukagundua blade na fillers za annulus zilikuwa zimewekewa alama vibaya wakati wa kuziondoa. Turnover ya makaratasi ilikuwa mbovu sana, na fundi aliyehusika alikubali kuwa kulikuwa na makosa kabla ya kuondoka. Tulishauriana na foreman, lead mech, na powerplant engineer, wakatuambia tufanye tuwezavyo kurekebisha mpangilio sahihi wa blade na fillers; inashauriwa ifanyike ukaguzi kamili shift inayofuata kabla ya kuwasha engine.
summary: Turnover mbaya iliacha blade na fillers za engine namba 1 kwenye B757 zikiwa na alama zisizo sahihi, hivyo wafanyakazi wa shift mpya walilazimika kurekebisha mpangilio na kuripoti tatizo kwa wasimamizi.

narrative_text: Tuli-take over ile job ya kurudisha #1 engine fan assembly pamoja on the B757 kutoka previous shift, na tukakuta fan blades na annulus fillers zime-markiwa vibaya during removal. Turnover paperwork ilikuwa mbaya sana, na yule mechanic aliekuwa amefanya job alikubali mwenyewe ati kuna screw-up before ku-punch out. Tuli-confirm na foreman, lead mech na powerplant engineer, wakatuambia 'do your best' kufanya correct reinstall ya blades na fillers; kesho next shift wafanye verification check kabla ya engine run.
summary: Turnover mbaya iliacha fan blades na fillers za #1 engine kwenye B757 zime-mismarked, hivyo crew ya sasa walilazimika ku-figure out correct sequencing wenyewe.

narrative_text: B777-200 in Hangar Bay is down for the potable/waste water storage tank replacement; the new tank from ZZZ1 stock arrived damaged and Supervisor X asked mechanics to swap the inlet fitting onto the old tank, but the fitting is molded as one piece with the tank, not a separate assembly. An Engineering Order was issued but only a partial one-page repair procedure starting at Step 6 was received, and inspection of the mating seal on both tanks showed additional damage. Next shift needs to chase Engineering for the complete technical data/E.O. before any installation decision is made, and confirm tank availability status with Stores.
summary: AOG waste water tank swap on B777-200 is on hold pending complete Engineering Order documentation after a damaged replacement tank and an incomplete repair procedure were found.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 iliyoko Hangar Bay bado imesimama kwa sababu ya kubadilisha tanki la maji machafu; tanki jipya lililotoka stoo ya ZZZ1 lilikuja limeharibika, na Supervisor X aliagiza mafundi wabadilishe fitting ya inlet kwa tanki la zamani, ijapokuwa fitting hiyo ni sehemu moja na tanki, haiwezi kutolewa peke yake. Engineering Order ilitolewa lakini ilikuwa na ukurasa mmoja tu wa maelekezo ukianzia Hatua ya 6, na ukaguzi wa seal ya kuunganisha kwenye matanki mawili ulionyesha uharibifu zaidi. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufuatilia Engineering kupata taarifa kamili ya kiufundi kabla ya kufanya uwekaji, na kuthibitisha hali ya upatikanaji wa tanki na Stores.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha tanki la maji machafu kwenye B777-200 imesimama kwa sababu ya tanki lililoharibika na maelekezo ya Engineering yasiyo kamili, hivyo yanahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Hii B777-200 iko Hangar Bay imesimama kwa waste water tank replacement; tank mpya ya ZZZ1 stock ilikuja damaged, na Supervisor X akasema mechanics wa-swap ile inlet fitting kwenda kwa old tank, lakini fitting ni one piece na tank, si assembly separate. Engineering waliissue E/O lakini tulipata one page tu ya repair steps ikianzia Step 6, na tulipo-inspect mating seal kwa both tanks tukapata damage zaidi. Next shift wafuatilie Engineering wapate full technical data kabla ya kufanya installation decision, na wacheck na Stores kuhusu tank availability.
summary: B777-200 waste water tank job iko on hold kwa sababu ya damaged part na incomplete E/O documentation, inahitaji follow-up na Engineering.

narrative_text: B737-700 pack trip fault troubleshot overnight; findings pointed to faulty R system bleed overtemp switches rather than heat exchanger contamination per the flight manual, so we deviated from the standard procedure after discussing with the shift manager and zone supervisor. Decision was made around 0100 to replace the 390 and 490 bleed overtemp switches, but we ran out of time on the ramp aircraft to complete the job. Next shift lead has been briefed and logbook entry left open for switch replacement plus required leak check afterward - please confirm completion.
summary: Faulty R system bleed overtemp switches on B737-700 need replacement and leak check, handed over to next shift after time ran out.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa na tatizo la pack kujizima usiku, na baada ya uchunguzi tuligundua kuwa switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R ndizo zenye hitilafu, na si heat exchanger kama ilivyoelekezwa kwenye mwongozo wa ndege. Baada ya majadiliano na meneja wa zamu pamoja na msimamizi wa zone, iliamuliwa saa saba usiku kubadilisha switch za 390 na 490, lakini muda haukutosha kukamilisha kazi hiyo kwenye ndege iliyoko rampuni. Zamu inayofuata imeelezwa kikamilifu na maandishi yameachwa wazi kwenye logbook kuhusu kubadilisha switch na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji baada ya hapo - tafadhali thibitisha kama kazi imekamilika.
summary: Switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R kwenye B737-700 zinahitaji kubadilishwa na kufanyiwa ukaguzi wa uvujaji, kazi imekabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: switch za overtemp za bleed upande wa R

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-troubleshoot pack trip fault kwa hii B737-700 usiku mzima, tukagundua ile bleed overtemp switches za R system ndizo zina fault, si heat exchanger kama flight manual inavyosema, so tukaamua tu-deviate na standard procedure. Tukaenda ku-discuss na shift manager na zone supervisor, tukakubaliana around 0100 tu-replace hizo 390 na 490 switches, lakini time ikaisha tukiwa ramp na hatukuweza kukamilisha job. Tumeshampa turnover next shift lead, logbook entry iko open ikisema switches zinabadilishwa halafu leak check ifanyike baadaye - confirm kama imefanyika.
summary: Bleed overtemp switches za R system kwenye B737-700 zinahitaji replacement na leak check, job imepewa next shift baada ya time kuisha.

entities.text: bleed overtemp switches za R system

narrative_text: During accumulator replacement on the A320 (Aircraft X) hydraulic system in the hangar, the Lead Technician stowed the manual gear drop and re-energized the system around end of shift without confirming all personnel were clear of the wheel well. A technician who had gone back to check the accumulator for leaks got his legs caught between the ladder and the main landing gear as it retracted, narrowly avoiding serious injury. Follow-up needed: reinforce clearance/verbal confirmation procedures before re-energizing gear systems, and review time-pressure practices near shift change.
summary: A technician was nearly caught in the landing gear wheel well when the Lead re-energized the hydraulic system without confirming all personnel were clear during accumulator replacement on the A320.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha accumulator kwenye mfumo wa hydraulic wa ndege ya A320 (Aircraft X) hangarini, Fundi Mkuu (Lead) alirudisha manual gear drop na kuwasha tena mfumo karibu na mwisho wa zamu bila kuthibitisha kama wafanyakazi wote walikuwa mbali na wheel well. Fundi mmoja aliyekuwa amerudi kuangalia uvujaji wa accumulator miguu yake ilinaswa kati ya ngazi na landing gear kuu wakati ikirudi ndani, hatua ndogo tu kutoka kupata jeraha kubwa. Hatua inayohitajika: kusisitiza taratibu za uthibitisho wa eneo salama kabla ya kuwasha mifumo ya gear, na kupitia upya utaratibu wa kufanya kazi kwa haraka karibu na mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Fundi mmoja alikaribia kunaswa kwenye wheel well wakati Lead alipowasha tena mfumo wa hydraulic bila kuthibitisha usalama wa wafanyakazi wakati wa kubadilisha accumulator kwenye A320.

narrative_text: Wakati tulikuwa tuki-replace accumulator kwenye hydraulic system ya A320 (Aircraft X) hangarini, Lead ali-stow ile manual gear drop na kuwasha system tena karibu na end of shift bila kuconfirm kama watu wote walikuwa clear ya wheel well. Fundi mmoja aliyerudi kucheck accumulator kama inaleak, miguu yake ilinaswa kati ya ladder na landing gear ikiwa inaretract, karibu kupata jeraha kubwa. Tunahitaji ku-reinforce ile clearance procedure kabla ya kuwasha gear system tena, na ku-review huu tabia ya kufanya kazi kwa haraka near shift change.
summary: Fundi alikaribia kunaswa kwenye wheel well wakati Lead alipo-re-energize hydraulic system bila kuconfirm usalama wa watu wakati wa accumulator replacement kwenye A320.

narrative_text: On the ATR 72 right-hand engine, the #2 fire handle warning light was found illuminated; the fire loop cannon plug was pulled, found contaminated with water, cleaned and reconnected, and the system then checked good. Ignition system A and B ops checks were also completed satisfactorily, and the ignition lead was found misrouted, requiring the lower cowl to be dropped for correction before reinstalling the igniter, lead, and cowl with safety wire and the oil cooler line torqued. Incoming shift should verify all cowl panels (fwd and aft) are properly closed and secured, confirm the maintenance stand has been removed, and double-check safety wire and loose oil line connections on the right side before returning aircraft to service.
summary: Right engine fire warning traced to water in the fire loop cannon plug and a misrouted ignition lead, requiring cowl removal and reinstallation; next shift must confirm cowl closure, stand removal, and safety wire before release.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya ATR 72, taa ya onyo ya moto namba mbili upande wa injini ya kulia ilionekana ikiwaka, na baada ya kuondoa plagi ya fire loop ilibainika kuwa na maji ndani yake; ilisafishwa na kurudishwa, na mfumo ukafanyiwa ukaguzi ukaonekana mzuri. Vilevile, waya wa ignition ulikutwa haujawekwa vizuri hivyo ilibidi kufungua cowl ya chini kuirekebisha, kabla ya kufunga tena igniter, waya, na kuufunga cowl kwa waya wa usalama na kukaza bomba la mafuta ya baridi ya injini. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kuhakikisha paneli zote za cowl (mbele na nyuma) zimefungwa vizuri, stendi ya matengenezo imeondolewa, na waya za usalama pamoja na mabomba ya mafuta upande wa kulia yamekaguliwa kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwenye huduma.
summary: Onyo la moto la injini ya kulia lilisababishwa na maji kwenye plagi ya fire loop na waya wa ignition uliokosewa njia, hivyo zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa cowl, uondoaji wa stendi, na waya za usalama kabla ya kurudisha ndege kwenye huduma.

entities.text: bomba la mafuta ya baridi ya injini

narrative_text: Kwenye R-hand engine ya ATR 72, #2 fire handle warning light ilikuwa imewaka, so nikatoa ile fire loop cannon plug ku-troubleshoot, nikakuta maji ndani yake, nikaiclean, nikai-reconnect, na system ika-check good. Pia nilifanya ops check ya ignition A na B, zote zikawa good, lakini nikagundua ignition lead ilikuwa misrouted hivyo nilibidi nidrop lower cowl kuirekebisha kabla ya kurudisha igniter, lead, na kufunga cowl na safety wire plus kutorque ile oil cooler line. Next shift wahakikishe cowls zote (fwd na aft) zimeclose vizuri, maintenance stand imeondolewa, na safety wire pamoja na oil lines upande wa right zime-check kabla ya kurelease aircraft.
summary: R-hand engine fire warning ilitokana na maji kwenye fire loop cannon plug na ignition lead iliyo-misroute, so next shift wanahitaji ku-verify cowl closure, stand removal, na safety wire kabla ya release.

narrative_text: ATR-72 in the hangar on jacks: completed full NLG strut service per job card and AMM 12-12-32 after previous shift flagged low strut with no leakage signs. On removal of the strut servicing tool, the second half of the tool (same part number, chrome-threaded like the schrader valve) was left behind on the schrader valve, which later broke and caused sheet metal damage behind the NLG when the aircraft returned to the hangar. Next shift please inspect NLG area for full extent of damage and confirm tool inventory/count before closing the job card.
summary: During NLG strut servicing on an ATR-72, a mistakenly unremoved tool piece broke the schrader valve and damaged sheet metal, requiring follow-up inspection.

entities.text: full NLG strut service per job card and AMM 12-12-32

narrative_text: Ndege ya ATR-72 ilikuwa hangarini ikiwa juu ya jacks; huduma kamili ya NLG strut ilifanywa kufuata job card na AMM 12-12-32 baada ya shift iliyopita kuripoti strut kuwa chini bila dalili za uvujaji. Wakati wa kutoa tool ya huduma, sehemu ya pili ya chombo hicho (yenye namba sawa na ile ya kwanza, na thread inayofanana na ya schrader valve) ilisahaulika juu ya schrader valve, na baadaye ikasababisha valve hiyo kuvunjika na uharibifu wa sheet metal nyuma ya NLG ndege iliporudi hangarini. Shift inayofuata iangalie eneo la NLG kwa uharibifu zaidi na ihakikishe hesabu ya vifaa kabla ya kufunga job card.
summary: Wakati wa huduma ya NLG strut kwenye ATR-72, kipande cha tool kilichosahaulika kilisababisha uharibifu wa schrader valve na sheet metal, hivyo ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa na ATR-72 hapo hangar ikiwa on jacks, tukafanya full service ya NLG strut kufuata job card na AMM 12-12-32 baada ya previous shift kuflag strut ilikuwa low but hakuna leakage. Ile tool ya servicing, part yake ya pili (ina same part number, chrome na imethread kama schrader valve) ilibaki imeinstall pale kwa schrader valve, na later ikasababisha valve ikabreak na sheet metal damage nyuma ya NLG wakati ndege irudi hangarini. Next shift wapitie NLG area waangalie damage yote na wa-confirm tool count kabla ya kuclose job card.
summary: During NLG servicing kwenye ATR-72, tool piece iliyobaki accidentally ilisababisha schrader valve kubreak na sheet metal damage, so follow-up inspection inahitajika.

narrative_text: On the B737-900 in the hangar, panels 195BL and 195CL were removed to gain access to two fasteners requiring cleanup; dry sanding did not fully clear the surface, and a Dremel tool was then used, which removed some surrounding material beyond the intended area. Work stopped immediately and the inspector was consulted to confirm the correct surface condition, then the lead was notified for direction on next steps. Follow-up needed: inspector/lead to assess extent of damage on the fasteners and surrounding surface, confirm rework or part replacement, and review work card instructions and drawings for clarity before further attempts.
summary: Excess material was inadvertently removed from fasteners near panels 195BL/195CL on a B737-900 during a cleanup task using a Dremel tool, requiring inspector and lead review before proceeding.

narrative_text: Katika ndege ya B737-900 ndani ya hangar, paneli namba 195BL na 195CL ziliondolewa ili kupata nafasi ya kusafisha volti mbili zilizohitaji kazi. Njia ya kusugua kwa mkono haikufanya kazi vizuri, hivyo chombo cha Dremel kilitumika, na wakati wa kazi hiyo sehemu ya uso isiyokusudiwa iliondolewa kimakosa. Kazi ilisimamishwa mara moja, mkaguzi akashauriwa kuthibitisha hali sahihi ya uso, kisha kiongozi wa zamu akaarifiwa ili kupata maelekezo ya hatua ijayo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: mkaguzi na kiongozi wachunguze kiwango cha uharibifu kwenye volti na eneo la jirani, wathibitishe kama sehemu zinahitaji kutengenezwa upya au kubadilishwa, na kaadi za kazi pamoja na michoro zifafanuliwe zaidi kwa kazi za baadaye.
summary: Sehemu ya uso isiyokusudiwa iliondolewa kimakosa karibu na volti kwenye paneli 195BL/195CL za B737-900 wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha kwa kutumia Dremel, hivyo mkaguzi na kiongozi wanahitajika kuchunguza kabla ya hatua zaidi.

narrative_text: Kwa ile B737-900 iko hangar, tulitoa panels 195BL na 195CL ili tupate access kwa hizo fasteners mbili zenye zilihitaji kusafishwa. Dry sanding haikufanya kazi poa, so tukatumia Dremel tool, lakini in the process kuna surface ambayo haikutakikana kuguswa ikaanza kutoka. Nilistop kazi immediately, nikaenda kwa inspector kuconfirm surface inasupposed kuwa vipi, then nikatafuta lead kupata guidance ya next steps. Follow-up inahitajika: inspector na lead wacheck extent ya damage kwa fasteners na surface ya jirani, waconfirm kama rework au part replacement inahitajika, na work card pamoja na drawings ziwe clear zaidi before attempt ingine.
summary: Kuna surface ambayo ilitoka bila kutakikana karibu na fasteners kwa panels 195BL/195CL za B737-900 wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha na Dremel tool, so inspector na lead wanahitajika kufanya review kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: CRJ200 was received on turnover from dayshift still on jacks with NLG torque link change incomplete; release was set for a time that left minimal margin to finish the job. Under pressure from Lead and Maintenance Control to hurry, extra mechanics were pulled in to downjack quickly and Proximity System targets were not reset per the manual. Aircraft departed and NLG failed to retract, resulting in an air return; next shift must verify targeting was completed and confirm whether a gear swing is required before further dispatch.
summary: A rushed NLG torque link turnover led to missed proximity target rigging and an air return after gear failed to retract.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ200 ilikabidhiwa kutoka zamu ya mchana ikiwa bado juu ya jacks, kazi ya kubadilisha torque links za NLG haijakamilika, na muda wa kuruhusiwa kuruka ulikuwa umewekwa karibu sana hivyo kupunguza muda wa kumaliza kazi. Kwa sababu ya shinikizo kutoka kwa Lead na Maintenance Control kuhimiza kuharakisha, mafundi wengine waliitwa kusaidia kushusha ndege haraka, na hatua ya kuweka targets za mfumo wa Proximity iliachwa kimakosa. Ndege ilipoondoka, gia la mbele halikurudi ndani kama ilivyotarajiwa, na ikalazimu kurudi uwanjani; zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha targets zimewekwa sahihi na kuthibitisha kama gear swing inahitajika kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ukaguzi wa haraka wa torque links za NLG ulisababisha kukosekana kwa uwekaji sahihi wa targets za Proximity na ndege kulazimika kurudi baada ya gia kushindwa kurudi ndani.

narrative_text: Tulipata turnover ya CRJ200 kutoka dayshift ikiwa bado iko juu ya jacks, torque link change ya NLG haijaisha, na release time ilikuwa imewekwa karibu sana so muda ulikuwa mchache sana kumaliza job. Lead na Maintenance Control walikuwa wanauliza 'how much longer?' kila mara mpaka wakaleta mechanics wengine wasaidie kudownjack haraka, na tukamiss kuset targets za Proximity System kabla ya kufunga job. Aircraft ilipo-depart NLG haikurudi ndani properly ikafanya air return; next shift wajaribu kuconfirm kama targets ziliwekwa sawa na kama gear swing inahitajika kabla ya kuidispatch tena.
summary: Job ya torque links za NLG ilifanywa kwa haraka sana ikasababisha targets za Proximity kutosetiwa, na aircraft ikafanya air return baada ya gear kushindwa kuretract.

narrative_text: During shift turnover on the MD-80, the outgoing technician confirmed part and serial numbers for the right-side ice protection anticipator and thermostat. When I went back to verify the left side, I found two thermostats installed instead of one thermostat and one anticipator, since both components look nearly identical. I removed the incorrectly installed thermostat and fitted the correct anticipator in its place; please confirm the logbook entry and part numbers are updated before further sign-off.
summary: A technician found a thermostat mistakenly installed in place of the ice protection anticipator on the left side of an MD-80 and corrected it during shift handover verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukabidhi zamu kwenye ndege ya MD-80, fundi wa zamu iliyopita alikuwa amethibitisha namba za sehemu na serial za anticipator na thermostat za mfumo wa kuzuia barafu upande wa kulia. Nilipoenda kuthibitisha upande wa kushoto, nilikuta thermostat mbili zimewekwa badala ya thermostat moja na anticipator moja, kwa kuwa vipande hivyo vinafanana sana. Niliondoa thermostat iliyowekwa kimakosa na kufunga anticipator sahihi mahali pake; tafadhali hakikisha logbook na namba za sehemu zimesahihishwa kabla ya kutia sahihi kazi hiyo.
summary: Fundi aligundua thermostat imewekwa kimakosa badala ya anticipator ya mfumo wa kuzuia barafu upande wa kushoto wa ndege ya MD-80, na akairekebisha wakati wa kuhakiki zamu.

narrative_text: Wakati wa turnover kwenye MD-80, fundi wa shift iliyopita ali-check part na serial numbers za right side ice protection anticipator na thermostat, akaonekana ni sawa. Nilipoenda ku-verify left side, nikakuta thermostat mbili zime-install badala ya thermostat moja na anticipator moja, coz hizo parts zinafanana sana ukiangalia. Nili-remove ile thermostat iliyowekwa wrong halafu nikafunga anticipator sahihi mahali pake; tafadhali confirm logbook entry na part numbers ziko sawa kabla ya ku-sign off.
summary: Fundi aligundua thermostat imewekwa kimakosa instead of anticipator kwenye left side ya ice protection system ya MD-80, akaicorrect during shift verification.

narrative_text: Aircraft arrived just after 0000Z with a pilot report of a lightning strike, and inspection found extensive damage around the nose cone area. After consultation with Maintenance Control, the aircraft was released for two more flight cycles per AMM reference, but this decision appears to have been driven by aircraft-availability pressure rather than full compliance with inspection procedure. Next shift needs to verify the AMM reference used, confirm records are properly closed out, and re-inspect the nose cone before further dispatch.
summary: Aircraft released after lightning-strike inspection despite nose cone damage, likely due to schedule pressure; follow-up inspection and record verification required.

narrative_text: Ndege iliwasili muda mfupi baada ya saa saba usiku ikiwa na ripoti ya rubani kuhusu radi kuipiga, na ukaguzi ulionyesha uharibifu mkubwa karibu na sehemu ya pua ya ndege. Baada ya mashauriano na Maintenance Control, ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea kufanya kazi kwa mizunguko miwili zaidi ya safari kwa kuzingatia rejea ya AMM, lakini uamuzi huu unaonekana kuchochewa na uhaba wa ndege badala ya kufuata taratibu kamili za ukaguzi. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha rejea ya AMM iliyotumika, kuhakikisha kumbukumbu zimekamilika, na kukagua tena sehemu ya pua kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea kufanya kazi baada ya radi kuipiga licha ya uharibifu kwenye pua, jambo linaloonekana kusababishwa na uhaba wa ndege; ukaguzi zaidi unahitajika.

entities.text: muda mfupi baada ya saa saba usiku

narrative_text: Aircraft ilifika saa saba usiku ikiwa na lightning strike report kutoka kwa pilot, na baada ya inspection tukapata damage kubwa sana kwenye nose cone area. Tulishauriana na Maintenance Control na wakasema aircraft iendelee kufanya kazi kwa two more flight cycles kwa reference ya AMM, lakini najua hiyo decision ilikuwa influenced na ukosefu wa aircrafts zingine za kuoperate, si kwa sababu ya procedure kuridhika. Next shift wahakikishe wame-verify hiyo AMM reference, wame-close out records vizuri, na wafanye re-inspection ya nose cone kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: Aircraft iliruhusiwa kuendelea baada ya lightning strike japo kulikuwa na damage kwenye nose cone, inaonekana due to schedule pressure; inspection ya ziada inahitajika.

narrative_text: During the A330 right engine change, previous shift robbed the anti-ice valve, start valve and duct assembly from the old engine and installed them on the new engine without raising any robbing paperwork or Maintenance reporting form. Incoming crew was only verbally told at turnover that parts were robbed, and later completed the shop work order sign-off and M/M leak/operational checks based on that verbal info alone, since no jobcards exist for A330 engine changes (unlike A320/319 which callout the anti-ice valve removal/reinstall step). Please verify and close out the robbing documentation for these three components before further release, and flag the missing engine-change jobcard gap to Engineering/QA.
summary: Parts robbed off the old A330 engine and installed on the new one without proper robbing paperwork, discovered after sign-off due to lack of an A330 engine-change jobcard.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha engine ya kulia ya A330, shift iliyotangulia ilitoa valve ya anti-ice, start valve, na duct assembly kutoka kwenye engine ya zamani na kuziweka kwenye engine mpya bila kujaza fomu ya robbing wala maintenance reporting form. Sisi tuliopokea kazi tuliambiwa tu kwa mdomo wakati wa turnover kuwa parts zimetolewa, na baadaye tukafanya sign-off ya shop work order na leak/operational checks kwa mujibu wa M/M kutegemea tu maelezo hayo ya mdomo, kwa sababu kampuni haina jobcard ya engine change ya A330 (tofauti na A320/319 ambayo ina hatua ya kuondoa na kurudisha anti-ice valve). Tafadhali hakikisheni documentation ya robbing kwa hizo parts tatu imekamilika kabla ya release yoyote, na mjulishe Engineering/QA kuhusu upungufu wa jobcard.
summary: Parts zilitolewa kwenye engine ya zamani ya A330 na kuwekwa kwenye mpya bila documentation sahihi ya robbing, jambo lililogunduliwa baada ya sign-off kwa sababu ya kukosekana jobcard ya engine change.

narrative_text: Kwa hii A330 right engine change, previous shift walirob parts - anti-ice valve, start valve na duct assembly - kutoka kwa old engine wakaziinstall kwa new engine bila kufanya robbing paperwork ama maintenance reporting form. Sisi tuliopokea job tuliambiwa tu verbally during turnover ati parts zimerobbed, ndio tukaenda tuka-sign off ile shop work order na kufanya leak/operational checks per M/M kutegemea tu hiyo verbal info, kwa sababu company haina jobcard ya A330 engine change (tofauti na A320/319 ambayo ina step ya remove/reinstall anti-ice valve). Tafadhali confirm documentation ya robbing kwa hizo three components ikamilike kabla ya release, na raise the jobcard gap kwa Engineering/QA.
summary: Parts zilirobbed kutoka old A330 engine zikaenda new engine bila proper paperwork, ikagunduliwa baada ya sign-off kwa sababu ya kukosekana jobcard ya A330 engine change.

narrative_text: A320 RH main landing gear side stay bushing job (EC/RA task card) was picked up mid-shift under time pressure while waiting on the retaining nut and washer to arrive. Lead verbally briefed final torque as 500 ft-lbs and initial torque as 440 ft-lbs, but the task card details were not re-verified as a crew before torquing began. Next shift please confirm torque values against the actual EC/RA paperwork before final torque is applied, and re-check inspector sign-off on the initial torque setting.
summary: RH main gear side stay bushing torque values were relayed verbally instead of confirmed against the EC/RA card, requiring verification by next shift before final torque.

entities.text: RH main landing gear side stay bushing

narrative_text: Kazi ya bushing ya side stay ya gear kuu ya kulia (RH) ya ndege A320, chini ya EC/RA task card, ilianzishwa wakati wa shinikizo la muda huku tukisubiri nut na washer mpya kufika. Lead alitueleza kwa mdomo kuwa torque ya mwisho ni 500 ft-lbs na ya awali ni 440 ft-lbs, lakini hatukurejea pamoja kama timu kuhakiki taarifa hizo kwenye task card kabla ya kuanza kukaza. Shift inayokuja tafadhali hakikisheni namba za torque zinalingana na hati halisi ya EC/RA kabla ya torque ya mwisho kufanywa, na mrejeshe sahihi ya inspector kwenye torque ya awali.
summary: Namba za torque za bushing ya side stay ya gear ya RH zilipitishwa kwa mdomo badala ya kuhakikiwa kwenye hati ya EC/RA, hivyo zinahitaji ukaguzi na shift inayofuata.

entities.text: bushing ya side stay ya gear kuu ya kulia (RH)

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya ile RH main gear side stay bushing job kwa A320, under EC/RA task card, tukiwa na time pressure while tunasubiri nut na washer mpya kufika. Lead alitupea verbally final torque as 500 ft-lbs na initial torque 440 ft-lbs, lakini hatuku-cross check na wenzetu kwa task card kabla ya kuanza torquing. Next shift please hakikisheni torque values against actual EC/RA paperwork before final torque, na mcheck tena inspector sign-off kwa ile initial torque setting.
summary: Torque values za RH main gear side stay bushing zilipitishwa verbally tu badala ya kuverify na EC/RA card, so next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm kabla ya final torque.

entities.text: RH main gear side stay bushing

narrative_text: B757-300 door 1-Left escape slide had detached and was replaced per AMM 25-66-01 following a verbal turnover from swing shift; the old slide was removed and a new one installed. On arrival at the down-line station, crew reported the D-Ring missing and the Door Assist Bottle empty, apparently overlooked during the changeout as the D-Ring was confused with another ring on the slide. Next shift to verify D-Ring installation and Assist Bottle pressure/status before further dispatch, and confirm AMM steps were fully completed.
summary: A B757-300 1-Left door slide replacement was completed but the D-Ring and Assist Bottle check were missed, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B757-300 ilikuwa na tatizo la slide ya mlango wa 1-Left iliyokuwa imeanguka, na ilibadilishwa kufuatana na AMM 25-66-01 baada ya maelezo ya mdomo kutoka kwa zamu ya jioni; slide ya zamani iliondolewa na mpya kufungwa. Ilipofika kwenye kituo cha chini, wafanyakazi waliripoti kuwa D-Ring haikuwepo na chupa ya msaada wa mlango (Door Assist Bottle) ilikuwa tupu, jambo lililosahaulika wakati wa kazi kwani D-Ring ilichanganywa na pete nyingine kwenye slide. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe D-Ring imefungwa vizuri na hali ya chupa ya msaada kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuendelea na safari, na kuthibitisha hatua zote za AMM zimekamilika.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa slide ya mlango wa 1-Left kwenye B757-300 ulikamilika lakini ukaguzi wa D-Ring na chupa ya msaada ulisahaulika, hivyo unahitaji ukaguzi wa ziada.

entities.text: chupa ya msaada wa mlango (Door Assist Bottle)

narrative_text: Kwa B757-300, door 1-Left slide ilikuwa imeanguka, tukafanya replacement kufuata AMM 25-66-01 baada ya verbal turnover kutoka swing shift; old slide iliondolewa na new one ikafungwa. Aircraft ilipofika down-line station, crew waliripoti D-Ring missing na Door Assist Bottle ilikuwa empty, seems ilisahaulika during changeout coz D-Ring ilichanganywa na ring mwingine kwenye slide. Next shift wa-verify D-Ring installation na status ya Assist Bottle before dispatch, na confirm AMM steps zote zimefanywa vizuri.
summary: Slide replacement ya door 1-Left kwenye B757-300 ilikamilika lakini D-Ring check na Assist Bottle zilisahaulika, so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: During the #2 layover check on the MD-11, I completed the C1, C2 and C3 cargo compartment inspections under Item 45, except for cycling the C3 cargo door, which was passed on as a verbal turnover due to time pressure. The incoming technician should confirm the C3 door cycle was actually completed before further dispatch. Inspection was signed off and witnessed prior to departure, but please verify the verbal turnover was closed out properly.
summary: Technician handed over verbal turnover for uncompleted C3 cargo door cycle check on MD-11 during layover inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa layover namba mbili kwa ndege ya MD-11, nilikamilisha ukaguzi wa sehemu za mizigo C1, C2 na C3 kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye Item 45, isipokuwa kufungua na kufunga mlango wa C3 ambao niliuachia mfanyakazi mwingine kwa maelezo ya mdomo kutokana na uchache wa muda. Fundi atakayeendelea na kazi anaombwa kuthibitisha kuwa zoezi hilo la mlango wa C3 limekamilika kabla ya ndege kuruka tena. Ukaguzi ulikamilika na kushuhudiwa kabla ya ndege kuondoka, lakini tafadhali hakikisha maelezo yale ya mdomo yamefuatiliwa ipasavyo.
summary: Fundi aliachia maelezo ya mdomo kuhusu ukaguzi usiokamilika wa mlango wa C3 kwenye ndege ya MD-11.

narrative_text: Kwa hii #2 layover check ya MD-11, nilifanya inspection ya C1, C2 na C3 cargo compartments kama Item 45 inavyotaka, lakini cycling ya C3 cargo door sikuweza kufanya kwa sababu ya time pressure, so niliachia verbal turnover kwa next technician. Mtu atakaye-take over anaombwa akonfirm door cycle imefanywa kabla ya dispatch. Inspection ilikuwa signed off na kuwitnessed before departure, lakini please verify ile verbal turnover imefuatiliwa properly.
summary: Technician aliachia verbal turnover ya C3 cargo door cycle check ambayo haikukamilika kwenye MD-11 layover inspection.

narrative_text: On the B737-400 in the hangar for PSU replacement, approximately 28 oxygen generators were installed with shipping safety pins still in place, and this was only verbally passed to the next shift instead of being fully documented on the maintenance write-up. Inspection was able to verify part numbers, firing pin and release pin installation, and PSU drop per the manual, but could not stamp off the pin removal task since it was left incomplete by maintenance. Please follow up with maintenance lead to confirm all safety pins are removed from rows XYZ before further inspection buy-off, and reinforce that partial work must be fully documented, not just verbally handed over.
summary: Incomplete documentation and communication gap between mechanics and inspection over oxygen generator safety pin removal on a B737-400 led to a partial, unstamped inspection task.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-400 iliyokuwa hangarini kwa kazi ya kubadilisha PSU, jenereta za oksijeni takribani 28 ziliwekwa zikiwa bado na pini za usalama za usafirishaji, na taarifa hii ilipitishwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu bila kuandikwa vizuri kwenye karatasi ya kazi. Ukaguzi ulithibitisha namba za sehemu, uwekaji wa pini za kufyatua na kutolewa, pamoja na kushuka kwa PSU kulingana na mwongozo, lakini haikuwezekana kutia muhuri kamili kwani kazi ya kuondoa pini katika safu XYZ haikukamilika. Tafadhali fuatilia na kiongozi wa matengenezo kuhakikisha pini zote za usalama zimeondolewa kabla ya ukaguzi wa mwisho, na ihakikishwe kazi isiyokamilika inaandikwa kikamilifu badala ya kupitishwa kwa maneno tu.
summary: Kulikuwa na mawasiliano hafifu kati ya mafundi na wakaguzi kuhusu kuondolewa kwa pini za usalama za jenereta za oksijeni kwenye B737-400, hivyo kazi kubaki bila kukamilika na muhuri wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-400 iliyokuwa hangar kwa PSU replacement, tuliweka approximately 28 oxygen generators lakini zilikuwa bado na safety pins za shipping, na hii information ilipitishwa verbally tu kwa next shift bila kuandikwa fully kwenye maintenance write-up. Inspection ilithibitisha part numbers, firing pin na release pin installation, na PSU drop check kwa manual, lakini hatukuweza kutoa stamp kamili kwa sababu pin removal task kwenye rows XYZ haikukamilika. Tafadhali fuatilia na maintenance lead ku-confirm pins zote zimeondolewa kabla ya inspection buy-off, na tuhakikishe partial work inaandikwa vizuri si kupitishwa kwa maneno tu.
summary: Kuna miscom kati ya mechs na inspection kuhusu oxygen generator safety pins kwenye B737-400, so task imebaki incomplete bila stamp ya inspection.

narrative_text: A321 (Ref X) had an air interrupt while parked and lost the green hydraulic system, requiring manual gear deployment; the outstanding EO covering this exact hydraulic failure mode had still not been accomplished on this tail. Management deferred the EO again, citing downtime concerns, even after this failure demonstrated the risk it was written to prevent. Next shift must escalate EO compliance on this aircraft and check fleet-wide status before further dispatch.
summary: A321 suffered a green hydraulic system failure requiring manual gear extension because a known EO addressing this exact fault had not been accomplished, and management again deferred the fix.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 ilipata hitilafu ya hewa ikiwa imeegeshwa, na mfumo wa hydraulic wa green ukashindwa kabisa, hivyo timu ililazimika kuteremsha gear kwa mkono. EO iliyotolewa kushughulikia hitilafu hii mahususi ilikuwa bado haijafanyiwa kazi kwenye ndege hii, na hata baada ya tukio hili, uongozi uliahirisha tena EO kwa sababu ya muda itakaochukua. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kufuatilia kwa haraka utekelezaji wa EO hii na kuhakikisha ndege nyingine zenye tatizo kama hili hazijaachwa bila kufanyiwa kazi.
summary: Ndege ya A321 ilipoteza mfumo wa hydraulic wa green na kulazimika kuteremsha gear kwa mkono kwa sababu EO muhimu haikutekelezwa, na uongozi uliahirisha tena marekebisho.

narrative_text: Ile A321 ilipata air interrupt ikiwa parked, na tukapoteza green hydraulic system kabisa, so team ilibidi ideploy gear manually. Ile EO ambayo inaaddress exactly hii failure bado haija-accomplish kwa hii tail, na management wameahirisha tena wakisema itachukua muda mrefu. Zamu inayofuata lazima ifuatilie hii EO compliance na kucheck fleet-wide status kabla ya dispatch yoyote ijayo.
summary: A321 ilipoteza green hydraulic system na ikabidi gear ideployiwe manually kwa sababu EO muhimu bado haijafanywa, management wakiahirisha tena.

narrative_text: During climb the B757 right engine overheat EICAS and warning activated; right bleed was switched off and the power reduced light extinguished, so the aircraft continued with bleed off. A high power engine run of approximately 5 minutes at takeoff power was performed and no discrepancies were found with bleeds on or off, so the aircraft was released for continued service. However, after logbook sign-off Maintenance Control requested a follow-up leak check of the pneumatic ducting and bleed air tubing in the right engine nacelle, and the incoming technician subsequently found an actual leak on the high pressure duct between the HPSOV and top of engine. Follow-up needed: review why the general visual inspection and idle leak check were not completed before sign-off, and confirm duct repair status before next flight.
summary: A right engine overheat warning on a B757 was cleared after a high power run showed no fault, but a later inspection found an actual bleed duct leak that should have been checked before logbook sign-off.

entities.text: leak check of the pneumatic ducting

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupaa, ndege ya B757 ilionyesha onyo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini ya kulia (EICAS), na fundi aliyekuwepo alizima bleed ya kulia hadi taa ya kupungua nguvu ikazimika, ndege ikaendelea safari na bleed ikiwa imezimwa. Ukaguzi wa injini ulifanywa kwa muda wa dakika tano kwa nguvu ya juu kama za kuruka, na hakuna hitilafu iliyoonekana ikiwa bleed imewashwa au imezimwa, hivyo ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea na safari. Hata hivyo, baada ya kusaini kitabu cha matengenezo, Kitengo cha Udhibiti wa Matengenezo kiliomba ukaguzi wa ziada wa uvujaji kwenye mabomba ya hewa karibu na injini ya kulia, na fundi aliyefuata alibaini uvujaji halisi kwenye bomba kati ya HPSOV na sehemu ya juu ya injini. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kupitia kwa nini ukaguzi wa jumla na ukaguzi wa uvujaji haukufanyika kabla ya kusaini kitabu, na kuthibitisha hali ya ukarabati wa bomba kabla ya safari ijayo.
summary: Onyo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini ya kulia ya B757 lilionekana kutokuwa na hitilafu baada ya jaribio la nguvu, lakini ukaguzi uliofuata ulibaini uvujaji halisi wa bomba ambao ulipaswa kukaguliwa kabla ya kusaini kitabu cha matengenezo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa injini kwa nguvu ya juu

narrative_text: Ile time tulikuwa tuna-climb, right engine overheat EICAS na warning zilikuja on, tukazima right bleed na power reduced light ikaenda off, so tukaendelea na bleed ikiwa off. Nikafanya high power engine run kama dakika tano at takeoff power, na hakuna discrepancy iliyoonekana on or off bleeds, kwa hiyo nikasign logbook ni ok for continued service. Lakini baada ya ku-sign, Maintenance Control waliomba turudi tu-troubleshoot na tufanye leak check ya pneumatic ducting kwenye nacelle area ya right engine, na yule technician aliyepokea turnover akapata leak halisi kwenye high pressure duct between HPSOV na top of engine. Tunahitaji follow-up: tuangalie kwa nini general visual inspection na idle leak check hazikufanyika before sign-off, na tuconfirm duct imefixiwa kabla ya next flight.
summary: Right engine overheat warning kwenye B757 ilionekana clear baada ya high power run, lakini baadaye leak halisi ilipatikana kwenye duct ambayo ingepaswa kuchekiwa kabla ya kusign logbook.

narrative_text: Robbed the #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) from Aircraft Y to replace the inop unit on Aircraft X; all paperwork was completed except the serviceable parts tag, which I missed since I was focused on the robbed-parts tag. At shift change I was told a serviceable tag is required, and there was confusion between duty center, lead controller, QC supervisor and receiving inspector on whether to print a physical tag or just issue one in the computer. Next shift please confirm with QC/receiving inspection which method is correct and ensure a properly printed and filled serviceable tag is generated before closing out the job.
summary: A robbed FCU panel swap between two B737-500s was completed without the required serviceable parts tag, and follow-up is needed to resolve confusion over correct tag documentation procedure.

narrative_text: Tulitoa #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) kutoka kwa Ndege Y ili kubadilisha ile iliyokuwa mbovu kwenye Ndege X; karatasi zote zilikamilishwa isipokuwa tag ya serviceable part, ambayo nilisahau kwa sababu nilikuwa nimezingatia tu ile tag ya kitu kilichotolewa. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu niliambiwa kuwa tag ya serviceable inahitajika, na kulikuwa na mkanganyiko kati ya duty center, lead controller, msimamizi wa QC na receiving inspector kuhusu kama tag ichapishwe kwa mkono au itolewe tu kwenye kompyuta. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali thibitisheni na QC/receiving inspection njia sahihi, na muhakikishe tag ya serviceable imechapishwa na kujazwa vizuri kabla ya kazi kufungwa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa kifaa cha FCU kati ya ndege mbili za B737-500 ulikamilika bila tag ya serviceable inayohitajika, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika kutatua mkanganyiko wa taratibu za nyaraka.

narrative_text: Tulirob ile #1 Nav Control Panel (FCU) kutoka Aircraft Y kubadilisha ile inop kwa Aircraft X; paperwork zote zilikuwa complete except serviceable parts tag, nilimiss kwa sababu nilikuwa nimefocus tu kwa ile robbed-parts tag. Kwa shift change waliniambia serviceable tag inahitajika, na kulikuwa na confusion kati ya duty center, lead controller, QC supervisor na receiving inspector kama tuprint tag physically ama tuissue tu number kwenye computer. Next shift tafadhali confirm na QC/receiving inspection method sahihi, na mhakikishe serviceable tag imeprint na kufilled properly kabla ya kuclose out ile job.
summary: Wakati wa kurob FCU panel kati ya ndege mbili za B737-500, serviceable tag ilimissed, so follow-up inahitajika kuclear confusion ya documentation procedure.

narrative_text: Rudder R&R on the B737-800 was not completed overnight due to inadequate hangar tooling; the overhead crane lacks sufficient height and the sling setup used for 700-series rudders does not transfer safely to the 800. Nose jacking attempts on the ramp incline nearly caused the aircraft to roll off the jack, so the crew shifted to an outside washrack crane with an extension arm, but after six mechanics and a crane operator worked an extended period, only the #1 hinge bolt was installed. Next shift needs proper equipment/tooling assessment before continuing, as current setup is unsafe and inefficient for 800 rudder changes.
summary: Overnight B737-800 rudder installation was left incomplete due to inadequate crane/tooling and unsafe jacking conditions, requiring equipment review before continuation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kuondoa na kuweka rudder mpya kwenye ndege ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku kucha kwa sababu vifaa vya hangar havitoshi; crane haifiki urefu unaohitajika na mfumo wa sling unaotumika kwa ndege za 700 haufai kwa 800. Majaribio ya kuinua sehemu ya mbele ya ndege kwa jack yalikaribia kusababisha ndege kuanguka kutoka kwenye jack, hivyo wafanyakazi walihamishia kazi hiyo nje kwenye washrack wakitumia crane yenye extension arm, lakini baada ya mafundi sita na dereva wa crane kufanya kazi kwa muda mrefu, bolt moja tu ya hinge ya kwanza ndiyo iliwekwa. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kupitia upya vifaa na taratibu kabla ya kuendelea kwani hali ya sasa si salama wala haifanyi kazi vizuri.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha rudder ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku kwa sababu ya uhaba wa vifaa na hatari za kuinua ndege, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa vifaa kabla ya kuendelea.

entities.text: bolt moja tu ya hinge ya kwanza

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-attempt rudder R&R kwa hii B737-800 lakini haikukamilika overnight kwa sababu hangar tooling ni inadequate; ile overhead crane haifiki height inayohitajika na sling setup ya 700 haiwezi kutumika direct kwa 800. Tuli-try nose jacking huko ramp lakini incline ilikuwa inaweza kufanya aircraft i-roll off jack, so supervision waka-instruct tutumie ile crane ya nje kwenye washrack yenye extension arm, but after mechanics sita na crane operator kufanya kazi masaa mengi, ni bolt moja tu ya #1 hinge ndio iliingia. Next shift wanahitaji ku-review equipment na tooling before wanaendelea kwa sababu hii setup ya sasa si safe wala efficient.
summary: Rudder R&R ya B737-800 haiku-complete overnight due to poor tooling na crane setup, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-assess equipment kwanza kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: On ship XYZ, #1 engine thrust reverser bypass pin was not removed after job card completion, and the aircraft flew one revenue flight where the reverser failed to deploy on landing. Personnel movement was heavy during the shift due to ongoing security interviews of maintenance staff, and the original mechanic assigned to the aircraft was pulled and suspended mid-shift, leaving coverage gaps. Please verify all bypass pins and job card sign-offs on this tail before next dispatch, and confirm reassigned mechanics completed proper handover on all open items.
summary: A thrust reverser bypass pin was left installed after maintenance, causing a reverser deployment failure in flight, amid disrupted staffing from concurrent security interviews.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege XYZ, pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser ya injini namba 1 haikutolewa baada ya kazi ya job card kukamilika, na ndege ilifanya safari moja ambapo thrust reverser haikufunguka wakati wa kutua. Zamu hiyo ilikuwa na msukosuko mkubwa wa wafanyakazi kwa sababu ya mahojiano ya usalama yaliyokuwa yakiendelea, na fundi aliyekuwa amepangiwa ndege hiyo alitolewa na kusimamishwa kazi katikati ya zamu, hali iliyoacha pengo la usimamizi. Tafadhali hakikisheni pini zote za bypass na saini za job card kwenye ndege hii kabla ya safari inayofuata, na thibitisheni mafundi waliopangiwa upya walipokea taarifa kamili za kazi zilizobaki wazi.
summary: Pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser iliachwa ikiwa imewekwa baada ya matengenezo, na kusababisha reverser kushindwa kufunguka wakati wa ndege, huku wafanyakazi wakiwa wamevurugika kutokana na mahojiano ya usalama yaliyokuwa yakiendelea.

entities.text: pini ya bypass ya thrust reverser ya injini namba 1

narrative_text: Ship XYZ, baada ya job card kukamilika kwa #1 engine, thrust reverser bypass pin haikutolewa, na aircraft ikafanya flight moja tu reverser ikashindwa deploy wakati wa landing. Zamu ilikuwa na msukosuko sana kwa sababu ya interviews za security zilizokuwa zikiendelea, mechanic aliyekuwa assigned kwa hiyo aircraft alichukuliwa na kusimamishwa mid-shift, so kulikuwa na coverage gap. Tafadhali confirm bypass pins zote na job card sign-offs kwenye hii tail kabla ya next dispatch, na hakikisha mechanics walio-reassigned walipata proper handover ya open items zote.
summary: Bypass pin ya thrust reverser iliachwa kwenye #1 engine baada ya maintenance, ikasababisha reverser kushindwa deploy in-flight, wakati staffing ilikuwa disrupted na security interviews.

narrative_text: During engine maintenance on the MD-11, the #1 pylon thrust reverser was pinned per L1011-style lockout habit, but no log entry was made and it was not communicated at shift turnover. Aircraft was released to service and later had to air turn-back after a passenger noticed a flapping panel on the #1 pylon; the lockout pin was found still installed on arrival at the gate. Next shift must verify all reverser pins are removed/logged before release, and job cards need updating since the access panel closes flush and gives no visual indication of pin status from the ground.
summary: An MD-11 thrust reverser lockout pin was left installed and unlogged at turnover, causing an air turn-back, highlighting a need for improved pin-tracking procedures.

narrative_text: Wakati wa matengenezo ya injini kwenye ndege ya MD-11, pini ya kufunga thrust reverser kwenye pylon namba 1 iliwekwa kwa mtindo unaotumika kwenye L1011, lakini hakuna kumbukumbu iliyoandikwa wala taarifa iliyotolewa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Ndege iliruhusiwa kuendelea na safari na baadaye ilirudi uwanjani kwa sababu abiria aliona paneli ikipepea kwenye pylon namba 1; ilipofika geti, pini ya kufunga ilikutwa bado imewekwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha pini zote zimeondolewa na kuandikwa kwenye rekodi kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kusafiri, na taratibu za kazi zinahitaji kurekebishwa kwa kuwa paneli ya ufikiaji hufunga sawasawa na ganda la ndege bila kuonyesha hali ya pini kutoka nje.
summary: Pini ya thrust reverser ya ndege ya MD-11 iliachwa imewekwa bila kuandikwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, jambo lililosababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani, na kuonyesha haja ya kuboresha taratibu za ufuatiliaji wa pini.

narrative_text: Wakati wa maintenance ya engine kwenye MD-11, ile thrust reverser ya #1 pylon ili-pinned kwa style ya L1011, lakini hakuna log entry ilifanywa na hakuna aliye-inform during turnover. Aircraft ili-released for service na ikabidi i-turn-back mid-air baada ya pax ku-notice panel iki-flap kwenye #1 pylon; ilipofika gate, ile lockout pin ilikutwa bado imewekwa. Next shift lazima wa-verify pins zote zimeondolewa na ku-log kabla ya release, na job cards zinahitaji ku-updated kwa sababu ile access panel inafunga flush bila kuonyesha status ya pin kutoka ground.
summary: Thrust reverser lockout pin ya MD-11 iliachwa imewekwa bila kuandikwa during turnover, ikasababisha air turn-back, na inaonyesha need ya kuboresha pin tracking procedures.

narrative_text: Since there is no Crew Chief assigned to our area on the A300 line, management continues to direct me, as senior mechanic, to complete the Crew Chief turnover report at end of shift. This conflicts with the GPM, which states that only a Supervisor working jointly in the same area is required to prepare the turnover when no Crew Chief is assigned. Please follow up with Production Supervisor on assigning a Crew Chief for this area, or clarify in writing who is authorized to sign the turnover report so we stop operating outside the GPM.
summary: A senior mechanic is being required to complete Crew Chief turnover reports on the A300 line despite no Crew Chief being assigned, contrary to GPM policy, and requests clarification/assignment from management.

narrative_text: Kwa kuwa hakuna Crew Chief aliyewekwa katika eneo letu la A300, uongozi umeendelea kunielekeza mimi, kama fundi mwandamizi, kukamilisha ripoti ya turnover ya Crew Chief mwishoni mwa shift. Hali hii inakinzana na taratibu za GPM, ambazo zinasema ni Supervisor pekee anayefanya kazi katika eneo hilo hilo ndiye anayepaswa kuandaa ripoti hiyo endapo hakuna Crew Chief aliyeteuliwa. Tafadhali fuatilia suala hili na Production Supervisor ili aidha ateuliwe Crew Chief wa eneo hili, au itolewe maelezo rasmi ya nani mwenye mamlaka ya kutia sahihi ripoti hiyo, ili tuache kukiuka taratibu za kampuni.
summary: Fundi mwandamizi analazimika kukamilisha ripoti za turnover za Crew Chief kwenye ndege za A300 licha ya kutokuwepo Crew Chief aliyeteuliwa, jambo linalokiuka sera za GPM, hivyo anaomba ufafanuzi na hatua kutoka kwa uongozi.

entities.text: ripoti ya turnover ya Crew Chief

narrative_text: So since hakuna Crew Chief amewekwa kwa area yetu ya A300, management wamekuwa wakinipatia mimi, as the senior mechanic, kufill hiyo Crew Chief turnover report kila mwisho wa shift. Hii inakinzana na GPM, ambayo inasema ni Supervisor tu anayework palepale ndio anafaa kuandika turnover kama hakuna Crew Chief assigned. Tafadhali fuatilia na Production Supervisor kuhusu kuassign Crew Chief kwa hii area, ama watupe something in writing ya nani mwenye authority ya ku-sign hiyo report, ndio tuache kuviolate GPM.
summary: Senior mechanic analazimishwa kufill Crew Chief turnover reports kwa A300 line pasipo Crew Chief assigned, ikikiuka GPM, hivyo anaomba management wafuatilie na kutoa clarification.

narrative_text: During the fuel drain valve task on the A320 (parked, gate maintenance), the three technicians assigned were unfamiliar with the job and had limited AMM guidance on defueling before starting; power was on and tank showed 3000 lbs when the valve was worked loose. While loosening the valve counterclockwise, the keeper lock fell into the drip bucket and the valve assembly gave way, releasing fuel with the cover dropping into the bucket, though the valve was partially locked back before help was requested. Next shift needs to verify tank fuel state, confirm valve/keeper lock integrity and secure installation, and review AMM procedure adequacy for defuel-before-removal steps.
summary: Technicians unfamiliar with the task lost control of a fuel drain valve on a parked A320 due to unclear AMM guidance, requiring follow-up on valve integrity and fuel state.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kuondoa mafuta kwenye valve ya ndege ya A320 iliyokuwa imesimama, mafundi watatu waliopewa kazi hawakuwa na uzoefu na kazi hiyo, na maelezo ya AMM hayakuwa wazi kuhusu kuhamisha mafuta kabla ya kuanza; nguvu ilikuwa imewashwa na tanki lilionyesha uzito wa mafuta wa 3000 wakati valve ilipolegezwa. Wakati wa kulegeza valve kinyume cha saa, kifungo cha kushikilia (keeper lock) kilianguka kwenye ndoo na sehemu ya valve ikatoka ghafla, ikimwaga mafuta na kifuniko kikaanguka ndani ya ndoo, ingawa walifanikiwa kurudisha valve kwa sehemu kabla ya kuomba msaada. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kiwango cha mafuta kwenye tanki, kuangalia uimara wa valve na keeper lock, na kupitia upya taratibu za AMM kuhusu kuhamisha mafuta kabla ya kuondoa sehemu hiyo.
summary: Mafundi wasio na uzoefu walipoteza udhibiti wa valve ya mafuta kwenye A320 iliyosimama kutokana na maelekezo yasiyo wazi ya AMM, hivyo linahitajika ufuatiliaji wa hali ya valve na mafuta.

narrative_text: Kwa hii job ya fuel drain valve kwenye A320 iliyo parked, technicians watatu walioassignwa hawakuwa na experience na job hii, na AMM haikuwa na details za ku-defuel kabla ya kuanza kazi; power ilikuwa on na tank ilionyesha 3000 lbs wakati wakianza kulegeza valve. Tuli-turn valve counterclockwise, keeper lock ikaanguka kwa bucket na assembly ikatoka ghafla, mafuta yakamwagika na cover ikaanguka ndani ya bucket, lakini tuliweza ku-lock valve back kwa partial before tukaita Lead for help. Next shift wanahitaji kucheck fuel state ya tank, kuconfirm valve na keeper lock ziko sawa, na kureview AMM procedure kwa hizi defuel steps kabla ya removal.
summary: Technicians wasio na experience walipoteza control ya fuel drain valve kwenye A320 parked kwa sababu ya AMM isiyo clear, hivyo follow-up inahitajika kwa valve integrity na fuel status.

narrative_text: During the hangar swap to set up Aircraft X for RON work, Aircraft Y was towed out of the south hangar and Aircraft X was marshalled in deep to allow two narrow body aircraft to park behind it. As the guide man watched clearance at the #1 engine nose cowl, the Lead Technician slowed the tow but a popping sound was heard, and the radome of Aircraft X was found resting on the leading edge of Aircraft Z's left wing. Aircraft X was pushed back immediately and chocked, tow bar disconnected, and power/entry stand positioned; maintenance to inspect both aircraft for damage and review wing-walker/guide-man positioning before next hangar move.
summary: During a hangar repositioning move, Aircraft X's radome contacted the left wing leading edge of Aircraft Z due to inadequate clearance monitoring by the guide man.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege hangarini kuandaa Ndege X kwa kazi za RON, Ndege Y ilivutwa kutoka hangar ya kusini ili Ndege X iingizwe ndani zaidi, ikiwa nafasi ya kuegesha ndege mbili za narrow body nyuma yake. Fundi msimamizi alipunguza kasi ya kuvuta ndege huku mwongozaji akiwa mbele akiangalia nafasi kati ya nose cowl ya injini namba moja na eneo la radome, lakini sauti ya kudundika ilisikika na ikagundulika radome ya Ndege X imegusa ukingo wa mbele wa bawa la kushoto la Ndege Z. Ndege X ilisukumwa nyuma mara moja, magurudumu yakawekewa vizuizi, tow bar ikatolewa na stendi ya kuingilia ikawekwa; ukaguzi wa uharibifu kwa ndege zote mbili unahitajika, pamoja na mapitio ya nafasi za wafanyakazi wa kuongoza mabawa kabla ya kuhamisha ndege nyingine hangarini.
summary: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege hangarini, radome ya Ndege X iligusa ukingo wa bawa la kushoto la Ndege Z kutokana na ufuatiliaji hafifu wa nafasi na mwongozaji.

entities.text: nose cowl ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-move Aircraft X kuingia hangar deep kwa ajili ya RON work, so tukatoa kwanza Aircraft Y kutoka south hangar ndio kuwe na nafasi. Lead Technician alikuwa akimarshal, mimi kama guide man nikaenda front kuangalia clearance kati ya #1 engine nose cowl na radome ya Aircraft Z, lakini akapunguza speed kidogo tu na tukasikia popping sound - tukageuka tukaona radome ya Aircraft X imekaa juu ya leading edge ya left wing ya Aircraft Z. Tukapush back mara moja, tukaweka chocks, kutoa tow bar na ku-position power na entry stand; tunahitaji damage inspection kwa hizo aircraft zote mbili na turudi tu-review positioning ya wing walkers kabla ya move ingine yoyote hangarini.
summary: Wakati wa kufanya hangar move, radome ya Aircraft X iligonga leading edge ya left wing ya Aircraft Z kwa sababu guide man hakuwa na enough situational awareness kwa clearance.

narrative_text: On the B757-200, the mid lavatory was placarded inop for an external leak at the service port, but the two technicians handling it were pulled off for scheduled paid lunch before the clamp was installed and the inop sticker placed at the service panel. Two relief mechs were sent to finish the job with no written or verbal turnover, and the aircraft pushed back before MEL compliance was actually completed. When the original techs checked with the relief mechs, neither party realized the job was incomplete; supervisor was notified and asked to bring the aircraft back to the gate but refused, saying downline station ZZZ1 would handle it instead. Follow-up needed: confirm with ZZZ1 that the clamp was installed and MEL properly closed out before further dispatch.
summary: Lavatory MEL compliance on a B757-200 was left incomplete after a rushed shift/lunch handoff with no turnover, and the aircraft departed the gate without the clamp or inop placard confirmed installed.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757-200, choo cha katikati kiliwekwa alama ya inop kwa sababu ya uvujaji nje kwenye service port, lakini mafundi wawili waliokuwa wakishughulikia hilo waliondolewa kazini ili wapate chakula cha mchana kabla ya kuweka clamp na sticker ya inop pale kwenye paneli. Mafundi wengine wawili walipewa kazi ya kumaliza bila maelezo yoyote ya maandishi wala ya mdomo, na ndege ikaondoka geti kabla kazi ya MEL haijakamilika kikamilifu. Wafanyakazi wa awali waliporudi na kuuliza kuhusu hali ya MEL, wote waligundua kuwa kazi haikuwa imekamilika; msimamizi alijulishwa na kuombwa arudishe ndege gate lakini alikataa, akisema kituo cha ZZZ1 kitakamilisha kazi hiyo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: thibitisha na ZZZ1 kwamba clamp imewekwa na MEL imefungwa vizuri kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Kazi ya MEL kwenye choo cha ndege ya B757-200 iliachwa nusu baada ya mafundi kubadilishwa bila maelezo kamili, na ndege ikaondoka geti bila uhakika wa clamp au alama ya inop.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, mid lavatory ilikuwa placarded inop due external leak kwa service port, lakini sisi wawili tuliokuwa tunafanya job tuliitwa tuende lunch kabla ya kuweka clamp na kubandika inop sticker pale service panel. Wakaleta wale wengine mechs wawili wamalize kazi bila turnover yoyote, written ama verbal, halafu ndege ikaondoka gate kabla MEL compliance haijakamilika fully. Tuliporudi na kuuliza wale wengine kuhusu MEL, hakuna hata mmoja alikuwa anajua kama job haijaisha; tulienda kwa supervisor tukamwomba arudishe aircraft gate lakini akakataa, akasema atapiga simu ZZZ1 wamalize hapo. Follow-up inahitajika: confirm na ZZZ1 kama clamp imewekwa na MEL imeclose out properly kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: MEL job ya lavatory kwa B757-200 iliachwa incomplete baada ya rushed shift change bila turnover, na aircraft ikaondoka gate bila clamp au inop placard kuconfirm.

narrative_text: During nose gear drag brace installation on the MD-80, we found a corroded taper pin; the replacement ordered against the IPC did not match the original. Gear shop and machinist confirmed pins are individually machined per hole and a single pin cannot be substituted, so the entire drag brace assembly required replacement. New assembly arrived from stores late in shift; next crew to complete installation and verify sign-off from step 7 onward.
summary: A mismatched taper pin during nose gear drag brace work led to full assembly replacement, with installation to be completed by the next shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufunga drag brace ya nose gear kwenye ndege ya MD-80, tuligundua taper pin moja imeoza kwa kutu; pin mpya iliyoagizwa kwa kutumia IPC haikufanana na ile ya awali. Gear shop pamoja na fundi wa mashine walithibitisha kuwa pini hizo hutengenezwa kila moja kulingana na tundu lake mahususi, hivyo haiwezekani kubadilisha pin moja peke yake. Hii ilipelekea uamuzi wa kubadilisha assembly nzima ya drag brace, ambayo ilifika stoo karibu na mwisho wa shift. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kukamilisha ufungaji na kuhakikisha sahihi za ukaguzi zimekamilika kutoka hatua ya saba kuendelea.
summary: Pin isiyofanana ilisababisha kubadilishwa kwa drag brace assembly nzima ya nose gear, na kazi ya ufungaji itakamilishwa na shift inayofuata.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanya installation ya drag brace kwenye nose gear ya MD-80, tukagundua taper pin moja imeoza na kutu. Tuka-order replacement kutoka IPC lakini pin iliyokuja haikumatch na ile original. Tukaenda gear shop, machinist akatuconfirm kwamba hizo pins ni machined specifically per hole, so hatuwezi kuinstall pin moja tu. Mwishowe tulilazimika kuchange whole drag brace assembly, ambayo ilifika stores late kwenye shift - next crew waendelee na installation na wacheck sign-off kutoka step 7.
summary: Taper pin haiku-match ikasababisha kubadilishwa kwa drag brace assembly nzima, installation itacompletewa na shift inayofuata.

narrative_text: During the Number 2 Hydraulic System flush and EDP installation on the Q400, the aft cowl door was left open while working from the highlift, and the capped case drain line on top of the EDP was not spotted from that angle. The pump was hooked up on pressure, return, and bottom drain lines only, and the aircraft later dispatched with the case drain still capped, causing a reported hydraulic fluid loss and flight cancellation. Incoming shift needs to confirm the Number 2 EDP R/R is complete, verify all four hydraulic lines including the case drain are properly connected, and recommend closing cowl doors before lift access on future EDP tasks.
summary: A technician missed connecting a capped case drain line on the Q400's Number 2 EDP during installation, leading to a hydraulic fluid loss report and flight cancellation, requiring follow-up verification of the pump R/R.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kusafisha Mfumo wa Hydraulic Namba 2 na kufunga EDP kwenye ndege ya Q400, mlango wa cowl wa nyuma ulibaki wazi wakati fundi akifanya kazi kutoka kwenye highlift, na line ya case drain iliyokuwa na kifuniko juu ya EDP haikuonekana kutokana na pembe ile ya kufanyia kazi. Pump ilikamiliana tu na mistari ya pressure, return, na drain ya chini, kisha ndege ikaruka huku case drain ikiwa bado imefungwa, jambo lililosababisha taarifa ya upungufu wa maji ya hydraulic na hatimaye safari kufutwa. Shift inayoingia inatakiwa kuthibitisha kuwa R/R ya EDP Namba 2 imekamilika, kuangalia mistari yote minne ya hydraulic ikiwa imeunganishwa vizuri ikiwemo case drain, na kuhakikisha milango ya cowl inafungwa kabla ya kutumia lift kwenye kazi za EDP baadaye.
summary: Fundi alishindwa kuunganisha line ya case drain yenye kifuniko kwenye EDP ya Namba 2 ya Q400, jambo lililosababisha taarifa ya upungufu wa maji ya hydraulic na kufutwa kwa safari, hivyo linahitaji uthibitisho wa ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Jana wakati wa ile flush ya Number 2 Hydraulic System na kufunga EDP kwenye Q400, aft cowl door ilibaki open wakati fundi akiwa kwenye highlift, na case drain line iliyokuwa capped juu ya EDP haikuonekana from that angle. Pump ilikamiliana na pressure line, return line, na drain ya bottom tu, halafu aircraft ika-dispatch na case drain bado imefungwa, kukasababisha crew kureport low hydraulic fluid na flight kucancel. Shift inayoincoming iconfirm kama EDP R/R imekamilika, ichecki lines zote four za hydraulic ziko connected properly including case drain, na tukumbuke kuclose cowl doors kabla ya kutumia lift next time.
summary: Fundi alimiss kuconnect capped case drain line kwenye Number 2 EDP ya Q400 wakati wa installation, na hii ikaleta hydraulic fluid loss report na flight cancellation, so incoming shift inahitaji kufollow up.

narrative_text: Completed adjustments on the R normal brake control valve on the Fokker 100 after valve replacement by previous mech; scatter shield had been unfastened and moved aft to gain access during the job. After adjusting the brake tension spring at the capt's R rudder pedal, gear doors were closed and acft was pushed out and taxied for ops brake check, which came back good. Realized after first flight, when crew reported gear would not retract fully, that the scatter shield was never refastened before the wheel well was closed up. Next shift needs to verify scatter shield installation and fasteners on R wheel well before any further brake system closeout is signed off.
summary: A technician forgot to refasten the R wheel well scatter shield after brake valve adjustments, leading to a gear retraction problem on the aircraft's first flight.

narrative_text: Nilimaliza kazi ya ku-adjust R normal brake control valve kwenye ndege ya Fokker 100 baada ya fundi mwenzangu kubadilisha valve hiyo; scatter shield ilikuwa imefunguliwa na kusogezwa nyuma ili kupata nafasi ya kufanya kazi. Baada ya kurekebisha spring ya breki karibu na rudder pedal ya kulia ya kapteni, milango ya landing gear ilifungwa na ndege ikatolewa nje kwa ajili ya taxi na brake check, ambayo ilionekana sawa. Baadaye, wakati wa safari ya kwanza, tatizo la gear kutoingia vizuri kwenye wheel well liligundulika kuwa lilisababishwa na scatter shield ambayo sikuifunga vizuri kabla ya kufunga milango ya gear. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakikisha scatter shield na fasteners zake zimefungwa vizuri kwenye R wheel well kabla ya kutia sahihi kazi hiyo kama imekamilika.
summary: Fundi alisahau kufunga scatter shield kwenye R wheel well baada ya kurekebisha valve ya breki, jambo lililosababisha tatizo la gear kutoingia vizuri wakati wa safari ya kwanza ya ndege.

narrative_text: Nilimaliza adjustments kwenye R normal brake control valve ya Fokker 100 baada ya yule mech kubadilisha valve; scatter shield ilikuwa imetolewa na kusukumwa aft kupata access wakati wa job. Tulipo-adjust ile brake tension spring karibu na capt's R rudder pedal, tulifunga gear doors, tukatoka hangar na kufanya ops check ya brakes, ambayo ilikuwa good. Lakini kwenye first flight, crew waliripoti gear haiwezi retract properly, tukagundua scatter shield haikuwa refastened kabla ya kufunga wheel well. Shift inayofuata i-verify scatter shield na fasteners zake kwenye R wheel well kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote ya brake system.
summary: Fundi alisahau ku-refasten scatter shield kwenye R wheel well baada ya brake valve adjustments, na hii ndio ilisababisha gear retraction problem kwenye first flight.

narrative_text: ATR 72 at ZZZZ1 still has an unresolved propeller control fault; the replacement part was not on site so we reinstalled the previously removed hardware and ran an engine run-up for troubleshooting, but the fault persisted. During reassembly a safety wire was used in place of a cotter pin due to unavailability of stock, and this was not logged since the PVM was due to be replaced. Maintenance control has been briefed verbally and is sending the correct part with the relieving crew; incoming techs must confirm part installation, verify the cotter pin substitution, and complete the logbook entry.
summary: ATR 72 propeller control fault remains unresolved at ZZZZ1, with a temporary safety-wire fix undocumented and correct part/logbook follow-up required from the next crew.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ATR 72 iliyoko ZZZZ1 bado ina hitilafu ya propeller control ambayo haijatatuliwa; sehemu mpya haikuwepo kwenye stoo kwa hivyo tulirudisha vipuri vilivyokuwa vimeondolewa na kufanya engine run-up kwa ajili ya uchunguzi, lakini tatizo liliendelea kuwepo. Wakati wa kuunganisha tena, tulitumia safety wire badala ya cotter pin kwa sababu haikuwepo, na jambo hili halikuandikwa kwenye logbook kwa kuwa PVM alikuwa anatarajiwa kubadilishwa. Maintenance control walipewa taarifa kwa mdomo na watatuma sehemu husika pamoja na wafanyakazi watakaotuchukua nafasi; timu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha sehemu imewekwa vizuri, kuangalia matumizi ya safety wire badala ya cotter pin, na kukamilisha logbook entry.
summary: Ndege ya ATR 72 huko ZZZZ1 bado ina hitilafu ya propeller control ambayo haijatatuliwa, na urekebishaji wa muda kwa safety wire haujaandikwa, hivyo timu inayofuata inahitajika kufuatilia.

narrative_text: Kwa ATR 72 iko ZZZZ1, propeller control bado ina issue, haijafix. Part haikuwa available site, so tuka-reinstall zile parts za wale wa awali tukafanya engine run-up ya troubleshooting, lakini problem imebaki vilevile. Tulitumia safety wire badala ya cotter pin coz hatukuwa na stock, na hii haiku-documented kwa sababu PVM ilikuwa inaenda kubadilishwa. Maintenance control walijulishwa verbally na wanasend part sahihi na crew itakayo-relieve sisi; wale wanaokuja lazima wa-confirm installation, wacheck hiyo safety wire substitution, na wa-complete logbook entry.
summary: ATR 72 iko na propeller control fault ambayo bado haiju-resolve, na kuna temporary fix ya safety wire ambayo haiku-log, so next crew wana-follow up.

narrative_text: Handover: engine change on B737-700 (#2 engine) still requires closure of the thrust rating verification step. Data plate check confirmed both engines as 24K rated, but the CDU IDENT/CONFIG page cross-check was not independently verified before the EEC software check was signed off — this was assumed done by the mech who pulled the serial number. Before proceeding to the 65% power assurance run, next shift must confirm the thrust rating plug and CDU config page match the maintenance manual entry, as loaner engines from other facilities may carry a different rating (22K vs 24K).
summary: An engine change on a B737-700 proceeded to power assurance run-up without independent verification of the thrust rating plug/CDU config, based on an assumption between mechs, and next shift must confirm this before continuing.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya zamu: kazi ya kubadilisha injini namba mbili kwenye B737-700 bado inahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ya kuendelea. Data plate ilithibitisha injini zote mbili ni za kiwango cha 24K, lakini ukaguzi wa ukurasa wa IDENT/CONFIG kwenye CDU haukuthibitishwa moja kwa moja kabla ya kusaini hatua ya EEC check - ilidhaniwa fundi mwingine ameshafanya hivyo. Kabla ya kuendelea na jaribio la nguvu la asilimia 65, zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe thrust rating plug pamoja na taarifa za CDU zinalingana na maelekezo ya kitabu cha matengenezo, hasa ikizingatiwa injini za kukopa kutoka kituo kingine zaweza kuwa na kiwango tofauti (22K badala ya 24K).
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha injini kwenye B737-700 iliendelea hadi jaribio la nguvu bila uthibitisho wa kujitegemea wa kiwango cha injini, hivyo zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: Handover note: engine change ya #2 engine kwa B737-700 bado needs follow-up kabla ya kuendelea. Tuli-verify data plate, both engines ziko 24K rated, lakini CDU IDENT/CONFIG page hatukui-confirm independently before signing off ile EEC software check step - tuli-assume mech aliyekuwa amepea serial number ameshafanya hiyo check pia. Before proceeding to run-up area kwa 65% power assurance run, next shift lazima wathibitishe thrust rating plug na CDU config inamatch na maintenance manual, kwa sababu loaner engines kutoka facility ingine zaeza kuwa 22K badala ya 24K.
summary: Engine change kwenye B737-700 ilienda mpaka power assurance run bila kuthibitisha thrust rating independently, so next shift wanapaswa ku-verify hiyo before proceeding.

narrative_text: On the B757-200, L and R thrust levers were reported stiff and hard to move forward; lower torque box on L engine was removed per AMM 76-11-10 to inspect throttle cable linkage and FFG lever, then reinstalled. After reinstallation the levers still felt stiff/binding even when disconnected, but supervisor closed the item as fixed without further inspection. During subsequent engine start at the hangar an uncommanded rapid acceleration occurred, and troubleshooting found the lower torque box misaligned and improperly installed on the L engine. Next shift must re-verify torque box alignment/rigging per AMM 76-11-10-404-015 before next start and confirm proper sign-off documentation.
summary: Improperly reinstalled lower torque box on L engine of a B757-200 caused stiff/binding thrust levers and an uncommanded acceleration during ground start, requiring re-inspection and proper rigging verification.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757-200, levers za thrust za kushoto na kulia zilikuwa ngumu kusogeza mbele. Torque box ya chini ya engine ya kushoto ilitolewa kwa mujibu wa AMM 76-11-10 ili kukagua linkage ya throttle cable na FFG lever, kisha ikafungwa tena. Baada ya kufungwa, levers ziliendelea kuwa ngumu na kubana hata zikiwa hazijaunganishwa, lakini msimamizi alifunga hitilafu hiyo kama imeshughulikiwa bila ukaguzi wa ziada. Baadaye wakati wa kuanzisha engine hangarini, ilitokea kuongezeka kwa kasi bila amri, na ukaguzi ulionyesha torque box haikuwekwa sawa. Shift inayokuja lazima ikague upya uwekaji wa torque box kabla ya kuanzisha engine tena na kuthibitisha usahihi wa saini za kufunga kazi.
summary: Torque box ya chini ya engine ya kushoto ya B757-200 haikuwekwa sawa baada ya kukaguliwa, hali iliyosababisha levers ngumu na kuongezeka kasi bila amri wakati wa kuanzisha engine, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: kukague upya uwekaji wa torque box

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, thrust levers za L na R zilikuwa stiff sana, ngumu kusukuma forward. Tulitoa lower torque box ya L engine per AMM 76-11-10 kukagua throttle cable linkage na FFG lever, then tuka-reinstall. Lakini even after reinstalling, levers zilikuwa still binding hata zikiwa disconnected, lakini supervisor akasema imeshughulikiwa bila ku-inspect zaidi. Later wakati wa engine start hangarini, kulikuwa na uncommanded rapid acceleration, na troubleshooting ikaonyesha torque box ilikuwa misaligned na haiku-install properly. Next shift lazima ku-verify tena alignment ya torque box per maintenance manual kabla ya start next time, na kuconfirm sign-off iko sawa.
summary: Lower torque box ya L engine kwenye B757-200 haiku-install properly baada ya inspection, causing stiff levers na uncommanded acceleration wakati wa start, so inahitaji re-check ya alignment.

entities.text: ku-verify tena alignment ya torque box

narrative_text: B747 returned to cargo ramp after cockpit smoke traced to Capt's annunciator panel, which was replaced with a new unit. After the new panel install, an unexpected green FD/PMS light appeared on the overhead switching panel whenever either flight director was selected to A1 or C3. Troubleshooting so far has swapped autopilot pitch/roll computers and CADCs with no change; pulling the PMS coupler extinguishes the light, suggesting an internally shorted coupler, but no spare coupler is in stock. Next shift to coordinate with maintenance control on approval to apply MEL 34-38A (remove switching unit and collar the circuit breaker) pending parts availability.
