summary: Technicians are troubleshooting a persistent FD/PMS annunciator light following cockpit smoke and annunciator panel replacement on a B747, and are pursuing MEL relief due to lack of a replacement PMS coupler.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B747 ilirudi kwenye cargo ramp baada ya moshi kuripotiwa cockpit-ni, ukafuatiliwa hadi kwenye annunciator panel ya Kapteni, ambayo ilibadilishwa na mpya. Baada ya ufungaji wa panel mpya, taa ya kijani ya FD/PMS ilianza kuwaka kwenye overhead switching panel kila flight director ya Kapteni au FO ilipochaguliwa kwenye A1 au C3. Hadi sasa tumebadilisha autopilot pitch/roll computers na CADCs bila mafanikio; kuvuta PMS coupler kunazima taa hiyo, hivyo tunashuku coupler imepata short ndani, lakini hakuna nakala ya ziada stoo-ni. Zamu ijayo iwasiliane na maintenance control kupata idhini ya kutumia MEL 34-38A wakati vipuri vikisubiriwa.
summary: Mafundi wanafuatilia tatizo la taa ya FD/PMS iliyoendelea kuwaka baada ya moshi cockpit-ni na kubadilishwa kwa annunciator panel kwenye ndege ya B747, na wanatafuta idhini ya MEL kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa PMS coupler mpya.

narrative_text: Ile B747 ilirudi cargo ramp baada ya smoke kuripotiwa cockpit-ni, ikafuatiliwa hadi kwa Capt's annunciator panel, ambayo ilikuwa tayari imebadilishwa na panel mpya. Baada ya install ya panel mpya, tukaona green FD/PMS light inawaka kwa overhead switching panel kila mara flight director ya Capt au FO ime-select kwa A1 au C3. Tumeshaswap autopilot pitch/roll computers na CADCs, hakuna mabadiliko; ukivuta PMS coupler, light inazima, so tuna-suspect coupler ime-short internally, lakini hakuna spare coupler stock-ini. Next shift wa-coordinate na maintenance control ku-request MEL 34-38A relief wakati wanasubiri parts.
summary: Wanafundi wana-troubleshoot FD/PMS light ambayo iliendelea kuwaka baada ya smoke incident na panel replacement kwenye B747, na wana-pursue MEL approval kwa sababu ya lack ya PMS coupler mpya.

narrative_text: Completed fuel nozzle removal and replacement on the B737 MAX per Engineering Authorization step and AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Verified part numbers on the new nozzles and seals, checked bolt installation and torque, and confirmed B-nut torque and safety wiring. Next shift to double-check inspector sign-off on torque values and safety wire before engine run, as procedural steps were tight and warrant a second look.
summary: Technician completed and verified a B737 MAX fuel nozzle replacement per AMM procedure, with recommendation for inspector re-check before engine run.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kuondoa na kufunga upya fuel nozzles kwenye ndege ya B737 MAX imekamilika kufuata taratibu za Engineering Authorization na AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Nimehakiki namba za sehemu mpya, uwekaji na torque ya bolti, pamoja na torque na usalama wa B-nuts. Shift inayofuata iangalie tena sahihi ya inspector kuhusu torque na safety wire kabla ya kuwasha injini, kwa sababu hatua za taratibu zilikuwa ngumu na zinahitaji ukaguzi wa ziada.
summary: Fundi amekamilisha na kuhakiki ubadilishaji wa fuel nozzles kwenye B737 MAX kwa mujibu wa taratibu za AMM, na anapendekeza ukaguzi wa ziada na inspekta kabla ya kuwasha injini.

entities.text: kuondoa na kufunga upya fuel nozzles

narrative_text: Tumemaliza kufanya fuel nozzle removal and replacement kwa B737 MAX kufuata Engineering Authorization step na AMM 73-11-05-000-802-G-00. Nili-verify part numbers za nozzles mpya na seals, nikacheck bolt installation na torque, plus torque na safety wiring ya B-nuts, everything ilikuwa within limits. Next shift wasikie wa-double check inspector sign-off kuhusu torque values na safety wire kabla ya engine run, kwa sababu hizo steps zilikuwa tight kidogo.
summary: Technician ame-verify na kukamilisha fuel nozzle replacement kwenye B737 MAX per AMM procedure, na anapendekeza inspector a-recheck torque na safety wire kabla ya engine run.

narrative_text: During corrosion inspection on the B757-200 floor beam at STA:395 RBL 12, we removed intercostals from STA:395 to STA:418 per the upgrade lead's paperwork. When the upgrade lead came to collect the paperwork we were still mid-task, so I noted the intercostal removal on turnover but in the rush forgot to mention we also disconnected several pulley brackets. Next shift needs to be told about the disconnected pulley brackets, which have their own separate work card for reinstallation.
summary: Turnover note omitted mention of disconnected pulley brackets during floor beam corrosion work on a B757-200, requiring follow-up on their separate reinstallation work card.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kutu kwenye floor beam ya ndege B757-200 eneo la STA:395 RBL 12, tuliondoa intercostals kutoka STA:395 hadi STA:418 kulingana na karatasi za kazi alizoleta upgrade lead. Alipokuja kuchukua karatasi hizo tulikuwa bado hatujamaliza kazi, hivyo niliandika kwenye turnover kuhusu uondoaji wa intercostals lakini kwa haraka nilisahau kutaja kuwa tulikuwa pia tumeondoa baadhi ya pulley brackets. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufahamishwa kuhusu pulley brackets hizo, ambazo zina work card yake tofauti ya kuzirudisha.
summary: Taarifa ya turnover ilisahau kutaja pulley brackets zilizoondolewa wakati wa kazi ya kutu kwenye floor beam ya B757-200, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji kwa work card yake ya kurudisha.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-inspect corrosion kwa floor beam ya B757-200 kwa STA:395 RBL 12, tukaanza kuondoa intercostals kutoka STA:395 mpaka STA:418 as per ile paperwork ya upgrade lead. Alikuja kuchukua paperwork tukiwa bado tuna-remove ile intercostal, so niliandika turnover kuhusu hiyo part lakini nikiwa nimehurry nikasahau ku-mention kwamba tuliondoa pia pulley brackets kadhaa. Next shift wajue kuhusu hizo pulley brackets, ziko na separate work card ya reinstallation.
summary: Turnover note ilisahau kutaja pulley brackets zilizo-disconnect wakati wa corrosion job kwa floor beam ya B757-200, so follow-up inahitajika kwa ile reinstallation work card.

narrative_text: During the #1 engine fan change on B727-200, inspector wrote up the #1 bearing for replacement and I ordered the part from stores using the number listed in the training manual, without cross-checking it against the IPC for correct effectivity. Bearing was still in transit from stores at shift turnover, so relief crew went ahead and installed it. Records dept later flagged the part number as incorrect, and aircraft had to be grounded again for rework of the #1 engine #1 bearing - please verify IPC effectivity before ordering next time.
summary: Wrong bearing part number was ordered from the training manual without IPC verification, leading to incorrect installation and aircraft grounding for rework.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha fan ya engine namba moja kwenye B727-200, mkaguzi aliandika kadi ya kubadilisha bearing namba moja, na niliagiza spare kutoka stores kwa kutumia namba niliyoipata kwenye kitabu cha mafunzo bila kuthibitisha na IPC kama ni sahihi kwa ndege hiyo. Bearing ilikuwa bado safarini kutoka stores wakati wa kukabidhi shift, kwa hivyo wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata waliifunga bila kuthibitisha zaidi. Baadaye idara ya records iligundua kuwa namba ya part si sahihi, na ndege ililazimika kusimamishwa tena kufanyiwa marekebisho ya bearing ya engine namba moja - tafadhali mfuatiliaji wa shift ijayo athibitishe namba sahihi za spare kabla ya kufunga chochote.
summary: Bearing isiyo sahihi iliagizwa kwa kutumia namba ya kitabu cha mafunzo bila kuthibitisha na IPC, hali iliyosababisha ufungaji mbaya na ndege kusimamishwa kufanyiwa marekebisho.

entities.text: kubadilisha fan ya engine namba moja

narrative_text: So during the #1 engine fan change kwenye B727-200, inspector aliandika N/R card ya kubadilisha #1 bearing, nikaorder part kutoka stores nikitumia part number kutoka training manual bila kuverify na IPC kama ni sahihi effectivity-wise. By the time ya turnover bearing ilikuwa bado enroute kutoka stores, so relief crew waka-install tu ile bearing bila kuangalia zaidi. Records dept ndio waligundua later kwamba part number si sahihi, ikabidi aircraft igrounded tena for rework ya #1 engine bearing - tafadhali next shift wathibitishe part number na IPC effectivity kabla ya ku-order chochote next time.
summary: Wrong bearing part number ilikuwa ordered kutoka training manual bila kucheki IPC, na hiyo ikapelekea installation mbaya na aircraft kugroundiwa for rework.

entities.text: wathibitishe part number na IPC effectivity

narrative_text: Dash 8-400 was down all day for #2 engine oil pressure indication fluctuating at and above rating detent; swing shift replaced several items with no improvement. Grave shift installed a replacement relay in relay junction box 1 under the cabin floor, using a part number provided by a lead, and it passed all AMM operational checks at the time. Note that a green sheet exists in ATA-79 wiring manual referencing an engineering order on this relay that is easy to miss and is not clearly worded, so please verify correct part number before any future relay swap on this aircraft to avoid repeat of the fault.
summary: Dash 8-400 #2 engine oil pressure indication fault was addressed with a relay replacement that passed checks, but the part number reference in the ATA-79 green sheet needs verification to prevent recurrence.

entities.text: green sheet in ATA-79 wiring manual

narrative_text: Ndege ya Dash 8-400 ilikaa chini siku nzima kwa sababu ya shinikizo la mafuta la injini namba mbili kubadilika badilika ikifikia kiwango cha juu; zamu ya jioni ilibadilisha vipuri kadhaa lakini tatizo halikuisha. Zamu ya usiku ilifunga relay mpya katika relay junction box namba moja iliyopo chini ya sakafu ya kabini, wakitumia namba ya kipuri iliyotolewa na kiongozi wa zamu, na ukaguzi wote wa uendeshaji kulingana na AMM ulipita wakati huo. Kumbuka kuwa kuna karatasi ya kijani kwenye kitabu cha nyaya ATA-79 inayohusiana na agizo la uhandisi kuhusu relay hii ambayo ni rahisi kutoiona na haielezwi vizuri, hivyo tafadhali hakikisha namba sahihi ya kipuri kabla ya kubadilisha relay tena ili kuepuka tatizo hili kujirudia.
summary: Tatizo la shinikizo la mafuta ya injini namba mbili kwenye Dash 8-400 lilishughulikiwa kwa kubadilisha relay iliyopita ukaguzi, lakini namba ya kipuri katika karatasi ya kijani ya ATA-79 inahitaji kuthibitishwa ili kuzuia kujirudia.

entities.text: shinikizo la mafuta la injini namba mbili
ukaguzi wa uendeshaji kulingana na AMM
karatasi ya kijani kwenye kitabu cha nyaya ATA-79

narrative_text: Hii Dash 8-400 ilikuwa down siku nzima kwa oil pressure indication ya engine namba mbili, ilikuwa inafluctuate karibu na rating detent. Swing shift walibadilisha vitu kadhaa but hakuna kilichosaidia. Sisi grave shift tukaamua kubadilisha relay kwenye relay junction box 1 chini ya cabin floor, tukapata part number kutoka kwa lead, tukainstall na ikapita operational checks zote za AMM saa hiyo. Cha muhimu, kuna green sheet kwenye ATA-79 wiring manual inayotaja engineering order kuhusu hii relay ambayo si rahisi kuiona na haiko clear sana, kwa hivyo next time mtu akihitaji kubadilisha relay hii, ahakikishe part number ni sahihi ili tusirudie tatizo hili.
summary: Dash 8-400 ilikuwa na oil pressure indication issue kwa engine namba mbili, relay ilibadilishwa na ikapita checks, lakini part number kwenye green sheet ya ATA-79 inahitaji kuverify ili kuepuka repeat.

entities.text: oil pressure indication ya engine namba mbili
green sheet kwenye ATA-79 wiring manual

narrative_text: On arrival at the gate, B777-200's #1 Engine kept running about four minutes after chocks and later showed smoke for a few minutes; flight deck displayed a Left Engine Fuel Valve message that cleared per Chapter-31 MAT reference, so aircraft was released after a one-hour delay with two normal subsequent starts. During taxi to the hangar for the inbound A-Check, the Cutoff switch failed to shut down #1 Engine on first and second attempts, and the Fire handle had to be pulled before the engine spooled down about 30 seconds later. Next shift needs to follow up on the Fuel Control Unit fault, pull the MAT printout that was generated, and coordinate with engineering before any further engine runs.
summary: A B777-200 had a Left Engine Fuel Valve fault and an engine that would not shut down normally via the Cutoff switch, requiring the Fire handle to stop it; follow-up on the fuel control unit fault is required.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupokea ndege ya B777-200 kwenye geti, Engine namba 1 iliendelea kufanya kazi kwa dakika kama nne baada ya kuwekwa chocks, na baadaye ikaonekana moshi kwa muda mfupi; kwenye cockpit kulikuwa na ujumbe wa Left Engine Fuel Valve ambao ulikaguliwa kwenye Chapter-31 na kuonekana ni wa kawaida kufuta, hivyo ndege ilisafirishwa baada ya ucheleweshaji wa saa moja na kuanzishwa vizuri mara mbili baadaye. Wakati wa kusogeza ndege kuelekea hangar kwa ukaguzi wa A-Check, Engine namba 1 haikuzimika kwa kutumia Cutoff switch mara mbili, hivyo ilihitajika kuvuta Fire handle kabla injini kuzima baada ya sekunde thelathini. Zamu inayokuja inafaa kufuatilia hitilafu ya Fuel Control Unit, kupata nakala ya taarifa iliyochapishwa kutoka MAT, na kushauriana na uhandisi kabla ya kuendesha injini tena.
summary: Ndege ya B777-200 ilikuwa na hitilafu ya Left Engine Fuel Valve na injini isiyozima kwa njia ya kawaida, hivyo ikahitaji kutumia Fire handle, hali inayohitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi wa Fuel Control Unit.

narrative_text: Tulipokea B777-200 kwenye gate, na #1 Engine ilikaa ikirun kama dakika nne baada ya chocks, kisha tukaona smoke kidogo pale engine. Cockpit display ilikuwa na message ya Left Engine Fuel Valve, tukacheck Chapter-31 na ikaonekana ni erasable message tu, so aircraft ilirelease baada ya delay ya about one hour, na starts mbili zilizofuata zilikuwa normal. Lakini wakati wa taxi kuelekea hangar kwa A-Check, Cutoff switch ilifail kushut down #1 Engine mara mbili, mpaka tukalazimika kuvuta Fire handle ndipo engine ikaspooldown after 30 seconds. Zamu ijayo waangalie ile Fuel Control Unit fault, wapate ile MAT printout, na wawasiliane na engineering kabla ya engine runs zozote zingine.
summary: B777-200 ilikuwa na Left Engine Fuel Valve fault na engine ambayo haikushut down normally, ikilazimu kutumia Fire handle, hivyo Fuel Control Unit fault inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: B737-300 gear air sense proximity switch was replaced after two air turnbacks earlier in the day for landing gear indication faults. New sensor was spliced in and mounted, gap set to target per AMM, and system checkout was turned over to the relief crew. Follow-up needed: verify sensor face orientation against the correct mounting flange/holes, as the aircraft returned for a third air turnback and inspection found the sensor mounted 90 degrees off target despite the gap reading correctly.
summary: A misoriented replacement gear proximity switch on a B737-300 passed gap checks but caused a third air turnback, requiring re-inspection of the mounting.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilikuwa na tatizo la switch ya hisi ya hewa ya gia ya kutua, na tulibadilisha sensor mpya baada ya ndege kurudi uwanjani mara mbili awali kwa sababu ya hitilafu za onyo la gia. Sensor mpya iliunganishwa na kuwekwa, pengo likapimwa kulingana na kiwango kilichoainishwa kwenye mwongozo wa matengenezo, kisha kazi ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu inayofuata kwa ukaguzi wa mfumo. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kwani ndege ilirudi uwanjani mara ya tatu, na ukaguzi ulibaini sensor ilikuwa imewekwa ikiwa imegeuzwa nyuzi 90 kutoka mahali sahihi, ingawa kipimo cha pengo kilionekana sahihi.
summary: Sensor ya gia iliyowekwa vibaya kwenye ndege ya B737-300 ilisababisha ndege kurudi uwanjani mara ya tatu, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: switch ya hisi ya hewa ya gia

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tunafanyia troubleshoot ile B737-300 yenye landing gear problem, baada ya kurudi uwanjani mara mbili siku hiyo kwa gear indication faults. Tuka-splice ile new proximity switch, nikai-mount na tuka-set gap kulingana na maint manual, kisha tukafanya turnover ya system checkout kwa relief crew. Follow-up inahitajika ASAP maana ndege ilifanya third air turnback, na inspection ikaonyesha kwamba sensor ilikuwa imewekwa 90 degrees off from target, ingawa gap reading ilionekana sahihi wakati wa kuiset.
summary: Sensor ya gear iliyo-mount vibaya kwenye B737-300 ilipita gap check lakini ikasababisha third air turnback, hivyo inahitaji re-check ya mounting.

narrative_text: On job card WXBCV for the B737-200 passenger oxygen system operational check, I completed and stamped steps 02-A through 02-J(1). During step 02-J(2) I found all mask bags and hoses discolored and failing inspection, so I wrote them up and ordered replacement masks. I had to leave at shift change before completing the card, so the incoming lead technician needs to follow up on installation and final sign-off of step 02-J(2).
summary: Passenger oxygen mask bags and hoses failed inspection on job card WXBCV and the card remains open for completion after shift change.

narrative_text: Kwenye job card WXBCV ya ukaguzi wa mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria kwa ndege ya B737-200, nilikamilisha na kusaini hatua za 02-A mpaka 02-J(1). Nilipofika hatua ya 02-J(2), nilibaini mifuko ya masks na hoses zote zimebadilika rangi na kufeli ukaguzi, hivyo nikaandika ripoti na kuagiza masks mpya. Zamu yangu ilikwisha kabla sijamaliza kazi hiyo, hivyo fundi atakayeendelea anahitajika kukamilisha ufungaji na kusaini hatua ya mwisho ya 02-J(2).
summary: Mifuko ya masks na hoses za mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria zilifeli ukaguzi kwenye job card WXBCV na kazi bado haijakamilika baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mfumo wa oksijeni wa abiria

narrative_text: Kwenye job card WXBCV ya oxygen system check ya pax kwa hii B737-200, nilicomplete na kustamp steps 02-A mpaka 02-J(1) sawasawa. Nikifika step 02-J(2), nikakuta mask bags na hoses zote zime-discolor na zime-fail inspection, so niliandika write-up na kuorder replacement masks mpya. Shift yangu iliisha kabla sijamaliza card hii, kwa hivyo lead technician anayefuata anahitaji ku-follow up na kukamilisha installation na sign-off ya step 02-J(2).
summary: Mask bags na hoses za oxygen system ya pax zilifail inspection kwenye job card WXBCV, kazi bado haija-complete baada ya shift change.

narrative_text: B737-800 arrived at the gate and ramp reported a dent on the left horizontal stabilizer leading edge, about 6 ft outboard of the fuselage. The mechanic assigned to inspect it got pulled to another aircraft before the dent measurement and SRM evaluation were finished, and a second mechanic only completed the clean-up of the area, not the inspection. Next shift please confirm the SRM damage assessment and measurement have actually been completed and signed off before further dispatch, as this was not verbally handed over properly.
summary: Incomplete SRM inspection of a left horizontal stabilizer dent was mistakenly assumed complete due to poor handover between reassigned mechanics.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-800 ilifika geti na wafanyakazi wa ramp waliripoti bonge (dent) kwenye ukingo wa mbele wa horizontal stabilizer ya kushoto, karibu futi 6 kutoka fuselage. Fundi aliyekuwa akifanya ukaguzi alihamishiwa ndege nyingine kabla ya kupima na kuthibitisha uharibifu kulingana na SRM, na fundi wa pili aliyeteuliwa alifanya tu usafi wa eneo hilo bila kukamilisha ukaguzi. Shift inayokuja tafadhali thibitisha kama tathmini ya SRM na vipimo vimekamilika na kusainiwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari, kwani kulikuwa na upungufu wa mawasiliano na makabidhiano ya kazi.
summary: Ukaguzi wa SRM kwa bonge kwenye horizontal stabilizer ya kushoto haukukamilika kutokana na mawasiliano hafifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya fundi.

narrative_text: Hii B737-800 ilarrive gate, ramp wakareport dent kwa left horizontal stabilizer leading edge, kama 6 ft outboard from fuselage. Mechanic aliyekuwa anahandle inspection alireassign kwa aircraft nyingine before hii dent measurement na SRM evaluation kukompletishwa, then mechanic wa pili akaassignwa tu ku-clean up eneo, si kukamilisha inspection. Next shift please mconfirm kama SRM assessment na measurement zimekompletishwa na kusignwa before dispatch, coz turnover ya verbal haikuwa proper hapo.
summary: SRM inspection ya dent kwa left horizontal stabilizer haikukompletishwa juu ya poor verbal handover kati ya mechanics waliobadilishwa.

narrative_text: A319 arrived requiring an MEL for a previous powerplant fire/overheat warning fault, per Maintenance Control, but boarding had already started before the Lead reached the aircraft. While handling an engine HPTCC replacement on another aircraft, the Lead coordinated by phone with Maintenance Control and applied MEL #26-12-01b from the jetway phone without the MEL book in hand, relying entirely on verbal guidance. Please confirm the logbook entry wording was correctly transcribed and verify no special maintenance procedures were missed during the phone-in MEL process.
summary: Lead Technician applied an MEL for a powerplant overheat warning fault on an A319 by phone, without direct access to the MEL manual, while juggling another aircraft's engine repair, requiring follow-up verification of the logbook entry.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A319 ilifika ikihitaji MEL kwa tatizo la awali la onyo la moto/joto kali la injini, kama Maintenance Control walivyoeleza, lakini abiria walikuwa tayari wanaanza kuingia kabla Lead hajafika kwenye ndege. Wakati huo huo, Lead alikuwa anashughulikia ubadilishaji wa HPTCC ya injini ya kushoto kwenye ndege nyingine, hivyo aliwasiliana na Maintenance Control kwa simu na kuweka MEL namba 26-12-01b akiwa kwenye simu ya jetway bila kitabu cha MEL mkononi. Inahitajika ukaguzi wa haraka kuhakikisha maneno yaliyoandikwa kwenye logbook ni sahihi na kwamba hakuna hatua maalum za matengenezo zilizosahaulika wakati wa mchakato huo wa simu.
summary: Kiongozi wa ufundi aliweka MEL kwa tatizo la onyo la moto la injini kwenye ndege ya A319 kwa njia ya simu bila kitabu cha MEL, huku pia akishughulikia ukarabati wa injini kwenye ndege nyingine, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho wa maandishi ya logbook.

entities.text: onyo la moto/joto kali la injini

narrative_text: Hii A319 ilifika na iko na issue ya zamani ya powerplant fire/overheat warning, Maintenance Control walisema lazima tu-apply MEL, lakini boarding ilikuwa imeanza kabla Lead hajaifikia aircraft. Wakati huo Lead alikuwa busy na HPTCC replacement ya left engine kwa ndege ingine, so akaenda ku-coordinate na Maintenance Control kwa simu na aka-apply MEL #26-12-01b akiwa jetway phone bila hata MEL book, akitegemea tu verbal guidance kutoka kwa controller. Tafadhali confirm logbook entry imeandikwa sawa na check kama kulikuwa na special procedures ambazo zilipita bila kufanywa during hiyo phone-in MEL process.
summary: Lead alifanya MEL apply kwa A319 kwa powerplant overheat warning issue kwa njia ya simu bila MEL book mkononi, wakati akihandle pia engine repair ya ndege ingine, so logbook entry inahitaji verification.

narrative_text: Continuing repair of intercostal blanket FOD damage on the MD-80 fan blades; still need to deburr the rough edge left over from the previous repair. Photos and signoff are required at the end of each shift per the applicable chart/publication reference. Please ensure supervisor and crew chief review and formal turnover are completed before shift end.
summary: Lead technician is handing over unfinished MD-80 fan blade FOD repair and deburring work requiring photo documentation and supervisor/crew chief turnover review.

entities.text: repair of intercostal blanket FOD damage

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha uharibifu wa FOD kwenye blanketi ya intercostal ya fan blades za ndege ya MD-80 bado inaendelea, na sehemu iliyobaki ya ukingo mkali kutoka kwa ukarabati uliopita bado inahitaji kusawazishwa. Kila mwisho wa zamu, ni lazima kupigwa picha na kutiwa sahihi kulingana na chati husika. Tafadhali hakikisheni msimamizi na crew chief wamepitia kazi hii na kufanya turnover rasmi kabla ya zamu kuisha.
summary: Fundi anayeongoza anakabidhi kazi isiyokamilika ya ukarabati wa fan blades za MD-80 zilizoharibiwa na FOD, ikihitaji picha na ukaguzi wa msimamizi na crew chief.

narrative_text: Bado tunaendelea na repair ya intercostal blanket FOD damage kwa fan blades za MD-80, na ile rough edge ya repair ya mwanzo bado inahitaji kudeburr. Kila end of shift lazima uchukue photos na signoff kulingana na chart iliyotolewa. Hakikisha supervisor na crew chief wamefanya review na turnover kabla shift haijaisha, sawa?
summary: Lead tech anahand over kazi ya FOD repair kwenye MD-80 fan blades ambayo bado haijakamilika, ikihitaji photos na supervisor/crew chief turnover.

entities.text: repair ya intercostal blanket FOD damage

narrative_text: While performing work card XX-XX-XX in the hangar, the aircraft nose rolled off the spot 3 center line and moved about 14 ft before contacting a scissor lift; it was re-chocked afterward. Likely causes include improperly positioned or worn nose wheel chocks, released parking brake accumulator pressure, and slope in the hangar floor. Next shift please ensure all three landing gear wheels are chocked per revised procedure, and flag the work card for a caution note update regarding brake accumulator pressure during chocking.
summary: Aircraft nose rolled off its hangar spot during maintenance due to chocking and brake accumulator issues, requiring procedure review.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kazi ya work card XX-XX-XX ndani ya hangar, sehemu ya mbele ya ndege ilitoka kwenye alama ya spot 3 na kusogea takribani futi 14 kabla ya kugonga scissor lift; baadaye ilirekebishwa kwa chocks. Chanzo kinachowezekana ni chocks za tairi la mbele kutowekwa vizuri au kuchakaa, pamoja na shinikizo la parking brake accumulator lililokuwa limetolewa, na pia mteremko wa sakafu ya hangar. Shift inayokuja tafadhali ihakikishe magurudumu yote matatu ya landing gear yamewekwa chocks kulingana na taratibu mpya, na kupendekeza kuongezwa maelezo ya tahadhari kwenye work card kuhusu shinikizo la brake accumulator wakati wa kuweka chocks.
summary: Sehemu ya mbele ya ndege ilitoka mahali pake wakati wa matengenezo hangarini kutokana na tatizo la chocks na shinikizo la brake accumulator, hali inayohitaji marekebisho ya taratibu.

narrative_text: Wakati tunafanya ile work card XX-XX-XX huko hangar, nose ya aircraft ilitoka kwenye spot 3 center line ikasogea kama 14 ft mpaka ikagonga scissor lift, tukairudisha na kuiweka chocks tena. Inawezekana chocks za nose wheel hazikuwa positioned properly au zimechakaa, plus parking brake accumulator pressure ilikuwa released, na floor ya hangar pia ina slope kidogo. Kwa next shift, hakikisheni landing gear zote tatu zime-chock as per updated procedure, na tupendekeze caution note iwekwe kwenye work card kuhusu hatari ya accumulator pressure wakati wa chocking.
summary: Nose ya aircraft ilitoka spot 3 wakati wa maintenance kwa sababu ya chocking issue na brake accumulator pressure, hivyo procedure inahitaji update.

narrative_text: During scheduled engine harness replacement on Aircraft X (B737-800), engine #2, a connector was removed and may not have been reinstalled due to the large number of AMTs working the job and pressure to release the aircraft on time. Please have the next shift verify all connectors on engine #2 harness are properly seated and secured before further dispatch. Recommend slowing down and double-checking installation steps regardless of schedule pressure.
summary: A connector on engine #2 may have been left disconnected after harness replacement on Aircraft X due to time pressure and crowded work conditions, requiring verification by incoming shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha waya za injini (engine harness) kwenye Ndege X, aina ya B737-800, injini namba #2, kiungio kimoja (connector) kiliondolewa na inawezekana hakikurudishwa vizuri kutokana na wafanyakazi wengi wa AMT waliokuwa kwenye kazi hiyo pamoja na shinikizo la kutaka ndege iondoke kwa wakati. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kukagua viunganisho vyote vya waya kwenye injini #2 kuhakikisha vimewekwa na kufungwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka. Ni vyema kupunguza kasi na kuhakikisha kila hatua ya ufungaji inakaguliwa vizuri hata kama kuna shinikizo la muda.
summary: Kiungio kimoja cha waya kwenye injini #2 ya Ndege X huenda kilisahaulika kufungwa baada ya ukarabati kutokana na shinikizo la muda, hivyo kinahitaji ukaguzi wa zamu inayofuata.

narrative_text: So during ile job ya ku-replace engine harness kwa Aircraft X, B737-800, engine #2, kuna connector ilitolewa na inawezekana haikurudishwa vizuri kwa sababu ya AMTs wengi walikuwa site siku hiyo na pressure ya kutaka aircraft irelease on time. Next shift wanaomba wa-verify connectors zote za engine #2 harness ziwe zime-seat properly na zime-secure kabla ya dispatch. Tuchukue muda vizuri next time, tusiache time pressure ituletee mistakes hata kama kuna deadline ya kutoa ndege.
summary: Connector moja ya engine #2 kwa Aircraft X inaweza kuwa haikufungwa vizuri baada ya harness replacement kwa sababu ya time pressure, so next shift wa-verify kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: Aircraft X (B747-400) TCAS lower antenna write-up: coax found bad at the bench plug. On instruction from the Line Maintenance Specialist, we pulled a good harness from Aircraft Y (ferry flight for corrosion repair) and were then directed to install the known-bad harness from Aircraft X onto Aircraft Y. A Union Steward intervened since the Specialist, a Management position, was performing hourly rated work himself. Next shift: confirm no bad part was installed on Aircraft Y, verify TCAS harness sourcing, and follow up on the policy/procedure conflict raised with Management.
summary: A known-bad TCAS harness was nearly swapped between two B747-400s under management pressure, raising procedural and union concerns needing follow-up.

narrative_text: Ndege X (B747-400) ilikuwa na hitilafu ya TCAS lower antenna; coax ilipatikana mbovu kwenye bench plug. Kwa maagizo ya Line Maintenance Specialist, tuliondoa harness nzuri kutoka Ndege Y (ambayo ilikuwa inaenda ferry flight kwa ukarabati wa corrosion), kisha tukaambiwa tufunge ile harness mbovu ya Ndege X kwenye Ndege Y. Union Steward aliingilia kati kwa sababu Specialist huyo, ambaye ni Management, alikuwa akifanya kazi ya hourly rated peke yake. Zamu ijayo: hakikisheni hakuna sehemu mbovu iliyofungwa kwenye Ndege Y, thibitisheni chanzo cha TCAS harness, na fuatilieni suala la sera lililoibuliwa na Management.
summary: Harness mbovu ya TCAS ilikaribia kufungwa kwenye ndege nyingine kutokana na shinikizo la Management, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kwenye Aircraft X (B747-400) kulikuwa na TCAS lower antenna write-up, tukapata coax ni bad kwenye bench plug. Line Maintenance Specialist akatuambia tu-rob harness nzuri kutoka Aircraft Y ambayo ilikuwa inaenda ferry flight kwa corrosion repair, then akatuambia tuinstall ile bad harness ya Aircraft X kwenye Aircraft Y badala yake. Union Steward alilazimika kuingilia kati kwa sababu huyu Specialist, ambaye ni Management, alikuwa anafanya hourly rated work mwenyewe. Kwa next shift, hakikisheni hakuna bad part iliyoinstall kwenye Aircraft Y, mconfirm TCAS harness sourcing, na mfollow up hii policy conflict na Management.
summary: Kulikuwa na pressure ya kuinstall known-bad TCAS harness kwenye ndege nyingine, jambo linalohitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: Final inspection was signed off on the #1 engine on the B737-200 after both engines were transferred from another aircraft, but it is unclear whether the required 'B' check and throttle rigging were actually completed before signoff. The previous shift passed on incomplete information, so the inspection was closed out before all tasks were verified. Next shift must confirm 'B' check status on both engines, verify throttle linkage rigging, and check that the castellated nut and cotter key on the throttle linkage are properly installed before further release.
summary: Final inspection on #1 engine was signed off before throttle rigging and 'B' check work were confirmed complete, due to poor shift turnover.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa mwisho ulisainiwa kwa injini namba moja ya ndege ya B737-200 baada ya injini zote mbili kuhamishwa kutoka ndege nyingine, lakini haijulikani wazi kama 'B' check na urekebishaji wa throttle linkage vilikamilika kabla ya kusainiwa. Zamu iliyotangulia ilitoa taarifa isiyokamilika, hivyo ukaguzi ulifungwa kabla kazi zote kuthibitishwa. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya 'B' check kwa injini zote mbili, kukagua urekebishaji wa throttle linkage, na kuhakikisha castellated nut na cotter key vimewekwa vizuri kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa injini namba moja ulisainiwa kabla ya kuthibitisha kazi za 'B' check na urekebishaji wa throttle, kutokana na taarifa mbovu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu.

narrative_text: Tuli-sign final inspection ya #1 engine kwa hii B737-200 baada ya engines zote mbili ku-transfer kutoka ndege ingine, lakini haiko clear kama 'B' check na throttle rigging zilikuwa complete kabla ya signoff. Shift ya jana walitupatia info ambayo haikuwa sahihi, so ukaguzi ulifungwa before kazi zote ku-verify. Shift inayokuja lazima ithibitishe status ya 'B' check kwa engines zote mbili, i-check throttle linkage rigging, na ihakikishe castellated nut na cotter key zimewekwa properly kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: Final inspection ya #1 engine ili-sign kabla ya 'B' check na throttle rigging kukamilika, kutokana na bad handover info kutoka shift ya jana.

narrative_text: On the B737, we replaced both the 90-degree and 120-degree flap gearboxes and completed the full flap gear lube per logbook and non-routine items, but ran out of time to check gearbox operation before shift end. Hydraulics were kept off most of the shift to support heavy engine work on both engines, which was leak-checked afterward. Verbal turnover was given to the incoming crew; Saturday shift lead should confirm flap gearbox operational check is completed before further dispatch.
summary: Flap gearbox replacement on B737 was completed but not operationally checked at shift end due to time pressure from concurrent engine work, requiring follow-up by incoming crew.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737, tulibadilisha gearbox za flap za digrii 90 na 120 na kukamilisha lube kamili ya gear kama ilivyoandikwa kwenye logbook, lakini muda haukutosha kufanya ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa gearbox kabla ya shift kuisha. Hydraulics zilibaki zimezimwa kwa muda mwingi wa shift kwa sababu ya kazi kubwa za engines zote mbili, ambazo baadaye zilikaguliwa kwa uvujaji. Turnover ya mdomo ilitolewa kwa wafanyakazi wa shift inayofuata; shift ya Jumamosi inafaa kuthibitisha kuwa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa gearbox ya flap umekamilika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa gearbox za flap kwenye B737 ulikamilika lakini ukaguzi wa uendeshaji haukufanyika kabla ya shift kuisha kwa sababu ya shughuli nyingi za wakati mmoja, hivyo unahitaji ufuatiliaji na shift inayofuata.

entities.text: gearbox za flap za digrii 90 na 120

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737, tumereplace zile flap gearboxes mbili, 90 degree na 120 degree, na tume-complete full gear lube kama logbook item na non-routine items zilivyokuwa. Lakini time ilituwahi, hatujafanya operational check ya gearboxes maana hydraulics zilikuwa off most of the shift kwa ajili ya heavy engine jobs kwenye both engines, ambazo tulizileak check baadaye. Nimefanya verbal turnover kwa incoming crew; shift ya Saturday wanapaswa kuconfirm gearbox operational check imekamilika before dispatch.
summary: Flap gearboxes za B737 zimereplace lakini operational check haijafanywa by shift end kwa sababu ya time pressure, so incoming crew wanapaswa kufollow up.

entities.text: flap gearboxes mbili, 90 degree na 120 degree

narrative_text: During overnight routine service on the B737-800 (BOW open), walkaround inspection found possible damage/delamination on the wing-to-body fairing panel. I requested an LEO around 0300 to defer the panel and release the aircraft, but local tech support had not completed it by shift turnover. Maintenance Supervisor became confrontational, insisting the LEO was unnecessary and that I finish the aircraft without reviewing the paperwork; next shift please confirm LEO status or arrange NDT before further dispatch.
summary: Wing-to-body fairing damage on a B737-800 was deferred pending an LEO, but a supervisor's unprofessional conduct delayed proper closeout, so the next shift must verify LEO/NDT completion before release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa huduma ya kawaida usiku kwenye ndege ya B737-800, ukaguzi wa awali ulionyesha uwezekano wa uharibifu au mgawanyiko kwenye kifuniko cha 'wing-to-body'. Niliomba LEO karibu saa tisa alfajiri ili kuruhusu ndege kuondoka huku hitilafu hiyo ikiwa imesajiliwa, lakini timu ya kiufundi haikuwa imekamilisha mchakato huo wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift. Msimamizi wa matengenezo alionyesha hasira na kudai LEO haikuhitajika bila kusoma nyaraka husika; shift inayokuja ihakikishe hali ya LEO au ipange ukaguzi wa NDT kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Uharibifu kwenye kifuniko cha 'wing-to-body' cha ndege ya B737-800 ulisababisha mgogoro kati ya fundi na msimamizi kuhusu uidhinishaji wa LEO, hivyo shift inayokuja inahitaji kuthibitisha hali kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa.

narrative_text: Wakati wa overnight routine service kwenye B737-800, wakati wa walkaround niligundua possible damage au delamination kwenye ile wing-to-body fairing panel. Niliomba LEO around 0300 ili tudefer ile panel na ndege iweze kuruhusiwa kuondoka, lakini local tech support hawajaikamilisha by the time ya shift turnover. Maintenance Supervisor alikuja akiwa na attitude, akidai LEO haikuwa necessary bila hata kusoma ile paperwork; next shift wacheki status ya LEO au warrange NDT kabla ya release.
summary: Kuna damage kwenye wing-to-body panel ya B737-800 ambayo ilikuwa pending LEO, lakini disagreement na supervisor ilidelay closeout, so next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm LEO/NDT kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: A321 RON aircraft was left to dayshift without a proper turnover; night shift could not finish the vibration survey after the blade change due to a vibration computer fault. Once avionics cleared the computer issue, the incoming technicians ran the survey but got verbal confirmation from the supervisor that engine #1 needed the check, when it was actually engine #2 that had the blade change. The survey was completed and signed off on the wrong engine before the error was discovered the next day. Follow-up required: verify correct engine on the blade change card and repeat the vibration survey on engine #2.
summary: Poor shift turnover and incorrect verbal confirmation led to a post-blade-change vibration survey being performed on the wrong engine on an A321.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 iliyokuwa RON haikupewa turnover sahihi kwa shift ya mchana baada ya night shift kushindwa kukamilisha vibration survey kutokana na hitilafu ya kompyuta ya vibration baada ya blade change. Baada ya avionics kurekebisha hitilafu hiyo, mafundi walioingia walipata uthibitisho wa mdomo kutoka kwa supervisor kuwa engine namba moja ndiyo ilihitaji ukaguzi, ilhali kumbe engine namba mbili ndiyo iliyofanyiwa blade change. Survey ilikamilishwa na kusainiwa kwenye engine isiyofaa kabla tatizo hilo kugunduliwa siku iliyofuata. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuthibitisha engine sahihi kwenye karatasi ya blade change na kurudia vibration survey kwenye engine namba mbili.
summary: Turnover mbovu na uthibitisho wa mdomo usio sahihi ulisababisha vibration survey kufanywa kwenye engine isiyofaa ya ndege ya A321 baada ya blade change.

narrative_text: Aircraft ya A321 ilikuwa RON na hapakuwa na proper turnover kwa dayshift kwa sababu night shift hawakuweza kukamilisha vibration survey baada ya blade change, kuna vibration computer ilikuwa na malfunction. Baada ya avionics kufix computer issue, technicians tuliopokea job tulipiga call supervisor kuconfirm ni engine gani inahitaji survey, akatuambia ni engine 1 lakini kumbe ni engine 2 ndiyo ilikuwa na blade change. Tukafanya survey na kusign off kwa engine mbaya kabla tatizo kugunduliwa next day. Inabidi tucheck tena blade change card na turudie vibration survey kwenye engine 2 correct one.
summary: Turnover haikuwa clear na supervisor akaconfirm engine mbaya, hivyo vibration survey ikafanywa kwenye engine isiyo sahihi ya A321 baada ya blade change.

narrative_text: B737 left inboard fuel tank access plate was reworked for a leak; old gasket and cracked sealant were replaced and leak check passed after fuel transfer. Aircraft returned with the same leak - turns out the plate installed at the opening does not match the correct plate number for that cavity, and the door key index was deformed so the mismatch was not obvious on fit-check. Next shift please verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram (not just hole/cavity match) on both wings, as the two innermost plates on the opposite wing show the same mix-up.
summary: Mismatched fuel tank access plates on a B737 caused a repeat leak after gasket replacement, requiring plate part-number verification on both wings.

entities.text: left inboard fuel tank access plate
verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram

narrative_text: Bamba la ufikiaji la tangi la mafuta upande wa ndani wa mrengo wa kushoto kwenye ndege ya B737 lilirekebishwa kwa sababu ya kuvuja; gasket ya zamani na sealant iliyopasuka ziliondolewa na ukaguzi wa kuvuja ulipita baada ya mafuta kuhamishwa. Ndege ilirudi ikiwa na tatizo lilelile - ikagundulika kuwa bamba lililowekwa halikufanana na namba sahihi ya bamba la eneo hilo, na alama ya ufunguo wa mlango ilikuwa imeharibika hivyo hitilafu hiyo haikuonekana wazi wakati wa ufungaji. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuthibitisha namba za mabamba kulingana na mchoro wa AMM (si tu kufanana kwa shimo) kwenye mabawa yote mawili, kwani mabamba mawili ya ndani kabisa upande wa mrengo mwingine yana tatizo lilelile.
summary: Mabamba ya tangi la mafuta yaliyochanganywa kwenye ndege ya B737 yalisababisha uvujaji kurudia baada ya kubadilishwa kwa gasket, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho wa namba za mabamba kwenye mabawa yote mawili.

entities.text: Bamba la ufikiaji la tangi la mafuta
kuthibitisha namba za mabamba kulingana na mchoro wa AMM

narrative_text: Kwenye hii B737, tulifanya rework ya ile left inboard fuel tank access plate kwa sababu ilikuwa inaleak; ile gasket ya zamani na cracked sealant tuliziremove, tukafanya leak check ikapass baada ya fuel transfer. Lakini aircraft imerudi na same issue - ikaonekana ile plate iliyowekwa haimatch na correct part number ya ile cavity, na ile door key index ilikuwa deformed so mismatch haikuwa obvious wakati wa fit-check. Next shift wasaidie ku-verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram (si tu hole match) kwa mabawa yote mawili, kwa sababu even zile innermost plates upande mwingine zina tatizo kama hilo.
summary: Mabamba ya fuel tank ya B737 yalikuwa swapped na kusababisha leak kurudia, hivyo next shift wana-verify plate part numbers kwenye mabawa yote mawili.

entities.text: left inboard fuel tank access plate
ku-verify plate part numbers against the AMM diagram

narrative_text: B737-700 #1 engine fan blade change (bird strike) taken over from RON Inspector, who briefed maintenance manual references and task cards completed to date. Fan blade weights and spinner weights confirmed with Maintenance Control, and fan blade platform pins inspected per manual before four steps were stamped off. Handed over to incoming Inspector with mechanics still lubricating and installing remaining blades per manual; note that engine run and borescope sign-off are still pending, and aircraft later diverted due to high engine vibration, so vibration history should be reviewed against the blade installation steps.
summary: Incoming inspector should review the #1 engine fan blade installation/sign-off steps after the aircraft diverted for high vibration following the bird-strike repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 ilikuwa ikifanyiwa ubadilishaji wa blade za fan za injini namba moja baada ya kugongwa na ndege, kazi iliyoanzishwa na Mkaguzi wa zamu ya usiku ambaye alinipa maelezo ya taratibu za matengenezo na hatua zilizokwisha kamilika. Nilithibitisha uzito wa blade mpya na uzito wa spinner pamoja na Udhibiti wa Matengenezo, kisha nikakagua pini za jukwaa la blade kama zinavyotakiwa kabla ya kutia sahihi hatua nne zilizokamilika. Nilimkabidhi Mkaguzi mwingine kazi hiyo huku mafundi wakiendelea kulainisha na kufunga blade zilizobaki, ingawa uendeshaji wa injini na ukaguzi wa borescope bado haujakamilika; baadaye ndege ililazimika kugeuza njia kwa sababu ya mtetemo mkubwa wa injini, hivyo suala hili linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.
summary: Mkaguzi anayeingia zamu anapaswa kufuatilia hatua za ufungaji wa blade za injini namba moja baada ya ndege kugeuza njia kutokana na mtetemo mkubwa wa injini.

entities.text: blade za fan za injini namba moja

narrative_text: Kwa B737-700 tulikuwa tuna-handle fan blade change ya engine number one baada ya bird strike, nikapewa turnover na RON Inspector ambaye alinionyesha maintenance manual references na ma-task cards zilizoshakamilika. Nilithibitisha fan blade weights na spinner weights na Maintenance Control, kisha nikaangalia fan blade platform pins kama manual inavyosema before ku-stamp hizo steps nne. Nikampa turnover Inspector mwingine, mechanics wakiwa bado wanaendelea kulubricate na kuinstall blades zilizobaki, lakini engine run na borescope sign-off zilikuwa bado; baadaye nikasikia ndege ilidivert kwa sababu ya high engine vibration, kwa hivyo hiyo issue inahitaji follow-up haraka.
summary: Inspector anayeingia anafaa ku-review fan blade installation steps za engine number one baada ya ndege kudivert kwa sababu ya high engine vibration.

entities.text: fan blade change ya engine number one

narrative_text: During the recent A320 elevator R&I, we later learned that one or more Elevator Servo-Control bushings may not have been reinstalled, discovered only after the operator reported tail flutter during a high-speed descent. Sign-off practice at the time allowed one technician to sign behind another without an RII inspection on this flight-control task, so verification was not enforced. Incoming shift please pull the task card and AMM pages used for that elevator install, confirm bushing part numbers/quantities against stock records, and flag this task for mandatory RII on future flight-control reassembly.
summary: An A320 elevator reassembly may have missed installing servo-control bushings due to lack of RII inspection and unclear sign-off responsibility, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kuondoa na kurudisha elevator ya ndege ya A320 hivi karibuni, tuligundua baadaye kwamba baadhi ya bushing za Elevator Servo-Control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri, jambo lililobainika baada ya shirika la ndege kuripoti mtikisiko wa mkia wakati wa kushuka kwa kasi. Utaratibu wa saini uliokuwepo wakati huo uliruhusu fundi mmoja kusaini kazi iliyofanywa na mwenzake bila ukaguzi wa RII kwenye kazi hii ya sehemu muhimu ya udhibiti wa ndege. Wafanyakazi wa shift inayoingia wanaombwa kupitia task card na kurasa za AMM zilizotumika, kuhakiki idadi na namba za bushing dhidi ya rekodi za stoo, na kuweka alama kwenye kazi hii ili ukaguzi wa RII uwe wa lazima kwa kazi zijazo za flight control.
summary: Ukaguzi wa baadaye ulionyesha kuwa bushing za elevator servo-control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri kwenye A320 kutokana na ukosefu wa ukaguzi wa RII, hivyo shift inayoingia inahitajika kuthibitisha na kurekebisha utaratibu.

narrative_text: Kwa ile elevator R&I ya A320 tuliyofanya, tumepata report kwamba bushings za Elevator Servo-Control huenda hazikuwekwa vizuri wakati wa reassembly, ilijitokeza baada ya crew kuripoti flutter kwenye tail wakati wa high speed descent. Wakati huo, sign-off procedure ilikuwa ya line moja tu, so fundi mmoja angeweza kusaini kazi iliyofanywa na mwenzake bila RII inspection kwenye flight control kama hii. Shift inayokuja please pitia ile task card na AMM pages zilizotumika, confirm bushing part numbers dhidi ya stock, na iwekwe flag ili RII iwe mandatory kwa future elevator work.
summary: Kuna possibility kwamba bushings za elevator servo-control hazikuwekwa vizuri kwenye A320 kwa sababu ya lack of RII inspection, hivyo next shift inatakiwa kuverify na kurekebisha procedure.

narrative_text: On the MD-80, #2 engine CSD and generator were replaced and serviced per manual after ZZZ found a loose B-nut at the CSD oil cooler that had caused the CSD to run dry; this reason was never passed on to the AMTs assigned the swap. Leak and ops check after engine run showed no leaks and oil stayed in the green band, so the job was closed and paperwork signed off. Next shift/AMTs should be briefed on the root cause (loose B-nut) before similar tasks, and the oil cooler B-nut torque should be re-verified to rule out recurrence.
summary: CSD/generator on #2 engine were changed without technicians being told the root cause was a loose B-nut at the oil cooler that ran the CSD dry, so follow-up briefing and B-nut check are needed.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-80, CSD na generator ya engine namba mbili zilibadilishwa na kuhudumiwa kwa mujibu wa manual, baada ya wafanyakazi wa ZZZ kugundua B-nut iliyokuwa legelege kwenye oil cooler ambayo ilisababisha CSD kukosa mafuta kabisa; sababu hii haikuwahi kufikishwa kwa mafundi waliopewa kazi ya kubadilisha vipengele hivyo. Ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji baada ya kuwasha engine ulionyesha hakuna uvujaji na kiwango cha mafuta kilikuwa sawa, hivyo kazi ilifungwa na fomu zikasainiwa. Shift inayokuja inapaswa kujulishwa chanzo halisi cha tatizo (B-nut legelege) kabla ya kazi kama hiyo, na ukakamilifu wa B-nut hiyo kwenye oil cooler uangaliwe upya kuzuia kujirudia.
summary: CSD na generator ya engine namba mbili zilibadilishwa bila mafundi kujulishwa kuwa chanzo cha tatizo ni B-nut legelege kwenye oil cooler, hivyo inahitajika taarifa zaidi na ukaguzi wa ziada.

narrative_text: Kwa MD-80, tulichange #2 engine CSD na generator kama per manual, baada ya wale wa ZZZ kupata loose B-nut kwa oil cooler ambayo ndio ilifanya CSD irun dry completely; issue hii haikuwahi kutold kwa AMTs walioassignwa job hiyo. Leak and ops check baada ya engine run ilikuwa clean, hakuna leak, na oil level ilikuwa in the green band, so job ikaclose na paperwork ikasignwa. Next shift washauriwe about root cause (loose B-nut) before wanaanza kazi kama hii, na B-nut ya oil cooler icheckwe tena torque yake ili kuavoid recurrence.
summary: CSD na generator ya #2 engine zilichangwa bila AMTs kujuishwa kuwa root cause ni loose B-nut kwa oil cooler, so follow-up briefing na re-check ya B-nut inahitajika.

narrative_text: B737-400 #1 ILS was placed on MEL overnight; while troubleshooting, an open wire was found in the freq tuning circuit between the NAV control panel and the NAV receiver, but its exact location could not be pinpointed before shift change. Aircraft was released with #1 ILS on MEL, but it was not recognized at the time that the same open wire could also affect the #1 VOR, which cannot be dispatched inop. Follow-up crew should note the #1 VOR requires verification/repair if not already closed out, as this discrepancy resurfaced nine days later via pilot write-up before being fixed by line maintenance.
summary: An unresolved open wire causing an ILS tuning fault also affected the VOR system, which was missed before dispatch and only corrected after a later pilot write-up.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 ilikuwa na hitilafu ya #1 ILS iliyowekwa kwenye MEL usiku wa kulala ZZZ; wakati wa uchunguzi, kifundo cha waya kilichokatika kiligunduliwa kwenye mzunguko wa kurekebisha frequency kati ya kidhibiti cha NAV na kipokezi cha NAV, lakini mahali hasa hapakuwezekana kubainika kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Ndege iliruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa na #1 ILS kwenye MEL, lakini haikutambuliwa wakati huo kuwa waya huo huo unaweza kuathiri pia #1 VOR, ambayo haifai kuruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa mbovu. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya #1 VOR, kwani hitilafu hiyo ilijitokeza tena baada ya siku tisa kupitia ripoti ya rubani kabla ya kurekebishwa na wafanyakazi wa matengenezo.
summary: Waya uliokatika ulisababisha hitilafu ya ILS na baadaye kuathiri VOR, jambo lililokosa kutambuliwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.

narrative_text: Ile B737-400 ilikuwa na #1 ILS ime-MEL usiku ule wa layover ZZZ; tukiwa tuna-troubleshoot, tukapata open wire kwenye freq tuning circuit kati ya NAV control panel na NAV receiver, lakini hatukuweza ku-locate exact spot kabla ya shift change. Aircraft ika-released na #1 ILS on MEL, lakini haikutudawn kwa wakati ule kwamba hiyo hiyo open wire inaweza kuaffect #1 VOR pia, na VOR haiwezi ku-dispatch ikiwa inop. Next shift wacheki #1 VOR status kwa sababu discrepancy hii ilirudi baada ya siku tisa through pilot write-up, na eventually maintenance wakaifix.
summary: Open wire iliyofanya ILS iwe MEL pia iliaffect VOR bila kutambuliwa mapema, ikapelekea write-up ya rubani baada ya siku tisa.

narrative_text: The BeechJet 400XP main cabin door air-stairs received for installation had a part number not listed as effective for this aircraft serial number per the manufacturer's IPC. Maintenance control instructed the technician to install anyway, citing past practice, but could produce no manufacturer documentation supporting cross-applicability, and the manufacturer confirmed no such approval exists. Stairs remain uninstalled pending correct-effectivity parts or written manufacturer authorization; next shift please do not release aircraft with these stairs fitted until documentation is resolved.
summary: Incorrect-effectivity air-stairs for a BeechJet 400XP were held back after maintenance control pressured installation without manufacturer documentation.

entities.text: correct-effectivity parts or written manufacturer authorization

narrative_text: Ngazi za mlango wa kabati kuu za BeechJet 400XP zilizoletwa kwa ufungaji zilikuwa na namba ya sehemu isiyoendana na serial number ya ndege hii kulingana na IPC ya mtengenezaji. Maintenance control walimwambia fundi afunge tu akitoa sababu kwamba hivyo ndivyo walivyokuwa wakifanya siku zote, lakini hawakuwa na hati yoyote kutoka kwa mtengenezaji inayothibitisha hilo, na mtengenezaji mwenyewe alithibitisha kutokuwepo kwa idhini kama hiyo. Ngazi hazijafungwa hadi sehemu sahihi au kibali cha maandishi kutoka kwa mtengenezaji kipatikane; zamu inayofuata isiruhusu ufungaji wa ngazi hizi kabla ya suala hili kutatuliwa.
summary: Ngazi za mlango zenye namba ya sehemu isiyofaa kwa BeechJet 400XP zilizuiliwa baada ya maintenance control kujaribu kushinikiza ufungaji bila hati za mtengenezaji.

entities.text: Ngazi za mlango wa kabati kuu
kibali cha maandishi kutoka kwa mtengenezaji

narrative_text: Zile air-stairs za main cabin door za BeechJet 400XP zilikuja na part number ambayo haiko effective kwa serial number ya hii aircraft, kwa mujibu wa IPC ya manufacturer. Maintenance control walimwambia technician a-install tu wakisema 'we've been doing it like that for years,' lakini hawakuwa na documentation yoyote kutoka manufacturer inayo-support hilo, na manufacturer wenyewe walithibitisha hakuna approval kama hiyo. Stairs bado hazijafungwa mpaka correct-effectivity parts au written authorization ipatikane -- zamu inayofuata please usi-release aircraft na hizi stairs mpaka issue hii i-clear.
summary: Air-stairs zenye wrong part number kwa BeechJet 400XP zime-hold baada ya maintenance control kujaribu kupressure installation bila manufacturer documentation.

narrative_text: CRJ900 CAT II/TOGA check completed after prior shift's RH pitot probe replacement did not resolve airspeed disagree between PFD-1 and PFD-2 on the DPS-450 ADTS. Swapped pitot probe adaptors from another test kit, reran the check, and both PFDs read 85 KTS correctly; leak check on RH probe verified good per AMM. Removed tape from AOA vanes and S2 ports, but tape on the LH S1 port was inadvertently left in place. Aircraft flew three legs and on the last leg crew reported EFIS COMP MON and a 250 FT altitude split; ground crew found melted tape at the LH S1 port and replaced the pitot/static probe before return to service. Next shift should audit tape removal procedure on CAT II job cards and confirm all S1/S2 port coverings are logged and removed prior to release.
summary: Leftover electrician's tape on the LH pitot S1 port after a CAT II/TOGA check caused an in-flight EFIS/altitude disagreement, requiring probe replacement; tape-removal verification process needs review.

narrative_text: Kazi ya CAT II/TOGA check kwenye CRJ900 imekamilika baada ya shift iliyopita kubadilisha pitot probe ya RH bila kutatua tatizo la airspeed kutofautiana kati ya PFD-1 na PFD-2 kwenye kifaa cha DPS-450. Nilibadilisha adaptors za pitot probe kutoka test kit nyingine, nikarudia ukaguzi, na PFD zote mbili zikasoma 85 KTS sawasawa; ukaguzi wa leak kwenye probe ya RH ulionekana mzuri kulingana na AMM. Tepu ilitolewa kwenye AOA vanes na S2 ports, lakini kwa bahati mbaya tepu ya S1 port upande wa kushoto haikutolewa. Ndege iliruka safari tatu, na katika safari ya mwisho crew waliripoti onyo la EFIS COMP MON pamoja na tofauti ya altitude ya futi 250; wafanyakazi wa ardhini walikuta tepu iliyoungua kwenye S1 port ya kushoto na kubadilisha pitot/static probe kabla ndege kurudi kazini. Shift inayokuja inatakiwa kuangalia utaratibu wa kutoa tepu kwenye job card ya CAT II na kuhakikisha ports zote za S1/S2 zimeandikwa na kutolewa kabla ya kutolewa kwa ndege.
summary: Tepu iliyosalia kwenye S1 port ya pitot upande wa kushoto baada ya ukaguzi wa CAT II/TOGA ilisababisha tofauti ya EICAS/altitude wakati wa ndege, hivyo probe kubadilishwa, na utaratibu wa kuangalia utolewaji wa tepu unahitaji kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: Tume-finish CAT II/TOGA check kwenye CRJ900 baada ya previous shift kubadilisha RH pitot probe lakini bado airspeed disagree kati ya PFD-1 na PFD-2 kwenye DPS-450 tester. Nika-swap pitot probe adaptors kutoka test kit nyingine, nika-rerun check, both PFDs zika-read 85 KTS vizuri; leak check ya RH probe ilikuwa good per AMM. Tuli-remove tape kwenye AOA vanes na S2 ports, lakini tape ya LH S1 port ilibaki bila kutolewa kwa mistake. Ndege ilifanya legs tatu, na kwenye last leg crew wame-report EFIS COMP MON message na altitude split ya 250 FT; ground crew walikuta tape imeungua karibu na LH S1 port, waka-replace pitot/static probe kabla aircraft kurudi service. Next shift wanahitaji kuangalia procedure ya tape removal kwenye CAT II job card na ku-confirm ports zote za S1/S2 zime-log na kutolewa before release.
summary: Tape iliyobaki kwenye LH pitot S1 port baada ya CAT II/TOGA check ilisababisha EFIS/altitude disagreement mid-flight, hivyo probe ika-replace na tape-removal check inahitaji kuboreshwa.

narrative_text: On MD-88 layover check, found battery charger circuit breaker popped; consulted maintenance manual and coordinator by phone, then rewired charger per verbal guidance and signed off as serviceable after seeing a small charge on the gauge. Crew later reported charger not charging enough and logged a separate emergency power check discrepancy; breaker reset fine. Day shift mechanic changed charger wiring and replaced batteries before release, but aircraft later showed smoke/fumes from the E&E compartment at the gate and battery/charger were replaced again by outstation mechanics. Follow-up needed: verify correct single-charger MEL wiring procedure was followed, as either the initial rewire or the day-shift follow-up work appears to have been done incorrectly.
summary: A battery charger wiring fix on an MD-88 was signed off but proved faulty, leading to a follow-on smoke/fumes event and requiring review of the MEL wiring procedure.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa usiku kwenye ndege ya MD-88, circuit breaker ya chaja ya betri ilipatikana imetoka; nilipiga simu kwa coordinator wa matengenezo na kuangalia maelezo kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo kabla ya kuunganisha upya waya kama nilivyoshauriwa. Baada ya kuona kiwango kidogo cha chaji kwenye kipimo, niliithibitisha ndege kuwa tayari kwa safari, lakini wafanyakazi wa ndege (marubani) walirudisha taarifa kuwa chaja haikuwa ikifanya kazi vizuri na wakaandika tatizo jingine kuhusu ukaguzi wa nguvu ya dharura. Fundi wa zamu ya mchana alibadilisha baadhi ya nyaya na betri kisha akairuhusu ndege kuendelea na safari, lakini muda mfupi baadaye moshi na mvuke vilionekana kutoka sehemu ya E&E wakati ndege ikiwa geti; mafundi wa kituo kingine walibadilisha betri na chaja tena. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kubaini kama utaratibu sahihi wa uunganishaji wa waya kulingana na MEL ulifuatwa, kwani inaonekana kazi ya awali au ile ya zamu ya mchana haikufanywa ipasavyo.
summary: Ukarabati wa waya za chaja ya betri kwenye ndege ya MD-88 ulithibitishwa kuwa sahihi lakini baadaye ulisababisha tatizo la moshi, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi wa utaratibu wa uunganishaji kulingana na MEL.

entities.text: circuit breaker ya chaja ya betri
utaratibu wa uunganishaji wa waya kulingana na MEL

narrative_text: Nilikuwa doing layover check kwa MD-88 na nikapata circuit breaker ya battery charger imepop; nikapiga call coordinator na kuangalia manual haraka before ku-rewire charger kama alivyoshauri. Niliona small charge kwenye gauge so nikasign off ndege as serviceable, lakini crew wakaripoti later kwamba charger haikuwa charging enough, wakaandika pia logbook entry mpya kuhusu emergency power check kutofanya kazi. Day shift mech alichange wiring ya charger na batteries kabla ya ku-release ndege, lakini shortly after ndege ikiwa geti, plts waliona smoke na fumes zikitoka E&E compartment na mechs wa outstation wakachange battery na charger tena. Tunahitaji follow-up ya haraka kuconfirm kama MEL wiring procedure ya single charger operation ilifuatwa correctly, coz inaonekana either job yangu au ya day shift ilikuwa incorrect.
summary: Battery charger rewire kwa MD-88 iliyokuwa signed off ilileta smoke event baadaye, hivyo tunahitaji kucheck kama MEL wiring procedure ilifuatwa sawasawa.

entities.text: MEL wiring procedure ya single charger operation

narrative_text: The Agusta A119 was grounded overnight after the pilot reported a rapid ITT spike to 805C during transition from idle to max power, and shut the engine down as a precaution. On inspection, EDU #1 showed ITT pegged at 1277C, so the engine compartment was opened per the AW A119 and PT6 EMM procedures and the engine trim compensator was swapped with one from the parts room. Note that the replacement unit had no accompanying paperwork; Records Office needs to confirm documentation before further flight. Next shift should verify trim compensator paperwork and re-check ITT readings on ground run.
summary: An Agusta A119 helicopter's engine was grounded and trim compensator replaced after an ITT overtemperature event, but the incoming shift must still confirm the replacement part's missing paperwork.

entities.text: re-check ITT readings on ground run

narrative_text: Helikopta ya Agusta A119 ilizuiwa kuruka usiku uliopita baada ya kiongozi ndege kuripoti joto la ITT kupanda ghafla hadi 805C wakati wa kubadilisha kutoka mwendo wa taratibu kwenda kasi kamili, na akaamua kuzima injini kwa tahadhari. Baada ya ukaguzi, kifaa cha EDU namba moja kilionyesha ITT ikiwa juu kabisa kwenye 1277C, hivyo sehemu ya injini ilifunguliwa kwa kufuata taratibu za matengenezo za Agusta-Westland na PT6, na kifaa cha trim compensator kikabadilishwa na kingine kilichotolewa ghalani. Ni muhimu kutambua kuwa kifaa kipya hakikuwa na nyaraka zake; Ofisi ya Kumbukumbu inahitajika kuthibitisha nyaraka hizo kabla ya safari nyingine. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha nyaraka za trim compensator na kuangalia tena vipimo vya ITT wakati wa majaribio ardhini.
summary: Helikopta ya Agusta A119 ilizuiwa na injini yake kubadilishiwa kifaa cha trim compensator baada ya tatizo la joto kupita kiasi la ITT, lakini zamu inayofuata bado inahitaji kuthibitisha nyaraka za kifaa kilichobadilishwa.

narrative_text: Ile Agusta A119 iligrounded usiku, pilot aliripoti ITT ikipanda ghafla mpaka 805C wakati wa transition kutoka idle kwenda max power, so akashut down engine kwa precaution. Baada ya kuangalia, EDU #1 ilikuwa inashow ITT imepeak kwenye 1277C, so tuka-decowl engine compartment kufuata AW A119 na PT6 EMM procedures, tuka-remove trim compensator na kuinstall replacement kutoka parts room. Cha kuzingatia, hiyo unit haikuwa na paperwork yake; Records Office wanahitaji kuconfirm documentation kabla ya next flight. Next shift wako-verify hiyo paperwork ya trim compensator na kurudia ITT check wakati wa ground run.
summary: Agusta A119 ilipata ITT overtemperature issue, trim compensator ika-replace, lakini bado kuna paperwork ya kifaa haijaconfirm kwa next shift.

entities.text: verify hiyo paperwork ya trim compensator
kurudia ITT check wakati wa ground run

narrative_text: During marshalling of a B787 into the gate this evening, a Company maintenance pickup truck cut into the safety area from the right side, passing very close behind the wing walker and under the jet bridge cab before parking near the maintenance offices. This occurred while the aircraft was still taxiing in, creating a serious ramp safety hazard. Please follow up with ramp supervision and maintenance dispatch to reinforce safety-area clearance procedures during active gate arrivals.
summary: A maintenance vehicle entered the safety area and passed close to ground crew while a B787 was being marshalled into the gate, posing a ramp safety hazard.

narrative_text: Wakati ndege ya B787 ikiwa inaelekezwa kwenye geti jioni ya leo, gari la matengenezo la kampuni liliingia eneo la usalama kutoka upande wa kulia, likipita karibu sana na mfanyakazi aliyekuwa akisaidia kuelekeza ndege, kisha likapitia chini ya sehemu ya jet bridge kabla ya kuegesha karibu na ofisi za matengenezo. Hali hii ilitokea wakati ndege bado ikiwa inasogea kuelekea geti, jambo lililoleta hatari kubwa ya kiusalama eneo la apron. Tafadhali fuatilia na wasimamizi wa apron na idara ya matengenezo ili kuimarisha taratibu za kuheshimu eneo la usalama wakati ndege zinapoingia geti.
summary: Gari la matengenezo liliingia eneo la usalama na kupita karibu na wafanyakazi wakati ndege ya B787 ikielekezwa kwenye geti, na kusababisha hatari ya kiusalama.

narrative_text: So leo jioni tulikuwa tuna-marshal B787 ikiingia gate, halafu maintenance pickup ikatokea kulia ikaingia kwa safety area, ikapita very close nyuma ya yule wing walker, ikapitia chini ya jet bridge cab kabla ya kuparki karibu na maintenance offices. Hii ilitokea wakati aircraft ilikuwa bado inasogea in, so ni real safety concern kwa ramp. Tafadhali fuatilia na ramp supervisor pamoja na maintenance dispatch ili wa-reinforce vizuri clearance procedures za safety area during active gate arrivals.
summary: Maintenance pickup iliingia safety area na kupita karibu na wing walker wakati B787 ikiwa inaelekezwa gate, ikileta safety hazard kwenye ramp.

narrative_text: Hydraulic mule was sent back to the hangar for the Fokker 100 after ground crew requested a fluid sample due to suspected overpressure at 3000 PSI, which reportedly blew out two engine pumps and steering valves. The unit was returned to service before shift change without waiting for the 90-day sample results, and no filters or parts were replaced even though it ran fine on our bench for over an hour. Next shift needs to confirm whether the hydro-unit gauges are calibrated (may not have been checked against actual aircraft pressure of 3600 PSI), and verify what paperwork exists for handling a possibly contaminated unit before it's cleared again.
summary: A hydraulic mule suspected of causing an overpressure event on a Fokker 100 was returned to service before sample results came back, raising calibration and contamination-handling concerns for follow-up.

narrative_text: Hydraulic mule ilirudishwa hangarini kwa ajili ya ndege ya Fokker 100 baada ya wafanyakazi wa uwanjani kuomba sampuli ya majimaji kwa sababu ya shaka ya presha kupita kiasi ya 3000 PSI, ambayo inasemekana ilisababisha pump mbili za injini na valves za usukani kuharibika. Kitengo hicho kilirudishwa kazini kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu bila kusubiri matokeo ya sampuli ambayo huchukua hadi siku 90, na hakuna sehemu wala filta zilizobadilishwa ijapokuwa kilifanya kazi vizuri dukani kwa zaidi ya saa moja. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kama gauge za hydro-unit zimehakikiwa vizuri (huenda hazikulinganishwa na presha halisi ya ndege ya 3600 PSI), na kuangalia kama kuna taratibu rasmi za kushughulikia kitengo kinachoshukiwa kuchafuliwa kabla ya kukirudisha tena kazini.
summary: Kitengo cha hydraulic mule kilichoshukiwa kusababisha tatizo la presha kupita kiasi kwenye ndege ya Fokker 100 kilirudishwa kazini kabla ya matokeo ya sampuli kupatikana, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji wa uhakiki wa vipimo na taratibu za uchafuzi.

narrative_text: Tulirudisha ile hydraulic mule hangar kwa ajili ya Fokker 100 baada ya mgmnt kusema wachukue sample ya hydro fluid kwa sababu unit ilionekana ime-overpressurize mpaka 3000 PSI, na hiyo ndio ilisababisha engine pumps mbili na steering valves ku-blow out. Kabla sample results zirudi (huchukua siku 90), hangar wakarudisha unit back to service bila kubadilisha even filters, ingawa ilirun sawa kwa zaidi ya hour moja kwa shop. Next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm kama hizo gauges za hydro-unit zime-calibrate, kwa sababu inaonekana aircraft pressure ilikuwa 3600 PSI si 3000, na pia tuangalie kama kuna paperwork ya kushughulikia unit ambayo inaweza kuwa contaminated kabla ya kuirudisha service.
summary: Hydraulic mule iliyoshukiwa kusababisha overpressure kwenye Fokker 100 ilirudishwa service kabla sample results, hivyo next shift lazima ifuatilie calibration ya gauges na paperwork ya contamination.

narrative_text: Took over the B767-300 bulk cargo door MEL job left by line maintenance from last night; found the spring tube in an unsafe condition with the rig pin wrongly installed and the end cap hardware removed. Only one partially installed screw was holding the compressed spring inside the tube, a serious risk of injury if it had released. No entry was made on the logpage and the previous shift did not properly brief what work had actually been done. Follow-up: pull the AMM before continuing, hold for correct tooling, and ensure all actions and the unsafe condition are logged and briefed at handover.
summary: Incoming technician found an unsafely rigged cargo door spring tube from the prior shift, with no logpage entry or proper handover briefing, requiring AMM reference and correct documentation before continuing.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi ya MEL ya mlango wa mizigo wa ndege B767-300 iliyoanzishwa na wafanyakazi wa line maintenance usiku uliopita; nikakuta spring tube katika hali hatarishi, rig pin imewekwa vibaya na vifaa vya end cap vimetolewa. Skrubu moja tu iliyowekwa nusu ndiyo ilikuwa ikizuia spring iliyobanwa kutoka ndani ya tube, hali ambayo ingeweza kusababisha jeraha kali au kifo. Hakukuwa na maelezo yoyote kwenye logpage kuhusu hatua zilizochukuliwa, na zamu iliyotangulia haikutoa taarifa sahihi wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Inashauriwa kurejelea Aircraft Maintenance Manual kabla ya kuendelea, kusubiri vifaa sahihi, na kuandika kwa uwazi hatua zote na hali hatarishi kwenye logpage.
summary: Fundi aliyeingia zamu alikuta mlango wa mizigo wa ndege ukiwa katika hali hatarishi bila kumbukumbu sahihi za kazi kwenye logpage, hivyo kuhitajika hatua za haraka za usalama na uandikaji bora.

narrative_text: Nilipokea ile bulk cargo door MEL job ya B767-300 ambayo line maintenance walikuwa wameanza usiku wa jana; nikakuta spring tube iko unsafe, rig pin imewekwa vibaya na end cap hardware imetolewa kabisa. Ni screw moja tu ambayo haikuwa fully installed ndiyo ilikuwa ikizuia spring compressed isitoke kwa nguvu, jambo ambalo lingeweza kusababisha serious injury. Hakuna entry kwenye logpage na handover ya zamu iliyopita haikueleza clearly nini kilifanyika. Tafadhali check AMM kabla ya kuendelea, wait for correct tooling, na uandike vizuri actions zote pamoja na hiyo unsafe condition.
summary: Fundi wa zamu aligundua cargo door spring tube iko katika unsafe condition bila proper logpage entry au handover briefing, hivyo inahitajika AMM reference na documentation kabla ya kuendelea na job.

narrative_text: On B727-200, the aux fuel tank was reinstalled after bilge work below it, but a mechanic noticed the L-hand tank fitting was touching the floor beam forging and flagged it verbally to his supervisor instead of writing a non-routine card. The supervisor passed this to the next shift supervisor verbally as well, so it never made it into the written turnover, and the area was closed up with no corrective action taken. Please verify the clearance on that tank fitting before further flight and get a non-routine card raised retroactively; the mechanic who first noticed it says his supervisor intends to pursue this further.
summary: An aux fuel tank clearance issue on a B727-200 was reported verbally but never documented, so it needs formal follow-up and inspection before further flight.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B727-200, tanki la ziada la mafuta lilirudishwa mahali baada ya kazi kufanyika chini yake, lakini fundi mmoja aligundua kuwa kifaa cha kushikilia tanki upande wa kushoto kilikuwa kinagusa muundo wa chuma wa sakafu, na akamweleza msimamizi wake kwa mdomo tu bila kuandika ripoti rasmi. Msimamizi huyo naye alimweleza msimamizi wa zamu inayofuata kwa maneno tu, hivyo taarifa hii haikuingizwa kwenye makabidhiano yaliyoandikwa, na eneo hilo likafungwa bila hatua yoyote kuchukuliwa. Ni muhimu kuthibitisha nafasi ya kifaa hicho cha tanki kabla ya safari nyingine na kuandika ripoti rasmi haraka, kwani fundi aliyegundua tatizo hili anasema msimamizi wake ana nia ya kufuatilia jambo hili zaidi.
summary: Tatizo la nafasi ya tanki la ziada la mafuta kwenye ndege ya B727-200 liliripotiwa kwa mdomo tu bila kuandikwa, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji rasmi na ukaguzi kabla ya safari nyingine.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile B727-200, aux fuel tank iliwekwa back baada ya kazi ya bilge chini yake, lakini mechanic mmoja aliona kwamba ile L-hand tank fitting inagusa ile floor beam forging na akamwambia supervisor wake kwa mdomo tu, hakuandika non-routine card. Supervisor akapass hiyo info kwa next shift supervisor pia kwa mdomo, so haikuingia kwenye written turnover, na wakaclose up ile area bila corrective action yoyote. Tafadhali tu-verify clearance ya hiyo fitting kabla ya next flight na tu-raise non-routine card retroactively, coz ule mechanic aliyeona kwanza anasema supervisor wake ana intent ya ku-pursue hii issue zaidi.
summary: Kuna aux fuel tank clearance issue kwenye B727-200 iliripotiwa verbally tu bila kuandikwa, so inahitaji follow-up rasmi na inspection kabla ya next flight.

narrative_text: During shift, rags left in the stabilizer jackscrew area on the B737-400 were not removed after fairing/seal work, and the aircraft could not be trimmed to zero degrees on check. Crew was juggling two sliding seal jobs on two late-arriving aircraft plus a spar damage finding that pulled in sheetmetal and engineering, so the jackscrew area was not properly closed out before shift end. Next shift must inspect jackscrew for FOD, confirm rags removed, and verify trim function before release.
summary: Rags left in the stabilizer jackscrew during a rushed shift with multiple concurrent jobs caused a trim-to-zero fault that next shift needs to inspect and clear.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu, vitambaa vilivyowekwa kwenye eneo la jackscrew ya stabilizer katika ndege ya B737-400 havikuondolewa baada ya kazi ya sliding seal, na hivyo ndege haikuweza kupimwa trim hadi digrii sifuri. Wafanyakazi walikuwa na majukumu mengi kwa wakati mmoja, ikiwemo kazi mbili za sliding seal kwenye ndege mbili zilizochelewa, pamoja na uharibifu wa spar uliohitaji timu za sheetmetal na engineering, hivyo eneo la jackscrew halikufungwa vizuri kabla ya zamu kuisha. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kukagua jackscrew kuhakikisha hakuna vitu vilivyosalia, na kuthibitisha trim inafanya kazi vizuri kabla ndege kutolewa.
summary: Vitambaa vilivyosalia kwenye jackscrew ya stabilizer wakati wa zamu yenye shughuli nyingi vilisababisha tatizo la trim, na zamu inayofuata inahitajika kukagua na kuthibitisha kabla ya kutoa ndege.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-400, tuligundua rags zilizowekwa kwenye jackscrew ya stabilizer hazikuondolewa baada ya sliding seal job, so aircraft haikuweza kutrim to zero degrees wakati wa check. Zamu ilikuwa na workload kubwa - two sliding seals, ndege zote zikiwa late arrivals, plus tukagundua spar damage ambayo ilihitaji sheetmetal na engineering kuja evaluate, so jackscrew area haikuclose out properly before shift end. Next shift wafanye inspection ya jackscrew for FOD, confirm rags zimeondolewa, na verify trim function kabla ya release.
summary: Rags zilibaki kwenye stabilizer jackscrew ya B737-400 wakati wa zamu yenye workload kubwa, causing trim fault ambayo next shift wanahitaji kuinspect na kuclear kabla ya release.

narrative_text: During RII sign-off for the nose landing gear Sequence Valve replacement on the B757-200, prior shift verbally confirmed the ADC VMU/MMO switch was returned to Normal and logged separately, so we assumed the aircraft was fully back to normal config after the Op/Leak checks. However, a permanent-type collar was left installed on the Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker, which had been pulled for the gear swing, and this was not caught before turnover. Flight crew subsequently had to use the Lock Override procedure to retract the gear after departure. Next shift/QA please review use of permanent collars on pulled breakers and confirm all breaker/config items are logged, not just verbally passed at turnover.
summary: A permanent collar left on a pulled Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker after nose gear maintenance was missed at shift turnover, forcing flight crew to use gear Lock Override in flight.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII baada ya kubadilisha Sequence Valve kwenye gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B757-200, zamu iliyotangulia ilituambia kwa mdomo kwamba swichi ya ADC VMU/MMO ilikuwa imerudishwa katika hali ya kawaida na kuandikwa kwenye logbook tofauti, hivyo tulidhani ndege nzima ilikuwa imerudi kwenye hali ya kawaida baada ya ukaguzi wa uendeshaji na uvujaji. Hata hivyo, kola ya kudumu iliachwa kwenye circuit breaker ya Gear Lever Lock iliyokuwa imetolewa kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo, na jambo hili halikugundulika kabla ya kukabidhi zamu. Wafanyakazi wa ndege walilazimika kutumia utaratibu wa Lock Override kurudisha gia baada ya kuruka. Zamu inayofuata na idara ya ubora wanaombwa kupitia matumizi ya kola za kudumu kwenye breakers zilizotolewa na kuhakikisha taarifa zote za usanidi zinaandikwa, si kupitishwa kwa mdomo tu.
summary: Kola ya kudumu iliyoachwa kwenye circuit breaker ya Gear Lever Lock baada ya matengenezo ya gia ya mbele haikugunduliwa wakati wa kukabidhi zamu, na kusababisha wafanyakazi wa ndege kutumia Lock Override wakiwa angani.
