narrative_text: Wakati wa RII sign-off baada ya kubadilisha ile Sequence Valve kwa nose gear ya B757-200, previous shift walitwambia kwa mdomo tu kwamba ADc VMU/MMO switch imerudi Normal na wamesign separate logbook entry, so tulidhani aircraft iko back to normal config baada ya Op check na Leak check. Lakini kumbe kuna permanent collar iliachwa kwenye Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker ambayo ilikuwa pulled kwa ajili ya gear swing, na hii haikuonekana kabla ya turnover. Flight crew waliishia ku-use Lock Override procedure kurudisha gear baada ya kutake-off. Next shift na QA please recheck matumizi ya permanent collars kwenye breakers zilizo-pulled, na hakikisha config items zinaandikwa kwenye logbook, si kuambiana tu kwa mdomo wakati wa turnover.
summary: Permanent collar iliachwa kwenye Gear Lever Lock circuit breaker baada ya gear maintenance na haikugunduliwa turnover, hivyo flight crew wakalazimika ku-use Lock Override wakiwa airborne.

narrative_text: B737-700 arrived late with a dual bleed trip on #1 engine, which has a known history of bleed trip issues; per instruction we did not troubleshoot that item further. During lockout we mistakenly isolated the high stage valve instead of the bleed valve (PRSOV), and the fail-safe engine run afterward did not catch the error due to time pressure from a shift change and weather delays. Aircraft was later moved to another gate; next shift please verify correct valve lockout status on #1 engine before next dispatch.
summary: Wrong valve (high stage instead of PRSOV) was locked out on #1 engine during a rushed shift-change troubleshooting event, and the follow-up engine run failed to catch the error.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-700 iliwasili ikiwa imechelewa kutokana na tatizo la bleed trip mbili kwenye injini namba 1, ambayo ina historia ya matatizo kama hayo; tulielekezwa tusiendelee kuchunguza zaidi. Wakati wa kuzima valve, tulikosea na kufunga high stage valve badala ya bleed valve (PRSOV), na ukaguzi wa injini uliofuata haukubaini kosa hilo kwa sababu ya haraka iliyosababishwa na mabadiliko ya zamu na hali mbaya ya hewa. Ndege ilihamishwa baadaye hadi geti lingine; zamu inayofuata ihakikishe valve sahihi imefungwa kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Valve isiyo sahihi (high stage badala ya PRSOV) ilifungwa kwenye injini namba 1 wakati wa zamu yenye shughuli nyingi, na ukaguzi wa injini haukugundua kosa hilo.

narrative_text: B737-700 ilikuja late na dual bleed trip kwenye engine number 1, ambayo ina history ya bleed trips, so tuliambiwa tusiguse item hiyo tena. Wakati wa lockout, tuli-miss na tukafunga high stage valve badala ya bleed valve (PRSOV), na yule engine run ya fail-safe haikucatch mistake hiyo kwa sababu ya time pressure ya shift change na weather ilikuwa mbaya. Aircraft ilihamishiwa gate ingine baadaye; next shift wacheki valve iko correct kwa engine number 1 kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: Wrong valve (high stage badala ya PRSOV) ilifungwa kwa engine number 1 during rushed shift change, na engine run haikucatch ile mistake.

narrative_text: MEL 78-XX deferral is open on the B737-800 for Eng #1 thrust reverser actuators; only the upper left outboard sleeve actuator was worked on this shift, using the job card, while the MEL was updated to reflect both actuators still requiring replacement. The new actuator was only partially installed by end of shift, and the monitor deferral sheets were mistakenly tagged to the component instead of the airframe, so this needs correction. Next shift lead must confirm actuator installation is completed and verify the deferral paperwork/monitors are properly linked to the aircraft before close-out.
summary: Overnight actuator replacement on Eng #1 thrust reverser was left partially complete with deferral/monitor paperwork errors requiring next-shift follow-up.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha actuator ya thrust reverser ya Eng #1 kwenye ndege ya B737-800 haikukamilika usiku huu; actuator ya juu kushoto tu ndiyo iliyofanyiwa kazi kwa kutumia job card, ilhali MEL ilisemwa kuwa actuator zote mbili zinahitaji kubadilishwa. Karatasi za ufuatiliaji (monitor deferral sheets) zilibandikwa kimakosa kwenye kipengele badala ya ndege yenyewe, jambo linalohitaji kurekebishwa kabla ya kufunga kazi hii. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kuthibitisha usanikishaji wa actuator umekamilika na kuhakikisha nyaraka za MEL zimewekwa sawa.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa actuator ya thrust reverser ya Eng #1 haukukamilika usiku huu na kuna makosa ya nyaraka za MEL yanayohitaji kufuatiliwa na zamu inayokuja.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-800, MEL 78-XX deferral bado iko open kwa Eng #1 thrust reverser actuators; tulifanya replacement ya upper left outboard sleeve actuator tu kwa kutumia job card, but MEL bado inaonyesha actuators zote mbili zinahitaji replacement. By end of shift, installation ya actuator mpya ilikua only partial, na monitor deferral sheets zilikua zimeattachiwa kwa component instead of airframe, so hiyo inahitaji kufixiwa. Next shift wanafaa waverify kama installation imecomplete na wacheck MEL paperwork iko sawa before close-out.
summary: Overnight, actuator replacement ya Eng #1 thrust reverser ilikua partial na kuna paperwork issue ya MEL deferral inayohitaji follow-up na next shift.

narrative_text: Handover on the MD-80 fan blade blending job: at turnover on Friday, the only damage in work was limited to blade tip and acoustic liner areas. By the time the job was reassessed, the C-1 disk blades were found damaged well beyond manual limits, which does not match the condition recorded at turnover. Please verify the blending records and photos against the maintenance manual limits before continuing, since the engine repair is scheduled and this discrepancy needs to be resolved with the incoming shift.
summary: A shift-handover discrepancy on an MD-80 engine revealed C-1 disk blade damage exceeding manual limits, inconsistent with the lesser tip/liner damage noted at the original turnover.

narrative_text: Kuna suala la kufuatilia kuhusu kazi ya kusawazisha blade za injini ya ndege ya MD-80. Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu Ijumaa, uharibifu uliokuwepo ulikuwa kwenye ncha ya blade na sehemu ya acoustic liner pekee. Baadaye ilipatikana kuwa blade za disk ya C-1 zimeharibika zaidi ya kiwango kinachoruhusiwa na mwongozo wa matengenezo, jambo ambalo halifanani na hali iliyoripotiwa awali. Zamu inayofuata inaombwa kupitia rekodi na picha za kazi hiyo ili kubaini chanzo cha tofauti hii kabla ya kuendelea na ukarabati.
summary: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa zamu, blade za disk C-1 za injini ya MD-80 zilikutwa zimeharibika zaidi ya kiwango kinachoruhusiwa, tofauti na hali iliyoripotiwa awali ya uharibifu mdogo.

narrative_text: Kwa hii MD-80 engine, kulikuwa na blade blending job ambayo tulipokea turnover Ijumaa, na wakati huo damage ilikuwa tu kwa blade tip na acoustic liner. Sasa tumeona kwamba C-1 disk blades zimeharibika beyond maintenance manual limits, jambo ambalo halimatch na hali ya turnover ya awali. Please the next shift wa-verify records na photos against manual limits kabla ya kuendelea na repair, coz kuna discrepancy inabidi ifuatiliwe.
summary: During inspection, C-1 disk blades za MD-80 zilipatikana na damage beyond manual limits, tofauti na hali ndogo iliyoripotiwa during original turnover.

narrative_text: During walkaround on the B737, found a small quarter-sized red mark on the lower left side of the radome; area was cleaned and left side of fuselage, wing leading edge, gear, and flap areas were checked with no further signs of strike. Bird excrement and a small amount of blood at the 5 o'clock position of the #1 engine intake were not caught during that initial pass, which per MM required a separate bird strike inspection. That area was later reviewed and no damage was found, but next shift should confirm both MM references were fully completed and documented before dispatch.
summary: Technician found a possible bird strike mark on the radome and initially missed a related sign at the #1 engine intake requiring a separate MM inspection, which was later checked with no damage found.

entities.text: lower left side of the radome

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa nje wa ndege ya B737, dowa ndogo nyekundu ilionekana upande wa chini wa kushoto wa radome, ikafutwa na sehemu za bawa, gia, na flap zikakaguliwa bila dalili nyingine za mgongano na ndege. Wakati huo huo, kinyesi cha ndege pamoja na damu kidogo katika eneo la intake ya injini namba moja havikutambuliwa mara ya kwanza, jambo lililohitaji ukaguzi maalum wa mgongano na ndege kulingana na maelekezo ya matengenezo. Baadaye eneo hilo lilikaguliwa upya na hakuna uharibifu ulioonekana, lakini zamu inayofuata ihakikishe hatua zote za ukaguzi zimekamilika na kuandikwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka.
summary: Fundi aligundua dalili ya mgongano wa ndege kwenye radome na awali hakutambua alama nyingine karibu na intake ya injini iliyohitaji ukaguzi wa ziada, ambao baadaye ulifanywa bila kupata uharibifu.

narrative_text: Wakati wa walkaround kwenye B737, nilikuta dowa ndogo red spot upande wa chini left ya radome, nikaisafisha kisha nikacheck leading edge, gear, na flap area, hakuna dalili zingine za bird strike. Lakini niliskip kuona bird excrement na damu kidogo kwa 5 o'clock position ya #1 engine intake, ambayo kwa mujibu wa MM inahitaji separate bird strike inspection. Baadaye area hiyo ilicheckiwa tena na hakuna damage iliyopatikana, lakini next shift wahakikishe both MM references zimefuatwa na kuandikwa properly kabla ya dispatch.
summary: Fundi aliona possible bird strike mark kwenye radome na aliskip alama nyingine karibu na #1 engine intake iliyohitaji inspection ya ziada, ambayo baadaye ilicheckiwa bila damage.

narrative_text: Aircraft remains out of service for the fumes-odor decontamination job; multiple job card duplicates were circulating unstamped, causing confusion between shifts on what had actually been completed. After an initial Phase 1 decontam was signed off, engine runs revealed fumes were still present, so we restarted and completed a full Phase 2 decontamination, stamping each step as done. Please verify only the correct, final work cards were turned in this morning, as some duplicate/incomplete cards were mistakenly left in the office and may need to be pulled and discarded.
summary: Aircraft remained out of service after a Phase 2 fume decontamination was completed following card-duplication and turnover confusion, and the correct paperwork needs verification.

narrative_text: Ndege bado iko nje ya huduma kwa ajili ya kazi ya kuondoa harufu ya moshi ndani ya ndege; kulikuwa na nakala nyingi za jobcard bila muhuri, jambo lililosababisha mkanganyiko kati ya zamu kuhusu kazi iliyokwisha kufanyika. Baada ya Phase 1 ya usafishaji kukamilika na kusainiwa, tulipofanya majaribio ya injini tuligundua harufu bado ipo, hivyo tulianza upya na kukamilisha Phase 2 kikamilifu, tukipiga muhuri kila hatua ilipokamilika. Tafadhali hakikisheni jobcards sahihi tu ndizo zilizokabidhiwa asubuhi hii, kwa sababu baadhi ya nakala za ziada zisizo kamili ziliachwa ofisini kimakosa na huenda zikahitaji kuondolewa.
summary: Ndege ilibaki nje ya huduma baada ya usafishaji wa Phase 2 wa harufu ya moshi kukamilika kufuatia mkanganyiko wa nakala za jobcard, na hati sahihi zinahitaji kuthibitishwa.

entities.text: kazi ya kuondoa harufu ya moshi

narrative_text: Ile aircraft bado iko out of service kwa ile SOF (smell of fumes) decontam job; kulikuwa na duplicate jobcards nyingi zikizunguka bila kustampiwa, so kuli-cause confusion kati ya shifts kuhusu nini kimeshamalizika. Tulisign off Phase 1 decontam mapema, lakini tulipofanya engine runs tukanuka fumes bado, so tulianza upya tukafanya full Phase 2 mpaka tukakamilisha, kila step ikistampiwa as we went. Tafadhali verify ni zile correct final work cards ndizo zilizo-turn in asubuhi hii, coz kuna zile duplicate/incomplete cards ziliachwa ofisini by mistake na labda zinahitaji ku-discard.
summary: Aircraft ilibaki out of service after Phase 2 fume decontam ilikamilika following jobcard confusion, na paperwork sahihi inahitaji kucheckwa.

narrative_text: Responded to a gate call on the MAX 8 for a #2 thrust reverser fault on the MFD; two junior technicians with limited 737 experience handled it and were directed by the lead mechanic to defer the item rather than troubleshoot via BITE test. Inboard TR lock and safety wire were installed on #2 engine to restrict forward movement, and maintenance control was consulted by phone to confirm the deferral procedure before downgrading the aircraft to CAT 1. Note the crew faced pressure from gate agents and cabin crew to expedite; recommend follow-up review of deferral paperwork and additional MFD/thrust reverser training for junior staff.
summary: A #2 thrust reverser fault on a MAX 8 was deferred by inexperienced technicians under time pressure, requiring MC verification and CAT 1 downgrade.

narrative_text: Tulipokea wito wa kwenda geti kwa ndege ya MAX 8 kutokana na hitilafu ya thrust reverser namba 2 iliyoonekana kwenye MFD; mafundi wawili wapya wenye uzoefu mdogo wa 737 walishughulikia tatizo hilo na kuelekezwa na fundi mkuu kuahirisha ukarabati badala ya kufanya majaribio ya BITE. Walifunga inboard TR lock na waya wa usalama kwenye injini namba 2 ili kuzuia msogeo wa mbele, kisha wakawasiliana na maintenance control kwa simu kuthibitisha taratibu kabla ya kushusha hadhi ya ndege hadi CAT 1. Kulikuwa na msukumo wa haraka kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa geti na wahudumu wa ndani; inashauriwa kufanyike ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka za uahirishaji pamoja na mafunzo zaidi kwa mafundi kuhusu MFD na thrust reverser.
summary: Hitilafu ya thrust reverser namba 2 kwenye ndege ya MAX 8 iliahirishwa na mafundi wasio na uzoefu wa kutosha chini ya msukumo wa muda, jambo lililohitaji uthibitisho wa maintenance control na kushushwa hadhi hadi CAT 1.

narrative_text: Tulipata gate call kwa hii MAX 8 kwa sababu ya #2 thrust reverser fault iliyoonekana kwa MFD; two probationary mechanics wenye 737 experience ndogo ndio waliattend, wakielekezwa na lead mechanic kuipeleka #2 TR kwa deferral badala ya kufanya BITE test kwanza. Tuliweka inboard TR lock na safety wire kwa engine namba 2 ku-restrict forward movement, kisha tukapiga simu kwa maintenance control ku-confirm procedures kabla ya ku-downgrade aircraft hadi CAT 1. Kulikuwa na pressure kutoka kwa gate agents na flight attendant wakiuliza itachukua muda gani; tunahitaji ku-follow up na paperwork ya deferral pamoja na additional training kwa junior mechanics kuhusu MFD na thrust reverser.
summary: #2 thrust reverser fault kwa MAX 8 ili-deferred na mechanics wasio na experience ya kutosha chini ya time pressure, na ikahitaji maintenance control verification pamoja na CAT 1 downgrade.

narrative_text: During the wheelchair stowage change order on the B737-300, the FDR was removed briefly to allow adjustment of the upper attach rod, then re-seated in the rack but not secured. Shift ended before the R&R was documented, and the handover to the next crew did not flag that the FDR was still unsecured. Incoming technicians must inspect the FDR rack immediately and confirm it is properly secured and logged before further dispatch.
summary: An FDR was reinstalled but left unsecured during a stowage unit change and not documented at shift turnover, requiring immediate inspection and paperwork correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti cha magurudumu kwenye ndege ya B737-300, FDR iliondolewa kwa muda ili kuruhusu urekebishaji wa fimbo ya juu ya kushikilia, kisha ikarudishwa mahali pake lakini haikufungwa vizuri. Zamu ilikwisha kabla ya kazi hiyo kuandikwa kwenye rekodi, na wakati wa mkabidhiano hakuna aliyetaja kuwa FDR bado haijafungwa kikamilifu. Fundi wa zamu inayofuata anapaswa kukagua mara moja rafu ya FDR na kuhakikisha imefungwa sawasawa na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: FDR iliwekwa tena bila kufungwa vizuri wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti, na jambo hilo halikuandikwa wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu, hivyo linahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

entities.text: kubadilisha kifaa cha kuhifadhi kiti cha magurudumu
urekebishaji wa fimbo ya juu ya kushikilia

narrative_text: Tulikua tunafanya ile wheelchair stowage change order kwa B737-300, na ile FDR ilibidi tuiremove kidogo ili tuweze kuadjust ile upper attach rod. Baada ya kumaliza, FDR iliwekwa tena kwenye rack lakini haiku-secure vizuri, halafu shift ikaisha kabla mtu kuandika ile R&R kwenye logbook. Turnover haikutajwa kabisa kuhusu hiyo FDR, so fundi wa next shift lazima acheki rack hiyo mapema na ahakikishe imefungwa properly na ime-documented before dispatch.
summary: FDR iliwekwa tena bila kusecure wakati wa stowage change job na haikuandikwa kwenye handover, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka na documentation kabla ya flight ijayo.

narrative_text: Aircraft X was in overnight for A-Check items including a tow collar replacement and dual engine leak checks; I assumed the tow collar job was closed out since I saw techs working on it that morning, but the paperwork turnover was unclear. Under pressure to release the aircraft on schedule, I signed the Airworthiness Release after checking the Company Form and AML, but a Non-Routine Work Card was missed in the handover. The aircraft completed 6 legs before an air return occurred. Follow-up needed: tighten shift turnover communication and slow down paperwork verification during A-Check sign-offs.
summary: A rushed, unclear shift handover on an A-Check led to a missed non-routine work card and an Airworthiness Release sign-off error, resulting in an air return after six legs.

narrative_text: Ndege X ilikuwa imeshikiliwa usiku kwa ukaguzi wa A-Check, ikiwemo kubadilisha tow collar na kufanya leak checks za engine mbili; nilidhani kazi ya tow collar ilikuwa imekamilika kwani niliwaona mafundi wa zamu ya usiku wakiifanyia kazi asubuhi. Kutokana na shinikizo la wakati kuirudisha ndege ratiba, nilisaini Airworthiness Release baada ya kuangalia Company Form na AML, lakini kadi moja ya Non-Routine Work ilikosekana wakati wa kukabidhi kazi. Ndege ilifanya safari sita kabla ya kurudi ghafla angani kwa tatizo. Inahitajika kuboresha mawasiliano ya zamu na kutochelewa wakati wa kuthibitisha nyaraka za A-Check.
summary: Mawasiliano hafifu ya kukabidhi kazi kati ya zamu wakati wa A-Check yalisababisha kukosekana kwa kadi ya Non-Routine Work na hitilafu katika kusaini Airworthiness Release, hivyo kupelekea ndege kurudi baada ya safari sita.

narrative_text: Aircraft X ilikuwa overnight kwa A-Check, tulikuwa na tow collar replacement na leak checks za engines mbili; nikiona technicians wa night shift wanafanyia kazi tow collar asubuhi, nikadhani job ilikuwa complete lakini turnover haikuwa clear. Kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuirudisha aircraft on schedule, nilisign Airworthiness Release baada ya kucheck Company Form na AML, lakini kuna Non-Routine Work Card ilikosekana kwenye handover. Ndege ikafanya six legs kabla air return ikitokea. Tunahitaji kuboresha communication wakati wa shift turnover na kuslow down kwenye paperwork verification ya A-Check sign-off.
summary: Turnover isiyo clear na time pressure wakati wa A-Check ziliweza kufanya Non-Routine Work Card ikosekane, na hii ikapelekea air return baada ya six legs.

narrative_text: Overtime crew completed the stringer doubler/filler fabrication per SRM procedures on the B777-200; no elongated holes were observed on the stringer during fit-up. Fasteners were installed in the tight-access areas and the splice repair was closed out. Both the technician and inspection reviewed the repair and found no discrepancies, and Quality Control signed off the buyback; next shift should re-verify hole condition documentation before final closure.
summary: Overtime crew finished a stringer doubler/filler repair on a B777-200 with no defects noted, and it was signed off by inspection and QC, but documentation should be double-checked.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa muda wa ziada walimaliza kutengeneza doubler na filler kwenye stringer ya ndege ya B777-200 kwa kufuata taratibu za SRM, na hawakuona matundu yaliyoharibika kwenye stringer. Fasteners ziliwekwa katika sehemu ngumu kufikia, na ukarabati wa splice ulikamilika bila tatizo lolote kuonekana. Ukaguzi na fundi wote walithibitisha kuwa hakuna dosari, kisha Idara ya Ubora ilitia sahihi kuidhinisha kazi; zamu ijayo iangalie tena hati za ukaguzi wa matundu kabla ya kufunga kazi rasmi.
summary: Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku walimaliza ukarabati wa stringer kwenye ndege ya B777-200 bila dosari kuonekana, na kazi ilithibitishwa na ukaguzi pamoja na Idara ya Ubora, ingawa hati zinahitaji kuangaliwa tena.

narrative_text: Team ya overtime ilimaliza ku-fabricate doubler na filler kwa stringer ya B777-200 kufuata SRM procedures, hakuna elongated holes zilizoonekana kwenye stringer wakati wa fit-up. Fasteners ziliwekwa kwa zile tight-access areas na splice repair ikakamilika fine. Inspection na fundi wote walicheck repair na hawakupata discrepancy yoyote, then QC ika-sign off buyback; zamu inayofuata i-verify tena documentation ya hole condition kabla ya final closure.
summary: Overtime crew wamemaliza stringer doubler/filler repair kwenye B777-200 bila discrepancy, ime-sign off na inspection pamoja na QC, lakini documentation inahitaji kuangaliwa tena.

narrative_text: While servicing the L and R main landing gear on the B737-800 per the job instruction card, the aircraft was moved on management's request before shift change, and tooling/equipment was cleared and returned to complete the handover on time. After turnover, I noticed the strut extension looked off and found I had measured the X dimension from the wrong reference point, leaving it about 1/2 inch too high. I informed the oncoming lead mechanic of the error; he is arranging for a mechanic to recheck the strut extension and pressure. Follow-up needed: verify nose gear servicing still pending and confirm strut recheck is completed before next flight.
summary: A servicing error on the B737-800 main landing gear strut extension was found after shift turnover and flagged to the oncoming lead mechanic for recheck.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikihudumia main landing gear ya kushoto na kulia kwenye ndege ya B737-800 kulingana na job card, lakini menejimenti waliagiza ndege ihamishwe kabla ya mabadiliko ya shift, hivyo nikakamilisha kazi na kurudisha vifaa store. Baada ya kukabidhi kazi kwa shift inayokuja, niligundua strut extension haikuonekana sawa, na nikagundua nilipima X dimension kutoka sehemu isiyo sahihi, hivyo urefu ulikuwa juu kwa inchi nusu. Nilimjulisha lead mechanic wa shift inayokuja kuhusu tatizo hilo, na ameahidi mechanic mwingine atarudi kukagua strut extension na pressure. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kabla ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Kosa la kupima strut extension kwenye main landing gear ya B737-800 lilibainika baada ya kukabidhi kazi, na lead mechanic ameagizwa kufuatilia.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikiservice main landing gear, left na right, kwa hii B737-800 kufuata job instruction card, lakini management walitaka aircraft imoved before shift change so nikafinish servicing haraka na kurudisha equipment kwa tool room. Baada ya kufanya turnover, nikakuwa nikicheck area for cleanliness ndio nikanotice strut extension inaonekana off. Nikacheck job card nikagundua nilimeasure X dimension kutoka wrong point, so strut extension ilikuwa high by half inch. Nikamwinform oncoming lead mechanic, akaniambia atasend mechanic arecheck strut extension na pressure kabla flight ya next.
summary: Kuna error ya measurement kwenye strut extension ya main landing gear, B737-800, iligundulika after turnover na lead mechanic ameagiza recheck.

narrative_text: Heads up for next shift: took over a work package on the B737-200 tail section that previous shift had signed off as work and inspection complete, but the rudder PCU installation, ops check, and final ops check blocks were still blank. The vertical stabilizer access panels had already been closed up with no inspection actually done on that installation. I flagged it to the supervisor before closing the card, and the panel had to be reopened for the install to be properly inspected and signed. This is the second time in about a month this same job card gap has come up (previous case reported to the office) - the cards need revision so incoming shift please verify sign-offs against actual access status, not just the paperwork.
summary: Incoming shift found rudder PCU installation and inspection sign-offs missing despite access panels being closed, requiring reopening and proper inspection before release.

narrative_text: Taarifa kwa shift inayoingia: nilipokea kazi ya mkia wa ndege B737-200 ambayo shift iliyopita ilikuwa imeandikwa kazi na ukaguzi vimekamilika, lakini sehemu ya usimikaji wa rudder PCU, ukaguzi wa uendeshaji, na ukaguzi wa mwisho wa uendeshaji hazikuwa zimesainiwa. Vifuniko vya ufikiaji wa mkia (vertical stabilizer) vilikuwa vimefungwa tayari bila ukaguzi wowote kufanyika kwenye usimikaji huo. Nilimjulisha msimamizi kabla ya kuendelea, na vifuniko vilifunguliwa upya ili ukaguzi sahihi ufanyike na kusainiwa. Hii ni mara ya pili katika muda wa mwezi mmoja tatizo hili la kadi za kazi linajitokeza, hivyo shift inayofuata iangalie kwa makini saini zote kabla ya kufunga vifuniko.
summary: Shift inayoingia ilikuta usimikaji wa rudder PCU haujakaguliwa wala kusainiwa licha ya vifuniko vya ufikiaji kufungwa, hivyo ilibidi vifunguliwe tena kwa ukaguzi sahihi.

narrative_text: Update kwa next shift: nilipokea work package ya tail section ya B737-200 ambayo previous shift walikuwa wamesign off kama work and inspection complete, lakini yale blocks za rudder PCU installation, ops check, na final ops check hazikuwa zime-signed. Access panels za vertical stabilizer zilikuwa zimefungwa already bila inspection yoyote kufanyika kwenye installation ile. Nilimwambia supervisor before kuendelea, panel ikafunguliwa tena ili inspection ifanyike properly na kusainiwa. Hii ni mara ya pili in about a month hii issue ya job cards inarudia, so next shift please tuangalie sign-offs vizuri kabla ya kuclose panels.
summary: Next shift walikuta rudder PCU installation haijakaguliwa wala kusainiwa despite panels kufungwa, hivyo ilibidi zifunguliwe tena kwa proper inspection.

narrative_text: MD-88 duct burnout job card (MM 21-20-02-2) was not fully closed out during the previous shift's turnover due to weather and multiple crew changes; no verbal handover was given at the aircraft. During close-up, line 44 (remove caps from L/R augmentation valve T-fittings) was skipped, mistakenly believed already done. Aircraft was released to service, later diverted with a cabin odor/mechanical issue and evacuated on the runway. Next shift must verify all remaining caps/plugs removed and confirm full job card sign-off before further dispatch.
summary: Incomplete verbal turnover and a skipped close-up step on an MD-88 auto temperature system job card led to plugs being left in the augmentation valve fittings, causing an in-flight odor event and emergency evacuation.

narrative_text: Kazi ya duct burnout kwenye MD-88 (job card 21-20-02-2) haikukamilika vizuri wakati wa zamu iliyopita kwa sababu ya hali mbaya ya hewa na mabadiliko ya mafundi kadhaa; hakuna taarifa ya mdomo iliyotolewa kwenye ndege. Wakati wa close-up, line 44 ya kutoa vifuniko kwenye augmentation valve T-fittings za kushoto na kulia ilisahaulika kwa kudhani tayari imeshafanyika. Ndege ilirudishwa kazini na baadaye ikalazimika kutua dharura kutokana na harufu ya ajabu kwenye kabin, na wasafiri wakaondolewa kwa dharura kwenye njia ya kurukia. Zamu inayokuja lazima ihakikishe vifuniko vyote vimetolewa na job card imesainiwa kikamilifu kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Kukosekana kwa taarifa kamili ya makabidhiano na kusahaulika kwa hatua moja katika ukaguzi wa mfumo wa joto wa MD-88 kulisababisha vifuniko kubaki kwenye valve, na hatimaye tukio la harufu angani na uokoaji wa dharura.

entities.text: augmentation valve T-fittings za kushoto na kulia

narrative_text: Ile duct burnout job card ya MD-88 (MM 21-20-02-2) haikufinishiwa properly wakati wa previous shift kwa sababu ya weather mbaya na mafundi wengi walibadilishana bila kuachiana verbal turnover kwenye aircraft. Wakati wa close-up, fundi aliskip line 44 ya kutoa caps kwenye L na R augmentation valve T-fittings, akidhani step hiyo ilikuwa already done. Aircraft ilirudishwa service na baadaye ikadivert kwa emergency landing na evacuation kwa sababu ya odor kwenye cabin. Next shift wahakikishe caps zote zimetolewa na job card imesainiwa fully kabla ya dispatch yoyote nyingine.
summary: Kukosa verbal handover na kuskip step moja kwenye MD-88 auto temp system job card kulileta plugs kubaki kwenye augmentation valve, hivyo kusababisha odor event angani na emergency evacuation.

entities.text: L na R augmentation valve T-fittings

narrative_text: Handover: Rudder balancing job on the Gulfstream I in the other hangar was completed last night by the mechanic and a senior tech using an incomplete set of maintenance manual pages (Ref G-100, 51-60-00) — wording in the procedure was confusing though the figures/setup seemed to match. Paperwork was signed off before shift end without a thorough review; on closer read next day the procedure language remains ambiguous and was not followed to the letter. No immediate safety concern identified, but please flag to QA/Inspection for clarification of the balancing procedure and manual references before this is closed out.
summary: A rudder balancing task was signed off despite ambiguous manual references, and needs QA review to clarify the procedure.

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadilishano: Kazi ya kusawazisha rudder ya ndege ya Gulfstream I katika hangar nyingine ilikamilishwa jana usiku na fundi pamoja na fundi mwandamizi, wakitumia kurasa chache tu za kitabu cha matengenezo (Rejea G-100, 51-60-00) — maandishi ya utaratibu huo yalikuwa na utata ijapokuwa vipimo na mpangilio vilionekana sahihi. Karatasi za kazi zilisainiwa kabla ya mabadiliko ya shifti bila ukaguzi wa kina; baada ya kusoma tena kesho yake kwa umakini, utaratibu bado unaonekana kutokuwa wazi na haukufuatwa kikamilifu. Kwa sasa hakuna hatari ya haraka, lakini tafadhali suala hili lipelekwe kwa idara ya ukaguzi wa ubora (QA) ili kufafanua utaratibu wa kusawazisha na marejeo ya kitabu cha matengenezo kabla kazi kufungwa rasmi.
summary: Kazi ya kusawazisha rudder ilisainiwa licha ya utata katika marejeo ya kitabu cha matengenezo, na inahitaji ufafanuzi kutoka idara ya ubora.

narrative_text: Handover: Ile rudder balancing job ya Gulfstream I kwa hangar ingine ilikamilika jana usiku na mechanic pamoja na senior tech, lakini walikuwa na maintenance manual pages chache tu (Ref G-100, 51-60-00) — wording ya procedure ilikuwa confusing lakini figures na setup zilikuwa zinaonekana sahihi. Paperwork ilisainiwa before end ya shift bila review ya kutosha; nikisoma tena keshoye kwa makini nikaona procedure bado ni ambiguous na haikufuatwa to the letter. Hakuna immediate safety concern kwa sasa, lakini please flag hii kwa QA/Inspection ili tuclarify balancing procedure na manual references kabla ya kuclose out job hii.
summary: Rudder balancing job ilisainiwa ingawa manual references zilikuwa ambiguous, hivyo inahitaji QA review kwa clarification.

narrative_text: Dash 8-400 was found with the Weather Radar not installed by the previous station, only the transceiver, which should have been caught during the avionics coupler install. We were waiting on parts and cannibalized items that arrived just 15 minutes before departure, so the swing-shift Mechanic ran out of time and Maintenance Control swapped this aircraft with the RON aircraft already finishing its Line Check. The TMU and avionics coupler were installed, but after power-up the FMS 'Configuration Module Fail' message returned, so the Weather Radar test was not completed. Next shift needs to follow up on the coupler fault before attempting the Weather Radar check again.
summary: Weather Radar install/FMS coupler fault carried over from previous station, requires further troubleshooting on next shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Dash 8-400 ilikutwa bila Weather Radar kuwekwa na kituo kilichotangulia, transceiver pekee ndiyo iliwekwa, jambo ambalo lingegundulika wakati wa ufungaji wa avionics coupler. Tulisubiri vipuri, ikiwemo vilivyotolewa kwa ndege nyingine, ambavyo viliwasili dakika kumi na tano tu kabla ya ndege kuondoka, hivyo Fundi wa zamu ya jioni hakuwa na muda wa kutosha na Maintenance Control waliamua kubadilisha ndege hii na ile iliyokuwa RON ikimalizia Line Check. TMU na avionics coupler viliwekwa, lakini baada ya kuwasha mfumo, ujumbe wa 'Configuration Module Fail' wa FMS ulirudi tena, hivyo kipimo cha Weather Radar hakikufanyika. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe tatizo la coupler limetatuliwa kabla ya kujaribu tena Weather Radar.
summary: Tatizo la usakinishaji wa Weather Radar na hitilafu ya FMS coupler limebaki kwa zamu inayofuata kufuatilia.

entities.text: dakika kumi na tano kabla ya kuondoka

narrative_text: Kwa hii Dash 8-400, previous station hawakuweka Weather Radar, waliweka transceiver tu, na tungeigundua wakati wa install ya avionics coupler. Tulikuwa tunasubiri parts pamoja na zile cannibalized ambazo zilifika dakika 15 tu kabla ya departure, so yule swing-shift Mechanic akaishiwa na time na Maintenance Control wakaamua ku-swap na yule RON aircraft ambayo ilikuwa inamaliza Line Check. Coupler na TMU ziliwekwa sawa, lakini baada ya power-up, FMS ikirudisha 'Configuration Module Fail' tena, so hatukuweza ku-test Weather Radar. Next shift wafuatilie hiyo coupler fault kabla ya kujaribu Weather Radar tena.
summary: Weather Radar install na FMS coupler fault bado zina issue, next shift wa-follow up kabla ya test tena.

narrative_text: On B777-200, forward cargo pit ceiling wiring repair was completed at end of an extended shift with no turnover received from the previous crew. Two damaged wires were spliced per General Manual 2-0-15, and the two damaged C2 hydraulic pump cables were spliced with AMP copalum splices per SWPM 20-30-13 and signed off; a third small wire near the C2 cables with slight insulation discoloration was Teflon-taped but its write-up was inadvertently not documented. Aircraft was unpowered throughout so the hydraulic pump could not be functionally checked; incoming crew must verify close-up/securing of the area, confirm the untagged third wire write-up, and perform hydraulic pump operational check once powered.
summary: Incomplete documentation and unverified hydraulic pump function following overnight wiring repair on B777-200 forward cargo pit, requiring follow-up by next crew.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B777-200, ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye dari ya sehemu ya mizigo mbele ulifanywa mwishoni mwa zamu ndefu, bila taarifa yoyote kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa awali. Nyaya mbili zilizoharibika zilikarabatiwa kulingana na General Manual 2-0-15, na nyaya mbili za pampu ya hydraulic C2 zilikarabatiwa kwa splice za AMP copalum kulingana na SWPM 20-30-13 na kusainiwa, lakini waya wa tatu wenye alama ndogo ya kuharibika haukuandikwa kwenye ripoti kwa bahati mbaya. Ndege haikuwa na umeme wakati wote hivyo pampu ya hydraulic haikuweza kujaribiwa; zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha kufungwa kwa eneo hilo, kuandika taarifa ya waya wa tatu, na kufanya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic mara umeme utakaporudishwa.
summary: Ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye B777-200 uliachwa bila taarifa kamili na bila kuthibitishwa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic, hivyo zamu inayofuata inahitaji kufuatilia.

entities.text: nyaya kwenye dari ya sehemu ya mizigo mbele
nyaya za pampu ya hydraulic C2

ukaguzi wa utendaji wa pampu ya hydraulic

narrative_text: Kwa B777-200, tulikarabati wiring kwenye forward cargo pit ceiling mwishoni mwa shift ndefu bila turnover kutoka crew ya awali. Zile wires mbili zilikuwa spliced per General Manual 2-0-15, na zile C2 hydraulic pump cables mbili zilifanyiwa AMP copalum splices per SWPM 20-30-13 kisha ku-sign off, lakini ile third wire ndogo iliyokuwa na discoloration kidogo ilifunikwa na Teflon tape na sikuandika write-up yake kwa mistake. Aircraft haikuwa na power wakati wote so hatukuweza ku-check hydraulic pump operation; next crew wahakikishe close-up ya area, wajaze write-up ya ile third wire, na wafanye operational check ya hydraulic pump aircraft ikipata power.
summary: Baada ya wiring repair kwenye B777-200, kuna write-up ilikosekana na hydraulic pump haijachekiwa, so next crew wanahitaji ku-follow up.

narrative_text: Overnight shift completed installation of the No. 1 engine top mount on the Q400, following AMM tasks with guidance from the outgoing mechanic since I had not performed this task before; alignment was difficult but mount was torqued and cotter-pinned, and QC inspector signed it off as good. We then moved on to the spoiler tensioning task pending the 24-hr soak time. Next shift should be aware that another technician and QC later flagged a possible improper installation of the L-hand top engine mount; it was re-inspected and found acceptable, but please verify engine #1 mount integrity again before further work.
summary: Engine #1 top mount was installed and signed off as good, but a later concern about the L-hand mount was raised and re-cleared, so the mount should be re-checked by the next shift.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku ilikamilisha ufungaji wa mount ya juu ya injini namba moja ya ndege ya Q400, tukifuata maelekezo ya AMM baada ya fundi wa zamu iliyopita kunielekeza kwa kuwa sikuwahi kufanya kazi hiyo hapo awali; kulikuwa na changamoto ya ulinganifu lakini mount ilikaziwa na kuwekwa cotter pin, na mkaguzi wa ubora akaithibitisha kuwa nzuri. Baadaye tulihamia kazi ya spoiler tensioning huku tukisubiri muda wa saa 24 wa soaking. Zamu ijayo inapaswa kufahamu kuwa fundi mwingine pamoja na mkaguzi wa ubora baadaye waligundua dalili za ufungaji usiofaa wa mount ya juu upande wa kushoto wa injini; ilikaguliwa tena na kuonekana sawa, lakini ni vyema kuthibitisha tena hali ya mount hiyo kabla ya kazi zaidi.
summary: Mount ya juu ya injini namba moja ilifungwa na kuthibitishwa kuwa nzuri, lakini baadaye kulitokea wasiwasi kuhusu mount ya upande wa kushoto ambayo ilikaguliwa tena, hivyo inahitaji uhakiki zaidi na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: mount ya juu ya injini namba moja
mount ya juu upande wa kushoto wa injini

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku tulifanya installation ya top engine mount ya engine number one kwa Q400, tukifollow AMM tasks after previous shift mech ali-brief me kwa sababu sijawahi fanya hii kazi before. Kulikuwa na hard time kidogo na alignment lakini tuli-torque na cotter-pin as per AMM, na QC inspector ame-sign off kama nzuri. Baada ya hapo tuli-proceed na spoiler tensioning task huku tukisubiri ile 24-hr soak time. Next shift mjue kwamba baadaye technician na QC wengine walinotice possible improper installation ya L-hand top engine mount; iliverify tena ikaonekana OK, lakini ni vizuri mki-re-check engine #1 mounts kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Top engine mount ya engine #1 iliinstall na kusign off as good, lakini kuna concern iliyoibuka baadaye kuhusu L-hand mount ambayo ime-re-inspect, hivyo next shift wanapaswa kuverify tena.

entities.text: top engine mount ya engine number one

narrative_text: Completed the double nosewheel assembly change on the MD-88 near shift change, but tire pressure check was skipped due to time pressure and phone interruptions during the task. Flight departed and the next maintenance station found both tires flat, causing a delay. Incoming shift please ensure tire pressure verification is added as a mandatory step on the logbook sign-off before returning tools to storage.
summary: Nosewheel change on MD-88 was completed without a tire pressure check due to time pressure at shift change, resulting in flat tires and a delay at the next station.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha matairi mawili ya gurudumu la pua ya ndege ya MD-88 iliisha karibu na wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, lakini ukaguzi wa shinikizo la hewa la matairi haukufanyika kwa sababu ya haraka na simu zilizokuwa zikiingia wakati wa kazi. Ndege iliruka na station iliyofuata ikagundua matairi yote mawili ni tambara, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji wa safari. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuhakikisha ukaguzi wa shinikizo la matairi unafanywa na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla vifaa havijarudishwa stoo.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa matairi ya gurudumu la pua ya MD-88 haukuwa na ukaguzi wa shinikizo la hewa kwa sababu ya haraka wakati wa zamu, na hivyo kusababisha matairi tambara na ucheleweshaji wa safari station iliyofuata.

narrative_text: Tulimaliza ile nosewheel assembly change ya MD-88 karibu na shift change, lakini tire pressure check ikaskip kwa sababu ya time pressure na hizo phone calls zilikuwa zikiingia wakati wa kazi. Aircraft ikafly na next maintenance station wakakuta matairi yote mawili ni flat, ikasababisha delay ya flight. Shift inayofuata please hakikisheni tire pressure verification inakuwa mandatory step kwenye logbook sign-off kabla ya kurudisha equipment storage.
summary: Tire pressure check ilimissed baada ya nosewheel change kwenye MD-88 kwa sababu ya time pressure wakati wa shift change, na hiyo ikasababisha flat tires na delay next station.

narrative_text: CRJ700 came to us from day shift with a flap fail caution, traced to the right torque tube disconnected from the PDU. Night shift completed the right BPSU installation, manually retracted the flaps to correct the misalignment, then mechanically and electrically rigged the flap system and reconnected the torque tube per AMM, all confirmed by the RII inspector via tug test and measurement per the work order. Panels were closed after FOD check and the flap/slat operational check was run 7+ consecutive cycles with no faults recurring; next shift to monitor for any repeat caution message on the following flights.
summary: Right torque tube disconnection causing flap fail caution on a CRJ700 was rectified and rigged per AMM, with repeated operational checks clean, pending continued monitoring by next shift.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilikabidhiwa na zamu ya mchana ikiwa na tatizo la flap fail caution, lililotokana na torque tube ya upande wa kulia kutoka kwenye PDU. Zamu ya usiku ilimaliza kufunga BPSU upande wa kulia, ikarudisha flaps kwa mkono ili kusahihisha kutolingana, kisha ikafanya urekebishaji wa kimekaniki na kielektroniki wa mfumo wa flap na kuunganisha tena torque tube kulingana na AMM, kazi ikathibitishwa na afisa wa RII kupitia tug test na vipimo kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye work order. Paneli zilifungwa baada ya ukaguzi wa FOD na operational check ya flap/slat ikafanywa zaidi ya mara saba mfululizo bila hitilafu yoyote; zamu inayofuata ifuatilie kuhakikisha tatizo halijirudii kwenye safari zijazo.
summary: Tatizo la torque tube kujitenga na PDU lililosababisha flap fail caution kwenye CRJ700 lilirekebishwa na kupimwa kulingana na AMM, ukaguzi ukafanikiwa, lakini ufuatiliaji zaidi unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tuli-receive CRJ700 kutoka day shift ikiwa na flap fail caution, ikaturn out ni right torque tube imedisconnect kutoka kwa PDU. Sisi night shift tuli-finish installation ya right BPSU, tuka-manually retract flaps kufix misalignment, halafu tuka-rig flap system mechanically and electrically na tuka-reconnect torque tube per AMM, na RII akaconfirm installation kupitia tug test na measurements kama zilivyo kwa work order. Baada ya panels kufungwa tuka-do FOD check, tuka-run flap/slat operational check for 7+ cycles consecutively bila fault yoyote; next shift wafuatilie kuona kama caution message itarudi kwenye flights zijazo.
summary: Right torque tube ilikuwa imedisconnect kutoka PDU ikisababisha flap fail caution kwa CRJ700, iliconfirm-iwa fixed per AMM after operational checks zote zikapass, but follow-up bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: During troubleshooting of the Backup Generator Blocked message on the assigned aircraft, we opened the thrust reverser and top pylon panel and found a broken wire requiring a harness change; cannon plugs were reconnected and panels closed out under time pressure before end of shift. Two circuit breakers left pulled by another technician to lock the thrust reverser panel were not tagged with the non-routine paperwork, and the colleague who pulled them had already left for a second shift. Incoming shift must verify both circuit breakers are reset and confirm the non-routine card is properly closed before releasing the aircraft to service.
summary: Thrust reverser harness repair was completed but two untagged pulled circuit breakers were missed during shift handover, requiring verification before aircraft release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta chanzo cha tatizo la ujumbe wa Backup Generator Blocked kwenye ndege iliyopangiwa, tulifungua thrust reverser na paneli ya juu ya pylon na kugundua waya uliokatika uliohitaji kubadilishwa harness; cannon plugs zilirudishwa na paneli kufungwa tukiwa na shinikizo la muda kabla ya zamu kuisha. Circuit breakers mbili zilizotolewa na fundi mwenzangu kufunga paneli ya thrust reverser hazikuwa na lebo ya non-routine, na yule aliyezitoa alikuwa tayari ameondoka kwenda zamu nyingine. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha circuit breakers zote mbili zimerudishwa na fomu ya non-routine imefungwa vizuri kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwa huduma.
summary: Ukarabati wa harness ya thrust reverser ulikamilika lakini circuit breakers mbili zilizotolewa bila lebo zilisahaulika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, hivyo zinahitaji uthibitisho kabla ndege haijarudishwa kazini.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-troubleshoot Backup Generator Blocked message kwa aircraft, tukafungua thrust reverser na top pylon panel, tukapata broken wire ambayo ilihitaji harness change; tuka-reconnect cannon plugs na kuclose panels tukiwa na time pressure kabla ya shift kuisha. Kuna circuit breakers mbili zilizoachwa pulled na fundi mwenzangu kulock ile thrust reverser panel, lakini hazikuwa na non-routine tag, na yeye alikuwa ameshaenda second shift terminal. Incoming crew wahakikishe zile CBs zimerudishwa na non-routine card imeclosed vizuri kabla ya kurelease aircraft to service.
summary: Harness change ya thrust reverser ilikamilika lakini kuna circuit breakers mbili zilizoachwa pulled bila tag wakati wa handover, so inabidi zithibitishwe kabla aircraft haijarudi service.

narrative_text: On the B737-300, the autopilot stabilizer trim motor was replaced during a downline call, but the technician is unsure whether the rear mount bolt was fully torqued. Maintenance control was notified before shift turnover, but it appears the message did not carry over clearly to the next shift and no logbook writeup was made. Next shift please have line maintenance verify the rear mount bolt on the trim motor is properly tightened before further dispatch.
summary: Rear mount bolt on a B737-300 autopilot trim motor may not have been fully torqued after replacement, and the handover to maintenance control/next shift was incomplete, requiring verification before dispatch.

entities.text: verify the rear mount bolt on the trim motor is properly tightened

narrative_text: Katika ndege ya B737-300, motor ya trim ya autopilot ilibadilishwa wakati wa kazi ya downline, lakini fundi hana uhakika kama bolt ya nyuma ya mount ilikazwa vizuri kabisa. Idara ya udhibiti wa matengenezo ilijulishwa kabla ya zamu kubadilika, lakini inaonekana taarifa hiyo haikufika vizuri kwa zamu iliyofuata na hakuna kiingilio kilichoandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata itafute wafanyakazi wa line maintenance wathibitishe kuwa bolt hiyo ya nyuma imekazwa sawasawa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Bolt ya nyuma ya motor ya trim ya autopilot kwenye B737-300 huenda haikukazwa vizuri, na mawasiliano ya zamu hayakukamilika, hivyo uthibitisho unahitajika kabla ya ndege kutumika tena.

entities.text: wathibitishe kuwa bolt hiyo ya nyuma imekazwa sawasawa

narrative_text: Kwa B737-300, tuli-replace ile autopilot stabilizer trim motor kwa downline call, lakini sina uhakika kama ile rear mount bolt ilikazwa fully. Nili-call maintenance control kabla ya shift turnover kuwaeleza, lakini inaonekana handover haiku-clear vizuri kwa next shift na hakuna logbook entry iliyofanywa. Kwa hivyo next shift wa-confirm na line guys kwamba hiyo bolt ya rear mount imekazwa vizuri kabla aircraft haija-dispatch tena.
summary: Kuna doubt kama rear mount bolt ya trim motor ya B737-300 ilikazwa properly, na handover kati ya shifts haiku-complete, so inahitaji verification before dispatch.

entities.text: wa-confirm na line guys kwamba hiyo bolt ya rear mount imekazwa vizuri

narrative_text: Carryover from previous shift: B767-400ER had a fuel imbalance with fuel config light on, and the L CTR fuel boost pump was removed for replacement. The replacement pump installed was later found to be the wrong effectivity (unmodified unit), even though the previous shift ordered it using the manufacturer's part number off the removed unit. Next shift needs to verify effectivity of the pump currently installed and pull correct part before further dispatch; recommend review of part procurement process with supplier.
summary: Wrong-effectivity fuel boost pump was installed on a B767-400ER during a fuel imbalance carryover repair and needs verification/replacement.

narrative_text: Kutoka zamu iliyopita: ndege ya B767-400ER ilikuwa na tatizo la mafuta kutokusawazika na taa ya config ilikuwa inawaka, hivyo pump ya mafuta ya L CTR iliondolewa kwa ajili ya kubadilishwa. Pump iliyowekwa badala yake ilikuja kugundulika kuwa si ya effectivity sahihi kwa ndege hii, ingawa zamu iliyopita walidai walitumia namba ya sehemu kutoka kwa mtengenezaji ya ile pump iliyoondolewa walipofanya order. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha effectivity ya pump iliyopo sasa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, na inashauriwa mchakato wa kuagiza vipuri ufanyiwe ukaguzi wa ndani.
summary: Pump ya mafuta yenye effectivity isiyo sahihi iliwekwa kwenye ndege ya B767-400ER wakati wa kutengeneza tatizo la mafuta kutokusawazika, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho na marekebisho.

entities.text: pump ya mafuta ya L CTR
ukaguzi wa mchakato wa kuagiza vipuri

narrative_text: Carryover kutoka zamu iliyopita: ile B767-400ER ilikuwa na fuel imbalance na config light iliwaka, so tuliondoa L CTR fuel boost pump kwa ajili ya replacement. Ile pump ambayo ni-install ilikuja kugundulika si sahihi effectivity, unmodified unit, ingawa previous shift walisema walitumia manufacturer part number kutoka kwa ile iliyoondolewa wakati wa ku-order. Next shift wanafaa ku-verify effectivity ya pump iliyoko sasa before dispatch, na tunashauri procurement process irudiwe kuangaliwa na supplier.
summary: Wrong effectivity pump iliwekwa kwenye B767-400ER wakati wa kufix fuel imbalance, so inahitajika verification haraka.

narrative_text: On B757, the APU hour meter was replaced last shift, but the placard/MEL was not cleared because the ops check was never done and no INOP sticker was left on the new meter. I signed Block 7 of the ETOPS #1 check assuming the placard had been cleared and recorded the meter reading instead of estimating hours per Block 7B. Next shift, please verify the log for any open APU hour meter placard before signing Block 7, since the work card does not explicitly direct this check. Ops check and paperwork to remove the placard were completed on the return flight, but better turnover reporting is needed going forward.
summary: Miscommunication over an uncleared APU hour meter placard led to an incorrect ETOPS #1 check sign-off, since prior shift left no INOP sticker or turnover note.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B757, APU hour meter ilibadilishwa shift iliyopita, lakini placard/MEL haikuondolewa kwa sababu ops check haikufanywa na hakuna INOP sticker iliyowekwa kwenye meter mpya. Nilisaini Block 7 ya ETOPS #1 check nikidhani placard ilishaondolewa, na nikaandika reading ya meter badala ya kukadiria masaa kama inavyotakiwa. Shift inayofuata, tafadhali angalia logbook kuhusu placard yoyote ya APU hour meter kabla ya kusaini Block 7, kwa kuwa work card haisemi wazi kufanya hivyo. Ops check na makaratasi ya kuondoa placard yalikamilishwa wakati wa safari ya kurudi, lakini kunahitajika taarifa bora za turnover kati ya zamu.
summary: Kutokuwepo kwa mawasiliano sahihi kuhusu placard ya APU hour meter kulisababisha sahihi isiyo sahihi kwenye ETOPS #1 check, kwani zamu iliyotangulia haikuacha alama ya INOP wala taarifa ya turnover.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757, APU hour meter ilibadilishwa last shift, lakini placard/MEL haikuwa cleared kwa sababu ops check haikufanywa na hakuna INOP sticker iliyowekwa kwenye meter mpya. Nikasign Block 7 ya ETOPS #1 check nikifikiria placard ilikuwa imeshakua cleared, so nikarecord reading ya meter tu badala ya ku-estimate hours kama Block 7B inavyotaka. Next shift, please check logbook kama kuna open placard ya APU hour meter kabla ya kusign Block 7, coz work card haiseme wazi ku-review hiyo. Ops check na paperwork ya kuremove placard ziliisha kufanyika on return flight, lakini tunahitaji turnover reporting bora kati ya shifts.
summary: Kulikua na communication breakdown kuhusu APU hour meter placard, ikapelekea sign-off isiyo sahihi kwenye ETOPS #1 check kwa sababu ya poor turnover kutoka previous shift.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, #2 engine fuel shutoff cable R&R is still in progress; new cable was routed from the turnbuckle in the forward cargo bay through the pulley in the air conditioning bay to the #2 engine pylon quadrant. The pulley behind the aft cargo wall was reinstalled but the retaining nut was not confirmed torqued before I was pulled away on a family emergency. Verbal turnover was given to the incoming mechanic but the untorqued pulley/nut detail was not clearly communicated. Next shift must inspect and torque that pulley nut and the cable guard installation before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Incomplete #2 engine fuel shutoff cable installation on B737-500 left a pulley nut unconfirmed for torque due to an interrupted shift handover, requiring follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha cable ya #2 engine fuel shutoff kwenye B737-500 haijakamilika; cable mpya ilipitishwa kutoka turnbuckle iliyoko forward cargo bay hadi pulley ya air conditioning bay mpaka #2 engine pylon quadrant. Pulley iliyoko nyuma ya ukuta wa cargo iliwekwa tena lakini nut yake haikuthibitishwa kama imekazwa vizuri kabla sijaondoka ghafla kutokana na dharura ya kifamilia. Nilimpa taarifa ya mdomo fundi wa zamu inayofuata lakini suala la nut hiyo halikuelezwa vizuri. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kukagua na kukaza nut ya pulley hiyo pamoja na cable guard kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Ukarabati wa cable ya #2 engine fuel shutoff kwenye B737-500 uliachwa nusu njia kwa sababu ya dharura ya kifamilia, na nut ya pulley haikuthibitishwa kukazwa, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

narrative_text: Kwa B737-500, job ya kubadilisha #2 engine fuel shutoff cable haijaishia; cable mpya iliroutewa kutoka turnbuckle ya forward cargo bay through pulley ya air conditioning bay mpaka #2 engine pylon quadrant. Pulley ile ya nyuma ya cargo wall tuliiweka lakini sikuconfirm kama nut imetightened, family emergency ikanibana nikaenda haraka. Nilimwambia mechanic wa next shift kwa mdomo tu, lakini hakupata point ya hiyo nut vizuri. Next shift wanafaa kucheck na kutorque ile pulley nut na pia cable guard kabla ya kurelease ndege.
summary: Job ya #2 engine fuel shutoff cable kwenye B737-500 ilibaki nusu kwa sababu ya family emergency, na pulley nut haijaconfirm kutightened, so next shift wanafaa kucheck.

narrative_text: During the CVR ULB test on the Q400 tail section, the ULB Tester was borrowed from the bench instead of being pulled from its assigned drawer, and after the task it was returned to the wrong drawer since its correct storage location was unclear. The tester has since gone missing from Avionics for about two weeks; Stores was asked but could not confirm if it was pulled for turn-in. Follow-up needed: confirm the correct ULB Tester storage location, verify station tool authorization list, and check Aircraft Y tail section where a ULB Tester was reportedly found, in case it belongs to our inventory.
summary: A ULB Tester used during a Q400 CVR test was misplaced due to unclear storage procedures and remains unaccounted for, requiring follow-up with Stores and verification against another aircraft's tail section.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kipimo cha CVR ULB kwenye mkia wa ndege ya Q400, Kifaa cha kupima ULB (ULB Tester) kilitolewa kwenye meza badala ya kutolewa mahali pake rasmi cha kuhifadhiwa, na baada ya kazi kilirudishwa mahali pasipo sahihi kwa sababu eneo lake halali halikuwa wazi. Kifaa hicho kimekuwa hakipatikani kwa muda wa wiki mbili sasa, na Stores waliulizwa lakini hawakuweza kuthibitisha kama kilitolewa kwa ajili ya kurejeshwa. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuhakikisha mahali sahihi pa kuhifadhi ULB Tester, kuangalia orodha ya vibali vya vifaa vya kituo, na kukagua mkia wa ndege ya Aircraft Y ambako kifaa kimoja cha ULB kiliripotiwa kupatikana, ili kuona kama ni chetu.
summary: Kifaa cha kupima ULB kilichotumika wakati wa kipimo cha CVR kwenye ndege ya Q400 kilipotea kutokana na utaratibu usio wazi wa kuhifadhi vifaa, na kinahitaji ufuatiliaji na Stores pamoja na uangalizi kwenye ndege nyingine.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya CVR ULB test kwenye tail ya Q400, tulitumia ULB Tester ambayo ilikuwa imewekwa kwenye bench, si kwenye drawer yake ya kawaida, halafu baada ya kazi ikarudishwa drawer isiyo sahihi kwa sababu proper location haikuwa clear. Sasa ni kama wiki mbili, tester haipatikani Avionics, na Stores waliulizwa lakini hawajaconfirm kama ilipull for turn-in. Tunahitaji follow-up: confirm correct storage location ya ULB Tester, check station tool authorization list, na uangalie tail ya Aircraft Y ambapo ULB Tester nyingine iliripotiwa kupatikana, maybe ni yetu.
summary: ULB Tester iliyotumika during CVR test kwenye Q400 imepotea kwa sababu ya confusion ya storage location, na inahitaji follow-up na Stores pamoja na kuangalia Aircraft Y.

narrative_text: Took over the down-line fuel tank slat can repair on the B737-300 and found no turnover from the previous crew; paperwork was incomplete and parts were scattered. The tank had already been open over 18 hours with no tank sniffer check done, and in the confusion a confined space entry form was never completed. Repair was finished and Maintenance Control approved ferrying the aircraft with borrowed slat cans, but next shift must verify confined space entry documentation is closed out and review down-line crew continuity procedures.
summary: Down-line slat can repair on a B737-300 was completed despite missing turnover, scattered parts, and a skipped confined space entry form, requiring follow-up on documentation and crew continuity procedures.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi ya ukarabati wa slat can kwenye tanki la mafuta la ndege ya B737-300 mahali pa 'down-line' bila mkabidhi wowote kutoka kwa zamu iliyotangulia; makaratasi yalikuwa hayajakamilika na vipuri vilikuwa vimetapakaa ovyo. Tanki lilikuwa limefunguliwa kwa zaidi ya masaa 18 bila kufanyiwa ukaguzi wa hewa, na kwa sababu ya machafuko hayo fomu ya kuingia eneo lenye hatari (confined space entry) haikujazwa kabisa. Ukarabati ulikamilishwa na Maintenance Control wakaruhusu ndege kusafirishwa kwa kutumia slat cans za mkopo, lakini zamu inayokuja lazima ihakikishe fomu hiyo imekamilika na kupitia upya utaratibu wa mwendelezo wa wafanyakazi kwenye kazi za 'down-line'.
summary: Ukarabati wa slat can kwenye tanki la mafuta la B737-300 ulikamilishwa licha ya kukosekana kwa mkabidhi, vipuri vilivyotapakaa, na fomu ya eneo hatari isiyojazwa, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka na taratibu za wafanyakazi.

entities.text: fomu ya kuingia eneo lenye hatari

narrative_text: Nilipata hii job ya slat can repair kwa fuel tank ya B737-300 down-line lakini hakuna turnover kutoka crew iliyotangulia; paperwork ilikuwa messed up na parts zimetapakaa kila mahali. Tank ilikuwa imekaa open zaidi ya 18 hours bila tank sniffer check, na kwa hii confusion yote tukakosa kufanya confined space entry form kabisa. Repair ilikamilika na Maintenance Control wakaapprove ferry flight ya aircraft na borrowed slat cans, but next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm hiyo entry form imefanywa na tuangalie crew continuity procedure kwa down-line jobs.
summary: Slat can repair kwa B737-300 down-line ilifanywa bila turnover proper na confined space entry form ikakosekana, so follow-up inahitajika kwa documentation na crew continuity.

narrative_text: During cable tension checks on the CRJ-200 aileron, rudder and elevator systems, rig pins were installed in the rudder to support the upcoming Rudder PCU Functional Check, with plans to remove them after task completion post-lunch. With over 90 task cards in progress across dayshift and multiple mechanics working related tasks, the rig pin removal was missed and not caught since no travel check is required after this task. Incoming shift and lead mechanics must verify all rig pins are removed before aircraft release, especially when multiple technicians share pinning requirements across tasks.
summary: Rudder rig pins installed for a PCU functional check on a CRJ-200 were inadvertently left in place due to task overlap and workload, requiring verification by the next shift before release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa mvutano wa nyaya kwenye mifumo ya aileron, rudder na elevator ya ndege ya CRJ-200, pini za kurekebisha ziliwekwa kwenye rudder kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wa utendaji wa Rudder PCU uliokuwa unatarajiwa baada ya chakula cha mchana. Kutokana na wingi wa kadi za kazi zaidi ya tisini pamoja na mafundi kadhaa kufanya kazi zinazohusiana, uondoaji wa pini hizo ulisahaulika na haukugunduliwa kwa sababu hakuna ukaguzi wa ziada unaohitajika baada ya kazi hiyo. Zamu inayofuata na mafundi wakuu wanapaswa kuhakikisha pini zote zimeondolewa kabla ndege kutolewa kwa huduma, hasa pale mafundi wengi wanaposhirikiana katika kazi zinazohitaji pini zilezile.
summary: Pini za kurekebisha rudder kwenye ndege ya CRJ-200 zilisahaulika kuondolewa baada ya ukaguzi wa PCU kutokana na msongamano wa kazi, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha zimeondolewa.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa utendaji wa Rudder PCU

narrative_text: Wakati wa cable tension checks kwenye aileron, rudder na elevator ya CRJ-200, tuliweka rig pins kwenye rudder ili ku-support Rudder PCU Functional Check ambayo ilikuwa ifanyike after lunch, na plan ilikuwa ku-remove pins baada ya task kukamilika. Na task cards zilikuwa zaidi ya tisini plus mechanics wengine wako on different tasks, uondoaji wa rig pins ulisahaulika kwa sababu hakuna travel check inayohitajika after hiyo task. Next shift lazima wa-verify rig pins zote zimeondolewa before release ya aircraft, especially pale mechanics wengi wanashare pinning requirements kwenye tasks tofauti.
summary: Rig pins za rudder kwenye CRJ-200 zilisahaulika kuondolewa after PCU check kutokana na workload, so next shift lazima wa-confirm removal before release.

narrative_text: THSA was replaced after failing the oil inspection for a leak, but operational checks have failed repeatedly across multiple shifts, with position transducer suspected faulty. 1st shift signed off the non-routine without addressing the no-fix statement, and the stab control wheel still does not return to zero after the 13.5 up position/SEC 1 reset check. Aircraft was pulled back to the hangar from the gate and management was notified, but it was never formally removed from service. Next shift: assign a different mechanic and inspector to rerun the full ops check per the THSA replacement job card before further dispatch.
summary: THSA operational checks continue to fail across shifts with an unresolved no-fix statement, requiring an independent recheck before the aircraft can be returned to service.

narrative_text: THSA ilibadilishwa baada ya kukosa ukaguzi wa mafuta kwa sababu ya uvujaji, lakini ukaguzi wa uendeshaji umeendelea kushindwa kupitia zamu kadhaa, na inashukiwa kuwa position transducer ndiyo ina hitilafu. Zamu ya kwanza ilisaini non-routine bila kushughulikia taarifa ya kutopatikana kwa suluhu, na stab control wheel bado haichukui sifuri baada ya kuwekwa 13.5 up na SEC 1 kurudishwa upya. Ndege ilirudishwa hangar kutoka kwenye gate na uongozi ulijulishwa, lakini haijawahi kuondolewa rasmi kwenye huduma. Zamu inayofuata: mpangie fundi na inspector wengine tofauti wafanye tena ukaguzi kamili wa uendeshaji kulingana na job card ya kubadilisha THSA kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ukaguzi wa uendeshaji wa THSA umeendelea kushindwa kupitia zamu tofauti bila suluhu iliyothibitishwa, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi mpya na wafanyakazi tofauti kabla ndege haijarudishwa kwenye huduma.

narrative_text: So THSA ilibadilishwa after ilifail oil inspection due to leak, lakini ops checks zimeendelea kufail through zamu nyingi, na wanasuspect position transducer ndio ina fault. 1st shift walisign off ile non-routine bila kuaddress ile no-fix statement, na stab control wheel bado haireturn kwa zero after kuwekwa 13.5 up position na SEC 1 kufanyiwa reset. Ndege ilirudishwa hangar kutoka gate na management walinotified, lakini haijawahi kuremove from service rasmi. Kwa next shift: pata mechanic na inspector wengine different warerun ile full ops check kulingana na THSA replacement job card kabla ya kuidispatch tena.
summary: Ops checks za THSA zimeendelea kufail across shifts na no-fix statement bado haijaaddressed, kwa hivyo inahitajika independent recheck kabla ndege haijarudi kwa service.

narrative_text: B767-300ER right engine IDG was replaced overnight and given an engine run, leak check and operational check with no faults found; logbook signed off as good. Please note during the maintenance run all indications were normal, but follow up to confirm the shaft configuration was verified correct for the Pratt and Whitney engine, since a similar IDG replacement on another tail later required a shaft reconfiguration. Recommend re-verifying this installation before releasing the aircraft further.
summary: Right engine IDG on a B767-300ER was replaced and checked out normal, but shaft configuration should be re-verified given a similar case later needed correction.

entities.text: engine run, leak check and operational check

narrative_text: IDG ya injini ya kulia kwa ndege ya B767-300ER ilibadilishwa usiku uliopita na kufanyiwa uendeshaji wa injini, ukaguzi wa uvujaji na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji bila hitilafu kuonekana, hivyo logbook ilisainiwa kuwa sawa. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe kuwa mpangilio wa shaft ya IDG umewekwa sahihi kwa injini ya Pratt and Whitney, kwani kesi kama hii kwenye ndege nyingine baadaye ilihitaji kurekebishwa tena. Tafadhali fanya ukaguzi wa ziada kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari.
summary: IDG ya injini ya kulia ya B767-300ER ilibadilishwa na kuonekana sawa, lakini mpangilio wa shaft unahitaji kuthibitishwa tena kutokana na tukio jingine lililojitokeza baadaye.

entities.text: uendeshaji wa injini, ukaguzi wa uvujaji na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji

narrative_text: Tulibadilisha ile right engine IDG ya B767-300ER usiku, tukafanya engine run pamoja na leak check na operational check, hakuna trouble found so tuka-sign off kwa logbook kama good fix. Lakini zamu inayofuata i-verify vizuri kama shaft configuration ilikuwa correct for the Pratt and Whitney engine, kwa sababu kuna case ingine ilitokea baadaye ikahitaji kurekebishwa. Tafadhali msifanye assume tu, someone should double-check hiyo installation before releasing aircraft.
summary: Right engine IDG ya B767-300ER ilikuwa sawa during maintenance run, lakini shaft configuration inahitaji kuverifiwa tena kwa sababu ya issue iliyojitokeza later kwenye case kama hii.

narrative_text: Following flap track inspection completion on the B727-200, we reinstalled the main gear flying door and finished the flap track fairing, but had repeated difficulty aligning the attach linkage over the drag brace and had to reposition the door several times for fairing hardware access. Aircraft was returned to service after task closeout, but the flying door reportedly separated in flight after takeoff and was discovered missing only after arrival at destination. Suspect either the forward attach fitting or linkage possibly seated below the drag brace during repositioning; recommend follow-up inspection of forward attach fittings on similar tasks. Note there is no door indication switch for this door, so a dedicated sign-off step for flying door installation should be considered going forward.
summary: A B727-200 main gear flying door was lost in flight after a maintenance reinstall where the attach linkage may have been mispositioned, prompting recommendations for additional inspection and a dedicated sign-off.

narrative_text: Baada ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa flap track kwenye ndege ya B727-200, tulirudisha mlango wa flying door wa main gear na kumaliza fairing, lakini tulipata ugumu mara kadhaa kuweka linkage sawasawa juu ya drag brace, hivyo tukalazimika kuuhamisha mlango mara kadhaa ili kupata nafasi ya kufunga fairing hardware. Ndege ilirudishwa kwenye huduma baada ya kazi kukamilika, lakini baadaye ilielezwa kuwa mlango huo uliporomoka ukiwa angani muda mfupi baada ya kupaa, na haikugundulika mpaka ndege ilipofika kwenye kituo cha marudio. Tunashuku tatizo linaweza kuwa kwenye forward attach fitting au linkage kuwekwa chini ya drag brace wakati wa kuuhamisha mlango, hivyo tunapendekeza ukaguzi zaidi wa fittings hizo pamoja na kuanzishwa kwa sahihi maalum ya kuthibitisha ufungaji wa flying door, kwa kuwa mlango huu hauna door indication switch.
summary: Mlango wa flying door wa ndege ya B727-200 ulipotea ukiwa angani baada ya kazi ya matengenezo ambapo linkage huenda haikuwekwa vizuri, hivyo kupendekeza ukaguzi zaidi na sahihi maalum ya kuthibitisha kazi.

narrative_text: Tulipata turnover ikisema flap track inspection ya B727-200 imeisha, so tukaenda ku-reinstall flying door na kumaliza flap track fairing. Lakini tulipata shida kidogo ku-align attach linkage juu ya drag brace, tukalazimika ku-reposition ile door mara kadhaa ili tupate access ya kufunga fairing hardware. Baada ya kumaliza task, tuka-return aircraft to service, lakini baadaye tukaambiwa flying door imeondoka mid-flight after takeoff bila crew kujua, na waligundua imepotea only after landing destination. Tuna-suspect forward attach fitting au linkage inaeza kuwa iliwekwa below drag brace wakati wa repositioning, so tunarecommend follow-up inspection ya attach fittings, na pia tuwe na separate sign-off ya flying door installation kwa sababu hakuna door indication switch ya hii door.
summary: Flying door ya B727-200 iliondoka mid-flight baada ya installation ambapo linkage inaweza kuwa haikuwekwa vizuri juu ya drag brace, hivyo inahitajika follow-up inspection na separate sign-off.

narrative_text: On the A300 R/H inboard flap repair, the new Rib 7 being installed showed bent/dented ribs; the mechanic continuing the match-drilling per turnover was unaware and a non-routine repair form was raised after crew chief review. Follow-up two days later found the dents had simply been straightened on a machined part, which is not an acceptable repair method, and the crew chief agreed with this concern. By the next check, the crew chief confirmed management was aware but the repair was proceeding without NDT inspection or engineering approval, and the aircraft was released to service that Saturday. Next shift must verify whether Rib 7 has since received proper NDT/engineering sign-off before further flap closure work continues.
summary: A300 inboard flap Rib 7 repair proceeded without required NDT inspection or engineering approval despite mechanic concerns, and the aircraft was returned to service; status of proper sign-off needs verification.

narrative_text: Katika ukarabati wa flap ya ndani upande wa kulia (R/H inboard flap) kwenye ndege ya A300, Rib 7 mpya iliyokuwa ikiwekwa ilionekana imeinama/kubonyea, na fundi aliyeendelea na kazi ya kuchimba mashimo (match-drilling) kwa mujibu wa ripoti ya zamu iliyopita hakuwa na taarifa ya hali hiyo, hivyo fomu ya ukarabati usio wa kawaida ilijazwa baada ya kushauriana na kiongozi wa zamu. Siku mbili baadaye ilibainika kuwa uharibifu ulikuwa umenyooshwa tu bila kufuata utaratibu unaokubalika kwa sehemu iliyotengenezwa kwa mashine, jambo ambalo kiongozi wa zamu alikubaliana kuwa si sahihi. Baadaye ikathibitika kuwa uongozi ulifahamu hali hiyo lakini ukarabati uliendelea bila ukaguzi wa NDT wala idhini ya uhandisi, na ndege ilirudishwa kazini Jumamosi hiyo. Zamu inayofuata ihakikishe kama Rib 7 imepata uthibitisho sahihi wa NDT na uhandisi kabla ya kazi zaidi kuendelea.
summary: Ukarabati wa Rib 7 kwenye flap ya ndege ya A300 uliendelea bila ukaguzi wa NDT au idhini ya uhandisi licha ya wasiwasi wa mafundi, na ndege ilirudishwa kazini; hali ya idhini hiyo inahitaji kuthibitishwa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii repair ya R-hand inboard flap ya A300, Rib 7 mpya iliyokuwa inainstall ilikuwa na ribs zimebend, na yule mechanic alikuwa ana-continue na match-drilling kwa mujibu wa turnover report bila kujua issue hiyo, so tukaraise non-routine repair form baada ya kuongea na crew chief. Siku mbili baadaye tukagundua kwamba dents zilikuwa zimestraighten tu, ambayo si sawa kwa machined part, na crew chief mwenyewe akakubali concern hiyo. By Thursday, crew chief akaconfirm kwamba management walikuwa aware lakini repair iliendelea bila NDT inspection wala engineering approval, na aircraft ikarelease for service that Saturday. Zamu inayofuata i-verify kama Rib 7 imepata sign-off inayotakiwa ya NDT na engineering kabla ya kuendelea na flap closure.
summary: Repair ya Rib 7 kwenye flap ya A300 iliendelea bila NDT inspection wala engineering approval licha ya concerns za mechanic, na aircraft ikarudishwa service; inabidi tu-verify sign-off status.

narrative_text: Last week a mechanic requested a rush field service tool shipment near departure time for an Aircraft X flight, so I asked a co-worker to assist with the manual shipping tag and packing while I processed the shipping memo. I asked the mechanic twice if any of the tools were hazmat and he confirmed none were, so the tools were sent out to the gate. That night while updating the tool location log I discovered one of the tools was actually hazmat, and I had to advise the mechanic it cannot be shipped back without proper hazmat documentation. Follow-up needed: confirm tool status with mechanic and process correct hazmat paperwork before next shipment.
summary: A tool later found to be hazmat was shipped without proper documentation after being misidentified by the mechanic, requiring follow-up paperwork before return shipment.

narrative_text: Wiki iliyopita mfundi aliomba vifaa vya huduma vya uwandani vitumwe haraka muda mfupi kabla ya ndege ya Aircraft X kuondoka, hivyo nilimwomba mfanyakazi mwenzangu anisaidie kufunga na kutuma vifaa hivyo huku mimi nikiandaa hati maalum ya usafirishaji. Nilimuuliza mfundi mara mbili kama kuna kifaa chochote chenye hatari ya kemikali (hazmat) na akanihakikishia hakuna, hivyo vifaa vikatumwa hadi lango la ndege. Usiku huo huo, nilipokuwa nikisasisha rekodi ya mahali kifaa kilipo, niligundua kuwa kimoja kati ya vifaa hivyo ni hazmat, na nikamjulisha mfundi kuwa hakiwezi kurejeshwa bila nyaraka sahihi za hazmat. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuthibitisha hali ya kifaa hicho na kukamilisha nyaraka za hazmat kabla ya usafirishaji mwingine.
summary: Kifaa chenye hatari ya kemikali (hazmat) kilitumwa bila nyaraka sahihi baada ya kutambuliwa vibaya na mfundi, hivyo linahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Wiki jana kulikuwa na field service tools zilizohitajika ku-shipped haraka kwa sababu Aircraft X ilikuwa karibu ku-depart, so nilimwomba colleague wangu anisaidie na packing wakati mimi naprepare ile special tag na shipping memo. Nilimuuliza yule mechanic mara mbili kama kuna kitu chochote cha hazmat kwa hizo tools, akasema hakuna, so tukazi-ship hadi kwa gate. Later that night nilipokuwa naupdate tool location, ndio nikagundua moja ya hizo tools ni hazmat, nikam-advise mechanic kwamba haiwezi ku-return bila proper hazmat documentation. Tunahitaji follow-up ya kuconfirm status ya hiyo tool na kukamilisha documentation kabla ya next shipment.
summary: Tool ambayo ilikuwa hazmat ili-shipped bila proper documentation baada ya mechanic kutoa taarifa isiyo sahihi, hivyo inahitaji follow-up ya haraka.

narrative_text: Took over B777-200 from Day shift and completed the Engine 2 fire loop replacement per WDM 26-XX-XX-X and FIM 26-XX Task XXX referenced in the previous log entry; all clamps and shared attaching wires were checked and secured. After completion around 2000, the AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test was performed but did not pass, and the associated MEL item remains active; there was insufficient ground time before the XB:00 departure to troubleshoot further. Note that the torque and bonding meter checks under AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY (Fire Detector Assembly Removal) were not followed, as FIM 26-XX Task XXX only pointed to the Detector Element Removal procedure, which does not apply here. Next shift should re-verify the correct AMM reference, redo the torque/bonding checks, and rerun the operational test before further dispatch consideration.
summary: Engine 2 fire loop replacement on the B777-200 failed its operational test due to an incomplete torque/bonding check caused by conflicting AMM/FIM references, requiring follow-up before dispatch.

entities.text: AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test

narrative_text: Nilipokea ndege B777-200 kutoka kwa zamu ya mchana nikiendelea na kazi ya kubadilisha fire loop ya Injini ya Pili kwa kufuata WDM 26-XX-XX-X na FIM 26-XX Task XXX zilizotajwa kwenye logi iliyopita; clamps zote na waya zinazoshirikiana zilihakikishwa zimekazwa vizuri. Baada ya kukamilisha kazi saa saba mchana hivi, kipimo cha operational test cha mfumo wa kugundua moto kilifanywa lakini hakikupita, na tatizo la MEL bado liko wazi; muda uliobaki kabla ya ndege kuondoka haukutosha kufanya uchunguzi zaidi. Ni muhimu kuzingatia kuwa hatua za kukagua torque na bonding meter kama zinavyotakiwa na AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY hazikufuatwa kikamilifu kwa sababu FIM ilielekeza kwenye taratibu isiyohusiana na kazi iliyofanyika. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha marejeleo sahihi ya AMM, kurudia ukaguzi wa torque na bonding, kisha kurudia operational test kabla ya uamuzi wowote wa kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa fire loop ya Injini ya Pili kwenye B777-200 ulishindwa kwenye operational test kutokana na maelekezo yasiyolingana ya AMM na FIM, hivyo kuhitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi kabla ya safari.

entities.text: fire loop ya Injini ya Pili
operational test cha mfumo wa kugundua moto

narrative_text: Nilichukua handover ya B777-200 kutoka Day shift, nikaendelea na replacement ya Engine 2 fire loop kwa kufuata WDM 26-XX-XX-X na FIM 26-XX Task XXX kama ilivyo-note kwenye log page ya juzi; clamps zote na attaching wires za shared connections zilicheckwa ziko secure. Tukimaliza around 2000, tuka-run AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test lakini haikupass, na MEL bado iko active; hatukuwa na ground time ya kutosha kuendelea na troubleshooting maana departure ilikuwa XB:00.
