Kuna gap kwa sababu torque check na bonding meter check za AMM 26-XX-XX-XXX-XXY (Fire Detector Assembly Removal) hazikufuatwa, kwa sababu FIM ilikuwa inapoint tu kwa Detector Element Removal procedure ambayo haiapply hapa. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify AMM reference sahihi, warudie torque/bonding checks, then wa-rerun ile operational test kabla ya kuclear ndege for dispatch.
summary: Engine 2 fire loop replacement kwenye B777-200 ime-fail operational test kwa sababu ya conflicting AMM/FIM references, so follow-up inahitajika before dispatch.

entities.text: AMM Engine Fire Detection Operational Test

narrative_text: Handover: #2 engine nose cowl R&R (WO ref, MM 71-11-00) was not completed by end of shift — only 6 bolts fitted, remaining bolts finger-tight only, no torque or hookups done. Supervisor was informed of the exact stopping point but the logbook was short-signed against 71-11-00-4 step 3C(4), which reads as if the cowl is fully installed. Next shift must verify actual cowl status before further work/dispatch, as the paperwork does not reflect true state of installation.
summary: Nose cowl installation on #2 engine was left incomplete with only finger-tight bolts, but logbook entry incorrectly implies full installation per MM step 3C(4).

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya zamu: Kazi ya kuondoa na kurudisha nose cowl ya engine namba 2 haikukamilika mwishoni mwa zamu — bolt sita tu ndizo zilizowekwa, na zilizobaki ziliwekwa kwa vidole tu bila torque wala kuunganisha mifumo mingine. Supervisor alijulishwa hatua halisi tulipoishia, lakini logbook iliandikwa kana kwamba kazi imekamilika kulingana na hatua 3C(4) ya MM 71-11-00, jambo ambalo si kweli. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha hali halisi ya cowl kabla ya kazi yoyote zaidi au ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka, kwani hati za kazi hazionyeshi hali halisi ya usakinishaji.
summary: Usakinishaji wa nose cowl ya engine namba 2 haukukamilika lakini logbook ilionyesha kama kazi imekamilika, hivyo kuhitaji uhakiki wa haraka.

narrative_text: Handover: Ile nose cowl ya engine #2, ile R&R job ya MM 71-11-00, haikukamilika by end of shift — tulisecure na bolts sita tu, zingine ziko finger-tight tu, hakuna torque wala hookups zilizofanywa. Tulimwambia supervisor exact point tuliyoishia, lakini logbook ikaandikwa short-signed against step 3C(4), inaonyesha kama cowl imeinstall kabisa, ambayo si kweli. Next shift wanafaa ku-verify actual status ya cowl kabla ya kuendelea na kazi au dispatch, coz paperwork haionyeshi hali halisi.
summary: Nose cowl installation ya engine #2 iliachwa incomplete na bolts finger-tight tu, lakini logbook inasomeka kama kazi imekamilika kulingana na step 3C(4).

narrative_text: On #1 engine of the DC-10, we removed the reverser drive motor and overpressure shutoff valve, then installed a new drive motor with the 4 mount bolts; only the short duct section directly below the motor was disconnected. Next shift was briefed in detail before turnover. Be aware the aircraft later had an inflight shutdown due to a fire warning, traced to a duct clamp near the regulator valve about 4 ft from our work area, not the section we touched. Reversers, overpressure shutoff valve and wiring harness have since been replaced by another crew; recommend continued monitoring given this engine's chronic reverser history.
summary: Reverser drive motor replacement on #1 engine was followed by an unrelated duct clamp failure causing an inflight shutdown, prompting further repairs and continued monitoring.

entities.text: installed a new drive motor with the 4 mount bolts
inflight shutdown due to a fire warning

narrative_text: Kwenye injini namba 1 ya ndege ya DC-10, tuliondoa motor ya kuendesha reverser pamoja na valve ya kuzuia overpressure, kisha tukafunga motor mpya kwa bolti nne za kushikilia; sehemu pekee ya duct iliyoguswa ni ile fupi iliyo chini kabisa ya motor. Zamu iliyofuata ilielezwa vizuri kabla ya kuachiwa kazi. Ni muhimu kufahamu kuwa baadaye ndege ilifanya inflight shutdown kutokana na tahadhari ya moto, ambayo ilisababishwa na clamp ya duct karibu na regulator valve, umbali wa futi nne kutoka mahali tulipokuwa tukifanyia kazi. Reversers, valve ya overpressure na waya zilizoharibika zimeshabadilishwa na wafanyakazi wengine; inashauriwa ufuatiliaji zaidi kwani injini hii ina historia ya matatizo ya mara kwa mara kwenye reverser.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa motor ya reverser kwenye injini namba 1 ulifuatiwa na tatizo lisilo husiana la clamp ya duct lililosababisha inflight shutdown, hivyo kuhitaji ukarabati zaidi na ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: kufunga motor mpya kwa bolti nne
inflight shutdown kutokana na tahadhari ya moto

narrative_text: Kwa #1 engine ya DC-10, tuli-remove reverser drive motor na overpressure shutoff valve, kisha tuka-install drive motor mpya na zile 4 mount bolts; ni duct section moja tu fupi chini ya motor ndio ilifunguliwa. Next shift walipewa full briefing kabla ya turnover. Lakini msikie, baadaye ndege ilifanya inflight shutdown kwa sababu ya fire warning, na cause ilikuwa duct clamp karibu na regulator valve, kama futi 4 kutoka mahali tulikuwa tuna-work, si sehemu tuliyogusa. Reversers, overpressure shutoff valve na wiring harness zimeshabadilishwa na crew ingine; tafadhali endeleeni ku-monitor coz engine hii ina chronic history ya reverser issues.
summary: Baada ya kubadilisha reverser drive motor kwenye #1 engine, kulitokea inflight shutdown isiyo husiana na duct clamp failure, hivyo kuna haja ya follow-up na monitoring zaidi.

entities.text: install drive motor mpya na zile 4 mount bolts
inflight shutdown kwa sababu ya fire warning

narrative_text: During turnover on EO WVWX Rev A for B737-300, found one ground wire hanging loose and terminated it with a dual ground, but several other ground wires appear to be landed on the wrong terminating grounds per the EO. Notified lead and oncoming shift lead at 0330 and logged a write-up flagging the misrouted grounds, requesting Engineering authorization before further work or release. Please confirm Engineering auth status was actually issued and reviewed before this aircraft is dispatched, as it reportedly departed before the correction was verified.
summary: Ground wiring on a B737-300 was found misrouted during an EO turnover, and follow-up is needed to confirm Engineering authorization was completed before the aircraft's release.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuendelea na kazi ya zamu iliyopita kwenye EO WVWX Rev A ya ndege ya B737-300, tuligundua waya mmoja wa ground ukiwa umeachwa bila kuunganishwa, na tuliuunganisha na dual ground. Hata hivyo, waya wengine wa ground walionekana kuunganishwa mahali pasipofaa kulingana na maelekezo ya EO. Nilimjulisha lead na lead wa zamu inayofuata saa tisa na nusu usiku, na kuandika ripoti ya turnover ikieleza tatizo hilo na haja ya idhini ya Uhandisi kabla ya kazi zaidi. Ni muhimu kuthibitisha kama idhini hiyo ilitolewa na kuangaliwa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka, kwani taarifa zinaonyesha iliondoka kabla tatizo halijarekebishwa.
summary: Waya za ground kwenye ndege ya B737-300 ziligundulika kuunganishwa vibaya wakati wa turnover, na inahitajika kuthibitishwa kama idhini ya Uhandisi ilikamilika kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuondoka.

narrative_text: Wakati na-turnover job ya EO WVWX Rev A kwa B737-300, nilikuta ground wire moja iko hanging pekee, so nikai-terminate na dual ground. Lakini kuna zingine za ground wires zinaonekana zi-landed kwenye wrong terminating grounds according to EO. Nili-notify lead na oncoming shift lead saa nane na nusu, nikaandika turnover write-up ku-flag hii issue, tukiomba Engineering authorization kabla ya kazi zaidi ama release. Tafadhali confirm kama engineering auth ilitolewa na kuangaliwa kabla ndege haijaenda, kwa sababu inaonekana ilitoka before correction ime-verify.
summary: Ground wiring ya B737-300 ilipatikana ime-misroute wakati wa EO turnover, na inahitajika confirmation kama Engineering authorization ilikamilika kabla release.

narrative_text: During weekend modification work on the Dash 8-400, the aft flight attendant seat bulkhead assembly was removed and reinstalled to allow underfloor repairs; the seatbelt was not reinstalled on that seat. The lead technician mentioned the missing belt to the tech handling the job but assumed it would be fixed before release, and it was missed during the final airworthiness walkaround before sign-off. Gate maintenance is now installing a new seatbelt and the flight is delayed; next shift please confirm belt installation and inspect all bulkhead hardware disturbed during the modification before further sign-off.
summary: A missing flight attendant seatbelt on a Dash 8-400 went unnoticed after bulkhead removal for underfloor repairs, due to a communication gap, requiring gate maintenance follow-up and delaying the flight.

narrative_text: Wakati wa marekebisho ya wikendi kwenye ndege ya Dash 8-400, kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege sehemu ya nyuma kiliondolewa pamoja na muundo wake wa bulkhead ili kuruhusu ukarabati chini ya sakafu, lakini mkanda wa usalama haukurudishwa baada ya kazi kukamilika. Fundi mkuu alimwambia fundi mwenzake kuhusu mkanda uliokosekana lakini alidhani ingeshughulikiwa kabla ndege haijatolewa, na jambo hilo lilikosekana pia wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwisho kabla ya kusaini kibali. Sasa matengenezo ya getini yanaweka mkanda mpya na ndege imecheleweshwa; zamu inayofuata ihakikishe mkanda umewekwa vizuri na ikague sehemu zote za bulkhead zilizoguswa wakati wa marekebisho kabla ya kutia sahihi tena.
summary: Mkanda wa usalama wa kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege kwenye Dash 8-400 ulikosekana baada ya ukarabati wa bulkhead kutokana na mawasiliano hafifu kati ya mafundi, hali iliyosababisha ndege kucheleweshwa hadi mkanda mpya uwekwe.

entities.text: kiti cha mhudumu wa ndege sehemu ya nyuma

narrative_text: Kwa hii weekend mod kwenye Dash 8-400, wale walitoa ile bulkhead assembly ya aft FA seat kufanya underfloor repairs, lakini seatbelt haikurudishwa baada ya job kukamilika. Nilimwambia yule fundi anayehandle job kwamba seat inahitaji belt, nikadhani atafix before release, but tuka-miss during final walkaround before sign-off. Sasa gate maintenance wanainstall belt mpya na flight imedelay; next shift please confirm belt installation na icheki bulkhead hardware zote zilizoguswa during mod kabla ya sign-off ingine.
summary: Seatbelt ya FA seat kwenye Dash 8-400 ilikosekana baada ya bulkhead removal kwa underfloor repairs due to miscommunication, na flight imedelay mpaka gate maintenance waweke belt mpya.

narrative_text: During scheduled lube task on the A300 slat/ball screw and roller assy (both wings, per AMM ref), all panels were opened, serviced, and closed correctly by the sole technician on shift. Aircraft departed ZZZ1-ZZZ Day 3 night, and post-flight walk-around found two inboard leading edge panels missing; field service confirmed all hardware remained intact at the panel location. Suspect a missing/damaged bracket allowed the outboard panel to tuck under and depart with the adjacent one - other aircraft may have same defect, please flag for fleet-wide bracket inspection.
summary: Two inboard leading edge panels were lost in flight on the A300 after scheduled slat lube task, likely due to a missing/damaged bracket rather than technician error, requiring fleet inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya kawaida ya lubrication kwenye slat na ball screw ya ndege ya A300, mafundi walifungua paneli za mabawa yote mawili, wakafanya kazi kama AMM inavyoelekeza, kisha wakafunga vizuri. Ndege ilitoka ZZZ1 kwenda ZZZ usiku wa siku ya tatu, na baada ya kutua, ukaguzi ulionyesha paneli mbili za leading edge sehemu ya ndani zimepotea angani. Timu ya field service ilithibitisha kuwa vifaa vyote vilikuwa vimewekwa sawa mahali ambapo paneli ilitoka, hivyo tunashuku bracket iliyopotea au kuharibika ndiyo iliyosababisha paneli kutoka na kuvuta nyingine pamoja nayo - jambo hili linahitaji kuangaliwa kwa ndege nyingine pia.
summary: Paneli mbili za leading edge za ndege ya A300 zilipotea angani baada ya kazi ya lubrication, na inashukiwa tatizo la bracket badala ya kosa la fundi, hivyo ukaguzi wa meli nzima unahitajika.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-perform scheduled lube task kwa slat na ball screw nut ya A300, mabawa yote mawili, nilikuwa peke yangu so nikaopen panels, nika-lube kama AMM inavyosema, nikaclose access properly. Ndege ilideparture from ZZZ1 to ZZZ usiku wa Day 3, then after landing during walk-around pilot alireport panels mbili za inboard leading edge zimepotea kabisa. Field service walienda ku-verify na wakakuta hardware zote ziko installed sawa mahali panel ilitoka, so tunasuspect ni bracket iko missing au damaged ndiyo ilisababisha panel kutuck chini ya ile ingine na zote mbili zikaondoka - please flag hii for other aircraft pia coz inaweza kuwa fleet-wide issue.
summary: Panels mbili za leading edge za A300 zilipotea mid-flight baada ya lube task, inaonekana ni bracket issue si error ya fundi, so inahitaji follow-up kwa fleet nzima.

entities.text: panels mbili za inboard leading edge

narrative_text: During shift turnover, I found that a RINX 253 turbine engine part I inspected back in June had the same serial number as a part already scrapped under RINX 353, yet the FAA Form 8130 tag listed it as new. Incoming inspector needs to hold this part from further installation until the serial number discrepancy is verified against maintenance records. Please flag this with quality assurance before end of shift.
summary: An inspector discovered a duplicate serial number between an in-service part and a scrapped part, with the 8130 tag incorrectly certifying it as new, requiring urgent verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, niligundua kwamba sehemu ya injini ya turbine yenye namba RINX 253, niliyokagua mwezi Juni, ina namba ya serial sawa na sehemu iliyokwisha tupwa kama taka chini ya RINX 353, lakini fomu ya FAA 8130 inaonyesha kuwa ni mpya. Msimamizi anayeingia zamu anahitajika kuzuia sehemu hii isiwekwe kwenye ndege hadi hali hii ithibitishwe kwenye rekodi za matengenezo. Tafadhali wasiliana na idara ya udhibiti wa ubora kabla ya mwisho wa zamu.
summary: Mkaguzi aligundua kufanana kwa namba za serial kati ya sehemu iliyo kwenye matumizi na iliyotupwa, huku fomu ya 8130 ikionyesha vibaya kuwa mpya, hivyo kuhitaji uthibitisho wa haraka.

entities.text: sehemu ya injini ya turbine yenye namba RINX 253

narrative_text: Kwa hii shift turnover, niligundua kwamba ile turbine engine part, RINX 253, niliyo-inspect mwezi wa Juni, ina serial number sawa na part iliyokuwa scrapped kama RINX 353, lakini FAA Form 8130 inaonyesha ni new. Incoming inspector ahakikishe part hii haiendi ku-install mpaka discrepancy ya serial number itathibitishwa na maintenance records. Please flag hii issue na QA kabla ya end of shift.
summary: Inspector alipata serial number ya part ikifanana na scrapped part, huku 8130 tag ikisema ni new, so inahitaji verification haraka na QA.

narrative_text: A319 was released for service after overnight completion of the First Officer's sliding window replacement per AMM 56-12-11-400, work having been turned over from Third Shift with only final adjustments and trim installation pending. After release, the Third Shift mechanic called to report he had forgotten to install one of two bolts and nuts securing the window release handle to the window trolley bellcrank (IPC item #380). The aircraft was already on layover in ZZZ1; ZZZ1 maintenance confirmed the missing hardware and coordinated with our lead using IPC 56-12-11 to identify the correct part numbers. Follow-up: verify hardware install completed and re-inspect airworthiness sign-off before next dispatch.
summary: A319 was released for service with missing window-handle hardware after an incomplete overnight turnover, requiring urgent follow-up at the layover station.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A319 ilitolewa kwa huduma baada ya kazi ya kubadilisha dirisha la kuteleza la First Officer kukamilika usiku, kulingana na AMM 56-12-11-400, huku kazi ikiwa imekabidhiwa kutoka zamu ya tatu na kubaki tu marekebisho ya mwisho na ufungaji wa ukingo wa dirisha. Baada ya ndege kutolewa, fundi wa zamu ya tatu alipiga simu kuripoti kwamba alisahau kufunga bolt moja pamoja na nati zake kwenye kishikizo cha dirisha kilichounganishwa na bellcrank ya trolley ya dirisha (kipengele namba 380 cha IPC). Ndege ilikuwa tayari imelala ZZZ1, na wafanyakazi wa matengenezo huko walithibitisha vifaa hivyo vilikosekana, kisha wakashirikiana na kiongozi wetu kutumia IPC 56-12-11 kutambua namba sahihi za sehemu. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuthibitisha ufungaji umekamilika kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Ndege ya A319 ilitolewa kwa huduma ikiwa na vifaa vya kishikizo cha dirisha havijakamilika baada ya kukabidhiana kazi vibaya usiku, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka mahali ndege ilipolala.

entities.text: dirisha la kuteleza la First Officer

narrative_text: Aircraft A319 ilirelease for service baada ya ile window replacement ya First Officer's sliding window kukamilika usiku, tukifuata AMM 56-12-11-400 — kazi ilikuwa imekabidhiwa kutoka Third Shift na yale yaliyobaki ni final adjustments na ku-install trim tu. Baada ya release, yule mechanic wa Third Shift alicall akasema alisahau ku-install one of two bolts na nuts kwenye window release handle inayo-attach kwa window trolley bellcrank, item #380 kwa IPC. Ndege ilikuwa tayari on layover ZZZ1, so tulicall ZZZ1 maintenance wakaconfirm hardware ilikuwa missing, then tukatumia IPC 56-12-11 kupata part numbers sahihi na lead wetu. Follow-up: hakikisha hardware imefungwa properly kabla ya next dispatch, na tuverify sign-off ya airworthiness upya.
summary: A319 ilirelease ikiwa na bolts na nuts missing kwenye window release handle baada ya turnover isiyo complete, so inahitaji follow-up ya haraka kwa layover station.

narrative_text: During the Day 0 shift, we completed reinstallation of the vertical stabilizer tip (4) aft fairing on Aircraft X. It was later found on Day 1 that the aircraft had flown several legs with two circuit breakers left open, as the AMM step to pull C/Bs for the aft portion of the tip was not carried out since I assumed it did not apply to that section without VOR antennas. Next shift needs to confirm the affected C/Bs have been closed and verify the AMM steps for this task are re-reviewed before any further tip fairing work is signed off.
summary: Two circuit breakers were left open after a vertical stabilizer tip fairing reinstallation on Aircraft X due to a missed AMM step, requiring verification and review before further sign-off.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu ya Siku ya 0, tulikamilisha kazi ya kurudisha aft fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer (4) kwenye Ndege X. Ilibainika Siku ya 1 kuwa ndege ilikuwa imefanya safari kadhaa huku circuit breaker mbili zikiwa hazijafungwa, kwani hatua ya AMM ya kutoa C/Bs kwa sehemu ya nyuma ya ncha hiyo haikufuatwa kwa sababu nilidhani haihitajiki kwa sehemu isiyo na antena za VOR. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakikisha C/Bs zilizoathirika zimefungwa vizuri na kupitia tena hatua za AMM kabla ya kazi nyingine yoyote ya fairing kuidhinishwa.
summary: Circuit breaker mbili ziliachwa wazi baada ya kazi ya kurudisha fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer kwenye Ndege X kutokana na hatua ya AMM kukosa kufuatwa, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi na uthibitisho kabla ya kazi zaidi.

entities.text: aft fairing ya ncha ya vertical stabilizer (4)
hatua ya AMM ya kutoa C/Bs

narrative_text: Siku ya 0 tulifanya reinstallation ya vertical stabilizer tip (4) aft fairing kwa Aircraft X. Siku ya 1 ikagunduliwa kwamba ndege ilikuwa imefanya multiple flight legs na circuit breakers mbili hazija-close, kwa sababu sikufikiria requirement ya kupull C/Bs kwa aft portion ya tip since haina VOR antennas - nilikosea kufuata AMM steps zote. Next shift ihakikishe C/Bs hizo zimefungwa properly na wa-review AMM steps kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote ingine ya fairing.
summary: Circuit breakers mbili ziliachwa open baada ya reinstallation ya vertical stabilizer tip fairing kwa Aircraft X kwa sababu ya AMM step kukosa kufuatwa, inahitaji verification kabla ya sign-off inayofuata.

narrative_text: During prep for the #1 engine borescope inspection on the B767, I removed the gearbox crank pad cover so the engine could be turned, but my shift ended before the job was finished and I did not tell the incoming AMT where I had placed it. The cover was never reinstalled; aircraft departed, lost oil pressure/quantity, and #1 engine was shut down in flight with an air turn-back. Follow-up: reinforce shift-turnover checklist for open engine panels/covers and verify crank pad cover installation before closing up any borescope task.
summary: A missed crank pad cover reinstallation after an incomplete shift handover led to an in-flight #1 engine shutdown and air turn-back on a B767.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutayarisha ndege ya B767 kwa ukaguzi wa boroskopu wa injini namba 1, niliondoa kifuniko cha crank pad ili injini iweze kuzungushwa, lakini shift yangu ilikamilika kazi ikiwa bado haijakamilika na sikumwambia fundi aliyeingia mahali nilipoweka kifuniko hicho. Kifuniko hakikurudishwa; ndege ilianza safari na kupoteza shinikizo na kiwango cha mafuta, hivyo injini namba 1 ikazimwa hewani na ndege ikarudi uwanjani. Kinachohitaji ufuatiliaji: kuboresha utaratibu wa mkabidhiano wa shift kuhusu vifuniko vya injini vilivyofunguliwa, na kuhakikisha crank pad cover imerudishwa kabla ya kufunga kazi ya boroskopu.
summary: Kushindwa kurudisha kifuniko cha crank pad baada ya mkabidhiano hafifu wa shift kulisababisha kuzimika kwa injini namba 1 hewani na ndege kurudi uwanjani kwenye B767.

narrative_text: Wakati tuna-prepare #1 engine kwa borescope inspection kwa hii B767, nilitoa ile gearbox crank pad cover ndio engine iweze kugeuzwa, lakini shift yangu ikaend before job imecompletiwa na sikumtell yule AMT anayeingia nilipoweka ile cover. Cover haikurudishwa, ndege ikadepart ikapoteza oil pressure na quantity, matokeo #1 engine ika-shutdown mid-flight na wakafanya air turn-back. Follow-up: tuboreshe shift handover checklist kwa open panels na covers, na kila mtu ahakikishe crank pad cover imeinstalliwa vizuri kabla ya kuclose out borescope task.
summary: Crank pad cover haikurudishwa baada ya handover mbaya, na hiyo ikasababisha #1 engine ishutdown mid-flight na air turn-back kwa B767.

narrative_text: During the PS check on the A321 both engine IDGs were found low on oil and were serviced by the team using the green oil cart, with levels visually confirmed within limits by two technicians afterward. On the next flight the crew received an IDG over-temperature message, and post-flight troubleshooting found reddish fluid in one IDG, raising concern the servicing cart may have been contaminated or mislabeled. A fluid sample has been sent for lab analysis; next shift please follow up on results and hold the oil cart in question out of service pending confirmation.
summary: Suspected contamination of IDG servicing oil on an A321 triggered an in-flight over-temperature warning, and a fluid sample is pending lab analysis.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa PS kwa ndege ya A321, IDG za injini zote mbili zilionekana mafuta ni chini ya kiwango kinachotakiwa, na mafundi walizihudumia kwa kutumia trolley ya mafuta ya kijani baada ya kuthibitisha kiwango kwa macho. Baada ya safari iliyofuata, wafanyakazi wa ndege waliona ujumbe wa joto kali kwenye IDG, na uchunguzi wa baadaye ulibaini kioevu chenye rangi nyekundu ndani ya IDG moja, jambo linaloashiria huenda trolley ya kuhudumia ilikuwa na uchafuzi au lebo isiyo sahihi. Sampuli ya kioevu imetumwa kwa uchunguzi wa maabara, hivyo zamu inayofuata ihakikishe inafuatilia matokeo na trolley husika ibaki nje ya matumizi hadi uthibitisho upatikane.
summary: Uchafuzi unaoshukiwa wa mafuta ya kuhudumia IDG kwenye ndege ya A321 ulisababisha onyo la joto kali angani, na sampuli ya kioevu inasubiri matokeo ya maabara.

narrative_text: Ju ya PS check ya A321, engines zote mbili IDG zilikuwa low kwa oil, so tukaservice na yale green cart, na after servicing wale watu wawili wakaconfirm level iko within limits. Lakini after flight, crew waliona IDG temperature message ikiwa too high, so wakati wa troubleshooting wakapata reddish fluid ndani ya IDG moja, so tuna suspect huyo cart alikuwa contaminated au ame-mix na fluid tofauti. Sample ya fluid imeenda lab for testing, so next shift please fuatilia results na hiyo cart iendelee kuwa out of service mpaka tupate confirmation.
summary: IDG servicing oil ya A321 inasuspectiwa kuwa contaminated baada ya in-flight over-temperature warning, sample iko lab ikisubiri results.

narrative_text: During a QA audit, the #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve connector was found disconnected with no paperwork covering it. Reviewing my past work, I recalled that back in February, while doing the #2 engine igniter plug immersion depth check on this B777-200, I had to break a stubborn igniter boss loose and pulled that connector as a precaution to protect the wiring from the tools. The job got handed over at shift end due to parts delay, and the connector disconnection was never logged in the write-ups. Next shift needs to verify the connector is properly reconnected and safetied, and update the maintenance records accordingly.
summary: An engine hydraulic pump connector was left disconnected and undocumented after an igniter plug task was handed over mid-job, requiring follow-up inspection and paperwork correction.

entities.text: #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve connector

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa QA, kiunganishi cha valve ya depressurization ya pump ya hydraulic ya injini namba mbili kilipatikana kimetenganishwa bila hati yoyote ya kueleza sababu. Baada ya kupitia kazi zangu za nyuma, nilikumbuka kuwa mwezi Februari, wakati nikifanya ukaguzi wa immersion depth ya igniter plug ya injini namba mbili kwenye ndege hii ya B777-200, boss ya igniter ilikuwa ngumu kuachiliwa hivyo nikatumia zana nzito zaidi, na kwa tahadhari niliondoa kiunganishi hicho ili kulinda nyaya. Kazi ilikabidhiwa kwa shift ijayo mwisho wa kazi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa vipuri, na uondoaji wa kiunganishi haukutajwa kwenye ripoti zilizoandikwa. Shift inayokuja inahitajika kuhakikisha kiunganishi kimeunganishwa vizuri na kusalimika, pamoja na kusahihisha hati za matengenezo.
summary: Kiunganishi cha pump ya hydraulic ya injini kilibaki kimetenganishwa bila kuandikwa baada ya kazi ya igniter plug kukabidhiwa kwa shift nyingine, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi na usahihishaji wa hati.

entities.text: kiunganishi cha valve ya depressurization ya pump ya hydraulic
ukaguzi wa immersion depth ya igniter plug

narrative_text: Wakati wa QA audit, connector ya #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve ilipatikana disconnected bila documentation yoyote. Nikirudi kwa records za nyuma, nikakumbuka Februari, wakati nikifanya igniter plug immersion depth check kwenye hii B777-200, boss ilikuwa ngumu sana ku-loosen hivyo nikahitaji tools nzito, na kwa precaution niliondoa hiyo connector ili kuprotect wiring kutoka kwa tools. Job ilibidi ikabidhiwe kwa shift nyingine end of shift kwa sababu ya parts delay, na hiyo connector removal haikuandikwa kwenye write-ups. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify connector imerudishwa properly na kusafety, halafu ku-update maintenance log.
summary: Connector ya hydraulic pump ilibaki disconnected bila documentation baada ya igniter task kuhandover kwa shift nyingine, so inahitajika verification na kuupdate maintenance records.

entities.text: #2 engine hydraulic pump depressurization valve connector

narrative_text: B737-800 arrived last night with a crew report of a loud squeal from the cockpit handset. Stores pulled a replacement unit and the AMT swapped the handset at the gate before I relieved him; the old unit had no legible serial number so we logged it as UNK. Capt and I checked out the new handset and ops were normal, but Quality Assurance later found the replacement part number was wrong effectivity and it has since been replaced again with the correct part number. Please confirm QA closeout is documented in the logbook and verify no further interphone squawks from this tail.
summary: Wrong-effectivity handset was installed on a B737-800 to fix a cockpit interphone squeal, later corrected by QA, and logbook closeout needs verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-800 iliwasili jana usiku na ripoti ya sauti kali ya kupasuka kutoka kwenye handset ya cockpit. Stores walitoa kipande cha kubadilisha na fundi (AMT) akabadilisha handset kule gate kabla mimi kumhudumia zamu; kile kilichotolewa hakikuwa na namba ya serial inayosomeka hivyo tuliandika UNK kwenye logbook. Kapteni na mimi tulifanya ukaguzi wa handset mpya na mambo yalionekana sawa, lakini baadaye Quality Assurance walibaini part number iliyowekwa haikuwa sahihi kwa effectivity ya ndege hiyo, na handset imebadilishwa tena kwa namba sahihi. Tafadhali thibitisha kwamba kufungwa kwa suala hili na QA kumeandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook na kwamba hakuna malalamiko mengine ya interphone kutoka ndege hiyo.
summary: Handset yenye part number isiyo sahihi ilifungwa kwenye B737-800 kurekebisha tatizo la interphone, hitilafu iliyogunduliwa na QA baadaye na kurekebishwa.

narrative_text: Hii B737-800 ilikuja jana usiku na crew report ya loud squeal kutoka kwa cockpit handset. Stores walitoa unit ya kubadilisha, na yule AMT alikuwa amemaliza kubadilisha handset kwa gate before nikafika ku-relieve him; ile old unit haikuwa na serial number inayosomeka so tuliandika UNK kwenye logbook. Capt na mimi tulido checkout ya handset mpya, ops ikaonekana normal, lakini baadaye QA walipata kwamba part number tuliyoweka ilikuwa wrong effectivity, so handset imebadilishwa tena na correct part number. Please confirm kwamba QA closeout imeandikwa properly kwenye logbook, na verify hakuna squawks zingine za interphone kwa hii tail.
summary: Handset ya wrong part number ilifungwa kwenye B737-800 for interphone squeal, QA wakagundua effectivity issue baadaye na wakairekebisha.

narrative_text: During overnight service check handover, Crew Chief signed off the Airworthiness Release and closed the remaining blocks on the logbook without properly verifying two deferral entries. The LH Pack Flow Control Valve deferral sheet number was left off the compliance page, and the flashlight/cradle deferral code block was found blank and had to be reconstructed from the job card tally before release. Next shift must double-check all deferral sheet cross-references against job card entries before signing any Airworthiness Release, as the earlier gap caused confusion for the outbound Captain and a 95-minute departure delay.
summary: Incomplete deferral entries on the logbook during shift handover led to an improperly signed Airworthiness Release and a 95-minute flight delay.

narrative_text: Wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu ya usiku kwenye ukaguzi wa ndege, Fundi Mkuu alisaini Airworthiness Release na kufunga sehemu zilizobaki za logbook bila kuthibitisha vizuri maingizo mawili ya kuahirisha kazi. Namba ya karatasi ya kuahirisha kazi ya LH Pack Flow Control Valve haikuandikwa kwenye ukurasa wa uzingatiaji, na sehemu ya msimbo wa kuahirisha ya flashlight na kishikilizi (cradle) ilikutwa tupu, hivyo ikabidi kutafutwa tena kwa kutumia rekodi za job card kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuhakiki kwa makini maingizo yote ya kuahirisha kazi dhidi ya job card kabla ya kusaini Airworthiness Release yoyote, kwani pengo hili lilisababisha mkanganyiko kwa Kapteni wa safari na kuchelewa kwa dakika 95.
summary: Maingizo yasiyokamilika ya kuahirisha kazi kwenye logbook wakati wa mkabidhiano wa zamu yalisababisha Airworthiness Release kusainiwa vibaya na kuchelewa kwa ndege kwa dakika 95.

narrative_text: Jana usiku wakati wa handover ya service check, Crew Chief alisign Airworthiness Release na akaclose zile blocks zilizobaki bila kuverify vizuri zile deferral entries mbili. Ile deferral sheet number ya LH Pack Flow Control Valve haikuwekwa kwenye compliance page, na ile deferral code block ya flashlight na cradle ilikuwa blank, ikabidi tuitrace kutoka kwa job card tally before tunarelease aircraft. Next shift lazima wa-double check deferral sheets zote against job card entries kabla ya ku-sign Airworthiness Release yoyote, kwa sababu hii gap ilicause confusion kwa Captain wa outbound flight na delay ya 95 minutes.
summary: Deferral entries hazikukamilika kwenye logbook during shift handover, hivyo Airworthiness Release ikasainiwa vibaya na flight ika-delay kwa dakika 95.

narrative_text: Following a taxi-in vibration complaint from the outbound crew, I logged the write-up and reviewed the aircraft history, which showed one prior similar event on this B767-300ER. After inspecting the engine, wiring and sensors with no faults found, I replaced the engine vibration monitor using the part number pulled from the IPC and maintenance manual, then released the aircraft with the vibration system on carry-over. Post-departure it was discovered that the installed monitor's effectivity does not match this tail number, likely due to conflicting effectivity data in the maintenance manual versus the IPC. Next shift needs to confirm correct part effectivity, coordinate replacement, and track the change request submitted to the manuals department.
summary: A B767-300ER was released with an engine vibration monitor of incorrect part effectivity due to conflicting manual data, requiring follow-up part correction and a manual revision request.

entities.text: change request submitted to the manuals department

narrative_text: Baada ya wafanyakazi wa ndege waliotoka kuripoti tatizo la mtetemo wakati wa taxi-in, niliandika ripoti kwenye logbook na kuangalia historia ya ndege, ambapo ilionekana kulikuwa na tatizo kama hilo hapo awali kwenye ndege hii ya B767-300ER. Nilikagua injini, nyaya na sensa bila kupata hitilafu, kisha nikabadilisha kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini kwa kutumia namba ya sehemu niliyopata kwenye IPC na kitabu cha matengenezo, na baadaye nikaruhusu ndege kuondoka huku mfumo huo ukiwekwa kwenye orodha ya ufuatiliaji. Baada ya ndege kuondoka, ilibainika kuwa kifaa kilichowekwa hakikulingana na namba ya mkia wa ndege hii, jambo linaloonekana kutokana na taarifa zinazokinzana kwenye kitabu cha matengenezo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha sehemu sahihi, kuiweka, na kufuatilia ombi la mabadiliko lililotumwa idara ya vitabu vya matengenezo.
summary: Ndege ya B767-300ER iliruhusiwa kuondoka ikiwa na kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini chenye namba isiyolingana na ndege hiyo, hivyo kuhitaji marekebisho na mapitio ya kitabu cha matengenezo.

entities.text: kifaa cha kupima mtetemo wa injini
tatizo la mtetemo wakati wa taxi-in
ombi la mabadiliko lililotumwa idara ya vitabu vya matengenezo

narrative_text: Outbound crew walireport vibration issue wakati wa taxi-in, so nikaingiza write-up kwenye logbook na kucheck aircraft history, nikaona kulikuwa na previous incident moja tu kwenye hii B767-300ER. Nilifanya inspection ya engine, wiring na sensors, sikupata fault yoyote, so nikaamua kubadilisha ile vibration monitor nikitumia part number niliyopata kwenye IPC na maintenance manual, kisha nikarelease aircraft na system iko kwenye carry-over. Baada ya departure, tukaambiwa kwamba part effectivity ya ile monitor haimatch na tail number ya hiyo aircraft, sababu manual inaonyesha info inayo-conflict na IPC. Next shift wafuatilie correct part, wa-coordinate replacement, na watrack ile change request niliyosubmit kwa manuals department.
summary: B767-300ER ilirelesiwa na vibration monitor ambayo haimatch na tail number, kwa hivyo inahitajika follow-up ya part correction na manual review.

entities.text: change request niliyosubmit kwa manuals department

narrative_text: While troubleshooting a bleed leak on the A300, I opened the wheel well and pack bay access panels to trace the source. Two incoming technicians arrived near end of shift and I gave them a verbal handover before leaving for a taxi-tow assignment; there was no lead technician available to coordinate the turnover. It was later found that some panels were never reinstalled, resulting in aircraft damage. Next shift should verify all access panels are closed/secured before further dispatch and confirm lead coverage for future shift handovers.
summary: Verbal-only handover of an open A300 panel troubleshooting task, with no lead present, led to panels being left uninstalled and subsequent aircraft damage.

entities.text: wheel well and pack bay access panels

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta chanzo cha bleed leak kwenye ndege ya A300, nilifungua panels za wheel well na pack bay ili kuchunguza tatizo. Mafundi wawili wa shift inayofuata walifika karibu na mwisho wa zamu yangu, nikawapa taarifa ya mdomo kuhusu kazi iliyoendelea kabla ya kuhamishiwa kazi ya taxi-tow, kwani hapakuwa na lead technician wa kuratibu mabadiliko ya zamu. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa baadhi ya panels hazikurudishwa mahali pake, na hii ilisababisha uharibifu wa ndege. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuhakikisha panels zote zimefungwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kutumika tena, na kuwepo kwa lead technician wa kusimamia mabadiliko ya zamu siku zijazo.
summary: Taarifa ya mdomo pekee bila lead technician ilisababisha panels za ndege ya A300 kutorudishwa, hivyo kusababisha uharibifu.

entities.text: panels za wheel well na pack bay

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nina-troubleshoot bleed leak kwa A300, nikaopen access panels za wheel well na pack bay area kutafuta leak. Karibu na mwisho wa shift yangu, technicians wawili wa next shift walikuja ku-assist, nikawapea verbal handover tu kabla sijaenda ku-report kwa taxi-tow crew, kwa sababu hakukuwa na lead technician wa ku-coordinate turnover. Baadaye ikagundulika panels zingine hazikuwa reinstalled, ikasababisha aircraft damage. Next shift wahakikishe panels zote zime-close vizuri before dispatch, na tupate lead coverage kwa hizi turnovers zijazo.
summary: Verbal handover pekee bila lead technician ilisababisha panels za A300 kubaki open, na hatimaye aircraft damage.

entities.text: access panels za wheel well na pack bay area

narrative_text: During reinstallation of the Number-Two Forward Firewall panel on the S-76 Mark II, several camlocks required replacement and their retainers could not be located; QA inspected the area but no hardware was found and it was not noted in prior turnover notes. On the second panel, hardware count also did not match: three extra bolts, one missing spacer, and four missing washers were found before install. Please follow up with QA on the discrepancy and confirm hardware control/tool control procedures before this aircraft returns to service.
summary: Hardware discrepancies (missing retainers, spacer, and washers, plus extra bolts) found during firewall panel reinstallation on the S-76 Mark II were not documented in prior turnover and need QA follow-up before release to service.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuweka tena paneli ya Firewall ya Mbele Namba-Mbili kwenye helikopta ya S-76 Mark II, camlocks kadhaa zilihitaji kubadilishwa na retainers zake hazikupatikana; Idara ya Ubora (QA) ilikagua eneo hilo lakini hazikuonekana wala kuandikwa kwenye taarifa za awali za mabadiliko ya zamu. Kwenye paneli ya pili, idadi ya vifaa vya chuma pia haikulingana: bolts tatu za ziada zilipatikana, na spacer moja pamoja na washers nne zilikosekana kabla ya kufunga paneli. Tafadhali fuatilia jambo hili na QA na uhakikishe taratibu za udhibiti wa vifaa na zana kabla ndege hii kurejea kazini.
summary: Vifaa vya chuma vilivyokosekana au kuzidi vilipatikana wakati wa kuweka paneli za Firewall kwenye S-76 Mark II, jambo ambalo halikuandikwa awali na linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa QA kabla ndege kurejea huduma.

entities.text: paneli ya Firewall ya Mbele Namba-Mbili

narrative_text: Wakati wa ku-reinstall ile Number-Two Forward Firewall panel kwenye S-76 Mark II, kulikuwa na camlocks kadhaa ambazo zilihitaji replacement lakini retainers zake hazikupatikana; QA walikagua area lakini hakuna hardware ilipatikana, na haikuwa noted kwenye turnover notes za awali. Kwenye panel ya pili pia, hardware count haikumatch: kulikuwa na bolts tatu za extra, spacer moja missing, na washers nne missing kabla ya install. Tafadhali follow up na QA kuhusu discrepancy hii na confirm hardware control/tool control procedures kabla aircraft hii i-return to service.
summary: Kuna hardware discrepancies (missing retainers, spacer, washers, na extra bolts) zilizopatikana wakati wa panel reinstallation kwenye S-76 Mark II, ambazo hazikua documented awali na zinahitaji QA follow-up kabla ya return to service.

narrative_text: Overtime shift on the B737-200 trailing edge flap transmission: previous shift reported a bearing had failed and needed replacement, sourced from a flap transmission arriving from ATL. Turnover instructions said to pull the bearing assembly off the incoming unit and install it on the aircraft transmission, but no rigging details or checks were passed on, and the job was completed in under an hour based on assumption rather than confirmed data. Next shift please verify rigging requirements were not missed and confirm bearing assembly installation was properly documented and signed off.
summary: A bearing assembly swap on a B737-200 flap transmission was completed based on an incomplete shift turnover, raising concern about missed rigging verification.

entities.text: install it on the aircraft transmission

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya ziada kwenye ndege ya B737-200, nilipokea taarifa kuwa bearing ya flap transmission ilikuwa imeharibika na ilihitaji kubadilishwa, ikitolewa kutoka kwa transmission nyingine iliyokuwa ikisafirishwa kutoka ATL. Maelekezo niliyopewa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu hayakuwa kamili kuhusu taratibu za urekebishaji zinazohitajika, hivyo kazi ilifanywa kwa muda mfupi wa chini ya saa moja bila uhakika kamili wa hatua zote. Zamu ijayo iangalie tena kama ukaguzi na uwekaji wa hati ulifanyika ipasavyo kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuendelea na safari.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa bearing kwenye flap transmission ya B737-200 ulifanyika kwa msingi wa maelekezo yasiyo kamili ya zamu, hivyo ukaguzi wa ziada unahitajika.

narrative_text: Niliingia overtime kwenye B737-200 na turnover ilisema kuna bearing imeharibika kwenye flap transmission, na tulipaswa kui-rob kutoka kwa transmission nyingine iliyokuwa inatoka ATL. Ile turnover haikuwa na details za rigging au ni checks gani zilifanyika, so nikafanya install ya bearing assembly kwa mikono tu, job ikachukua chini ya saa moja. Next shift ni lazima wa-verify kama rigging requirements na documentation ziko sawa kabla ya kusign off ile job.
summary: Bearing assembly ilibadilishwa kwenye flap transmission ya B737-200 kwa msingi wa turnover isiyo kamili, hivyo verification zaidi inahitajika.

narrative_text: EMB-145 came into the hangar for a First Officer's windshield heat fault; third shift removed the bad windshield and prepped the frame with a new seal before turnover. Day shift Mechanic X installed the windshield and operational leak checks were good, but it was later found the seal used was not correct for the aircraft's mod status/effectivity. Next shift needs to verify seal part number against effectivity records and confirm with the Lead Mechanic before closing out the RII sign-off. Please double-check any windshield seal jobs in progress for correct effectivity.
summary: A First Officer's windshield seal installed on an EMB-145 during shift turnover did not match the aircraft's mod effectivity, requiring follow-up verification with the Lead Mechanic.

narrative_text: Ndege ya EMB-145 iliingia hangar kwa sababu ya hitilafu ya joto la kioo cha mbele upande wa First Officer; shift ya usiku ilitoa kioo kilichoharibika na kuandaa fremu pamoja na seal mpya kabla ya kukabidhi kazi. Shift ya mchana, Fundi X aliweka kioo hicho na ukaguzi wa leak ulikuwa mzuri, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kuwa seal iliyowekwa haikuwa sahihi kulingana na hali ya marekebisho (mod effectivity) ya ndege hiyo. Shift inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha namba ya seal dhidi ya rekodi za effectivity na kuongea na Fundi Kiongozi kabla ya kufunga saini ya RII. Tafadhali kaguweni tena kazi zozote za seal za kioo zinazoendelea kuhakikisha effectivity ni sahihi.
summary: Seal ya kioo cha mbele cha First Officer kwenye ndege ya EMB-145 haikuwa sahihi kulingana na effectivity ya ndege, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho zaidi na Fundi Kiongozi.

entities.text: kioo cha mbele upande wa First Officer

narrative_text: EMB-145 iliingia hangar kwa windshield heat fault upande wa First Officer; third shift walitoa ile windshield mbovu na kuprep frame na seal mpya kabla ya turnover. Day shift, Mechanic X akaweka ile windshield na operational leak checks zikawa fine, lakini baadaye tukagundua seal iliyotumika haikuwa correct kwa mod status/effectivity ya ndege. Next shift lazima wa-verify part number ya seal against effectivity records na kuongea na Lead Mechanic before kufunga RII sign-off. Tafadhali check tena kazi zozote za windshield seal zinazoendelea kuhakikisha effectivity ni sahihi.
summary: Seal ya First Officer windshield kwenye EMB-145 haikuwa correct kulingana na effectivity, hivyo next shift wanahitaji ku-verify na Lead Mechanic.

narrative_text: On the A320, we removed and installed the #1 normal brake servo valve per the maintenance reference card, but the aircraft had no electrical power due to #2 engine removal for pylon duct work, so the required leak and operational check could not be completed. A follow-up card was written to accomplish the leak/op check once power was restored, but no verbal handover was given to the incoming shift, and the card was signed off without the deferred check being clearly linked. Next shift must verify the leak and op check on the #1 brake servo valve was actually performed before further release; this was tied to a recurring hot/sticky brake condition on that side.
summary: Incomplete leak/op check on a replaced #1 brake servo valve was not properly passed down to the next shift, risking premature sign-off.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A320, tuliondoa na kufunga valve ya breki namba 1 (normal brake servo valve) kwa kufuata kadi ya matengenezo, lakini ndege haikuwa na umeme kwa sababu injini ya pili ilikuwa imeondolewa kwa kazi ya pylon duct, hivyo ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji haukukamilika. Tuliandika kadi nyingine ili ukaguzi huo ufanyike baada ya umeme kurudishwa, lakini hatukumpa zamu inayofuata maelezo ya mdomo kuhusu kilichobaki kufanyika, na kadi ilisainiwa bila kuunganishwa wazi na kazi iliyoahirishwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji wa valve hiyo umefanyika kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kutumika, kwani tatizo hili lilihusiana na breki kupata joto na kushikama mara kwa mara upande huo.
summary: Ukaguzi wa uvujaji na uendeshaji wa valve ya breki namba 1 haukukamilika wala kuelezwa vizuri kwa zamu iliyofuata, hali iliyoweza kusababisha kadi kusainiwa kimakosa.

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320, tuliremove na kuinstall ile #1 normal brake servo valve kwa kufuata reference card, lakini aircraft haikuwa na power kwa sababu #2 engine ilikuwa imeondolewa kwa ile pylon duct job, so ile leak na op check haikufanyika. Tuliandika follow-up card ili ifanyike after power irudishwe, but hatukufanya verbal handover kwa next shift, na card ikasainiwa without kuunganisha vizuri na deferred item. Next shift wahakikishe ile leak and op check ya valve imefanyika kabla ya ku-release ndege, kwa sababu hii ilikuwa related na ile recurring hot/sticky brake issue upande huo.
summary: Leak and op check ya #1 brake servo valve haikukamilika na hakuna verbal handover iliyofanywa, ikileta hatari ya card kusainiwa mapema bila kukamilisha task.

narrative_text: B737-700 fuel nozzle replacement (positions 5-9) was carried over from previous shift; incoming tech was told the earlier-installed nozzles were already signed off, so part number verification against the engineering order was not repeated before continuing. Remaining nozzles were installed, mounting flange bolts and coupling nuts were torqued and safetied, but shrouds are not yet reinstalled. Next shift must confirm all nozzle part numbers match the engineering order before proceeding with the pressure leak check.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement on a B737-700 continued across shifts without re-verifying part numbers, and the pressure leak check plus shroud installation remain outstanding.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha nozzle za mafuta kwenye ndege ya B737-700 (positions 5 mpaka 9) iliendelezwa kutoka shift iliyopita; fundi aliyekuja alijulishwa kwamba nozzle zilizowekwa awali tayari zimekaguliwa na kuridhiwa, hivyo uhakiki wa part number dhidi ya engineering order haukurudiwa kabla ya kuendelea. Nozzle zilizobaki ziliwekwa, bolts za flange na coupling nuts zikafungwa kwa torque na kuwekewa safety, lakini shrouds bado hazijarudishwa. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha part numbers zote za nozzle zinalingana na engineering order kabla ya kuendelea na pressure leak check.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa nozzle za mafuta kwenye B737-700 uliendelezwa bila kurudia uhakiki wa part numbers, na pressure leak check pamoja na ufungaji wa shrouds bado hazijakamilika.

narrative_text: Ile kazi ya kubadilisha fuel nozzles kwa B737-700, positions 5 through 9, ilikuwa carried over kutoka shift iliyopita; niliambiwa tu ati nozzles zilizoinstalled awali zime-signed off already, kwa hivyo si-kucheki tena part numbers dhidi ya engineering order kabla ya kuendelea. Nozzles zilizobaki tuli-install, tuka-torque flange bolts na coupling nuts na tuka-safety, lakini shrouds bado hazija-installed. Next shift wa-confirm part numbers zote against engineering order kabla ya ku-proceed na pressure leak check.
summary: Fuel nozzle replacement job kwa B737-700 iliendelea bila kuhakiki part numbers tena, na pressure leak check na shrouds bado hazijafanywa.

narrative_text: B767-300 rudder PCA replacement was completed and checked out normally, including rig pin install, trim set, and multi-system operational checks, but the RII final inspection was never signed off before the aircraft was moved from the hangar back to the line due to concrete work blocking the bay. Job was worked off maintenance manual pages instead of RII work cards, so the required inspection sign-off reminder was missed during handover between shifts. Downline station completed the RII inspection after the flight, but this needs to be flagged for the hangar crew and lead AMT so paperwork discipline is reinforced when working off manual pages. Please confirm RII status on any open rudder actuator jobs before further release.
summary: RII final inspection for a rudder actuator/PCA replacement on a B767 was missed due to time pressure and use of non-RII paperwork, and was later completed at the next station.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha rudder PCA kwenye ndege ya B767-300 ilikamilika na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji ukafanyika vizuri, ikiwemo kuweka rig pin na kurekebisha trim, lakini ukaguzi wa mwisho wa RII haukufanyika kabla ndege haijahamishwa kutoka hangar kwenda line kwa sababu ya kazi za saruji zilizokuwa zikiendelea nyuma ya bay. Kazi ilifanywa kwa kutumia karatasi za maintenance manual badala ya work cards zenye sehemu za RII, hivyo ukumbusho wa ukaguzi ulikosekana wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu. Kituo kingine kilifanya ukaguzi wa RII baada ya ndege kuruka, jambo ambalo linahitaji kuarifiwa kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar na lead AMT ili nidhamu ya nyaraka iimarishwe. Tafadhali hakikisha status ya RII kwa kazi zozote za rudder actuator zinazoendelea kabla ya kutolewa kwa ndege.
summary: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa RII kwa ubadilishaji wa rudder actuator kwenye B767 ulikosekana kutokana na shinikizo la muda na matumizi ya karatasi zisizo sahihi, na baadaye ulikamilika kituo kingine.

narrative_text: Ile rudder PCA replacement kwa B767-300 ilikamilika sawa, tuli-check operation na all 3 hyd systems, tukaweka rig pin na kuset trim as required, lakini RII final inspection haikufanyika kabla aircraft ime-move kutoka hangar kwenda line kwa sababu ya concrete work iliyokuwa inaendelea behind our bay. Tulikuwa tunafanya job kwa maintenance manual pages badala ya RII work cards, so ile reminder ya kusign RII ilikosekana during shift turnover. Downline station walicomplete ile RII inspection baada ya flight, lakini hii inahitaji kuflagiwa kwa hangar crew na lead AMT ili tuimarishe paperwork discipline when working off manual pages. Please confirm RII status ya any open rudder actuator jobs kabla ya release yoyote.
summary: RII final inspection ya rudder actuator kwenye B767 ilikosekana kwa sababu ya time pressure na kutumia karatasi mbaya, na ilimaliziwa station ingine baadaye.

narrative_text: At Parts Receiving, found a box of PSU panels with O2 generators that the storekeeper wanted to bin directly without inspection tags, saying the system allows this. Stock balance actually shows a generic 180-month shelf life instead of the required 999 code, which means the actual generator shelf life (12 or 15 years depending on part number) was never verified against the Work Order notes. Parts are on hold pending Lead/Inspector review; someone changed the tag status to Y overnight but shelf life field still needs correction before these PSU panels can be released to stock or aircraft.
summary: PSU panels with O2 generators were nearly binned without proper HAZMAT shelf-life tagging, and follow-up is needed to verify correct expiry dates before release.

narrative_text: Kwenye eneo la kupokea vipuri, tulikuta boksi la paneli za PSU zenye vizalishi vya O2 ambazo mfanyakazi wa stoo alitaka kuziweka moja kwa moja kwenye bini bila lebo za ukaguzi, akisema mfumo wa kompyuta unaruhusu hivyo. Rekodi ya stoo inaonyesha muda wa matumizi wa miezi 180 badala ya msimbo sahihi wa 999, hivyo muda halisi wa matumizi wa vizalishi vya O2 (miaka 12 au 15 kutegemea namba ya sehemu) haujathibitishwa kwa kuangalia maelezo ya Work Order. Vipuri vimesimamishwa vikisubiri ukaguzi wa Lead na Inspector; lebo ilibadilishwa usiku kucha lakini sehemu ya muda wa matumizi bado inahitaji kurekebishwa kabla ya kutolewa stoo au kwa ndege.
summary: Paneli za PSU zenye vizalishi vya O2 zilikaribia kuwekwa binini bila lebo sahihi za ukaguzi wa HAZMAT, hivyo ufuatiliaji unahitajika kuthibitisha muda sahihi wa matumizi kabla ya kutolewa.

narrative_text: Kwa Parts Receiving, nilikuta box ya PSU panels zenye O2 generators ambazo storekeeper alitaka aziweke bin direct bila inspection tags, akisema system inaruhusu hivyo. Stock balance inaonyesha shelf life ya generic 180 months instead ya ile 999 code inayotakiwa, so hatujathibitisha shelf life halisi ya hizo generators (inaweza kuwa 12 or 15 years kutegemea part number) kutoka kwa Work Order notes. Parts ziko on hold zikisubiri Lead na Inspector wa-review; tag status ilibadilishwa overnight kuwa Y lakini shelf life field bado inahitaji kufix kabla ya kurelease hizo PSU panels kwa stock ama plane.
summary: PSU panels zenye O2 generators zilikaribia ku-bin bila proper HAZMAT tags, so follow-up inahitajika kuconfirm shelf life sahihi kabla ya release.

narrative_text: During tonight's scheduled check on the B757, the 700+ lb fly-away kit was removed from the aft cargo compartment while the logbook signoff was in progress, and shift change created confusion over whether removal needed a logbook entry at all. A day-shift tech advised us that this kit is only signed off when installed, not removed, so no entry was made and responsibility for signoff was left unclear. Next shift please confirm with QA/records whether an entry is required for kit removal before release, as the aircraft was released with this write-up open and later had to be grounded elsewhere for a nose-heavy condition.
summary: Miscommunication over logbook signoff responsibility for a removed fly-away kit led to an aircraft release with an open item, resulting in a nose-heavy condition and later grounding.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa ndege ya B757 usiku huu, kifaa cha fly-away kit chenye uzito wa zaidi ya kilo 300 kiliondolewa kwenye sehemu ya mizigo ya nyuma huku sahihi ya logbook ikiwa bado haijakamilika, na mabadiliko ya zamu yalisababisha mkanganyiko kuhusu kama uondoaji huo unahitaji kuandikwa kwenye logbook. Fundi wa zamu ya mchana alituambia kuwa kifaa hicho husainiwa tu kinapowekwa, si kinapoondolewa, hivyo hakuna maelezo yaliyoandikwa na hakukuwa na uwazi kuhusu nani anastahili kusaini. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali mthibitishe na idara ya ubora kama kuna haja ya kuandika maelezo hayo kabla ya kutoa ndege, kwani ndege ilitolewa ikiwa na hitilafu hiyo bado wazi, na baadaye ilibidi isimamishwe mahali pengine kwa sababu sehemu yake ya mbele ilikuwa nzito kupita kiasi.
summary: Mkanganyiko wa mawasiliano kuhusu wajibu wa kusaini logbook kwa kifaa kilichoondolewa ulisababisha ndege kutolewa ikiwa na hitilafu wazi, na baadaye kusimamishwa kwa sababu ya uzito usio sawa mbele.

narrative_text: Leo usiku tulikuwa tunafanya scheduled check kwa B757, na wakati tunaendelea na logbook signoff, watu walikuwa wanaondoa ile fly-away kit ya zaidi ya 700 lbs kutoka aft cargo. Kulikuwa na shift change wakati huo huo, na fundi wa day shift akatuambia kwamba signoff ya hiyo kit inafanywa tu ikiwa imewekwa (installed), sio ikiondolewa, so hakuna entry iliyofanywa kwenye logbook. Next crew please fuatilia na QA kama entry inahitajika kwa removal ya kit, kwa sababu ndege ilipewa airworthiness release na hiyo write-up bado open, na baadaye ilibidi i-ground mahali pengine kwa sababu ilikuwa nose heavy.
summary: Kulikuwa na miscommunication kuhusu nani anasign logbook baada ya fly-away kit kuondolewa, na hiyo ikasababisha aircraft kupewa release na open write-up ambayo baadaye ikasababisha grounding kwa sababu ya nose heavy condition.

narrative_text: Q400 at 4-spot, PIREP on #2 engine TQ/FF/ITT split; swing shift ordered the P2.6 valve and pulled the AMM removal/install task. I completed R&R of the P2.7 inter-compressor bleed valve but did not cross-check the supplement requiring heat shrink on the P6 Cannon connector, so it was installed without it. Day shift lead has been briefed and is following up on the heat shrink installation before further engine run/close-out.
summary: A Q400 P2.7 bleed valve replacement was completed without applying required heat shrink to the P6 Cannon connector due to a missed AMM supplement, and day shift has been notified to correct it.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Q400 iko 4-spot, kuna ripoti ya rubani kuhusu tatizo la injini namba mbili - TQ, FF na ITT split. Shift ya jioni walishaagiza valve ya P2.6 na kutoa task ya AMM ya kuondoa na kufunga. Mimi nilifanya kazi ya kuondoa na kufunga valve ya P2.7 lakini sikuangalia nyongeza ya maelekezo inayotaka heat shrink ifungwe kwenye kiungio cha Cannon P6, hivyo ilifungwa bila hiyo heat shrink. Nimeshamweleza kiongozi wa shift ya mchana na anafuatilia jambo hili kabla ya hatua nyingine yoyote kuchukuliwa kwenye ndege.
summary: Kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya P2.7 kwenye ndege ya Q400 ilikamilika bila kufunga heat shrink inayotakiwa kwenye kiungio cha Cannon P6 kwa sababu ya kupuuza nyongeza ya maelekezo, na kiongozi wa shift ya mchana ameshaarifiwa.

narrative_text: Q400 iko 4-spot, tuna PIREP ya #2 engine - TQ, FF na ITT split. Swing shift walishaorder ile P2.6 valve na wakaprint AMM task ya removal and installation. Mimi nilifanya R&R ya P2.7 inter-compressor bleed valve, lakini sikucheck ile supplement inayosema lazima ufunge heat shrink kwenye P6 Cannon connector, so ikaenda bila hiyo heat shrink. Nimeshatell Day shift lead kuhusu hii issue, anafollow up before they sign off or run the engine tena.
summary: Baada ya kufanya R&R ya P2.7 bleed valve kwenye Q400, heat shrink ya P6 Cannon connector haikufungwa kwa sababu ya kumiss ile supplement, na Day shift lead ameshaarifiwa afollow up.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, the standby hydraulic module in the MLG wheel well was replaced after a previous shift's replacement unit was found cracked in the same spot. New module was installed per the maintenance manual, leak-checked and operationally tested, and passed. A month later the reverser hydraulic line was found disconnected and pushed behind the B pumps, never reconnected to the new module. Maintenance manual does not call out the adapter/plug for the reverser line or require a reverser operational test after module replacement -- next shift please flag this to engineering and verify reverser line connection on any future module swaps.
summary: Standby hydraulic module on a B737-500 was replaced and tested per the manual, but the reverser hydraulic line was left disconnected because the manual does not call out the adapter or a reverser operational test.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-500, moduli ya hydraulic ya standby kwenye wheel well ya MLG ilibadilishwa baada ya ile iliyowekwa na zamu iliyopita kupatikana imepasuka mahali pale pale. Moduli mpya iliwekwa kufuata maintenance manual, ikafanyiwa leak check na operational test, na ikafaulu. Mwezi mmoja baadaye, line ya hydraulic ya reverser ilikutwa haijaunganishwa, imesukumwa nyuma ya B pumps bila kurudishwa kwenye moduli mpya. Maintenance manual haijataja adapter au plug ya line hiyo wala haijaeleza operational test ya reverser baada ya kubadilisha moduli -- zamu inayokuja iarifu engineering na kuhakikisha line ya reverser imeunganishwa vizuri kwa kazi zozote za baadaye za kubadilisha moduli.
summary: Moduli ya hydraulic ya standby kwenye B737-500 ilibadilishwa na kupimwa kufuata manual, lakini line ya reverser ilibaki bila kuunganishwa kwa sababu manual haitaji adapter wala operational test ya reverser.

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-500, tulichange ile standby hydraulic module kwenye MLG wheel well baada ya module iliyowekwa na shift iliyopita kupatikana imecrack sehemu ile ile. New module ilikuwa installed per manual, ikapitia leak check na operational test, ikapass sawa. Mwezi mmoja baadaye reverser line ikakutwa haiko connected, ilikuwa imesukumwa nyuma ya B pumps out of sight, haikurudishwa kwa module mpya. Manual haitaji adapter ya reverser line wala operational test ya reverser after module replacement -- next shift wafuatilie na engineering na wacheck reverser line connection kwenye future module swaps.
summary: Standby hydraulic module kwenye B737-500 ilibadilishwa na kutested per manual, lakini reverser line iliachwa disconnected kwa sababu manual haitaji adapter wala reverser operational test.

narrative_text: Repaired sound deadening material on the #2 engine cowling per SRM 54-00-01-2, using heat gun due to outside air temp being below the minimum required for curing. Patch had set but remained tacky to touch after reheating; a second heat application did not improve cure. Incoming shift to recheck the patch at least 1 hour before shift change and confirm proper set before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Engine cowling patch repair on #2 engine remains tacky after cold-weather cure attempts and needs rechecking by next shift.

entities.text: at least 1 hour before shift change

narrative_text: Nimefanya ukarabati wa sound deadening material kwenye cowling ya engine namba 2 kufuata SRM 54-00-01-2, nikitumia heat gun kwa sababu joto la nje lilikuwa chini ya kiwango kinachohitajika kukausha patch. Baada ya muda patch ilionekana imeshikamana lakini bado ilikuwa inanata nikigusa, na hata baada ya kurudia heat gun mara ya pili haikubadilika. Shift inayofuata ichunguze tena patch angalau saa moja kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu ili kuhakikisha imekauka vizuri kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kusafiri.
summary: Ukarabati wa patch kwenye cowling ya engine namba 2 bado unanata baada ya kukaushwa kwenye joto la baridi, hivyo unahitaji kuchunguzwa tena na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: saa moja kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu

narrative_text: Nilifanya repair ya sound deadening material kwa #2 engine cowling as per SRM 54-00-01-2, nikatumia heat gun kwa sababu outside air temp ilikuwa below minimum required for cure. Patch ilikuwa imeset lakini bado ilikuwa tacky nikigusa, so nikarudia heat gun lakini haikusaidia kuwa harder. Next shift wachek tena patch at least 1 hour before shift change kuconfirm imeset vizuri kabla ya release ya aircraft.
summary: Patch ya #2 engine cowling bado ni tacky baada ya heat gun applications mbili, so next shift wanahitaji kurecheck kabla ya release.

narrative_text: During the scheduled check on the B757, the body torque tube install inspection was signed off for one of the doors after discrepancies were found at the vendor facility the day before. Both L4 and R4 door assist actuator B-nuts were found disconnected on the pneumatic lines, with red streamers still attached, discovered when sidewall panels forward of the L4/R4 door cutouts were removed. Given the time elapsed since the original event, the exact cause could not be confirmed, but overlapping maintenance tasks or a missed step are suspected; incoming crew should verify B-nut installation and torque tube inspection sign-off before further dispatch.
summary: Disconnected B-nuts with streamers still attached were found on both L4 and R4 door assist actuators during a scheduled check, and the cause remains unconfirmed due to elapsed time, requiring follow-up verification.

entities.text: L4 and R4 door assist actuator B-nuts

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kawaida wa ndege ya B757, ukaguzi wa ufungaji wa body torque tube ulisainiwa kwa mlango mmoja baada ya matatizo kugundulika kwa kampuni ya nje siku moja kabla. Nati za B (B-nuts) za actuator za milango ya L4 na R4 zilikutwa zikiwa hazijaunganishwa kwenye mabomba ya pneumatic, huku streamer nyekundu zikiwa bado zimefungwa, hali iliyogunduliwa baada ya paneli za pembeni mbele ya milango ya L4 na R4 kuondolewa. Kwa sababu ya muda mrefu uliopita tangu tukio hilo la awali, chanzo halisi cha tatizo hakikuweza kuthibitishwa, lakini inashukiwa kazi za matengenezo zilizofanyika kwa wakati mmoja au hatua iliyosahaulika; zamu inayofuata inashauriwa kuthibitisha ufungaji wa nati za B na saini ya ukaguzi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Nati za B zilizotenganishwa pamoja na streamer bado zikiwa zimefungwa ziligunduliwa kwenye actuator za milango ya L4 na R4 wakati wa ukaguzi, na chanzo cha tatizo hakijathibitishwa kutokana na muda mrefu uliopita.

entities.text: Nati za B (B-nuts) za actuator za milango ya L4 na R4

narrative_text: So during hii scheduled check ya B757, nilisign off ile install inspection ya body torque tube kwa moja ya doors, baada ya discrepancies kupatikana kwa vendor siku moja kabla. Both L4 na R4 door assist actuator B-nuts zilikutwa disconnected kwenye pneumatic lines, na red streamers bado zimebaki attached, ilionekana baada ya sidewall panels forward ya L4/R4 cutouts kutolewa. Kwa sababu ya muda umepita sana tangu ile event ya awali, sijaweza kuconfirm exact cause, but tunasuspect overlapping maintenance tasks ama step iliyoskip; next shift wachek B-nut installation na torque tube sign-off kabla ya kuendelea na dispatch.
summary: Walipata B-nuts disconnected na streamers bado attached kwenye L4 na R4 door assist actuators during check, so next shift inafaa iverify installation kwa sababu cause bado haijaconfirm.

entities.text: L4 na R4 door assist actuator B-nuts

narrative_text: On the B737-300, three cracks on the #3 slat aft edge were stop-drilled and NDT completed per SRM reference; verification confirmed the repair was correctly logged and the slat was programmed for repeated inspections. However, a later ramp inspection found the aircraft still flying with a temporary repair to the #3 slat outer lower skin that is not authorized by the Boeing SRM, despite engineering having endorsed it previously. Next shift please follow up with Engineering and QA to clarify the correct SRM disposition before further flight, and confirm the repeat inspection schedule is being tracked.
summary: Unauthorized temporary repair found on B737-300 #3 slat despite prior stop-drill sign-off, requiring Engineering/QA clarification before further flight.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-300, nyufa tatu kwenye ukingo wa nyuma wa slat namba 3 zilichimbwa (stop-drill) na ukaguzi wa NDT ukafanywa kulingana na rejea ya SRM, na ukaguzi ulithibitisha kazi ilikuwa sahihi na slat ikapangwa kwa ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara. Hata hivyo, ukaguzi wa baadaye kwenye uwanja uligundua ndege ikiendelea kutumika ikiwa na ukarabati wa muda kwenye ngozi ya chini ya nje ya slat hiyo, jambo ambalo halijaidhinishwa na kitabu cha SRM cha Boeing, ingawa idara ya uhandisi ilikuwa imekubali ukarabati huo hapo awali. Zamu ijayo tafadhali wasiliana na Uhandisi na Idara ya Ubora kufafanua hatua sahihi kabla ndege haijaruka tena, na kuhakikisha ratiba ya ukaguzi wa marudio inafuatiliwa.
summary: Ukarabati wa muda usioidhinishwa uligunduliwa kwenye slat namba 3 ya B737-300 licha ya kazi ya awali kuthibitishwa, hivyo kuhitaji ufafanuzi kutoka Uhandisi na Idara ya Ubora.

entities.text: ngozi ya chini ya nje ya slat

narrative_text: Kwenye B737-300, zile cracks tatu kwa #3 slat aft edge zilifanyiwa stop-drill na NDT ikakamilika kulingana na SRM reference, na tulithibitisha kwamba kazi ilikuwa correct na slat ika-programiwa for repeated inspections. Lakini later, wakati wa ramp inspection, wakakuta ndege ikiendelea ku-fly na temporary repair kwa slat outer lower skin ambayo haija-authorized na Boeing SRM, hata ingawa Engineering walikuwa wame-endorse hiyo repair awali. Next shift wafuatilie na Engineering na QA ku-clarify correct disposition kabla aircraft haija-fly tena, na confirm kama repeat inspection schedule inafuatwa.
summary: Temporary repair isiyo-authorized ilipatikana kwa #3 slat ya B737-300 despite sign-off ya awali, so inahitajika follow-up na Engineering/QA kabla ya further flight.

narrative_text: Owner-builder of the experimental exhibition-category aircraft carried out the condition inspection himself, assuming this was permitted under experimental rules, but it was later confirmed an A&P mechanic sign-off was required and this was never obtained. During a subsequent flight the engine lost power and the aircraft was damaged on landing, though there were no injuries. Follow-up needed: verify inspection paperwork status, determine whether the power loss is linked to the unsigned condition inspection, and confirm proper A&P sign-off procedures before further flight.
summary: An owner-performed condition inspection on an experimental aircraft was not signed off by an A&P mechanic as required, and the engine later lost power, causing landing damage that may be maintenance related.

narrative_text: Mmiliki wa ndege ya majaribio (experimental) alifanya ukaguzi wa hali ya ndege mwenyewe, akidhani inaruhusiwa kwa sababu ni ndege ya aina ya majaribio, lakini baadaye ikabainika kuwa ukaguzi huo ulihitaji kuthibitishwa na fundi mwenye leseni ya A&P, jambo ambalo halikufanyika. Wakati wa safari iliyofuata, injini ilipoteza nguvu na ndege ikaharibika wakati wa kutua, ingawa hakuna majeraha yaliyotokea. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuangalia hati za ukaguzi, kuchunguza kama tatizo la injini lilitokana na ukaguzi usiothibitishwa, na kuhakikisha taratibu sahihi za uthibitisho wa fundi zinafuatwa kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ndege ya majaribio ulifanywa na mmiliki bila idhini ya fundi mwenye leseni, na baadaye injini ilipoteza nguvu, hali iliyosababisha uharibifu wakati wa kutua.

narrative_text: Huyu owner wa hiyo experimental aircraft alifanya ile condition inspection mwenyewe, akidhani ni sawa kwa sababu ni experimental, lakini baadaye ikaonekana ilihitajika A&P mechanic sign-off ambayo haikuwahi kufanywa. Baadaye wakati wa flight, engine ikaloss power na aircraft ikapata damage wakati wa landing, ingawa hakuna injuries. Tunahitaji kufuatilia maintenance records, kuangalia kama hiyo power loss inahusiana na ile inspection isiyo-signed, na ku-confirm proper sign-off procedures kabla ya flight nyingine.
summary: Owner alifanya condition inspection bila A&P sign-off kwenye experimental aircraft, halafu engine ika-lose power ikasababisha damage wakati wa landing.

narrative_text: While servicing a low portable oxygen bottle from a B787 (tail number not confirmed), found corroded batteries inside the bottle assembly, which could pose a spark/fire hazard. This is the third time such corrosion has been found on this bottle style, and each time it was only caught because the green indicator light failed to illuminate during test. Recommend B787 portable oxygen bottles be added to a more frequent inspection interval instead of only checking at servicing/hydrostatic due dates, since current hydro/due intervals are longer than other fleet types. Please flag this component design issue to engineering/reliability for review.
summary: Corroded batteries found inside a B787 portable oxygen bottle during servicing, prompting a recommendation for more frequent inspections due to a recurring design/detection issue.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhudumia chupa ya oksijeni ya kubebeka ya ndege ya B787 iliyokuwa na kiwango cha chini, tuligundua betri ndani ya chupa hiyo zimeoza kutu, jambo ambalo linaweza kusababisha cheche na hatari ya moto. Hii ni mara ya tatu tunapata tatizo hili la kutu kwenye betri za muundo huu wa chupa, na kila mara hugunduliwa tu kwa sababu taa ya kijani ya majaribio haiwaki. Napendekeza chupa za oksijeni za B787 zikaguliwe mara kwa mara badala ya kusubiri hadi zihitaji huduma au tarehe ya mtihani wa maji, kwani muda wake wa ukaguzi ni mrefu zaidi ukilinganisha na fleet nyingine. Tafadhali suala hili la muundo lipelekwe kwa idara ya uhandisi kwa ufuatiliaji zaidi.
summary: Betri zilizooza kutu zimepatikana ndani ya chupa ya oksijeni ya kubebeka ya B787 wakati wa huduma, hivyo kupendekezwa ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara kutokana na tatizo la muundo linalojirudia.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ku-service ile portable oxygen bottle ya B787 iliyokuwa low, tulikuta batteries ndani ya bottle zime-corrode, na hiyo inaweza cause spark ndani ya bottle. Hii ni mara ya tatu naona hii issue kwenye hii style ya bottle - kila time inagunduliwa tu kwa sababu ile green light ya test haiwaki. Naomba B787 oxygen bottles zi-check mara kwa mara, si kusubiri hadi due for servicing au hydrostatic test date, kwa sababu interval yao ni ndefu kuliko fleets zingine. Please flag hii kwa engineering kwa follow-up ya design issue.
summary: Batteries za corroded zimepatikana kwenye B787 oxygen bottle wakati wa servicing, hivyo kuna haja ya more frequent checks kwa sababu ya recurring design issue.

narrative_text: During the Aileron Servo Controls job card, a technician in the flight deck noticed the snap wire on the guarded switch for the cargo compartment fire extinguisher agent discharge appeared broken. While checking the switch, the guard was pulled and the No. 1 fire extinguisher bottle discharged into the forward pit. Maintenance should pull the associated circuit breaker before handling this guarded switch in future, and the discharged bottle needs replacement/recharge and logbook entry before next flight.
summary: A guarded fire extinguisher switch was inadvertently activated during inspection, discharging the No. 1 bottle into the forward pit, requiring bottle replacement and procedural correction.

entities.text: guarded switch for the cargo compartment fire extinguisher agent discharge

narrative_text: Wakati wa kazi ya ukaguzi wa Aileron Servo Controls, fundi aliyekuwa kwenye chumba cha marubani aligundua waya ya kinga kwenye swichi ya kutolea dawa ya kuzimia moto ya sehemu ya mizigo ilionekana imekatika. Alipojaribu kuangalia swichi hiyo, chupa ya kwanza ya kuzimia moto ilitolewa bila kukusudia hadi kwenye sehemu ya mbele ya ndege. Ni muhimu zamu inayofuata ihakikishe breaker husika imetolewa kabla ya kugusa swichi hiyo tena, na chupa iliyotumika ibadilishwe na kuandikwa kwenye logbook kabla ya safari ijayo.
summary: Swichi ya kinga ya kuzimia moto iliguswa kimakosa wakati wa ukaguzi na kusababisha chupa ya kwanza kutoa dawa, hivyo inahitajika ubadilishaji na marekebisho ya taratibu.

entities.text: swichi ya kutolea dawa ya kuzimia moto
chupa ya kwanza ya kuzimia moto
kazi ya ukaguzi wa Aileron Servo Controls

narrative_text: Wakati wa job card ya Aileron Servo Controls, technician alikuwa flight deck akiangalia guarded switch ya cargo fire extinguisher discharge, akaona snap wire imekatika. Alipopull guard ku-check, No. 1 fire extinguisher bottle iki-discharge bila kukusudia hadi forward pit. Next shift wahakikishe wanapull circuit breaker kabla ya kugusa switch hiyo, na bottle iliyodischarge ireplace na logbook entry ifanywe before next flight.
summary: Guarded switch ya fire extinguisher iliguswa kimakosa wakati wa inspection na kusababisha No. 1 bottle kudischarge, hivyo inahitaji replacement na procedure correction.
