narrative_text: During receiving, a stores clerk flagged a squib cartridge (hazmat 1.4 explosive) that should have required tagging with a washer stamp and wire for shelf-life/date code tracking, but the inspector finalized the transaction without applying it, relying only on the software prompt and paperwork match. A second inspector confirmed tagging was in fact required, and confusion appears linked to the software showing an inspect/tag mismatch versus a similar cargo extinguisher bottle cartridge part number. The item has been pulled to the supervisor's office for review; next shift needs to confirm correct tagging procedure for this part number and verify no other units were released without proper shelf-life tagging, since supervision reportedly knew of this discrepancy for days without briefing receiving inspectors.
summary: A squib cartridge was released from receiving without required shelf-life tagging due to a software inspect/tag mismatch, and supervision had not briefed inspectors despite knowing of the issue for days.

entities.text: tagging with a washer stamp and wire

narrative_text: Wakati wa kupokea vipuri, karani wa stoo aligundua cartridge ya squib (hazmat 1.4, kilipuzi) ambayo ilipaswa kuwekwa alama ya washer na waya kwa ajili ya kufuatilia tarehe ya matumizi, lakini mkaguzi alimaliza mchakato bila kufanya hivyo, akitegemea tu mfumo wa kompyuta na ulinganifu wa hati. Mkaguzi mwingine alithibitisha kuwa alama hiyo ilihitajika, na inaonekana mkanganyiko ulitokana na mfumo wa kompyuta kuonyesha maelekezo tofauti kati ya kipuri hiki na kipuri kingine kinachofanana cha chupa ya kuzimia moto ya mizigo. Kipuri hicho kimechukuliwa hadi ofisi ya msimamizi kwa uchunguzi zaidi; zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuthibitisha utaratibu sahihi wa kuweka alama kwa nambari hii ya kipuri na kuhakikisha hakuna vipuri vingine vilivyotolewa bila alama sahihi, kwani usimamizi ulijua tatizo hili kwa siku kadhaa bila kuwaeleza wakaguzi wa upokeaji.
summary: Cartridge ya squib ilitolewa kutoka stoo bila alama ya lazima ya tarehe ya matumizi kwa sababu ya mkanganyiko wa mfumo wa kompyuta, na usimamizi haukuwahi kuwaeleza wakaguzi licha ya kujua tatizo hilo kwa siku kadhaa.

entities.text: kuweka alama ya washer na waya
chupa ya kuzimia moto ya mizigo

narrative_text: Wakati wa receiving, stores clerk alinotice squib cartridge (hazmat 1.4 explosive) ambayo ilisupposed kuwekwa tag ya washer stamp na wire kwa shelf-life tracking, lakini inspector aliifinalize bila kufanya hivyo, akitegemea tu system prompt na paperwork match. Inspector mwingine aliconfirm kwamba tagging ilikua required, na confusion inaonekana ilitoka kwa software kuonyesha inspect/tag mismatch kati ya hii part na cartridge nyingine ya cargo ext bottle inayofanana. Item hiyo imeshapelekwa supervisor's office for review; next shift inahitaji kuconfirm correct tagging procedure kwa part number hii na kuverify hakuna units zingine zilizoreleased bila proper tagging, kwa sababu supervision walijua issue hii kwa siku kadhaa bila kubrief inspectors wa receiving.
summary: Squib cartridge ilireleased bila required shelf-life tagging kutokana na software mismatch, na supervision hawakubrief inspectors ingawa walijua issue hii kwa siku kadhaa.

entities.text: tag ya washer stamp na wire

narrative_text: Signed off on oil filter work on the MD-80 #1 engine that was actually performed by another technician; I only witnessed the post-work engine run and leak check, which showed no leaks at the time. Aircraft later had an inflight shutdown of #1 engine due to oil loss, so this needs a full investigation of the filter installation. Please note I was on my first shift back from leave and coming off a near 24-hour duty period, so double-check all my sign-offs from this shift. Going forward, each mechanic must sign only for work they personally perform, not just observe.
summary: Technician signed for oil filter work performed by a colleague on an MD-80, and the aircraft subsequently suffered an inflight shutdown of the #1 engine due to oil loss.

narrative_text: Nilisaini kazi ya oil filter kwenye engine namba moja ya ndege ya MD-80 ambayo kwa kweli ilifanywa na fundi mwenzangu; mimi nilishuhudia tu engine ikiwashwa na leak check ikifanyika, na hapo hakukuwa na uvujaji wowote. Baadaye ndege ilipata tatizo la engine namba moja kuzimwa ikiwa angani kutokana na kupoteza mafuta, hivyo jambo hili linahitaji kufuatiliwa kwa undani kuhusu ufungaji wa filter hiyo. Tafadhali zingatia kuwa hii ilikuwa zamu yangu ya kwanza baada ya likizo, na nilikuwa nimeshafanya kazi karibu masaa ishirini na nne bila kupumzika, hivyo saini zangu zote za zamu hii zichunguzwe kwa makini. Kuanzia sasa, kila fundi anapaswa kusaini tu kazi aliyoifanya mwenyewe, si kazi aliyoiona tu ikifanywa.
summary: Fundi alisaini kazi ya oil filter iliyofanywa na mfanyakazi mwenzake kwenye ndege ya MD-80, na baadaye ndege hiyo ilipata tatizo la engine kuzimwa angani kutokana na upotevu wa mafuta.

narrative_text: Nilisign yale oil filter job kwenye MD-80 #1 engine lakini kwa ukweli ile kazi ilifanywa na mechanic mwenzangu, mimi nilikuwa tu present wakati wa engine run na leak check, na haikuonyesha leak yoyote wakati huo. Later kwenye flight, #1 engine ilishutdown inflight due to oil loss, kwa hivyo inahitajika investigation ya hiyo filter installation asap. Tafadhali note that hii ilikuwa first shift yangu baada ya leave, na nilikuwa nimeshakaa karibu masaa 24 without rest, so double-check sign-offs zangu zote za shift hii. Going forward, kila mechanic ana-sign tu kazi ambayo yeye mwenyewe amefanya, si kuangalia tu na kutrust kazi ya mwenzake.
summary: Mechanic alisign kazi ya oil filter iliyofanywa na colleague kwenye MD-80, na baadaye engine #1 ika-shutdown inflight due to oil loss.

narrative_text: Received only a verbal turnover on the EMB 140 that was towed to the gate for steering and gust lock complaints, no corresponding EICAS messages, and gear pins already installed by the previous technician. Replaced the nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch per AMM and ran op checks on air/ground, steering, and gust lock, all satisfactory, then closed out the job per the AMM steps. Next shift please note the AMM task sequence includes a step to install the gear pins but the close-out does not call out their removal, aircraft returned to gate after takeoff unable to retract gear with pins still installed, verify pin removal is captured as a mandatory step before further dispatch.
summary: A technician closed out an EMB 140 nose gear WOW switch job per AMM but the aircraft returned after takeoff with gear pins still installed because the task card lacked a pin-removal step.

entities.text: nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch
op checks on air/ground, steering, and gust lock

narrative_text: Nilipokea taarifa ya mdomo tu kuhusu ndege ya EMB 140 iliyovutwa hadi geti kwa sababu ya matatizo ya steering na gust lock, bila ujumbe wowote wa EICAS, na pini za gear zilikuwa zimewekwa tayari na fundi wa awali. Nilibadilisha kihisi cha air/ground (WOW) cha gear ya mbele kulingana na AMM na kufanya op check za air/ground, steering, na gust lock, zote zikaonekana sawa, kisha nikafunga kazi kama taratibu za AMM zinavyoelekeza. Shift inayofuata tafadhali angalia kwamba hatua za AMM zinataka pini za gear ziwekwe lakini hazitaji zoezi la kuzitoa, ndege ilirudi geti baada ya kuondoka kwa kutokuweza kukunja gear huku pini bado zikiwa zimewekwa, hivyo hakikisheni utoaji wa pini umeandikwa kama hatua ya lazima kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Fundi alifunga kazi ya kihisi cha WOW cha gear ya mbele ya EMB 140 kwa mujibu wa AMM lakini ndege ilirudi baada ya kuondoka kwa sababu pini za gear zilikuwa bado zimewekwa kwani hatua ya kuzitoa haikutajwa kwenye karatasi ya kazi.

entities.text: kihisi cha air/ground (WOW) cha gear ya mbele
op check za air/ground, steering, na gust lock

narrative_text: Nilipata verbal turnover tu kwa hii EMB 140 iliyokuwa towed mpaka gate kwa sababu ya steering na gust lock issues, hakuna EICAS messages zozote, na gear pins zilikuwa already installed na yule technician wa kabla. Nika-replace ile nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch kama AMM inavyosema, then nika-run op checks za air/ground, steering, na gust lock, zote zikawa good, halafu nika-close out job kwa mujibu wa AMM steps. Shift inayokuja tuangalie vizuri, AMM task ina step ya kuinstall gear pins lakini close-out haitaji kuzitoa, ndege ilirudi gate baada ya takeoff haikuweza retract gear na pins bado zimeingia, so tuconfirm removal ya pins imewekwa as mandatory step before dispatch tena.
summary: Fundi ali-close out job ya WOW switch ya nose gear kwenye EMB 140 kwa mujibu wa AMM lakini ndege ilirudi gate baada ya takeoff kwa sababu gear pins zilikuwa bado zimeingia, task card ikikosa step ya kuzitoa.

entities.text: nose landing gear air/ground (WOW) prox switch
op checks za air/ground, steering, na gust lock

narrative_text: On the B757-200, structures team removed corroded intercostals aft of station 395 (RBL 12 floor frame) along with attach angles/brackets, and relocated two pulley assemblies from the forward side of station 395 frame to station 4377 frame for access, leaving them floating on the cables. In the rush to complete turnover paperwork, the pulley relocation was not logged, and the crew's interpretation that flagging of controls/pulleys was not required per standard practice has since been found incorrect per maintenance manual guidance. Next shift must verify cable routing and pulley assembly positions at station 395/4377, confirm cables are properly centered and secured, and update the logbook to reflect the actual work performed and flag cockpit controls as required. Recommend review of maintenance practice interpretation on flagging requirements before further reassembly.
summary: Structures crew relocated pulley assemblies during corrosion repair on a B757-200 but failed to log the move or flag controls, an omission later found to violate maintenance procedure, requiring follow-up verification and documentation correction.

narrative_text: Wakati wa zamu yetu kwenye ndege ya B757-200, timu ya structures iliondoa sehemu za intercostal zilizooza karibu na station 395 (eneo la RBL 12), pamoja na attach angles na brackets zake, na pia kuhamisha pulley assemblies mbili kutoka mbele ya frame ya station 395 kwenda station 4377 ili kupata nafasi ya kufanya kazi, huku zikiachwa zikielea kwenye cables. Kwa haraka ya kumaliza risiti za mabadiliko ya zamu, mwenzangu alisahau kuandika kuwa pulley assemblies zilihamishwa, na tulidhani kwa mujibu wa taratibu za matengenezo kuwa hatukuhitajika kuweka alama kwenye vidhibiti vya kwenye chumba cha marubani wala kwenye pulley hizo, jambo ambalo baadaye limegundulika kuwa si sahihi. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakiki mwelekeo wa cables na nafasi ya pulley assemblies karibu na station 395 na 4377, kuthibitisha kuwa ziko sawa, na kusahihisha kumbukumbu za kazi pamoja na kuweka alama zinazohitajika.
summary: Timu ya matengenezo ilihamisha pulley assemblies wakati wa ukarabati wa kutu kwenye ndege ya B757-200 lakini haikuandika mabadiliko hayo wala kuweka alama zinazohitajika, jambo lililobainika baadaye kukiuka taratibu, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji na urekebishaji wa kumbukumbu.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B757-200, sisi na structures partner tulikuwa tuna-disassemble corroded structure karibu na RBL 12, station 395 floor frame, na tukamaliza kuremove intercostals aft ya station 395 pamoja na attach angles/brackets zake. Pia tulimove pulley assemblies mbili kutoka forward side ya station 395 frame kwenda station 4377 frame kupata access, tukaziacha zika-float kwenye cables. Kwa sababu tulikuwa tume-rush kumalizia turnover paperwork, mwenzangu alisahau ku-note kwamba pulley assemblies zilimoved, na tuliassume per maintenance practices kuwa hatukuhitaji ku-flag controls cockpit ama pulleys hizo, lakini baadaye imegundulika interp yetu ilikuwa si sahihi. Next shift wako-verify cable routing na position za pulley assemblies karibu na station 395/4377, wa-confirm ziko centered vizuri, na wa-update logbook kuonyesha kazi halisi iliyofanywa plus ku-flag controls kama inavyotakiwa.
summary: Structures team walimove pulley assemblies during corrosion work kwenye B757-200 lakini hawakulog change wala kuflag controls, kitu ambacho later kimeonekana kukiuka procedure, hivyo inahitaji follow-up verification na kusahihisha logbook.

narrative_text: Aileron cable rigging task was completed about eight days ago on the Embraer, with cable tensions adjusted per AMM 27-11-01 using the temperature/load chart, but readings were taken as hangar temperature was dropping. Aircraft was later released for a Functional Check Flight; crew found ailerons stiff and could not engage the Aileron Trim System, so the flight was cancelled and aircraft returned. Follow-up inspection found the flight deck aileron control cables over-tensioned; next shift please re-verify rigging and tension against current cabin temperature before further flight release.
summary: Aileron control cables were found over-tensioned after an aborted Functional Check Flight, traced back to earlier rigging done during a changing hangar temperature, requiring re-verification before next release.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za aileron kwenye ndege ya Embraer ilifanyika siku nane zilizopita, tensheni ikawekwa kulingana na chati ya joto kama AMM 27-11-01 inavyoelekeza, lakini joto la hangar lilikuwa likishuka wakati vipimo vikichukuliwa. Baadaye ndege ilipelekwa kwa ndege ya majaribio ya kiufundi (FCF), lakini wafanyakazi wa ndege waligundua aileron zimekakamaa na hawakuweza kuwasha mfumo wa Aileron Trim, hivyo safari ilisitishwa na ndege ikarudishwa. Ukaguzi zaidi ulionyesha nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron eneo la flight deck zimekazwa kupita kiasi; zamu inayofuata iangalie tena urekebishaji na tensheni kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege kuruka tena.
summary: Nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron zilikutwa zimekazwa kupita kiasi baada ya ndege ya majaribio kusitishwa, hali iliyochangiwa na urekebishaji wa awali uliofanyika wakati joto la hangar likibadilika, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi kabla ya safari nyingine.

entities.text: nyaya za udhibiti wa aileron eneo la flight deck
kazi ya kurekebisha nyaya za aileron

narrative_text: Aileron cable rigging task ilifanywa siku nane zilizopita kwenye Embraer, tension ikawekwa kwa mujibu wa AMM 27-11-01 load chart, lakini temperature ya hangar ilikuwa ikishuka wakati tunachukua readings, so si sahihi kabisa. Baadaye aircraft ikaenda kwa FCF, lakini crew wakapata aileron zimekakamaa na hawakuweza kuengage Aileron Trim System, hivyo flight ikacancel na ndege ikarudi ZZZ. Baada ya inspection, walipata flight deck aileron control cables zimekazwa over-tensioned; next shift wakague tena rigging na tension kabla ya kutoa release nyingine, usifanye assumption tu.
summary: Aileron control cables zilikutwa over-tensioned baada ya FCF ku-cancel, ikitokana na rigging ya awali iliyofanyika wakati temperature ikibadilika, so next shift wanahitaji kurecheck kabla ya release.

narrative_text: MEL fire detector loop heat-test procedure is ambiguous on the B737 MAX 8 currently in the hangar; it is unclear whether each loop segment or the loop in total must be tested, and no AMM reference or approved heat source tool is provided. Maintenance Control advised testing the loop at any single point, but this could mask multiple faults across other segments. Next shift please escalate to Engineering/Tech Pubs for a clarified AMM procedure before signing off the MEL item.
summary: Technician flagged ambiguous MEL heat-test wording for the fire detector loop on a B737 MAX 8, requiring engineering clarification before further sign-off.

entities.text: MEL fire detector loop heat-test procedure

narrative_text: Utaratibu wa MEL wa kupima joto la loop ya detector ya moto kwenye ndege ya B737 MAX 8 iliyopo hangarini haueleweki vizuri; haijulikani wazi kama kila sehemu ya loop inapaswa kupimwa au loop nzima kwa ujumla, wala hakuna rejea ya AMM au chombo kilichoidhinishwa cha kuongeza joto. Maintenance Control walishauri kupima loop mahali popote tu, lakini hii inaweza kuficha hitilafu nyingine katika sehemu zingine za loop. Zamu ijayo tafadhali wasiliana na Uhandisi/Tech Pubs ili kupata utaratibu ulio wazi wa AMM kabla ya kukamilisha kazi hii ya MEL.
summary: Fundi aliripoti utata katika maelekezo ya MEL kuhusu upimaji wa joto wa loop ya detector ya moto kwenye B737 MAX 8, hivyo linahitaji ufafanuzi kutoka kwa Uhandisi kabla ya kuendelea.

entities.text: utaratibu wa MEL wa kupima joto

narrative_text: Kuna confusion na hii MEL procedure ya heat test kwa fire detector loop kwa B737 MAX 8 iko hangar sasa hivi; haiko clear kama unatakiwa kutest kila loop segment ama loop nzima kwa jumla, na hakuna AMM reference wala approved heat source tool imepewa. Maintenance Control walisema tu test loop popote, lakini hiyo inaweza kuficha faults zingine kwa segments zingine. Next shift tafadhali mfollow-up na Engineering/Tech Pubs wapate clear AMM procedure kabla ya ku-sign off hii MEL item.
summary: Fundi ame-flag confusion kwenye MEL heat-test procedure ya fire detector loop kwa B737 MAX 8, so inahitaji clarification kutoka Engineering kabla ya kuendelea na sign-off.

narrative_text: MD-80 drain valve circuit breaker B1-842 was popping whenever the selector switch was set to DRAIN with system pressurized; troubleshooting traced the fault to wire M637022 between P1-652 and 53-292-2, which were left disconnected at end of shift. This job was not closed out and should have carried over as an open write-up, but the paperwork went missing and a supervisor later signed it off after simply pressurizing the system with no fault found, without confirming P1-652 and 53-292-2 were reconnected. Next shift must verify continuity/reconnection of P1-652 to 53-292-2 and re-check the drain valve circuit before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Drain valve circuit breaker fault on an MD-80 was left mid-repair with wiring disconnected, and the write-up was lost and signed off without confirming the reconnection, so the connection needs verification before further release.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya MD-80, circuit breaker ya drain valve B1-842 ilikuwa ikiruka kila selector switch ikiwekwa DRAIN wakati mfumo umepressurized; uchunguzi ulionyesha tatizo liko kwenye waya M637022 kati ya P1-652 na 53-292-2, ambazo ziliachwa zikiwa hazijaunganishwa mwishoni mwa zamu. Kazi hii haikukamilika na ingepaswa kuendelezwa na zamu inayofuata, lakini karatasi ya write-up ilipotea na baadaye supervisor alisaini kuwa imekamilika baada tu ya kupressurize mfumo na kutokuona tatizo, bila kuthibitisha kama P1-652 na 53-292-2 zimeunganishwa tena. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe kuunganishwa kwa P1-652 na 53-292-2 na kukagua tena mzunguko wa drain valve kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Tatizo la circuit breaker ya drain valve kwenye MD-80 liliachwa likiwa halijakamilika na nyaya zikiwa hazijaunganishwa, na write-up ilipotea na kusainiwa bila kuthibitisha muunganisho, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

entities.text: circuit breaker ya drain valve B1-842

narrative_text: Kwa hio MD-80, drain valve circuit breaker B1-842 ilikuwa ina-pop kila time selector switch iko DRAIN na system iko pressurized; nikaenda troubleshoot nikapata tatizo iko kwa wire M637022 kati ya P1-652 na 53-292-2, ambazo niliziacha disconnected mwisho wa shift yangu. Job haiku-close, ilikuwa isupposed to carry over kama open write-up, lakini paper ilipotea na supervisor akaenda kusign off after just akipressurize system na aka-find no fault, bila hata kuconfirm kama P1-652 na 53-292-2 zimereconnect. Next shift wanafaa wa-verify connection ya P1-652 to 53-292-2 na warecheck drain valve circuit kabla ya kurelease aircraft.
summary: Drain valve circuit breaker ya MD-80 iliachwa mid-repair na wires zikiwa disconnected, na write-up ikapotea ikasainiwa without confirming reconnection, so inahitaji verification zaidi.

narrative_text: Inspector arrived for the fan blade lube job card and found the blades already removed, cleaned, and lubed by the previous shift, with only two mechanics present who had never performed this task before and could not confirm the procedure followed. Blades on the rack and the hub/disk marks were not in sequential order, so the inspector could not verify correct reinstallation sequence and had to redo the pre-inspection from scratch. Next shift: confirm blade/hub sequencing before closing the card and verify staffing meets the minimum four-mechanic requirement for this task.
summary: Inspector found fan blade lube task completed by an unqualified, understaffed previous crew with blades out of sequence, requiring a full re-inspection.

narrative_text: Wakati inspector alipofika kwa kazi ya lube ya fan blades, aligundua blades tayari zimeondolewa, kusafishwa na kulubiwa na zamu iliyotangulia, na waliokuwepo ni mechanics wawili tu ambao hawajawahi kufanya kazi hiyo na hawakuwa na uhakika wa taratibu zilizofuatwa. Blades kwenye rack na alama za hub/disk hazikuwa katika mpangilio sahihi, hivyo inspector alilazimika kurudia ukaguzi tangu mwanzo kabla ya kuendelea. Zamu inayofuata: hakikisheni mpangilio wa blades na hub umethibitishwa kabla ya kufunga kadi, na idadi ya wafanyakazi inakidhi mahitaji ya chini ya mechanics wanne kwa kazi hii.
summary: Inspector aligundua kazi ya lube ya fan blades ilifanywa na wafanyakazi wachache wasio na uzoefu, blades zikiwa hazijapangwa vizuri, hivyo ukaguzi mzima ulilazimika kurudiwa.

narrative_text: Sasa inspector alifika for the fan blade lube card akakuta blades tayari zime-removed na kulubiwa na previous shift, lakini wale mechanics wawili waliokuwa pale walikuwa hawajawahi do this task na hawakujua exactly nini kilifanyika. Blades kwa rack pamoja na hub/disk marks zilikuwa hazijapangwa sequentially, so inspector alilazimika ku-redo pre-inspection from scratch kabla ya kusign off. Next shift ihakikishe blade na hub sequence ime-verify kabla ya kufunga card, na pia minimum ya mechanics wanne inakuwepo for this kind of job.
summary: Inspector alikuta fan blade lube imefanywa na mechanics wasio na experience na blades hazijapangwa vizuri, so ilibidi arudie inspection yote.

narrative_text: On the B737-800, the #1 engine Anti-Ice HP Modulating valve was deferred per MEL following an ACARS alert prior to arrival; during the lockout procedure a mid-task interruption led to the wrong connector being pulled, which was only caught after further troubleshooting found no fault on the HP valve itself. Maintenance Control was consulted and both valves plus associated seals and placards are being replaced to fully resolve the annunciation. Incoming shift please confirm the MPM steps were re-verified from the start and check the connector routing before closing this task out.
summary: A B737-800 engine anti-ice valve deferral task was disrupted by a distraction, causing a wrong-connector removal that requires follow-up verification and full valve/seal replacement.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-800, valve ya Anti-Ice ya injini namba moja ilipangwa kuahirishwa kwa mujibu wa MEL baada ya taarifa ya ACARS kabla ya kutua; wakati wa utaratibu wa kufunga valve, kulitokea usumbufu wa kazi nyingine ambao ulisababisha kutolewa kwa kiungio kisicho sahihi. Baada ya kufanya ukaguzi zaidi bila kupata hitilafu kwenye valve ya HP, Udhibiti wa Matengenezo ulishauriwa na iliamuliwa kubadilisha valve zote mbili pamoja na seal na alama zake ili kumaliza tatizo kabisa. Zamu inayofuata itahakikishe hatua zote za MPM zimesomwa upya tangu mwanzo kabla ya kufunga kazi hii.
summary: Kazi ya kuahirisha valve ya kupasha moto injini kwenye ndege ya B737-800 ilikatizwa na usumbufu, hivyo kusababisha hitilafu ya kiungio na hatimaye uamuzi wa kubadilisha valve zote mbili.

entities.text: valve ya Anti-Ice ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Kwa hiyo B737-800, tuli-defer #1 engine Anti-Ice HP Modulating valve kufuatia MEL baada ya ACARS alert kabla ya arrival; lakini during lockout procedure kuliingia distraction ikatufanya tu-pull connector mbaya bila ku-verify step kikamilifu. Tuli-troubleshoot zaidi tukiangalia HP valve lakini hakuna fault iliyopatikana, so tuliconsult Maintenance Control na wakaamua tu-replace valves zote mbili pamoja na seals na placards ili ku-clear annunciation. Shift inayofuata please i-confirm MPM steps zime-redo from scratch na i-check connector routing kabla ya ku-close hii task.
summary: Deferral ya HP valve kwa B737-800 iliharibika kidogo baada ya distraction ikasababisha wrong connector kutolewa, hivyo valves zote mbili zinachangiwa kubadilishwa na follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: B767 #1 engine was reactivated to allow sheet metal access for a separate deferred item, and thrust reverser deploy/stow was checked normally during that time. The original PIREP was closed based on that check, but this MEL was tied to the #1 engine High Pressure Shut-Off Valve MEL and should not have been closed independently. Next shift please verify MEL status on #1 engine HP shutoff valve before further dispatch and re-open the log if needed.
summary: Technician closed a thrust reverser log tied to the #1 engine HP Shut-Off Valve MEL without noticing the linkage, requiring MEL status verification before next dispatch.

narrative_text: Injini namba 1 ya B767 iliwashwa upya ili kuruhusu ufikiaji wa sehemu ya sheet metal kwa ajili ya kazi nyingine iliyoahirishwa, na wakati huo ilionekana thrust reverser inafanya kazi vizuri ikitoka na kurudi kawaida. Ripoti ya awali ilifungwa kwa msingi wa ukaguzi huo, lakini MEL hiyo ilihusiana moja kwa moja na High Pressure Shut-Off Valve ya injini namba 1 na haikupaswa kufungwa peke yake. Shift inayofuata iangalie hali ya MEL ya valve hiyo kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuondoka, na kufungua tena log kama inahitajika.
summary: Fundi alifunga log ya thrust reverser iliyokuwa imeunganishwa na MEL ya High Pressure Shut-Off Valve bila kutambua uhusiano huo, hivyo inahitajika ukaguzi wa hali ya MEL kabla ya safari inayofuata.

entities.text: ufikiaji wa sehemu ya sheet metal

narrative_text: Tuli-reactivate #1 engine ya B767 ili kupata access ya sheet metal kwa ile deferred item, na wakati huo thrust reverser ilikuwa inadeploy na kustow normally so tukafunga ile PIREP ya awali. Lakini turns out ile log ilikuwa tied to the #1 engine High Pressure Shut-Off Valve MEL, so haikupaswa kufungwa separately kama tulivyofanya. Next shift please recheck MEL status ya HP shutoff valve kabla ya dispatch, na ku-reopen log kama inahitajika.
summary: Fundi alifunga log ya thrust reverser bila kutambua ilikuwa linked na MEL ya HP Shut-Off Valve, kwa hiyo MEL status inahitaji kucheckwa kabla ya next dispatch.

narrative_text: DC-10 30F: previous shift had #2 engine reverser reactivated for troubleshooting, throttle reverse block removed and inop procedures cleared, but this was not verbally briefed to the incoming lead technician during turnover. Two mechanics were only told to close #2 fan cowls and stow the work platform, which was done and the aircraft was dispatched with the reverser deferred as inop but not mechanically locked out per MEL. The reactivation entry was logged in the electronic maintenance logbook but was never pulled up or reviewed by the lead, technician, or helper before dispatch; recommend verifying #2 reverser status and confirming electronic logbook entries are actively cross-checked at every shift turnover, not just filed.
summary: A DC-10 30F was dispatched with the #2 engine reverser improperly deferred/not locked out because a verbal shift-turnover briefing omitted a reactivation detail that was only recorded in the electronic maintenance logbook.

entities.text: close #2 fan cowls and stow the work platform

narrative_text: Kwa ndege ya DC-10 30F, shift iliyopita ilikuwa imewasha tena reverser ya injini namba 2 kwa ajili ya troubleshooting, na vizuizi vya throttle reverse na taratibu za inop ziliondolewa, lakini hii haikuelezwa kwa mdomo kwa fundi kiongozi wa zamu iliyofuata wakati wa turnover. Mafundi wawili waliambiwa tu wafunge fan cowls za injini namba 2 na kurudisha jukwaa la kazi mahali pake, jambo lililofanyika, kisha ndege ikaruhusiwa kuruka huku reverser ikiwa imewekwa kama inop bila kufungwa kikamilifu kama MEL inavyotaka. Taarifa ya kuwashwa tena ilikuwepo kwenye logbook ya kielektroniki lakini haikuangaliwa na fundi kiongozi, fundi aliyeripoti, wala msaidizi kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuondoka; inashauriwa hali ya reverser namba 2 ithibitishwe na kila taarifa ya logbook ya kielektroniki isomwe kikamilifu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu.
summary: Ndege ya DC-10 30F iliruhusiwa kuondoka huku reverser ya injini namba 2 ikiwa haijafungwa ipasavyo kwa sababu taarifa muhimu ya turnover haikusemwa kwa mdomo bali iliachwa tu kwenye logbook ya kielektroniki isiyoangaliwa.

entities.text: kufunga fan cowls na kurudisha jukwaa la kazi

narrative_text: Kwa hii DC-10 30F, shift ya jana walikuwa wame-reactivate #2 engine reverser kwa troubleshooting, wakaremove throttle reverse block na wakaclear inop procedures, lakini hakuna aliyebrief lead technician mpya about hiyo during turnover. Sisi wawili tuliambiwa tu tu-close #2 fan cowls na turudishe work platform, tulifanya hivyo, ndege ikaenda ika-dispatch na reverser ikiwa deferred as inop lakini haikuwa locked out kama MEL inavyorequire. Hiyo reactivation entry ilikuwa imeandikwa kwenye electronic logbook lakini hakuna aliye-pull up ku-check, si lead, si mimi, wala helper; tafadhali verify status ya #2 reverser na hakikisha kila mtu ana-cross-check electronic logbook entries kabla ya turnover, siyo kuiacha tu system.
summary: DC-10 30F ilidispatch na #2 reverser haiko locked out ipasavyo kwa sababu turnover brief haikutaja reactivation ambayo ilikuwa tu logged kwenye electronic logbook na hakuna aliyeicheck.

entities.text: close #2 fan cowls na turudishe work platform

narrative_text: During trim troubleshooting on the B757-200, the rudder LVDT was replaced at shift change but the outgoing mechanic did not sign for the installation, so I verified his work and countersigned per the General Manual before briefing the oncoming crew on required rig and operational checks. The next crew found that LVDT faulty, installed a new one, and signed it off as serviceable in the logbook, but the RII block was never signed off since the LVDT is not clearly listed as an RII item near the autopilot system. Please review the logbook entry and confirm RII sign-off is completed, and flag this ambiguity in the manual for clarification.
summary: An unsigned RII inspection on a replaced rudder LVDT was missed during shift handover due to unclear manual guidance and needs follow-up sign-off.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kutafuta hitilafu ya trim kwenye B757-200, LVDT ya rudder ilibadilishwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu lakini fundi aliyeondoka hakusaini usakinishaji, hivyo nilikagua kazi yake na kutia sahihi kulingana na General Manual kabla ya kuwaeleza zamu inayofuata kuhusu ukaguzi wa rig na uendeshaji unaohitajika. Zamu iliyofuata ilikuta LVDT hiyo ni mbovu, wakaweka mpya, na kuisaini kwenye logbook kama salama, lakini sehemu ya RII haikutiwa sahihi kwa sababu LVDT haionekani wazi kama kipengele cha RII karibu na mfumo wa autopilot. Tafadhali kagua logbook na thibitisha sahihi ya RII imekamilika, na uarifu utata huu kwenye manual ili ufafanuliwe.
summary: Ukaguzi wa RII kwa LVDT ya rudder iliyobadilishwa haukusainiwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu kutokana na maelekezo yasiyo wazi kwenye manual, hivyo unahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Wakati tunacheck trim problem kwenye B757-200, rudder LVDT ilibadilishwa during shift change lakini yule mechanic hakusign installation, so nili-verify kazi yake na kuweka sahihi yangu kama General Manual inavyosema, kisha nikabrief oncoming crew kuhusu rig na operational checks required. Crew ya next ika-find hiyo LVDT ni bad, wakaweka new one, wakai-sign off kwenye logbook kama serviceable, lakini RII block haikusainiwa kwa sababu LVDT haiko clearly listed as RII item karibu na autopilot system. Please recheck logbook entry uconfirm RII sign-off imefanywa, na uflag hii ambiguity kwenye manual for clarification.
summary: RII sign-off ya rudder LVDT iliyobadilishwa ilikosekana during shift handover kwa sababu ya manual isiyo clear, inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: B747-400 returned to the field after crew reported crew oxygen system pressure loss of 120 PSI over 2 hours. Previous shift had traced a chronic oxygen leak to the thermal compensator/regulator area and replaced a faulty transducer, but the supply line was left disconnected and capped, masking the true leak at the first observer's mask quick-disconnect fitting during the leak check. Gate mechanics could not identify the no-flow issue found by flight crew during preflight, and the line was only reconnected after further troubleshooting, causing a 51-minute departure delay before the aircraft returned. Next shift needs to verify the mask quick-disconnect valve fitting has been replaced and confirm full system leak check is completed before next dispatch.
summary: A B747-400 returned to the field due to crew oxygen pressure loss traced to a defective mask quick-disconnect fitting, after a prior maintenance error left the supply line disconnected during leak checks.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B747-400 ilirudi uwanjani baada ya wafanyakazi wa ndege kuripoti upotevu wa presha ya oksijeni ya PSI 120 kwa muda wa masaa mawili. Shift iliyopita ilikuwa imegundua uvujaji wa muda mrefu karibu na thermal compensator au regulator, na wakabadilisha transducer mbovu, lakini bomba la kupeleka oksijeni lilisahaulika kuunganishwa tena, hivyo tatizo halisi la uvujaji kwenye fitting ya mask ya kiongozi wa kwanza halikugundulika wakati wa ukaguzi wa uvujaji. Mafundi wa geti walishindwa kutambua sababu ya kukosekana kwa mtiririko wa oksijeni ambao wafanyakazi wa ndege waligundua kabla ya safari, na hii ilisababisha ucheleweshaji wa dakika 51 kabla ya kuondoka, kisha ndege kurudi baada ya masaa mawili angani. Shift inayoingia inahitajika kuhakikisha fitting ya valve ya mask imebadilishwa kikamilifu na ukaguzi mzima wa mfumo wa oksijeni umekamilika kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege ya B747-400 ilirudi uwanjani kutokana na upotevu wa presha ya oksijeni uliosababishwa na fitting mbovu ya mask, baada ya hitilafu ya awali ya matengenezo kusababisha bomba la oksijeni kutounganishwa wakati wa ukaguzi wa uvujaji.

narrative_text: B747-400 imerudi field baada ya crew kuripoti oxygen pressure loss ya 120 PSI within 2 hours. Shift ya awali walikuwa wamekamua leak ikafikia thermal compensator ama regulator area, wakabadilisha transducer iliyokuwa faulty, lakini supply line ikasahaulika kuconnect back, hivyo iyo leak halisi kwenye first observer's mask quick-disconnect fitting haikugundulika during leak check. Gate mechs walishindwa kuidentify iyo no-flow issue ambayo flight crew waligundua during preflight checks, na hii ikasababisha delay ya dakika 51 kabla ya departure, then aircraft ikarudi baada ya 2 hours in flight. Next shift wahakikishe mask quick-disconnect fitting imereplace properly na full system leak check imekamilika before dispatch.
summary: B747-400 ilirudi baada ya oxygen pressure loss kutokana na fitting mbovu ya mask, baada ya mistake ya maintenance ya awali kusababisha supply line kubaki disconnected during leak check.

narrative_text: B737-300 came into the hangar after its second air return, right after shift change, for an overheat problem on the No. 2 engine. We opened the engine cowl and reverser cowl, checked the fire loop and ruled it out, then pressurized the bleed system with APU bleed holding the PRSOV open and found no leaks. Lead technician spotted a loose duct clamp on the case during a walk-around check; bolts, gasket and clamp were replaced and safety-wired per the maintenance manual. Next shift please confirm final ops check and log entry before return to service.
summary: Engine bleed duct clamp found loose during overheat troubleshooting on B737-300 and was reinstalled per manual; final ops check pending.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 iliingia hangarini baada ya kurudi mara ya pili angani kutokana na tatizo la joto kupita kiasi kwenye injini namba mbili, muda mfupi baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Tulifungua kifuniko cha injini na cha reverser, tukachunguza fire loop na kuthibitisha si chanzo cha tatizo, kisha tukatumia hewa ya APU kujaribu mfumo huku PRSOV ikiwa wazi, hakuna uvujaji ulioonekana. Fundi mkuu aligundua clamp ya duct ikiwa legelege wakati wa ukaguzi wa mwisho, hivyo bolti, gasket na clamp vilibadilishwa na kufungwa kwa waya wa usalama kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo. Zamu inayofuata itathibitishe ukaguzi wa mwisho wa uendeshaji na kuingiza taarifa kwenye logbook kabla ndege haijarudi kazini.
summary: Clamp ya duct ya mfumo wa injini ilipatikana ikiwa legelege wakati wa uchunguzi wa tatizo la joto kwenye B737-300 na ilirekebishwa kulingana na mwongozo; ukaguzi wa mwisho bado unasubiriwa.

entities.text: muda mfupi baada ya mabadiliko ya zamu

narrative_text: Ile B737-300 ilikuja hangar baada ya air return ya pili, ikaingia straight baada ya shift change kwa sababu ya overheat problem kwa engine namba mbili. Tulifungua engine cowl na reverser cowl, tuka-check fire loop tukaona sio hiyo, then tuka-pressurize system na APU bleed while holding PRSOV open, hakuna leak iliyopatikana. Lead tech alikuja aki-do walk-around akaona ile duct clamp iko loose, so tukaenda kwa engine shop kuchukua bolts, gasket na safety wire tool, tukainstall duct na kuifunga per maintenance manual. Next shift wa-confirm ops check na wa-log iyo entry before release.
summary: Duct clamp ilipatikana loose wakati wa troubleshooting ya overheat kwa B737-300, ikafanyiwa fix per manual, ops check bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: Picked up mid-shift: contract maintenance was unable to secure the loose passenger seat at row 5 on the B737-300, seat kept slipping in the track. I applied MEL 25-6 to defer the entire seat assembly and released the aircraft, but on review afterward realized this was the wrong MEL application for the discrepancy. Please have SAN contract maintenance inspect and repair the seat track properly and clear the MEL as soon as possible. Flag this in the logbook so the next shift is aware of the correction needed.
summary: An incorrect MEL was applied to defer a loose row 5 passenger seat on a B737-300, and SAN contract maintenance now needs to fix the seat and clear the MEL properly.

narrative_text: Nilipokea kazi hii ikiwa tayari inaendelea wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu: fundi wa kandarasi alishindwa kutengeneza kiti cha abiria kwenye safu ya tano cha ndege ya B737-300, kiti kilikuwa kinalegea kwenye njia yake. Niliamua kutumia MEL 25-6 kuahirisha kiti kizima na ndege ikaruka, lakini baadaye nikagundua kuwa hilo halikuwa chaguo sahihi kwa tatizo hilo. Tafadhali hakikisha timu ya kandarasi ya SAN inarekebisha kiti hicho vizuri na kufunga MEL hiyo haraka iwezekanavyo. Weka kumbukumbu sahihi kwenye logbook ili zamu inayofuata ijue hali halisi.
summary: MEL isiyofaa ilitumika kuahirisha kiti cha abiria kilicholegea kwenye safu ya tano cha ndege ya B737-300, na sasa timu ya SAN inahitajika kukirekebisha na kufunga MEL hiyo.

narrative_text: Nilikuta hii issue tayari iko in work wakati wa turnover kwa maint control. Contract maintenance walikuwa wanajaribu kufix seat ya row 5 kwenye hiyo B737-300, but seat ilikuwa loose kwenye track na haikuwa fixable. Niliamua kuapply MEL 25-6 for the whole seat assembly na aircraft ikadepart, lakini baadaye nikagundua that was the wrong call kwa hii discrepancy. Please arrange na SAN contract maintenance wafix properly na waclear ile MEL, na hakikisha logbook entry iko updated for next shift.
summary: Wrong MEL iliapplyiwa kwa loose seat ya row 5 kwenye B737-300, na SAN contract maintenance wanahitajika kufix na kuclear MEL hiyo properly.

narrative_text: A320 fuel booster pump was replaced per the maintenance manual; only the leak check and cover installation remained at shift change, and this was logged accordingly. Daylight shift reportedly found the pump leaking, but the subsequent removal, O-ring reseal, and reinstallation done by two different technicians was never logged. Follow-up: a wiring fault was later found and repaired, and on ops check the pump fell out of the wing, so the undocumented removal/reinstall needs to be traced and the logbook record corrected before the aircraft comes off MEL.
summary: An undocumented pump removal and reinstallation by the following shift left an incomplete logbook trail, and the pump later fell out of the wing during an ops check.

narrative_text: Pampu ya mafuta (fuel booster pump) ya ndege ya A320 ilibadilishwa kufuatana na mwongozo wa matengenezo; wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, kilichobaki ni ukaguzi wa uvujaji na kufunga kifuniko, jambo ambalo liliandikwa vizuri kwenye logbook. Zamu ya mchana iligundua kuwa pampu bado inavuja, na mafundi wawili tofauti waliondoa na kurudisha pampu baada ya kubadilisha O-ring, lakini hawakuandika hatua hiyo kwenye logbook. Baadaye tatizo la nyaya liligunduliwa na kutengenezwa, na wakati wa ukaguzi wa uendeshaji pampu ilianguka kutoka kwenye bawa; hivyo ni muhimu kufuatilia hatua zilizokosa kuandikwa na kusahihisha rekodi kabla ndege haijarudi kwenye huduma.
summary: Kutokuandikwa kwa uondoaji na urudishaji wa pampu ya mafuta na zamu iliyofuata kulisababisha mkanganyiko, na baadaye pampu ilianguka kutoka kwenye bawa wakati wa ukaguzi.

narrative_text: Tulichange fuel booster pump ya A320 kufuatana na maintenance manual; ilibaki tu leak check na kufit cover ndio job iishe, na nikaweka logbook entry kabla ya kuenda. Daylight crew wakaja wakasema pump bado inaleak, wakaremove na kuinstall tena baada ya kubadilisha O-rings, lakini hawakudocument hiyo action kwenye logbook. Baadaye wakapata wiring fault wakairepair, halafu wakati wa ops check pump ikaanguka kabisa kutoka wing - so tunahitaji kutrace hiyo undocumented removal/reinstall na kusahihisha logbook kabla aircraft haijarudi kwenye service.
summary: Kuna undocumented removal na reinstallation ya fuel booster pump iliyofanywa na daylight crew, and later pump ilianguka from the wing during ops check.

narrative_text: B777-200 (Aircraft X) is parked at base with an IDG fault that triggered an ELEC GEN OFF EICAS advisory; MEL 24-XX-X was applied by maintenance to release the aircraft for service. Logbook entries and supporting MEL documentation were not fully completed before release, so incoming techs need to verify the paperwork and confirm troubleshooting steps taken so far. Please coordinate with flight crew on the deferred item status before next departure.
summary: IDG fault with ELEC GEN OFF advisory on B777-200 was MEL'd but requires follow-up on incomplete documentation and crew coordination.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B777-200 (Aircraft X) imesimama hapa base ikiwa na hitilafu ya IDG iliyosababisha ujumbe wa tahadhari wa ELEC GEN OFF kwenye EICAS; wafanyakazi wa matengenezo walitumia MEL 24-XX-X ili kuiruhusu ndege iendelee kutumika. Hata hivyo, nyaraka za logbook na uthibitisho wa MEL hazikukamilika kabla ya kuiruhusu ndege hiyo, hivyo timu ya zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki makaratasi hayo na kufuatilia hatua za uchunguzi zilizofanyika. Tafadhali wasiliana na wafanyakazi wa ndege kuhusu hali ya kipengele hiki kilichoahirishwa kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Hitilafu ya IDG kwenye B777-200 ilitumiwa MEL lakini bado inahitaji ufuatiliaji wa nyaraka zisizokamilika na mawasiliano na wafanyakazi wa ndege.

entities.text: ujumbe wa tahadhari wa ELEC GEN OFF

narrative_text: Aircraft X, hii B777-200, iko parked hapa base na ina IDG fault ambayo imetrigger ile ELEC GEN OFF advisory kwa EICAS. Maintenance wame-apply MEL 24-XX-X kuiclear ndege iende for service, lakini logbook entries na hiyo MEL documentation hazija-completeka fully, so next shift inafaa i-verify hizo paperwork na kucheck ile troubleshooting iliyofanywa. Pia mkumbuke ku-coordinate na flight crew kuhusu status ya hio deferred item kabla ya next departure.
summary: IDG fault na ELEC GEN OFF advisory kwa B777-200 zime-MEL lakini documentation bado haijakamilika, so next shift ihakikishe follow-up na flight crew.

narrative_text: MD-80 fuel pump and harness replacement was completed on overtime; tape application on fuel pump wiring was delayed pending an Engineering Approval addition to the AMM for the correct tape type. After approval arrived, tape was installed, fuel tank plates and spar wire feed-through grommet were leak-checked during fuel transfer, and tie tape was installed and signed off. Because the AMT was rushing to make the start of the next regular shift, recommend next crew double-check that all fuel tank paperwork (Work Cards, AMM reference, GPM 13-02) is complete and a dedicated Fuel Tank Coordinator function is confirmed for any follow-on work.
summary: Fuel tank work on an MD-80 was closed out under time pressure after an AMM tape-approval delay, so paperwork completeness and coordinator assignment should be verified by the next shift.

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha fuel pump na harness kwenye ndege ya MD-80 ilikamilika wakati wa overtime, lakini kulikuwa na ucheleweshaji kwa sababu ya kusubiri idhini ya Uhandisi kuhusu aina sahihi ya tape ya kutumika kwenye AMM. Baada ya idhini kufika, tape iliwekwa, na ukaguzi wa uvujaji ulifanyika kwenye fuel tank plates na grommet ya spar wakati fuel ikihamishwa, kisha tie tape iliwekwa na kazi ikasainiwa. Kwa kuwa fundi alikuwa na haraka kuanza zamu yake ya kawaida, inashauriwa zamu inayofuata ihakikishe karatasi zote za fuel tank (Work Cards, AMM, na GPM 13-02) zimekamilika na afisa maalum wa uratibu wa fuel tank ateuliwe kwa kazi zijazo.
summary: Kazi ya fuel tank kwenye MD-80 ilikamilishwa haraka baada ya ucheleweshaji wa idhini ya AMM, hivyo zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakiki nyaraka na uteuzi wa mratibu wa fuel tank.

narrative_text: Tulikamilisha ile fuel pump na harness replacement job kwa MD-80 during overtime, lakini kulikuwa na delay kidogo tukisubiri Engineering Approval ya tape type ya ku-satisfy AMM. Baada ya approval kufika, nika-install tape, tukafanya leak check kwa fuel tank plates na spar grommet wakati fuel ikitransfer, then tie tape ikawekwa na ikasign off. Nilikuwa na haraka ku-start regular shift yangu, so next crew wa-double check paperwork zote za fuel tank (Work Cards, AMM, GPM 13-02) na kama Fuel Tank Coordinator ame-assign properly kwa kazi zinazokuja.
summary: Fuel tank job kwenye MD-80 ilikamilika kwa haraka baada ya delay ya AMM approval, so next shift inapaswa kuverify paperwork na coordinator assignment.

narrative_text: Field trip crew swapped the misinstalled left/right PSU emergency oxygen generator containers on Aircraft X overnight per base manager/crew chief instructions, bypassing the agreed AMM procedure. The required safety ring PN and insertion tool pin were not available, so the swap was done without them, creating a risk of inadvertent generator activation and injury. Next shift must verify generator positions against drawing spec, confirm correct tooling is on site before any further work, and re-inspect all connections per AMM before returning aircraft to service.
summary: Oxygen generator containers were swapped without required safety tooling, creating an activation hazard that needs verification and re-inspection.

entities.text: verify generator positions against drawing spec

narrative_text: Wahandisi walioko kwenye field trip walibadilisha vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vya PSU vilivyowekwa vibaya upande wa kushoto na kulia wa Ndege X usiku, kufuatia maagizo ya meneja wa kituo na crew chief, bila kufuata utaratibu wa AMM uliokubaliwa awali. Vifaa muhimu vya usalama - pete ya usalama na pini ya kuingiza - havikuwepo, hivyo kazi ilifanywa bila hivyo, na kuweka hatari ya vyombo kuwaka bila kukusudia na kusababisha majeraha. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe nafasi sahihi za vyombo kulingana na mchoro rasmi, ihakikishe zana zinazohitajika zipo kabla ya kuendelea na kazi, na ikague tena miunganisho yote kwa mujibu wa AMM kabla ndege haijarudishwa kazini.
summary: Vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vilibadilishwa bila zana muhimu za usalama, hali inayohitaji ukaguzi wa haraka kabla ndege haijarudi kazini.

entities.text: vyombo vya oksijeni ya dharura vya PSU
