narrative_text: Field trip crew walifanya swap ya PSU oxygen generator containers usiku kwenye Aircraft X, kufuata instructions za base manager na crew chief, badala ya kufuata AMM procedure iliyokubaliwa. Tatizo ni kwamba safety ring PN na insertion tool pin hazikuwepo site, so kazi ilifanywa bila hizo, ikileta risk ya generator ku-activate accidentally na kusababisha injury. Next shift lazima wa-verify positions za generators against drawing, wahakikishe correct tooling iko available kabla ya kuendelea, na wa-re-inspect connections zote per AMM kabla aircraft haija-return to service.
summary: Oxygen generators zilibadilishwa bila required safety tools, so kuna activation hazard inayohitaji verification na re-inspection haraka.

entities.text: verify positions za generators against drawing

narrative_text: MD-80 remains AOG following pilot report of a runaway nose-down horizontal stabilizer trim that felt heavy on landing; contract maintenance on scene at arrival confirmed the same defect. During troubleshooting we could not duplicate the runaway condition — trim now runs normally nose-down but will not run nose-up. We began replacement of the primary trim motor, but the new unit (a serviceable pull from another aircraft) arrived missing half its motor-to-gearbox gasket; maintenance control was notified and agreed to install using the old gasket for troubleshooting purposes while a replacement gasket is ordered AOG. Next shift please verify installation per AMM, confirm gasket arrival, and re-check nose-up trim operation before releasing aircraft.
summary: MD-80 stabilizer trim motor replacement in progress with a temporary gasket while nose-up trim fault is still unresolved and needs follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Ndege ya MD-80 bado iko chini (AOG) baada ya rubani kuripoti tatizo la trim ya horizontal stabilizer kushuka chini yenyewe na kuhisi uzito wakati wa kutua; wafanyakazi wa matengenezo ya kandarasi walithibitisha hitilafu hiyo walipofika. Wakati wa uchunguzi, hatukuweza kurudia hali ile ile ya kushuka yenyewe — sasa trim inafanya kazi vizuri ikienda chini lakini haifanyi kazi ikienda juu. Tulianza kubadilisha motor ya trim, lakini kipande kipya (kilichotolewa kikiwa bado kizima kutoka ndege nyingine) hakikuwa na nusu ya gasket inayounganisha motor na gearbox; ofisi ya udhibiti wa matengenezo ilijulishwa na kukubali tuweke gasket ya zamani kwa madhumuni ya uchunguzi huku gasket mpya ikiagizwa kwa haraka. Zamu inayofuata iangalie ufungaji kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo (AMM), ithibitishe kuwasili kwa gasket mpya, na ikague tena uendeshaji wa trim ikienda juu kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kurudi kazini.
summary: Ndege ya MD-80 inaendelea kufanyiwa ukarabati wa motor ya trim ya stabilizer huku ikitumia gasket ya muda, na tatizo la trim kwenda juu bado halijatatuliwa kikamilifu.

entities.text: ufungaji kulingana na mwongozo wa matengenezo

narrative_text: Hii MD-80 bado iko AOG, pilot alireport kwamba horizontal stabilizer trim ilikuwa na runaway nose-down na ilikuwa heavy wakati wa landing; contract maintenance guys walikuwa on scene wakaconfirm defect hiyo hiyo. Tulitry ku-troubleshoot lakini hatuku-duplicate ile runaway condition — sasa trim inaoperate fine ikienda nose-down lakini haiwork ikienda nose-up. Tulianza kubadilisha primary trim motor, lakini ile unit mpya (ilikuwa serviceable kutoka ndege ingine) ilikuja missing half ya gasket kati ya motor na gearbox; tuli-notify maintenance control wakakubali tuinstall na ile old gasket kwa purposes za troubleshooting wakati gasket mpya inaorder AOG. Shift inayofuata please verify installation per AMM, confirm kama gasket imefika, na urudie kucheck nose-up trim operation kabla ya ku-release aircraft.
summary: MD-80 iko AOG, tunaendelea na trim motor replacement na temporary gasket, lakini nose-up trim fault bado haijafix kabisa so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: For A320 thrust reverser C-Duct harness work, note that the IPC currently shows a straight backshell for Connector 905P (left and right sides), but the correct installation per engineering requires a 90-degree backshell to give proper wire bend radius. This connector feeds the thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor, which is critical flight crew indication, so installing the wrong backshell risks wire stress and possible sensor malfunction. An engineering request has been filed to revise the work order and IPC illustrations/parts lists — next shift please confirm status of that revision with Engineering before releasing any further harness installs.
summary: IPC incorrectly specifies straight backshells for thrust reverser Connector 905P harnesses on both C-Ducts; engineering revision to correct to 90-degree backshells is in progress and needs follow-up before next installation.

entities.text: thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor
revise the work order and IPC illustrations/parts lists

narrative_text: Kwa kazi ya waya za thrust reverser C-Duct za ndege ya A320, kitabu cha IPC bado kinaonyesha backshell ya moja kwa moja (straight) kwa Connector 905P, upande wa kushoto na kulia, lakini kulingana na maelekezo sahihi ya uhandisi inatakiwa iwe backshell ya pembe ya digrii 90 ili kuepusha waya kuinama vibaya. Connector hii inaunganisha na proximity sensor ya thrust reverser inayotoa taarifa muhimu kwa marubani, hivyo kutumia backshell isiyo sahihi kunaweza kusababisha waya kubanwa na sensor kushindwa kufanya kazi vizuri. Ombi la kurekebisha work order na michoro ya IPC limeshapelekwa kwa idara ya uhandisi; zamu inayofuata iangalie maendeleo ya marekebisho hayo kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji mwingine wa waya.
summary: IPC inaonyesha backshell isiyo sahihi kwa Connector 905P ya thrust reverser katika ndege za A320, na marekebisho ya kiuhandisi yanasubiriwa kufuatiliwa na zamu inayofuata.

entities.text: kurekebisha work order na michoro ya IPC

narrative_text: Kwa hii A320 thrust reverser C-Duct harness job, IPC bado imeandika straight backshell kwa Connector 905P, both left na right side, lakini per engineering ni lazima iwe 90-degree backshell ndio wire bend radius iwe sawa. Connector hii inaenda kwa thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor, ambayo ni critical indication kwa flight crew, so ukiweka wrong backshell utaleta wire stress na sensor inaweza ku-malfunction. Engineering wameshafanya request ya ku-revise hiyo work order na IPC illustrations/parts list, kwa hivyo next shift wa-confirm status ya revision hiyo na Engineering kabla ya kuendelea na installation nyingine.
summary: IPC ina wrong backshell part number kwa Connector 905P thrust reverser harness on A320, Engineering wanafanya revision na next shift wanapaswa ku-follow up kabla ya installation.

entities.text: thrust reverser stow and lock proximity sensor
ku-revise hiyo work order na IPC illustrations/parts list

narrative_text: Overnight shift completed the wire splice repair on MD-11 (electrical wiring/connectors) in the area affected by the external power/APU and fuel system faults, following on from day shift avionics who ran the new wiring to the electrical center. Repair was done per wiring diagrams and maintenance manuals, and cursory checks were performed with the crew chief and engineer, with work signed off on the job card. Next shift/routing manager must ensure the aircraft is pushed back and engines run to fully verify the fuel system, APU, and #3 engine shutdown function before return to service.
summary: Handover on MD-11 wiring splice repair for electrical/fuel system faults, pending engine-run verification including #3 engine shutdown check.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku imekamilisha kazi ya kuunganisha nyaya (splice) kwenye ndege ya MD-11 katika eneo lililokuwa na hitilafu za nguvu ya nje, APU, na mfumo wa mafuta, kufuatia kazi ya awali ya zamu ya mchana ya avionics waliopitisha nyaya mpya hadi kituo cha umeme. Ukarabati ulifanywa kwa kuzingatia michoro ya wiring na miongozo ya matengenezo, na ukaguzi wa awali ulifanyika pamoja na crew chief na engineer, kazi ikathibitishwa kwenye job card. Zamu inayokuja inatakiwa kuhakikisha ndege inasukumwa nje na injini kuwashwa kwa ajili ya uthibitisho kamili wa mifumo hiyo, hasa kuhusiana na tatizo la kuzima injini namba tatu.
summary: Taarifa ya makabidhiano kuhusu ukarabati wa nyaya kwenye MD-11 unaosubiri uthibitisho wa mfumo wa mafuta na injini namba tatu.

entities.text: injini kuwashwa kwa ajili ya uthibitisho

narrative_text: Night shift tume-complete ile wire splice repair kwenye MD-11, kwenye eneo lililokuwa na issues za external power, APU, na fuel system. Tulipokea turnover kutoka day shift avionics ambao walikuwa wame-run new wiring mpaka electrical center, hivyo tuli-splice kwa kutumia wiring diagrams na maintenance manuals, tukafanya cursory checks na crew chief na engineer, kazi ikasainiwa kwenye job card. Next shift lazima ihakikishe aircraft inapushiwa nje na engine ku-run kwa full verification ya fuel system na APU, hasa kwa hiyo issue ya kushut down engine number three.
summary: Handover kwa MD-11 kuhusu wire splice repair ambayo inasubiri engine run verification, especially engine #3 shutdown issue.

narrative_text: During RII inspection of the replacement Number 8 Slat for the B767-300 in the hangar, I found an existing aircraft damage sticker and an adjacent dent on the inboard leading edge lip, not visible earlier since the slat was packed inverted in the crate. I halted the inspection and asked Line Maintenance to trace the part's prior aircraft history, but the sticker could not be matched to any recorded damage on that aircraft or wing. Next shift needs to continue researching SRM damage limits for this area and hold installation until serviceability is confirmed.
summary: An unexplained damage sticker and dent were found on a replacement B767-300 slat during RII inspection, and installation is on hold pending SRM damage-limit review and part-history verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII wa Slat namba 8 mbadala kwa ndege ya B767-300 pale hangarini, nilikuta stika ya uharibifu iliyokuwepo awali pamoja na bonyeo karibu na ukingo wa mbele wa ndani, ambayo haikuonekana mwanzoni kwa sababu slat ilifungwa kinyume ndani ya kasha. Nilisimamisha ukaguzi na kuomba Line Maintenance wafuatilie historia ya sehemu hiyo kwenye ndege iliyotangulia, lakini stika hiyo haikulingana na rekodi yoyote ya uharibifu wa ndege au bawa hilo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuendelea kuchunguza mipaka ya uharibifu kwenye SRM na kusimamisha usakinishaji hadi uthibitisho wa ubora wa kifaa upatikane.
summary: Stika ya uharibifu isiyoeleweka na bonyeo viligundulika kwenye slat mbadala ya B767-300 wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII, hivyo usakinishaji umesimamishwa hadi uthibitisho wa mipaka ya uharibifu na historia ya kifaa ukamilike.

narrative_text: So wakati na-do RII inspection ya Number 8 Slat mbadala kwa B767-300 pale hangar, nikapata damage sticker ya zamani na dent karibu na inboard leading edge lip, haikuonekana awali coz slat ilikuwa packed inverted kwa crate. Nikastop inspection na ku-ask Line Maintenance wa-trace part history ya aircraft iliyotangulia, lakini sticker haikumatch na damage records za hiyo aircraft au wing. Next shift wanahitaji ku-continue checking SRM damage limits for that area na ku-hold installation mpaka serviceability i-confirm.
summary: Kuna damage sticker na dent zisizoelezeka zilipatikana kwenye replacement slat ya B767-300 during RII inspection, so installation imesimama pending SRM check na part history verification.

narrative_text: While reviewing the work package for the Dash 8-400 (job card for the tail cone repair), I missed checking the RII buyback, major repair sign-off, and airworthiness release before shift end. I handed the incomplete package to the swing shift supervisor at 1800, who caught the discrepancies after the aircraft had already departed at 0100. A mechanic had to be dispatched to the diversion station to complete the RII inspection and issue the major repair airworthiness release. Next shift please note we need better paperwork review support during the day, as workload and constant callouts are causing packages to be missed.
summary: A lead technician missed reviewing critical RII and airworthiness paperwork on a Dash 8-400 tail cone repair before the aircraft departed, requiring a mechanic to be sent to the diversion station to close it out.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukagua kifurushi cha kazi cha ndege ya Dash 8-400 kinachohusiana na ukarabati wa tail cone, sikuweza kukamilisha ukaguzi wa RII buyback, uthibitisho wa ukarabati mkubwa, na cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Nilikabidhi kifurushi hicho kwa msimamizi wa zamu ya jioni saa sita mchana, ambaye alibaini makosa hayo baada ya ndege kuwa imeondoka tayari saa saba usiku. Fundi mmoja alilazimika kutumwa kituo cha dharura kukamilisha ukaguzi wa RII na kutoa cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege. Zamu inayokuja tafadhali zingatieni haja ya usaidizi zaidi wa kukagua nyaraka mchana kwa sababu shughuli nyingi na simu za mara kwa mara zinasababisha makosa kama haya.
summary: Msimamizi mkuu wa ufundi alishindwa kukagua nyaraka muhimu za RII na uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege ya Dash 8-400 kabla ya kuondoka, hivyo fundi alihitajika kutumwa kituo kingine kukamilisha kazi hiyo.

entities.text: cheti cha uwezo wa kurudi kwa ndege

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nikireview work package ya Dash 8-400, job card ya tail cone repair, lakini sikupata time ya kucheck ile RII buyback, major repair sign-off, na airworthiness release kabla ya shift kuisha. Nikahand over package kwa swing shift supervisor saa sita mchana, na ndiye alicatch zile discrepancies baada ya aircraft kuwa imeondoka saa saba usiku. Mechanic alilazimika kutumwa kwa station ile ndege ilienda ili afanye RII na atoe airworthiness release ya major repair. Kwa next shift, tunahitaji msaada zaidi wa kureview paperwork mchana, coz workload ni mzito sana na maintenance control na ops wanacall constantly, hivyo packages zinapass bila kucheck properly.
summary: Lead technician alimiss kucheck RII buyback na airworthiness release kwenye Dash 8-400 tail cone repair kabla aircraft kuondoka, hivyo mechanic akatumwa station nyingine kukamilisha paperwork.

narrative_text: Continuing work on the Citation 560 Ultra rudder trim system: previous shift replaced the trim actuator and signed it off before I took over, so cable installation was not independently rechecked. Rudder trim was traveling more in one direction than the other, so the trim tab control chain was recentered on the sprocket in the cockpit and at the actuator, cables were retensioned, and the travel check passed within limits. Next shift should verify the actuator installation and sprocket centering were properly documented, and confirm no further asymmetry shows up on subsequent checks.
summary: Rudder trim asymmetry on the Citation 560 Ultra was corrected by recentering the trim tab chain/sprocket and retensioning cables, but actuator installation was not independently verified and needs follow-up documentation.

narrative_text: Tunaendelea na kazi ya mfumo wa rudder trim wa ndege ya Citation 560 Ultra; shift iliyopita walibadilisha actuator ya trim na kuisaini kabla sijapokea kazi, hivyo usimamizi wa cables haukuangaliwa upya kwa makini. Rudder trim ilikuwa ikisogea zaidi upande mmoja kuliko mwingine, kwa hiyo mnyororo wa udhibiti wa trim tab ulirekebishwa katikati kwenye gia cockpit na pia kwenye actuator, cables zikawekwa tension tena, na ukaguzi wa msogeo ukapita ndani ya viwango vinavyokubalika. Shift inayokuja inapaswa kuhakiki kama ufungaji wa actuator na urekebishaji wa gia uliandikwa vizuri, na kufuatilia kama tatizo la usawa halitajitokeza tena.
summary: Tatizo la usawa wa rudder trim kwenye Citation 560 Ultra lilirekebishwa kwa kuweka katikati mnyororo na gia ya trim tab na kuweka tension ya cables, lakini ufungaji wa actuator haujathibitishwa kikamilifu na unahitaji ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: mnyororo wa udhibiti wa trim tab

narrative_text: Tunaendelea na ile job ya rudder trim system kwa Citation 560 Ultra; previous shift walibadilisha ile trim actuator wakaisign off before nikuje, so sikucheck vizuri kama cable installation ilikuwa sahihi. Rudder trim ilikua ikitravel zaidi upande mmoja kuliko mwingine, so tuli-recenter ile trim tab chain kwenye sprocket cockpit na pia kwenye actuator, tuka-tension cables, na travel check ikapass within limits. Next shift wanafaa wa-verify kama actuator installation na sprocket centering zimedocumented vizuri, na kufollow-up kama asymmetry haitarudi tena.
summary: Rudder trim asymmetry kwenye Citation 560 Ultra ilifixiwa kwa kurecenter chain/sprocket na kutension cables, lakini actuator installation haija-verify fully so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: Overnight shift adjusted the L1 door stops on the MD-80 per the job card, with a second mechanic assisting under the assumption this was a routine door rig. The prior write-up actually referenced a failed running torque check on the door set screws, but this detail was not passed on at turnover, so the rig was completed per the maintenance manual without replacing any hardware. Discrepancy was caught the following night; aircraft did not fly in this condition and new set screws/nuts have now been ordered. Follow-up: door inspection required once parts arrive, and turnover notes need to specify running torque failures and manual references going forward.
summary: A door rig on an MD-80 was completed without addressing a set-screw running torque failure because the turnover note lacked technical detail, requiring new parts and a follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Tuliwekewa kazi ya kurekebisha L1 door stops kwenye ndege ya MD-80 kama ilivyoandikwa kwenye job card, na fundi mwingine alitumwa kutusaidia akidhani ni door rig ya kawaida. Maandishi ya awali ya matengenezo kwa kweli yalihusu set screws zilizoshindwa 'running torque check', lakini taarifa hii haikuelezwa vizuri wakati wa turnover, hivyo tuliendelea kurekebisha mlango kwa mujibu wa maintenance manual bila kubadilisha vipuri. Tatizo liligundulika usiku uliofuata, ndege haikuruka katika hali hiyo, na vipuri vipya vimeshaagizwa. Kinachosubiriwa: ukaguzi wa mlango baada ya vipuri kufika, na turnover notes zinahitaji kuwa na maelezo zaidi ya kiufundi pamoja na rejea za maintenance manual.
summary: Marekebisho ya mlango wa MD-80 yalifanywa bila kushughulikia tatizo la set screws kwa sababu turnover haikuwa na maelezo ya kutosha, hivyo vipuri vipya vimeagizwa na ukaguzi unasubiriwa.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tulipewa job ya kuadjust L1 door stops kwenye MD-80 kulingana na job card, na mechanic mwingine akaja kuassist akifikiri ni door rig tu ya kawaida. Turns out ile maandishi ya awali ilikuwa inarefer kwa set screws ambazo zilifail ile running torque check, lakini hiyo detail haikuwekwa clearly kwenye turnover, so tukafanya rig kama per maintenance manual bila kuorder parts mpya. Tulidiscover discrepancy hiyo usiku uliofuata - aircraft haikufly hivyo, na parts mpya zimeagizwa sasa. Follow-up: door inspection lazima ifanyike parts zikifika, na next time turnover sheet iwe na technical details na maintenance manual references ziko clear.
summary: Door rig ya MD-80 ilifanywa bila kuaddress tatizo la set screws kwa sababu turnover haikuwa na details za kutosha, hivyo parts mpya zimeorder na inspection inasubiriwa.

narrative_text: B737-400 (tail assigned for gear/flap damage rectification) had the left-hand inboard trailing edge aft flap signed off as installed and rigged by prior shift mechanic and inspector, but on inspection the eccentric dead-weight rollers were badly out of rig, loose enough to cause severe vibration in service. Re-rigged the flap this shift and walked a new line mechanic through the correct procedure, since the flap ships from the shop with cotter keys installed but unrigged. Next shift needs to verify the sign-off/logbook discrepancy is reported and confirm no other flap surfaces from this aircraft were signed off without proper rig checks.
summary: A left inboard aft flap on a B737-400 was falsely signed off as rigged by the previous shift, requiring re-rig and follow-up on the paperwork discrepancy.

entities.text: left-hand inboard trailing edge aft flap

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-400 iliyokuwa ikirekebishwa baada ya uharibifu wa gia na flap ilikuwa na flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto ambayo ilisainiwa na fundi na mkaguzi wa zamu iliyopita kuwa imewekwa na ku-rigiwa vizuri, lakini wakati wa ukaguzi ilionekana rollers za eccentric hazikuwa sawa kabisa, na hii ingeweza kusababisha mtetemo mkubwa wakati wa safari. Katika zamu hii, flap hiyo imerekebishwa upya na fundi mpya wa line amefundishwa jinsi ya kufanya kazi hiyo kwa usahihi, kwani flap hutoka workshop ikiwa na cotter keys zimewekwa lakini haijapangwa vizuri. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuripoti tofauti hii ya saini kwenye logbook na kuhakikisha hakuna sehemu nyingine za flap za ndege hii zilizosainiwa bila ukaguzi sahihi wa urekebishaji.
summary: Flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto ya ndege ya B737-400 ilisainiwa kimakosa kuwa imerekebishwa na zamu iliyopita, hivyo ikahitaji kufanyiwa kazi upya na kufuatiliwa kwa tofauti ya nyaraka.

entities.text: flap ya nyuma ya ndani upande wa kushoto
kuripoti tofauti hii ya saini kwenye logbook

narrative_text: Hiyo B737-400 ambayo ilikuwa na damage kwa gear na flaps, ile L-hand inboard aft flap ilikuwa imesainiwa na mech na inspector wa shift iliyopita kwamba imewekwa na kurigiwa, lakini nikacheck nikaona eccentric rollers ziko out of rig kabisa, loose sana, ingeeza cause vibration kubwa in flight. Nimeirig upya hiyo flap saa hii shift na nimeshow new line mech vile procedure inaenda, kwa sababu flap inatoka shop na cotter keys zimewekwa lakini haijarigiwa. Next shift wanahitaji ku-report hiyo discrepancy ya logbook sign-off na ku-confirm kama kuna flap zingine za hiyo aircraft zilisainiwa bila proper rig check.
summary: Ile L-hand aft flap ya B737-400 ilisainiwa vibaya na shift iliyopita ati imerigiwa, so ilibidi tuirig upya na kufuatilia hiyo discrepancy ya paperwork.

entities.text: ku-report hiyo discrepancy ya logbook sign-off

narrative_text: MD-80 overnight service check: swing shift Avionics had been troubleshooting a pax intercom breaker popping, and grave shift took over to R&R 3 pax service units. Around 0430 Avionics installed the 3 new units while I completed the oxygen generator transfer, but I forgot to call for inspection before Avionics signed off the logbook write-up and I signed off the service check after 0600 with the aircraft already scheduled to fly. Aircraft has since flown 3 legs and is now at ZZZ1 for heavy check - please notify Inspection there to review this maintenance and open a line non-routine work card.
summary: A missed inspection call-out after pax service unit replacement on an MD-80 needs to be reviewed by Inspection at ZZZ1 before further dispatch.

narrative_text: Wakati wa service check ya usiku kwa ndege ya MD-80, shift ya jioni ya Avionics walikuwa wakifanya troubleshooting ya intercom ya abiria iliyokuwa ikiondoa breaker mara kwa mara, kisha sisi wa shift ya usiku tukapewa kazi ya kubadilisha vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria. Karibu saa kumi na moja alfajiri, Avionics walimaliza kufunga vitengo vipya huku mimi nikikamilisha kazi ya kuhamisha jenereta za oksijeni, lakini nilisahau kuita ukaguzi kabla Avionics hawajatia sahihi kwenye logbook, na mimi nikatia sahihi baada ya saa kumi na mbili asubuhi ndege ikiwa tayari imepangiwa safari. Ndege imeshafanya safari tatu na sasa iko ZZZ1 kwa heavy check - idara ya ukaguzi pale inahitaji kuarifiwa ili kuchunguza kazi hii na kutengeneza non-routine work card.
summary: Ukaguzi ulisahaulika baada ya kubadilishwa kwa vitengo vya huduma za abiria kwenye ndege ya MD-80, na hali hiyo sasa inahitaji kuangaliwa na idara ya ukaguzi huko ZZZ1.

entities.text: vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria
kubadilisha vitengo vitatu vya huduma za abiria

narrative_text: Kwa hii overnight service check ya MD-80, swing shift Avionics walikuwa wanafanya troubleshooting ya pax intercom ambayo ilikuwa inapop breaker, then sisi grave shift tukaambiwa turemove and replace zile 3 pax service units. Karibu 0430 Avionics walikuja na units mpya wakaziinstall wakati mimi nafanya oxygen generator transfer, but nikasahau kucall inspection kabla Avionics hawajasign logbook write-up, na mimi nikasign service check baada ya 0600 ndege ikiwa already scheduled for a flight. Ndege imeshafly 3 trips na sasa iko ZZZ1 kwa heavy check - inspection department pale wanafaa kuarifiwa wachunguze hii maintenance na wagenerate line non-routine work card.
summary: Kuna missed inspection call-out after pax service units replacement kwenye MD-80, na sasa inahitaji review na Inspection huko ZZZ1.

entities.text: remove and replace zile 3 pax service units

narrative_text: Night shift installed the air intake spinner extension on the #2 engine but did not sign off the corresponding block on the 'B' check work card covering all three GPM parts. Day shift completed the spinner and fairing installation, torqued both to manual values, and signed the block for all three items even though the extension was fitted by the previous crew. Please verify with the crew chief who actually performed the extension install so the card reflects the correct technician, and confirm torque values on the extension were properly recorded.
summary: Sign-off on the #2 engine air intake spinner 'B' check card does not match who actually installed the spinner extension, requiring verification.

narrative_text: Zamu ya usiku waliweka spinner extension kwenye engine namba mbili lakini hawakusaini sehemu husika kwenye kadi ya ukaguzi wa 'B' inayohusu vipengele vyote vitatu vya GPM. Zamu ya mchana tulikamilisha ufungaji wa spinner na fairing, tukazibana kwa torque sahihi kulingana na maintenance manual, na kusaini kadi hiyo kwa vitu vyote vitatu ingawa extension iliwekwa na zamu iliyopita. Tafadhali thibitisha na crew chief husika ni nani hasa aliyefunga extension ili kadi ionyeshe fundi sahihi, na uhakiki torque values za extension zimeandikwa vizuri.
summary: Kuna tofauti kati ya aliyesaini kadi ya ukaguzi wa 'B' na aliyefunga spinner extension kwenye engine namba mbili, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho.

entities.text: torque sahihi kulingana na maintenance manual

narrative_text: Night shift walifunga ile air intake spinner extension kwa engine number two lakini hawaku-sign ile block kwenye 'B' check card ambayo inacover vitu vitatu vya GPM. Mimi nikaja nika-complete installation ya spinner na fairing, nika-torque zote according to manual, na nika-sign card kwa vitu vyote vitatu ata ingawa extension iliwekwa na crew ya usiku. Ni lazima tu-verify na crew chief ni nani hasa alifanya install ya extension ili documentation iwe sahihi, na tu-confirm torque values za extension zi-recorded properly.
summary: Kuna discrepancy kwenye sign-off ya 'B' check card ya spinner extension kwa engine number two, inahitaji verification na crew chief.

narrative_text: After completing the aircraft job, we separated our three tool containers (SLI labels attached, no HAZMAT) from three HAZMAT-labeled hard cases on the baggage cart and briefed the escort that only the tooling boxes should go out on the first ZZZ1 flight, with the HAZMAT cases routed through the freight house. She was told to leave the cart in place and to pass on a turnover note if she wasn't available in the morning, but I did not manage to hand her a copy of step 3A after Maintenance Control confirmed receipt of all documents. Next shift needs to verify the HAZMAT cases were never loaded with our tooling and confirm the missing paperwork copy is closed out with Maintenance Control.
summary: Tooling and HAZMAT containers were segregated and briefed to the escort before the ZZZ1 flight, but a paperwork copy (step 3A) was not handed over, requiring follow-up confirmation.

narrative_text: Baada ya kumaliza kazi kwenye ndege, tulitenganisha masanduku matatu ya zana zetu (yenye lebo za SLI, bila HAZMAT) na masanduku matatu magumu yenye lebo za HAZMAT kwenye gari la mizigo, na tukamweleza msindikizaji kuwa masanduku ya zana pekee ndiyo yatakayosafirishwa kwenye ndege ya kwanza ya ZZZ1, huku masanduku ya HAZMAT yakipitishwa kupitia idara ya mizigo. Aliambiwa aache gari mahali pale pale na aandike taarifa ya makabidhiano kama hatakuwepo asubuhi, lakini sikufanikiwa kumpa nakala ya hatua ya 3A baada ya Udhibiti wa Matengenezo kuthibitisha kupokea nyaraka zote. Zamu inayofuata inahitaji kuhakikisha masanduku ya HAZMAT hayakupakiwa pamoja na zana zetu, na kufuatilia nakala ya nyaraka iliyokosekana na Udhibiti wa Matengenezo.
summary: Zana na masanduku ya HAZMAT yalitenganishwa na kuelezwa kwa msindikizaji kabla ya ndege ya ZZZ1, lakini nakala ya nyaraka (hatua ya 3A) haikukabidhiwa, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

entities.text: masanduku magumu yenye lebo za HAZMAT

narrative_text: Baada ya kumaliza job kwa aircraft, tuli-separate zile tool containers tatu zenye SLI labels, no HAZMAT, na zile hard cases tatu za HAZMAT kwa baggage cart, tukamwambia escort ati boxes za tooling ndizo zitaenda na first ZZZ1 flight tu, na hizo HAZMAT ziende through freight house. Tulimwambia aache cart pale pale na aweke turnover note kama hatakuwa available asubuhi, lakini sikufanikiwa kumpea copy ya step 3A baada ya Maintenance Control ku-confirm wamepokea documents zote. Next shift wahakikishe hizo HAZMAT hazikuenda na tooling yetu, na wa-follow up hiyo missing paperwork na Maintenance Control.
summary: Tooling na HAZMAT containers zili-separate na kuelezwa kwa escort kabla ya ZZZ1 flight, lakini copy ya step 3A haikupewa, so inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: B767-300ER left engine hydraulic pump job was passed through four different shift handovers before completion, and the logbook entry noting case drain and pressure filters removed with housing loosely installed was never verbally reiterated. Incoming technician completed hose/filter housing tightening and proceeded straight to cockpit for engine run without checking the logbook, skipping the required filter contamination check. Upon later removing the housing it was found that no filters were installed at all. Next shift must verbally confirm all open logbook items on multi-shift jobs, especially hydraulic filter status, before any engine run is attempted.
summary: A B767 left engine hydraulic pump job handed over across four shifts led to an engine run being performed without filters installed because the logbook note was not verbally reiterated.

narrative_text: Kazi ya pump ya hydraulic ya engine ya kushoto ya B767-300ER ilipitishwa kwa zamu nne tofauti kabla ya kukamilika, na kumbukumbu ya logbook iliyosema filters za case drain na pressure ziliondolewa na housing kufungwa kwa ulegevu haikuwahi kusemwa kwa mdomo kati ya mafundi. Fundi aliyekuja baadaye alimaliza kukaza hoses na housing kisha akaenda moja kwa moja kufanya engine run bila kuangalia logbook, na hivyo kukosa ukaguzi wa lazima wa uchafu kwenye filter. Baadaye ilipofunguliwa housing ilibainika kuwa hazikuwa na filters kabisa. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha kwa mdomo vipengele vyote wazi vya logbook kwenye kazi zinazopitishwa zamu nyingi, hasa hali ya filters za hydraulic, kabla ya kufanya engine run yoyote.
summary: Kazi ya pump ya hydraulic ya B767 iliyopitishwa zamu nne ilisababisha engine run kufanywa bila filters kuwekwa kwa sababu kumbukumbu ya logbook haikusemwa kwa mdomo.

narrative_text: Ile job ya left engine hydraulic pump ya B767-300ER ilipita zamu nne tofauti kabla ya kukamilika, na logbook entry iliyosema pressure filters ziliondolewa na housing kufungwa loosely haikurudiwa verbally kwa yeyote. Fundi aliyekuja alimaliza kukaza hoses na filter housing kisha akaenda cockpit straight kufanya engine run bila hata kuangalia logbook, akaskip ile filter contamination check ilivyotakiwa. Baadaye tuligundua housing haina filters kabisa - hakuna aliyekuwa amesema chochote. Zamu inayofuata lazima ihakikishe logbook items zote za multi-shift job zinapitiwa verbally, hasa status ya hydraulic filters, kabla ya ku-attempt engine run yoyote.
summary: Job ya B767 hydraulic pump iliyopita zamu nne iliishia na engine run kufanyika bila filters kuwekwa kwa sababu logbook note haikurudiwa verbally.

narrative_text: Aircraft X came in with a potable water system inop write-up; troubleshooting started on first shift and continued into second shift, with parts changed and panels removed. No written turnover or Form 10194 was left for third shift, only a verbal handover, so we had no clear picture of what work was actually completed. Supervisor was notified immediately, and during the RON check we found multiple cargo panels still open confirming undocumented work had been done. Leads and crew chiefs must ensure all turnover is logged per company policy before shift change.
summary: Undocumented multi-shift troubleshooting on Aircraft X's potable water system left the incoming crew without a proper turnover, exposing a procedural gap in shift handover documentation.

narrative_text: Ndege Aircraft X ilikuwa na hitilafu ya mfumo wa maji safi (potable water) ambayo ilianza kufanyiwa kazi shift ya kwanza na kuendelea shift ya pili, huku baadhi ya vipuri vikibadilishwa na paneli kadhaa kutolewa. Cha kusikitisha, hakuna turnover iliyoandikwa wala Form 10194 iliyowekwa kwa shift ya tatu, ni maelezo ya mdomo tu yaliyotolewa, hivyo hatukuwa na uhakika wa kazi iliyofanyika. Supervisor alijulishwa mara moja, na wakati wa ukaguzi wa RON tulikuta paneli nyingi za mizigo bado wazi, ikithibitisha kazi ilifanyika bila kuandikwa. Ni muhimu viongozi wa shift na crew chiefs wahakikishe kila turnover inaandikwa kama sera ya kampuni inavyotaka.
summary: Kazi ya kutafuta hitilafu ya mfumo wa maji safi kwenye Aircraft X ilifanyika kwa shift mbili bila kuandikwa vizuri, na hivyo kusababisha mkanganyiko wakati wa mabadiliko ya shift.

narrative_text: Aircraft X ilikuwa na write-up ya potable water system inop, troubleshooting ilistart shift ya kwanza na ika-continue mpaka second shift, parts zikabadilishwa na panels zingine zikatolewa. Lakini turnover ya written haikuwepo, hata Form 10194 haikuwekwa kwa third shift, tulipewa verbal turnover tu, so hatukuwa na clear picture ya kazi iliyofanyika. Nikamjulisha supervisor immediately, na tukienda kwa RON check tukakuta cargo panels kadhaa zikiwa bado open, ikiconfirm kwamba kazi ilikuwa inafanyika without proper documentation. Leads na crew chiefs wanahitaji kuensure turnover zote zinadocumented as per company policy kabla ya shift change.
summary: Kuna troubleshooting ya potable water system kwenye Aircraft X iliyofanyika kwa shifts mbili bila proper documentation, causing confusion wakati wa handover.

narrative_text: DC-9 50 standby horizon indicator was replaced after a red-flag fault and passed all functional checks per the manual, but voltage at the indicator measured 60 VAC instead of the 120 VAC specified on the wiring diagram. The same 60 VAC reading was confirmed on a second aircraft, and after consulting other technicians it was accepted as normal, likely a drawing misprint. Next shift should follow up with Engineering to get an official authorization issued to correct the wiring diagram, even though the unit is functioning correctly.
summary: Standby horizon on a DC-9 50 checks out functionally, but a voltage discrepancy against the wiring diagram needs formal Engineering correction.

narrative_text: Kiashiria cha standby horizon cha ndege ya DC-9 50 kilibadilishwa baada ya kuonyesha hitilafu (red flag), na kikapita vipimo vyote kwa mujibu wa mwongozo, lakini voltage iliyopimwa kwenye kiashiria ilikuwa 60 VAC badala ya 120 VAC kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye mchoro wa nyaya. Usomaji huohuo wa 60 VAC ulithibitishwa kwenye ndege nyingine, na baada ya kushauriana na mafundi wenzangu, tulikubaliana kuwa hilo ni la kawaida na huenda mchoro una kosa la uchapishaji. Zamu inayofuata ifuatilie suala hili na idara ya Uhandisi ili kupata idhini rasmi ya kurekebisha mchoro wa nyaya, ingawa kifaa kinafanya kazi vizuri.
summary: Kiashiria cha standby horizon cha DC-9 50 kinafanya kazi vizuri, lakini tofauti ya voltage dhidi ya mchoro wa nyaya inahitaji kufuatiliwa na Uhandisi.

narrative_text: Kwa hii DC-9 50, ile standby horizon indicator ilikuwa na red flag, tukaibadilisha na iki-pass functional checks zote kama manual inavyosema. Lakini tukigundua voltage reading kwa indicator ni 60 VAC badala ya 120 VAC kama wiring diagram inavyoonyesha. Tulicheki na aircraft ingine, same reading, so after kuconsult na wenzetu tukaona 60 VAC ndio normal na diagram ndio ina typo. Next shift wafuatilie na Engineering wapate authorization ya kurekebisha ile drawing, hata kama unit inafanya kazi poa.
summary: Standby horizon indicator ya DC-9 50 ime-pass checks lakini kuna voltage discrepancy na wiring diagram inahitaji kufuatiliwa na Engineering.

narrative_text: During takeoff roll the DC-9 30 crew could not keep the nosewheel tracking on the runway at 80 kts and the takeoff was aborted; aircraft returned to gate. Investigation traced the cause to the recent L-Check where both elevator power control actuating cylinders and universal joints were replaced, and the elevator rod ends on both left and right sides were reinstalled without proper torque and safetying. Please ensure all mechanics involved in the reassembly are re-briefed on rod end torque/safety procedures and confirm sign-off documentation is reviewed before next flight release.
summary: A DC-9 30 aborted takeoff due to nosewheel control issues traced to improperly torqued and unsafetied elevator rod ends from a recent L-Check, requiring documentation review and crew re-briefing.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kukimbia kabla ya kuruka, ndege ya DC-9 30 ilishindwa kudhibiti gurudumu la mbele kwenye njia ya kurukia ikiwa na spidi ya 80 kts, hivyo marubani walisimamisha safari na ndege kurudishwa geti. Uchunguzi ulibaini kuwa tatizo lilitokana na kazi ya L-Check iliyofanyika hivi karibuni, ambapo mabomba ya kudhibiti elevator na viungo vyake vilibadilishwa, lakini sehemu za mwisho za fimbo za elevator upande wa kushoto na kulia hazikufungwa vizuri kwa torque wala kuwekewa usalama unaostahili. Tafadhali hakikisha mafundi wote waliohusika wanapewa mafunzo tena kuhusu taratibu za torque na usalama, na nyaraka za kazi zikaguliwe kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ndege ya DC-9 30 ilisimamisha safari kwa sababu ya tatizo la gurudumu la mbele lililotokana na sehemu za elevator zisizofungwa vizuri baada ya L-Check, hivyo kunahitajika ukaguzi wa nyaraka na mafunzo tena kwa mafundi.

entities.text: sehemu za mwisho za fimbo za elevator

narrative_text: During takeoff roll, hii DC-9 30 crew walishindwa ku-control nosewheel kwenye runway at 80 kts, so wakaabort takeoff na ndege ikarudi gate. Investigation ikaonyesha kwamba tatizo lilitoka kwa L-Check ya hivi karibuni, where elevator power control actuating cylinders na universal joints zilibadilishwa, lakini elevator rod ends za left na right hazikuwa torqued wala safetied properly wakati wa reassembly. Tafadhali hakikisha mechanics wote walio-involve wanapewa re-briefing kuhusu torque na safety procedures, na documentation i-review kabla ya next flight release.
summary: DC-9 30 iliabort takeoff kwa sababu ya nosewheel control issue iliyosababishwa na elevator rod ends ambazo hazikuwa torqued/safetied vizuri baada ya L-Check, hivyo inahitajika review ya documentation na re-briefing ya mechanics.

narrative_text: Stores personnel processed a hazmat shipment pick in Software B and booked the AWB in Software A, but did not realize the AWB number had to be entered back into Software B to close out the shipment, leaving it incomplete. Root cause appears to be inexperience with hazmat shipping procedures across the two systems. Recommend reinstating two-person sign-off on all hazmat shipments and scheduling refresher training on ground/air hazmat shipping for all shipping staff before next shift.
summary: A hazmat shipment was left incomplete after staff failed to close it out in Software B, prompting calls for two-person sign-off and refresher training.

narrative_text: Mfanyakazi wa stoo alichukua agizo la kusafirisha bidhaa hatari (hazmat) kwenye mfumo B na kukamilisha uandikishaji wa AWB kwenye mfumo A, lakini hakutambua kuwa nambari ya AWB ilipaswa kurudishwa mfumo B ili kufunga shehena hiyo kikamilifu. Chanzo cha tatizo ni ukosefu wa uzoefu katika taratibu za usafirishaji wa bidhaa hatari kati ya mifumo hiyo miwili. Inashauriwa kurejesha utaratibu wa uthibitisho wa watu wawili kwa usafirishaji wote wa hazmat, na kupanga mafunzo ya ziada kuhusu usafirishaji wa nchi kavu na anga kabla ya zamu ijayo.
summary: Shehena ya bidhaa hatari haikufungwa vizuri kwa sababu ya kutojua taratibu za mfumo, hivyo kuhitajika mafunzo na uthibitisho wa watu wawili.

narrative_text: Msee wa stores alichukua pick ya hazmat kwenye Software B, akaenda akabook AWB kwenye Software A, lakini hakujua ati anafaa ku-input hiyo AWB number back kwenye Software B ndio i-close out properly. Kwa hivyo shipment ilibaki incomplete, na cause ni lack of experience na hazmat shipping procedures. Tunapendekeza turudishe two-person sign-off kwa hazmat shipments zote, plus refresher training ya ground and air shipping kwa wale wanahusika kabla ya next shift.
summary: Hazmat shipment ilibaki incomplete baada ya AWB kutokuwa closed out properly kwenye Software B, hivyo kuna haja ya sign-off ya watu wawili na training.

narrative_text: During the HC1 Heavy Check on Aircraft X (B737-700), two cracks were found on the L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin and repair was started per SRM Repair 11, which calls for a 2024-T3 doubler at .090in thickness. Night shift verified the material tag as 2024-T3 .090in and signed off the fab steps before handing over to dayshift, but the actual tag showed 2023-T3 and a dayshift mechanic raised concern about correctness of the material, which was not resolved before continuing installation. All solid fasteners are installed; the job is on hold pending Engineering Authorization for the two blind fasteners. Next shift must confirm actual doubler material/thickness against SRM Table 201/202 before any further installation or E/A approval.
summary: A B737-700 heavy-check stabilizer repair proceeded with an unverified/possibly incorrect doubler material due to a communication breakdown between night and day shift, requiring material confirmation before completing fastener installation.

entities.text: L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa HC1 Heavy Check kwenye Aircraft X (B737-700), nyufa mbili zilipatikana kwenye L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin na kazi ya ukarabati ilianzishwa kwa kufuata SRM Repair 11, ambayo inahitaji doubler ya 2024-T3 na unene wa .090in. Shift ya usiku ilithibitisha lebo ya chuma kuwa 2024-T3 .090in na kusaini hatua za utengenezaji kabla ya kukabidhi kazi kwa shift ya mchana, lakini lebo halisi ilionyesha 2023-T3, na fundi wa shift ya mchana aliuliza kama chuma ni sahihi, jambo ambalo halikutatuliwa kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji. Fasteners zote za solid zimefungwa; kazi imesimama ikisubiri idhini ya Engineering Authorization kwa fasteners mbili za blind. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha aina na unene halisi wa doubler kulingana na SRM Table 201/202 kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji au kupata idhini ya E/A.
summary: Ukarabati wa stabilizer kwenye B737-700 uliendelea huku aina ya chuma cha doubler ikiwa haijathibitishwa vizuri kutokana na mawasiliano mabovu kati ya shift za usiku na mchana, hivyo inahitajika uthibitisho kabla ya kukamilisha ufungaji wa fasteners.

entities.text: L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin

narrative_text: Kwa hii HC1 Heavy Check ya Aircraft X (B737-700), tulipata cracks mbili kwenye L/H Horizontal Stabilizer lower inspar skin, so repair ikaanzishwa kwa SRM Repair 11 ambayo inataka doubler ya 2024-T3, .090in thick. Night shift walicheck material tag ikaonekana 2024-T3 .090in, wakasign off fab steps kabla ya kuhandover kwa dayshift, lakini turns out tag halisi ilikuwa 2023-T3, na dayshift mechanic aliuliza kama material ni sahihi but hakuna aliyefollow up properly kabla kazi ikiendelea. All solid fasteners zimeinstall, tunasubiri Engineering Authorization ya zile blind fasteners mbili. Next shift wacheck vizuri material na thickness ya doubler against SRM Table 201/202 kabla ya kuproceed na installation au E/A approval.
summary: Repair ya stabilizer kwenye B737-700 iliendelea na doubler material ambayo haikuconfirm properly juu ya communication breakdown kati ya night na day shift, so inahitajika verification kabla ya kukamilisha fastener installation.

narrative_text: Corrosion was found on the intercostal at the aft end of the BS 986.50 floor beam on the B737-400, visible from the ground through the open outflow valve; the area also had a roughly trimmed rework cutout for a Hi-Lok, and photos were taken before shift turnover. At morning handover, graveyard advised dayshift that the aircraft would be ferried out for the floor beam repair, but the write-up was instead closed out on dayshift with only surface corrosion removed by a graveyard mechanic who stayed late. Next shift please confirm whether Airframe Shop ever evaluated this discrepancy, as there is no documentation of their review before paint and final sign-off.
summary: Handover flags that a suspected structural corrosion finding on a B737-400 floor beam was signed off without Airframe Shop evaluation, needing follow-up verification.

entities.text: intercostal at the aft end of the BS 986.50 floor beam

narrative_text: Kutu ilipatikana kwenye intercostal ya sehemu ya nyuma ya floor beam ya BS 986.50 kwenye ndege ya B737-400, ikionekana kutoka chini kupitia outflow valve iliyokuwa wazi; eneo hilo pia lilikuwa na sehemu iliyokatwa kwa uzembe kwa ajili ya Hi-Lok, na picha zilipigwa kabla ya kubadilisha zamu. Wakati wa mkutano wa asubuhi, zamu ya usiku ilieleza zamu ya mchana kuwa ndege ingepelekwa mahali pengine kwa matengenezo makubwa ya floor beam, lakini badala yake hitilafu ilifungwa na zamu ya mchana huku fundi wa zamu ya usiku aliyebaki akiondoa tu kutu ya juu juu. Zamu inayokuja ihakikishe kama Airframe Shop walishirikishwa kutathmini tatizo hili, kwani hakuna nyaraka zinazothibitisha ukaguzi wao kabla ya kupaka rangi na kusaini kazi kukamilika.
summary: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya zamu inaonyesha kuwa hitilafu ya kutu inayoshukiwa kuwa ya kimuundo kwenye floor beam ya B737-400 ilisainiwa kukamilika bila tathmini ya Airframe Shop, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Kuna corrosion iliokutwa kwa intercostal, aft end ya BS 986.50 floor beam kwa B737-400, ilikuwa inaonekana ukistand chini na kuangalia through open outflow valve; area hiyo pia ilikuwa na rework cutout iliyokatwa roughly kwa Hi-Lok kupita, na inspection walipiga photos kabla ya turnover. Kwa morning meeting, graveyard shift walieleza dayshift kuwa aircraft itaferried mahali pengine kwa floor beam repair kwa sababu job ni extensive, lakini mwisho write-up ilisign off na dayshift, huku graveyard mechanic aliyestay over aki-remove tu surface corrosion. Next shift wacheki kama Airframe Shop kweli walievaluate discrepancy hii, kwa sababu hakuna documentation ya review yao before painting na final sign-off.
summary: Handover inaflag kwamba corrosion finding kwenye B737-400 floor beam ilisign off bila Airframe Shop kuevaluate, hivyo inahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: During RII inspection of the CRJ700 left-hand wing 1-3 Slat Track rub blocks, inspector found reinstalled worn rub blocks that had been hand-ground and polished to a new profile with no approved data. Mechanic and Maintenance Lead could not produce documentation, and both Maintenance Supervisor and Line QC Lead dismissed concerns raised about non-compliance with Engineering's requirement to return worn parts for evaluation. These are flight-control load-bearing surfaces, so next shift must obtain approved engineering disposition before any further work is signed off.
summary: Inspector flagged undocumented re-profiling of slat track rub blocks on a CRJ700 and was rebuffed by supervision when requesting approved data.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa RII kwenye bawa la kushoto la ndege CRJ700, sehemu ya 1-3 ya Slat Track, mkaguzi aligundua rub blocks za zamani zilizorudishwa lakini zikiwa zimechongwa kwa mkono na kung'arishwa kuwa umbo jipya bila nyaraka zozote za idhini. Fundi na Kiongozi wa Matengenezo hawakuweza kutoa uthibitisho wa maandishi, na Msimamizi wa Matengenezo pamoja na Kiongozi wa Udhibiti wa Ubora walikataa malalamiko kuhusu kutofuata agizo la Uhandisi la kurejesha vipande vilivyochakaa kwa tathmini. Kwa kuwa hivi ni vipengele muhimu vinavyobeba mzigo wa udhibiti wa ndege, zamu ijayo inapaswa kupata kibali rasmi cha kihandisi kabla ya kazi yoyote zaidi kuidhinishwa.
summary: Mkaguzi aligundua urekebishaji usio na nyaraka wa rub blocks za slat track kwenye CRJ700 na akakataliwa na wasimamizi alipoomba idhini rasmi.

narrative_text: Wakati wa RII inspection kwenye left wing ya CRJ700, sehemu ya 1-3 Slat Track, niliona zile rub blocks ni za zamani, zimereinstall lakini zimefilewa na kupolishwa kuwa profile mpya bila approved data yoyote. Nikamuuliza Mechanic na Maintenance Lead wanipe documentation, wakakataa, hata Maintenance Supervisor na Line QC Lead walipokuja walidismiss concerns zangu kuhusu Engineering's requirement ya kurudisha worn parts kwa evaluation. Hizi ni flight control load bearing surfaces, kwa hivyo next shift inafaa ipate engineering disposition approved kabla ya kusign off kazi yoyote zaidi.
summary: Inspector aliflag undocumented modification ya slat track rub blocks kwenye CRJ700 na akarefusiwa na supervision alipoomba approved data.
